### NUTrade1.Core/BidEligibility.cs

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Whether a student may bid on a listing, and if not, the reason in words they can act on.
 5  ///
 6  /// This is the client's copy of the checks `requestBid` makes before it mints a deposit QR.
 7  /// The server is the authority — a seller who got past this would still be refused there,
 8  /// and again in `commitDeposit` — but asking here first means nobody is ever shown a bid
 9  /// form, or a deposit screen, for a bid that was never going to be accepted.
10  /// </summary>
11  public static class BidEligibility
12  {
13      public const string OwnListing = "You can't bid on your own listing.";
14      public const string SignedOut = "Sign in to place a bid.";
15      public const string Unverified = "Confirm your email before bidding.";
16      public const string NotAcceptingBids = "This auction isn't accepting bids.";
17      public const string Ended = "This auction has already ended.";
18  
19      /// <summary>
20      /// Null when <paramref name="uid"/> may bid on <paramref name="listing"/> right now;
21      /// otherwise the reason they may not. Ownership is checked first, because it is the
22      /// one refusal no amount of waiting or verifying will ever change.
23      /// </summary>
24      public static string? WhyNot(Listing? listing, string? uid, bool isVerified, DateTimeOffset now)
25      {
26          if (listing is null) return NotAcceptingBids;
27          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(uid)) return SignedOut;
28          if (IsSeller(listing, uid)) return OwnListing;
29          if (!isVerified) return Unverified;
30          if (listing.Status != ListingStatus.Active) return NotAcceptingBids;
31          if (listing.AuctionEndsAt is { } ends && ends <= now) return Ended;
32          return null;
33      }
34  
35      /// <summary>True when <paramref name="uid"/> posted <paramref name="listing"/>.</summary>
36      public static bool IsSeller(Listing? listing, string? uid) =>
37          listing is not null
38          && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(uid)
39          && string.Equals(listing.OwnerUid, uid, StringComparison.Ordinal);
40  }
```

### NUTrade1.Core/Money.cs

```csharp
 1  using System.Globalization;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// Helpers for money handled as whole centavos. NUTrade never stores fractional pesos
 7  /// as floating point; a value of <c>1000</c> means ₱10.00.
 8  /// </summary>
 9  public static class Money
10  {
11      public const long CentavosPerPeso = 100;
12  
13      public static long FromPesos(decimal pesos) => (long)Math.Round(pesos * CentavosPerPeso, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
14  
15      public static decimal ToPesos(long centavos) => centavos / (decimal)CentavosPerPeso;
16  
17      /// <summary>Formats centavos as e.g. "₱10.00".</summary>
18      public static string ToDisplay(long centavos) =>
19          "₱" + ToPesos(centavos).ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
20  }
```

### NUTrade1.Core/NUTradeConstants.cs

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Cross-cutting constants for the NUTrade domain. Values that the client and the
 5  /// Cloud Functions must agree on live here so there is a single source of truth.
 6  /// </summary>
 7  public static class NUTradeConstants
 8  {
 9      /// <summary>Posting fee for every listing after a student's free first one, in centavos (₱10.00).</summary>
10      public const long AdditionalFeeCentavos = 1_000;
11  
12      /// <summary>Featured Priority Pin upgrade fee, in centavos (₱20.00).</summary>
13      public const long PriorityFeeCentavos = 2_000;
14  
15      /// <summary>PayMongo QR Ph codes expire roughly this many minutes after creation.</summary>
16      public const int QrExpiryMinutes = 10;
17  
18      /// <summary>A listing stuck in <c>pending_payment</c> longer than this is expired by a scheduled Function.</summary>
19      public const int PendingListingExpiryHours = 24;
20  
21      /// <summary>
22      /// The commitment deposit held to place a bid, as a percentage of it. Mirrors
23      /// BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT in functions/src/constants.ts — the server is the authority,
24      /// this is only for telling the student before they tap.
25      /// </summary>
26      public const int BidDepositPercent = 15;
27  
28      /// <summary>Minimum / maximum photos per listing ("Add up to 4 photos"). Mirrored by MAX_LISTING_PHOTOS.</summary>
29      public const int MinListingPhotos = 1;
30      public const int MaxListingPhotos = 4;
31  
32      /// <summary>
33      /// Every auction runs this long. There is no duration picker — sellers choose a
34      /// package, not a length. Mirrored by AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS in functions/src/constants.ts.
35      /// </summary>
36      public const int AuctionDurationHours = 24;
37  
38      /// <summary>How long a winning bidder has to pay before the bid is released.</summary>
39      public const int OrderPaymentWindowHours = 24;
40  
41      /// <summary>
42      /// The programs a student picks from at registration, stored as-is in
43      /// <c>users/{uid}.program</c>. Mirrored by PROGRAMS in functions/src/constants.ts,
44      /// which is what completeSignup accepts, and by programs() in firestore.rules, which
45      /// is what a student may set on their own profile.
46      /// </summary>
47      public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Programs = ["SACE", "SAHS", "SABM", "SHS"];
48  
49      /// <summary>
50      /// Whether a listing in <paramref name="status"/> has used its owner's one free post.
51      /// The Free package is a student's first listing, once ever: anything submitted and
52      /// not turned down counts — waiting for approval, live, or finished in any way. A
53      /// rejected listing gives the free post back so a refused first attempt can be fixed
54      /// and resubmitted for free; drafts and unpaid listings never count.
55      /// Mirrored by FREE_POST_USED_STATUSES in functions/src/constants.ts, which is what
56      /// createQrPayment enforces — the app only uses this to hide the option.
57      /// </summary>
58      public static bool UsesFreePost(ListingStatus status) => status is
59          ListingStatus.PendingApproval or
60          ListingStatus.Active or
61          ListingStatus.Matched or
62          ListingStatus.Completed or
63          ListingStatus.Expired;
64  
65      public static long FeeForPackage(ListingPackage package) => package switch
66      {
67          ListingPackage.Free => 0,
68          ListingPackage.Additional => AdditionalFeeCentavos,
69          ListingPackage.Priority => PriorityFeeCentavos,
70          _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(package), package, "Unknown listing package"),
71      };
72  
73      /// <summary>
74      /// Cheap shape check before a sign-up request is sent. Students register with any
75      /// personal email — there is no campus-domain restriction — so the only thing worth
76      /// catching client-side is an obvious typo. Ownership of the address is established
77      /// by the emailed one-time code, and being an actual NU student by ID review.
78      /// </summary>
79      public static bool IsValidEmail(string? email)
80      {
81          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email)) return false;
82  
83          var trimmed = email.Trim();
84          var at = trimmed.IndexOf('@');
85          if (at <= 0 || at != trimmed.LastIndexOf('@')) return false;
86  
87          var domain = trimmed[(at + 1)..];
88          return domain.Length >= 3
89              && domain.Contains('.')
90              && !domain.StartsWith('.')
91              && !domain.EndsWith('.')
92              && !trimmed.Contains(' ');
93      }
94  }
```

### NUTrade1.Core/QrImageData.cs

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Turns the QR image PayMongo hands back into PNG bytes the app can draw and save.
 5  ///
 6  /// PayMongo's QR Ph `code.image_url` is not a hosted file: it is a `data:image/png;base64,…`
 7  /// URI. MAUI reads a string image source as a web address or a file name, so passing that
 8  /// string straight to an Image shows nothing. Decoding it here gives the screen something
 9  /// it can render, and the same bytes are what "Save QR" writes to the gallery.
10  /// </summary>
11  public static class QrImageData
12  {
13      private static readonly byte[] PngSignature = [0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A];
14      private static readonly byte[] JpegSignature = [0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF];
15  
16      /// <summary>
17      /// The decoded image when either field carries one inline — a data URI in
18      /// <paramref name="imageUrl"/>, or bare base64 in <paramref name="imageBase64"/>.
19      /// Null when there is nothing inline, including when <paramref name="imageUrl"/> is a
20      /// real web address; see <see cref="RemoteUri"/> for that case.
21      /// </summary>
22      public static byte[]? TryDecode(string? imageUrl, string? imageBase64)
23      {
24          if (TryDecodeDataUri(imageUrl) is { } fromUri) return fromUri;
25          return TryDecodeBase64(imageBase64);
26      }
27  
28      /// <summary>The image's web address, when PayMongo sent a hosted image instead of an inline one.</summary>
29      public static Uri? RemoteUri(string? imageUrl) =>
30          Uri.TryCreate(imageUrl?.Trim(), UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
31          && (uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp)
32              ? uri
33              : null;
34  
35      private static byte[]? TryDecodeDataUri(string? value)
36      {
37          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return null;
38          var text = value.Trim();
39          if (!text.StartsWith("data:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return null;
40  
41          var comma = text.IndexOf(',');
42          if (comma < 0) return null;
43  
44          // Only base64 payloads: a QR is binary, and a percent-encoded PNG is not a thing
45          // anyone sends.
46          var header = text[..comma];
47          if (!header.EndsWith(";base64", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return null;
48  
49          return TryDecodeBase64(text[(comma + 1)..]);
50      }
51  
52      private static byte[]? TryDecodeBase64(string? value)
53      {
54          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return null;
55          try
56          {
57              var bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(value.Trim());
58              return IsImage(bytes) ? bytes : null;
59          }
60          catch (FormatException)
61          {
62              return null;
63          }
64      }
65  
66      /// <summary>
67      /// A cheap sanity check on the first few bytes, so a truncated or mislabelled payload
68      /// is reported as "no QR" instead of saved to someone's gallery as a broken picture.
69      /// </summary>
70      private static bool IsImage(byte[] bytes) =>
71          bytes.AsSpan().StartsWith(PngSignature) || bytes.AsSpan().StartsWith(JpegSignature);
72  }
```

### NUTrade1.Core/Abstractions/IAuthService.cs

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Firebase Authentication session lifecycle. Students register with any personal
 5  /// email and a password — there is no campus-domain restriction. Two independent
 6  /// gates follow: a one-time code emailed to that address proves they own it, and
 7  /// <see cref="IsVerified"/> reflects the <c>verified</c> custom claim, which is what
 8  /// actually unlocks posting and bidding.
 9  /// </summary>
10  public interface IAuthService
11  {
12      /// <summary>The signed-in user's UID, or null when signed out.</summary>
13      string? CurrentUid { get; }
14  
15      /// <summary>The signed-in user's email, or null when signed out.</summary>
16      string? CurrentEmail { get; }
17  
18      bool IsSignedIn { get; }
19  
20      /// <summary>
21      /// True once the <c>verified</c> custom claim is present on the ID token. Until then
22      /// Firestore rules and the Cloud Functions reject listing creation and bidding.
23      /// </summary>
24      bool IsVerified { get; }
25  
26      /// <summary>
27      /// True when the ID token carries <c>role: admin</c>. Only decides whether the app
28      /// shows admin screens — every admin action is re-checked by its Cloud Function.
29      /// </summary>
30      bool IsAdmin { get; }
31  
32      /// <summary>Raised after a sign-in or sign-out so the Shell can re-evaluate the auth gate.</summary>
33      event EventHandler? AuthStateChanged;
34  
35      /// <summary>Restores a persisted session on app start. Safe to call when already signed in.</summary>
36      Task RestoreSessionAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
37  
38      /// <summary>Signs in an existing account.</summary>
39      Task<OperationResult> SignInWithEmailAsync(string email, string password, CancellationToken ct = default);
40  
41      /// <summary>
42      /// Whether this build can offer "Continue with Google". False when no Google OAuth
43      /// client is configured for the running platform, so the button can be hidden rather
44      /// than failing when tapped.
45      /// </summary>
46      bool IsGoogleSignInAvailable { get; }
47  
48      /// <summary>
49      /// Signs in with a Google account, creating the NUTrade account on first use.
50      /// Google having verified the address does not skip the NUTrade code — the
51      /// <c>verified</c> claim is still granted only by <see cref="IEmailVerificationService"/>.
52      /// </summary>
53      Task<OperationResult> SignInWithGoogleAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
54  
55      /// <summary>Creates a new account for any valid email address.</summary>
56      Task<OperationResult> SignUpWithEmailAsync(string email, string password, CancellationToken ct = default);
57  
58      /// <summary>
59      /// Re-reads the ID token so a claim granted since sign-in — typically <c>verified</c>,
60      /// after an admin approves the account — takes effect without making the student sign
61      /// out and back in.
62      /// </summary>
63      /// <param name="force">
64      /// Skips the short freshness window and always goes to the network. Screens that poll
65      /// this on every appearance leave it false; a caller that has just changed the claims
66      /// server-side and needs the new value immediately passes true.
67      /// </param>
68      Task RefreshClaimsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default, bool force = false);
69  
70      Task SignOutAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
71  }
```

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Bidding, as it actually works: a bid is not placed until a commitment deposit behind it
 5  /// has been paid.
 6  ///
 7  /// <see cref="RequestBidAsync"/> validates the amount and hands back a QR code. Nothing
 8  /// appears on the listing until <see cref="CheckDepositAsync"/> confirms the money landed
 9  /// — and that polling is not belt-and-braces, it is the mechanism: PayMongo's webhook has
10  /// never arrived in this project, so the app asking is what places the bid.
11  ///
12  /// The deposit is refundable. Being outbid, losing, having the bid declined, withdrawing,
13  /// or the seller cancelling all return it as in-app credit. Only winning and then failing
14  /// to turn up loses it.
15  /// </summary>
16  public interface IDepositService
17  {
18      /// <summary>

20      /// first. Fails when the amount is under the listing's current minimum.

23          string listingId, long amountCentavos, CancellationToken ct = default);

27      /// The payment screen calls this on a timer while the QR is on screen.
28      /// </summary>
```

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
```

```csharp
 3  /// <summary>A lightweight success/failure wrapper so services can report errors without throwing across layers.</summary>
 4  public readonly record struct OperationResult(bool Succeeded, string? Error = null)
 5  {
 6      public static OperationResult Ok() => new(true);
 7      public static OperationResult Fail(string error) => new(false, error);
 8  }
 9  
10  /// <summary>An <see cref="OperationResult"/> that also carries a value on success.</summary>
11  public readonly record struct OperationResult<T>(bool Succeeded, T? Value = default, string? Error = null)
12  {
13      public static OperationResult<T> Ok(T value) => new(true, value);
14      public static OperationResult<T> Fail(string error) => new(false, default, error);
15  }
```

```csharp
10  {
```

```csharp
12      PendingPayment,
13      Active,
14      Matched,
15      Completed,
16      Expired,
17      Cancelled,
18

20      PendingApproval,
21  
22      /// <summary>An admin turned it down. Terminal; see <see cref="Listing.RejectionReason"/>.</summary>
23      Rejected,
24  }
```

### NUTrade1.Core/Models/BidDeposit.cs

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
  2  
  3  /// <summary>
  4  /// Where a commitment deposit is in its life. Mirrors DEPOSIT_STATUS in
  5  /// functions/src/constants.ts.
  6  /// </summary>
  7  public enum DepositStatus
  8  {
  9      Unknown = 0,
 10  
 11      /// <summary>QR issued, waiting for the money to land. The bid does not exist yet.</summary>
 12      AwaitingPayment,
 13  
 14      /// <summary>Paid and held against a live bid.</summary>
 15      LockedInEscrow,
 16  
 17      /// <summary>The handover was confirmed; the deposit went to the seller.</summary>
 18      CreditedToSeller,
 19  
 20      /// <summary>Returned to the bidder — outbid, lost, declined, withdrawn or cancelled.</summary>
 21      RefundedToBuyer,
 22  
 23      /// <summary>The winning bidder never turned up. The only way to lose a deposit.</summary>
 24      Forfeited,
 25  
 26      /// <summary>The QR lapsed unpaid, so the bid it was for never went live.</summary>
 27      Expired,
 28  }
 29  
 30  /// <summary>
 31  /// A bid and the deposit standing behind it.
 32  ///
 33  /// A bid does not exist until its deposit is paid: <c>requestBid</c> hands back one of
 34  /// these with a QR code, and only once PayMongo confirms the money does the bid appear on
 35  /// the listing. Keeping both amounts together is the point — a student needs to see that
 36  /// they are scanning for <see cref="DepositDisplay"/>, not for their whole bid.
 37  /// </summary>
 38  public sealed class BidDeposit
 39  {
 40      public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 41      public string ListingId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 42      public string ListingTitle { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 43  
 44      /// <summary>The bid this deposit is for.</summary>
 45      public long AmountCentavos { get; set; }
 46  
 47      /// <summary>What has to be scanned now — a percentage of the bid.</summary>
 48      public long DepositCentavos { get; set; }
 49  
 50      public int DepositPercent { get; set; }
 51  
 52      public DepositStatus Status { get; set; } = DepositStatus.Unknown;
 53  
 54      public string? QrImageUrl { get; set; }
 55      public string? QrImageBase64 { get; set; }
 56      public string? QrPayload { get; set; }
 57      public DateTimeOffset? QrExpiresAt { get; set; }
 58  
 59      /// <summary>Set once the deposit is paid and the bid has been written.</summary>
 60      public string? CommittedBidId { get; set; }
 61  
 62      /// <summary>Why it went back, when it did. See REFUND_REASON in the Functions.</summary>
 63      public string? RefundReason { get; set; }
 64  
 65      public DateTimeOffset? CreatedAt { get; set; }
 66      public DateTimeOffset? ResolvedAt { get; set; }
 67  
 68      public string AmountDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(AmountCentavos);
 69      public string DepositDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(DepositCentavos);
 70  
 71      /// <summary>True once the bid is actually live on the listing.</summary>
 72      public bool IsCommitted => Status == DepositStatus.LockedInEscrow;
 73  
 74      /// <summary>Still waiting on the student to scan.</summary>
 75      public bool IsAwaitingPayment => Status == DepositStatus.AwaitingPayment;
 76  
 77      /// <summary>Nothing more will happen to this deposit.</summary>
 78      public bool IsResolved => Status is DepositStatus.CreditedToSeller
 79          or DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer
 80          or DepositStatus.Forfeited
 81          or DepositStatus.Expired;
 82  
 83      public bool HasQrImage => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(QrImageUrl);
 84  
 85      public string StatusDisplay => Status switch
 86      {
 87          DepositStatus.AwaitingPayment => "Waiting for your deposit",
 88          DepositStatus.LockedInEscrow => "Deposit held — your bid is live",
 89          DepositStatus.CreditedToSeller => "Released to the seller",
 90          DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer => RefundDisplay,
 91          DepositStatus.Forfeited => "Deposit forfeited — you didn't show up",
 92          DepositStatus.Expired => "The code expired before it was paid",
 93          _ => "Unknown",
 94      };
 95  
 96      private string RefundDisplay => RefundReason switch
 97      {
 98          "outbid" => "Outbid — deposit returned",
 99          "auction_lost" => "Auction lost — deposit returned",
100          "seller_cancelled" => "Seller cancelled — deposit returned",
101          "withdrawn" => "Bid withdrawn — deposit returned",
102          "no_show_dismissed" => "Dispute resolved in your favour — deposit returned",
103          _ => "Deposit returned",
104      };
105  }
```

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Maps to <c>chats/{chatId}</c>. Created by a Cloud Function when an auction is won —
 5  /// never by the client, which is why the document is read-only in firestore.rules.
 6  /// </summary>
 7  public sealed class Chat
 8  {
 9      public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;
10  
11      public string ListingId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
12  
13      /// <summary>Denormalized so the chat list can name the item without reading the listing.</summary>
14      public string ListingTitle { get; set; } = string.Empty;
15  
16      /// <summary>Exactly the two trading parties' UIDs.</summary>
17      public IList<string> ParticipantUids { get; set; } = new List<string>();
18  
19      public string SellerUid { get; set; } = string.Empty;
20  
21      public string BuyerUid { get; set; } = string.Empty;
22  
23      /// <summary>The bid that won the auction, in centavos.</summary>
24      public long WinningBidCentavos { get; set; }
25  
26      /// <summary>
27      /// UIDs that have confirmed the handover. The trade only closes when both are
28      /// present — one tap must not be able to credit the other party with a completed
29      /// trade that never happened.
30      /// </summary>
31      public IList<string> CompletedBy { get; set; } = new List<string>();
32  
33      public string LastMessage { get; set; } = string.Empty;
34  
35      public DateTimeOffset? LastMessageAt { get; set; }
36  
37      public ChatStatus Status { get; set; } = ChatStatus.Active;
38  
39      /// <summary>True once both sides confirmed and a Function archived the room.</summary>
40      public bool IsClosed => Status == ChatStatus.Archived;
41  
42      public bool HasConfirmed(string? uid) =>
43          uid is not null && CompletedBy.Contains(uid);
44  
45      /// <summary>The other party's UID, from the perspective of <paramref name="uid"/>.</summary>
46      public string? PartnerUid(string? uid) =>
47          uid is null ? null : ParticipantUids.FirstOrDefault(p => p != uid);
48  }
```

### NUTrade1.Core/Models/Listing.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.ComponentModel;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>Maps to <c>listings/{listingId}</c> in Firestore.</summary>
  6  public sealed class Listing : INotifyPropertyChanged
  7  {
  8      public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;
  9  
 10      public string OwnerUid { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 11  
 12      public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 13  
 14      public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 15  
 16      public ItemCondition Condition { get; set; } = ItemCondition.Unknown;
 17  
 18      public ItemCategory Category { get; set; } = ItemCategory.Unknown;
 19  
 20      /// <summary>What the seller typed when <see cref="Category"/> is <c>Other</c>; empty otherwise.</summary>
 21      public string CategoryOther { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 22  
 23      /// <summary>
 24      /// The category to show a buyer: the seller's own words when they picked "Other", the
 25      /// humanized enum name otherwise. Listings written before "Other" required a value fall
 26      /// back to "Other".
 27      /// </summary>
 28      public string CategoryLabel => Category == ItemCategory.Other && CategoryOther.Length > 0
 29          ? CategoryOther
 30          : Humanize(Category);
 31  
 32      /// <summary>1–4 Storage paths for the item's photos.</summary>
 33      public IList<string> Photos { get; set; } = new List<string>();
 34  
 35      public CampusZone CampusZone { get; set; } = CampusZone.Unknown;
 36  
 37      /// <summary>What the seller typed when <see cref="CampusZone"/> is <c>Other</c>; empty otherwise.</summary>
 38      public string CampusZoneOther { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 39  
 40      /// <summary>The meetup location to show a buyer. Empty when the listing predates the fixed list.</summary>
 41      public string MeetupLabel => CampusZone switch
 42      {
 43          CampusZone.Unknown => string.Empty,
 44          CampusZone.Other => CampusZoneOther.Length > 0 ? CampusZoneOther : "Elsewhere on campus",
 45          CampusZone.Itso => "ITSO",
 46          CampusZone.Sdao => "SDAO",
 47          CampusZone.Avr => "AVR",
 48          CampusZone.AccountingAndRegistrarOffice => "Accounting and Registrar Office",
 49          var zone => Humanize(zone),
 50      };
 51  
 52      public ListingPackage Package { get; set; } = ListingPackage.Free;
 53  
 54      /// <summary>Set true by a Function when a <see cref="ListingPackage.Priority"/> fee is paid.</summary>
 55      public bool IsPinned { get; set; }
 56  
 57      public ListingStatus Status { get; set; } = ListingStatus.Draft;
 58  
 59      /// <summary>Opening bid, in centavos, before any bids are placed.</summary>
 60      public long StartingBidCentavos { get; set; }
 61  
 62      /// <summary>Minimum amount, in centavos, a new bid must exceed the current highest bid by.</summary>
 63      public long MinIncrementCentavos { get; set; }
 64  
 65      /// <summary>Optional reserve, in centavos; below this the seller isn't obligated to sell.</summary>
 66      public long? ReservePriceCentavos { get; set; }
 67  
 68      /// <summary>
 69      /// False while a regular listing waits for the next hourly refresh to join the
 70      /// feed. Priority listings are published visible straight away — that is what the
 71      /// fee buys. Set server-side at publish time; the client cannot write it.
 72      /// </summary>
 73      public bool IsVisible { get; set; }
 74  
 75      /// <summary>The hourly slot this listing joins the feed at.</summary>
 76      public DateTimeOffset? VisibleFrom { get; set; }
 77  
 78      /// <summary>Current highest bid, in centavos. Equal to <see cref="StartingBidCentavos"/> until the first bid.</summary>
 79      public long CurrentHighestBidCentavos { get; set; }
 80  
 81      /// <summary>UID of the current highest bidder, if any.</summary>
 82      public string? HighestBidderUid { get; set; }
 83  
 84      public int BidCount { get; set; }
 85  
 86      /// <summary>Set by a Function when the auction goes live; drives the countdown.</summary>
 87      public DateTimeOffset? AuctionEndsAt { get; set; }
 88  
 89      public string? WinningBidId { get; set; }
 90  
 91      /// <summary>The order the winning bid created, once the auction is matched.</summary>
 92      public string? OrderId { get; set; }
 93  
 94      public DateTimeOffset CreatedAt { get; set; }
 95  
 96      /// <summary>Set by <c>approveListing</c> when an admin puts the auction live.</summary>
 97      public DateTimeOffset? PublishedAt { get; set; }
 98  
 99      /// <summary>
100      /// The package whose fee actually cleared, stamped server-side when the listing
101      /// enters the admin queue. Approval honours this, not the draft's <see cref="Package"/>.
102      /// </summary>
103      public ListingPackage? PaidPackage { get; set; }
104  
105      /// <summary>When the fee cleared and the listing joined the admin queue.</summary>
106      public DateTimeOffset? SubmittedForApprovalAt { get; set; }
107  
108      /// <summary>The admin's note when <see cref="Status"/> is <see cref="ListingStatus.Rejected"/>.</summary>
109      public string? RejectionReason { get; set; }
110  
111      /// <summary>Minimum a new bid must reach right now to be valid.</summary>
112      public long MinNextBidCentavos =>
113          BidCount == 0 ? StartingBidCentavos : CurrentHighestBidCentavos + MinIncrementCentavos;
114  
115      /// <summary>Live "1h 23m" / "45s" text, refreshed by <see cref="TickCountdown"/>. Empty once ended.</summary>
116      public string CountdownText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
117  
118      public bool AuctionEnded { get; private set; }
119  
120      public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
121  
122      /// <summary>Recomputes <see cref="CountdownText"/>/<see cref="AuctionEnded"/> against <paramref name="now"/>.
123      /// Called every second by a page-owned dispatcher timer while the auction is live.</summary>
124      public void TickCountdown(DateTimeOffset now)
125      {
126          var (text, ended) = Format(AuctionEndsAt, now);
127          if (text == CountdownText && ended == AuctionEnded) return;
128  
129          CountdownText = text;
130          AuctionEnded = ended;
131          PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(CountdownText)));
132          PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(AuctionEnded)));
133      }
134  
135      /// <summary>`AcademicSupplies` -> `Academic Supplies`. Mirrors EnumDisplayConverter.Humanize,
136      /// which lives in the app project and so cannot be reached from here.</summary>
137      private static string Humanize<T>(T value) where T : struct, Enum
138      {
139          var name = value.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
140          var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(name.Length + 4);
141          for (int i = 0; i < name.Length; i++)
142          {
143              if (i > 0 && char.IsUpper(name[i]) && !char.IsUpper(name[i - 1])) sb.Append(' ');
144              sb.Append(name[i]);
145          }
146          return sb.ToString();
147      }
148  
149      private static (string Text, bool Ended) Format(DateTimeOffset? endsAt, DateTimeOffset now)
150      {
151          if (endsAt is not { } ends) return (string.Empty, false);
152  
153          var remaining = ends - now;
154          if (remaining <= TimeSpan.Zero) return ("Ended", true);
155  
156          return remaining.TotalHours >= 1
157              ? ($"{(int)remaining.TotalHours}h {remaining.Minutes}m", false)
158              : ($"{remaining.Minutes}m {remaining.Seconds}s", false);
159      }
160  }
```

```csharp
53      /// </summary>
```

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Core;
```

```csharp
  3  /// <summary>Why a <see cref="LedgerEntry"/> exists. Mirrors LEDGER_KIND in functions/src/wallet.ts.</summary>
  4  public enum LedgerKind
  5  {
  6      Unknown = 0,
  7  
  8      /// <summary>A buyer's commitment deposit credited after a confirmed handover.</summary>
  9      DepositCredit,
 10  
 11      /// <summary>A deposit forfeited by a no-show buyer.</summary>
 12      Forfeit,
 13  
 14      /// <summary>In-app credit — a seller cancelled, or a payout was declined.</summary>
 15      RefundCredit,
 16  
 17      /// <summary>Balance sent off-platform. Always negative.</summary>
 18      Payout,
 19  }
 20  
 21  public enum PayoutStatus
 22  {
 23      Unknown = 0,
 24      Requested,
 25      Paid,
 26      Declined,
 27  }
 28  
 29  public enum PayoutMethod
 30  {
 31      Unknown = 0,
 32      GCash,
 33      Maya,
 34  }
 35  
 36  /// <summary>
 37  /// A student's spendable balance. "Spendable" is exact: raising a payout request debits
 38  /// it straight away, so this is never money that is already promised to somebody.
 39  /// </summary>
 40  public sealed class Wallet
 41  {
 42      public string Uid { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 43      public long BalanceCentavos { get; set; }
 44      public DateTimeOffset? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
 45  
 46      public string BalanceDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(BalanceCentavos);
 47  }
 48  
 49  /// <summary>One line of the append-only record behind <see cref="Wallet.BalanceCentavos"/>.</summary>
 50  public sealed class LedgerEntry
 51  {
 52      public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 53      public string Uid { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 54      public LedgerKind Kind { get; set; } = LedgerKind.Unknown;
 55  
 56      /// <summary>Negative for anything leaving the wallet.</summary>
 57      public long AmountCentavos { get; set; }
 58  
 59      public string? ListingId { get; set; }
 60      public string? BidId { get; set; }
 61      public string? PayoutRequestId { get; set; }
 62      public string? Note { get; set; }
 63      public DateTimeOffset? CreatedAt { get; set; }
 64  
 65      public bool IsCredit => AmountCentavos >= 0;
 66  
 67      /// <summary>Signed, so a row reads as "+₱120.00" or "−₱500.00" without further work.</summary>
 68      public string AmountDisplay =>
 69          (IsCredit ? "+" : "−") + Money.ToDisplay(Math.Abs(AmountCentavos));
 70

 72      {
 73          LedgerKind.DepositCredit => "Deposit received",
 74          LedgerKind.Forfeit => "Deposit forfeited",
 75          LedgerKind.RefundCredit => "Credit added",
 76          LedgerKind.Payout => "Cashed out",
 77          _ => "Adjustment",
 78      };
 79  }

100          PayoutStatus.Requested => "Waiting on an admin",
101          PayoutStatus.Paid => "Sent",
102          PayoutStatus.Declined => "Declined",
103          _ => "Unknown",
104      };
105  }
```

### NUTrade1/AppShell.xaml.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Core;
  2  using NUTrade1.Services;
  3  using NUTrade1.Views;
  4  
  5  namespace NUTrade1;
  6  
  7  public partial class AppShell : Shell
  8  {
  9      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 10      private readonly IUserService _users;
 11      private readonly WinWatcher _wins;
 12      private bool _gateApplied;
 13  
 14      public AppShell(IAuthService auth, IUserService users, WinWatcher wins)
 15      {
 16          InitializeComponent();
 17  
 18          _auth = auth;
 19          _users = users;
 20          _wins = wins;
 21  
 22          RegisterDetailRoutes();
 23  
 24          _auth.AuthStateChanged += (_, _) => Dispatcher.Dispatch(async () => await ApplyGateAsync());
 25      }
 26  
 27      private static void RegisterDetailRoutes()
 28      {
 29          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.ListingDetail, typeof(ListingDetailPage));
 30          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.Payment, typeof(PaymentPage));
 31          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.OrderPayment, typeof(OrderPaymentPage));
 32          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.ChatRoom, typeof(ChatRoomPage));
 33          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.ListingApprovals, typeof(ListingApprovalsPage));
 34          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.Wallet, typeof(WalletPage));
 35          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.Payouts, typeof(PayoutsPage));
 36          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.BidDeposit, typeof(BidDepositPage));
 37          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.PhotoViewer, typeof(PhotoViewerPage));
 38          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.ReviewListing, typeof(ReviewListingPage));
 39          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.Register, typeof(RegisterPage));
 40          Routing.RegisterRoute(Routes.ForgotPassword, typeof(ForgotPasswordPage));
 41      }
 42  
 43      protected override async void OnNavigated(ShellNavigatedEventArgs args)
 44      {
 45          base.OnNavigated(args);
 46          if (_gateApplied) return;
 47          _gateApplied = true;
 48          await ApplyGateAsync();
 49      }
 50  
 51      /// <summary>The screens a signed-out student is allowed to be on.</summary>
 52      private static readonly string[] SignedOutRoutes =
 53          { Routes.Welcome, Routes.Login, Routes.Register, Routes.ForgotPassword };
 54  
 55      /// <summary>
 56      /// Sends the student to Welcome, the emailed-code screen, profile setup or the app,
 57      /// whichever their account state calls for.
 58      ///
 59      /// It only moves them when they are somewhere that state does not allow. Anything
 60      /// that refreshes the ID token raises AuthStateChanged — opening Profile does, on
 61      /// every visit — and redirecting to the Feed tab on each of those bounced students
 62      /// off whichever tab they had just opened.
 63      /// </summary>
 64      private async Task ApplyGateAsync()
 65      {
 66          // Pick up a persisted refresh token before deciding where to land, so a
 67          // returning student is not bounced through the login screen on every launch.
 68          await _auth.RestoreSessionAsync();
 69  
 70          var location = CurrentState.Location.OriginalString.Trim('/');
 71  
 72          string target;
 73          if (!_auth.IsSignedIn)
 74          {
 75              // Signed out: stop watching for wins and drop anything meant for the last account.
 76              _wins.Stop();
 77              NotificationCenter.Current.Clear();
 78              Toaster.Current.Clear();
 79              if (IsAt(location, SignedOutRoutes)) return;
 80              target = $"//{Routes.Welcome}";
 81          }
 82          else if (!_auth.IsVerified)
 83          {
 84              // Registration is not finished until the emailed code has been entered:
 85              // the "verified" claim is what the rules and Functions gate everything on.
 86              if (IsAt(location, Routes.VerifyEmail)) return;
 87              target = $"//{Routes.VerifyEmail}";
 88          }
 89          else if (await _users.GetCurrentProfileAsync() is null)
 90          {
 91              if (IsAt(location, Routes.ProfileSetup)) return;
 92              target = $"//{Routes.ProfileSetup}";
 93          }
 94          else
 95          {
 96              // In the app proper: announce won auctions (Bid Approved / You Have a Winner).
 97              _wins.Start();
 98  
 99              // Already past the gate — leave them on whichever tab or page they opened.
100              var onGateScreen = location.Length == 0
101                  || IsAt(location, SignedOutRoutes)
102                  || IsAt(location, Routes.VerifyEmail, Routes.ProfileSetup);
103              if (!onGateScreen) return;
104              target = Routes.FeedTab;
105          }
106  
107          await GoToAsync(target);
108      }
109  
110      private static bool IsAt(string location, params string[] routes) =>
111          routes.Any(r => location.Equals(r, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
112                       || location.StartsWith($"{r}/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
113  }
```

### NUTrade1/MauiProgram.cs

```csharp
  1  using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  2  using NUTrade1.Core;
  3  using NUTrade1.Services;
  4  using NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  using NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  6  using NUTrade1.Views;
  7  
  8  namespace NUTrade1
  9  {
 10      public static class MauiProgram
 11      {
 12          /// <summary>
 13          /// Flips the whole app back onto the in-memory <c>Stub*</c> services. They hold no
 14          /// seeded content any more, so this is a way to click through the UI with no
 15          /// network and no Firebase project — not a demo mode. Ship it as <c>false</c>.
 16          /// </summary>
 17          private static readonly bool UseStubServices = false;
 18  
 19          public static MauiApp CreateMauiApp()
 20          {
 21              var builder = MauiApp.CreateBuilder();
 22              builder
 23                  .UseMauiApp<App>()
 24                  .ConfigureFonts(fonts =>
 25                  {
 26                      // Inter throughout, as in the 2026-09 mockups; Lobster for the
 27                      // hand-lettered "Make it yours." on the home hero.
 28                      fonts.AddFont("Inter-Regular.ttf", "InterRegular");
 29                      fonts.AddFont("Inter-Medium.ttf", "InterMedium");
 30                      fonts.AddFont("Inter-SemiBold.ttf", "InterSemiBold");
 31                      fonts.AddFont("Inter-Bold.ttf", "InterBold");
 32                      fonts.AddFont("Inter-ExtraBold.ttf", "InterExtraBold");
 33                      fonts.AddFont("Lobster-Regular.ttf", "Lobster");
 34                  });
 35  
 36              StripPlatformInputChrome();
 37              RegisterServices(builder.Services);
 38              RegisterViewModels(builder.Services);
 39              RegisterPages(builder.Services);
 40  
 41  #if DEBUG
 42              builder.Logging.AddDebug();
 43  #endif
 44  
 45              return builder.Build();
 46          }
 47  
 48          /// <summary>
 49          /// Every text field and dropdown sits inside the rounded InputShell border from the
 50          /// mockups, so each platform's own chrome (Android's underline, the WinUI box and
 51          /// focus bar, the iOS rounded rect) is removed to leave just that one outline.
 52          /// </summary>
 53          private static void StripPlatformInputChrome()
 54          {
 55              Microsoft.Maui.Handlers.EntryHandler.Mapper.AppendToMapping("NUTradeBorderless", (handler, _) =>
 56              {
 57  #if ANDROID
 58                  handler.PlatformView.BackgroundTintList = Android.Content.Res.ColorStateList.ValueOf(Android.Graphics.Color.Transparent);
 59  #elif WINDOWS
 60                  StripTextBox(handler.PlatformView);
 61  #elif IOS || MACCATALYST
 62                  handler.PlatformView.BorderStyle = UIKit.UITextBorderStyle.None;
 63  #endif
 64              });
 65  
 66              Microsoft.Maui.Handlers.EditorHandler.Mapper.AppendToMapping("NUTradeBorderless", (handler, _) =>
 67              {
 68  #if ANDROID
 69                  handler.PlatformView.BackgroundTintList = Android.Content.Res.ColorStateList.ValueOf(Android.Graphics.Color.Transparent);
 70  #elif WINDOWS
 71                  StripTextBox(handler.PlatformView);
 72  #endif
 73              });
 74  
 75              Microsoft.Maui.Handlers.PickerHandler.Mapper.AppendToMapping("NUTradeBorderless", (handler, _) =>
 76              {
 77  #if ANDROID
 78                  handler.PlatformView.BackgroundTintList = Android.Content.Res.ColorStateList.ValueOf(Android.Graphics.Color.Transparent);
 79  #elif WINDOWS
 80                  handler.PlatformView.BorderThickness = new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Thickness(0);
 81                  handler.PlatformView.Background = new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent);
 82  #endif
 83              });
 84          }
 85  
 86  #if WINDOWS
 87          private static readonly System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.TextBox, object> StrippedBoxes = new();
 88  
 89          private static void StripTextBox(Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.TextBox box)
 90          {
 91              box.BorderThickness = new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Thickness(0);
 92  
 93              // MAUI re-runs this mapping when the Entry changes, but WinUI locks a control's
 94              // resources once it has loaded — so this happens once per box, and a failure is
 95              // cosmetic, never fatal.
 96              if (StrippedBoxes.TryGetValue(box, out _)) return;
 97              StrippedBoxes.Add(box, new object());
 98              try
 99              {
100                  // WinUI swaps these in on hover and focus (a transparent focused border also
101                  // hides the accent bar). Each key gets its own brush: a XAML object can't sit
102                  // in a dictionary twice.
103                  foreach (var key in new[]
104                  {
105                      "TextControlBorderBrush", "TextControlBorderBrushFocused", "TextControlBorderBrushPointerOver",
106                      "TextControlBackgroundFocused", "TextControlBackgroundPointerOver",
107                  })
108                  {
109                      box.Resources[key] = new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent);
110                  }
111              }
112              catch (System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException)
113              {
114                  // Already loaded and locked; it keeps the default hover/focus look.
115              }
116          }
117  #endif
118  
119          private static void RegisterServices(IServiceCollection services)
120          {
121              services.AddSingleton<AppShell>();
122              services.AddSingleton<INavigationService, ShellNavigationService>();
123              services.AddSingleton<WinWatcher>();
124              services.AddSingleton<IQrImageSaver, QrImageSaver>();
125  
126              if (UseStubServices) RegisterStubBackend(services);
127              else RegisterFirebaseBackend(services);
128          }
129  
130          /// <summary>
131          /// The real backend: Firebase Auth, Firestore and Storage over REST, plus the
132          /// callable Cloud Functions that own every privileged write. One HttpClient is
133          /// shared by all of them — creating one per service is the classic way to
134          /// exhaust sockets.
135          /// </summary>
136          private static void RegisterFirebaseBackend(IServiceCollection services)
137          {
138              services.AddSingleton(_ => new HttpClient { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30) });
139  
140              // One instance, two roles: IAuthService for the app, IFirebaseTokenProvider
141              // for the transports that need to attach its ID token.
142              services.AddSingleton<IGoogleAuthBroker, GoogleAuthBroker>();
143              services.AddSingleton<FirebaseAuthService>();
144              services.AddSingleton<IAuthService>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<FirebaseAuthService>());
145              services.AddSingleton<IFirebaseTokenProvider>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<FirebaseAuthService>());
146  
147              services.AddSingleton<FirestoreClient>();
148              services.AddSingleton<FunctionsClient>();
149  
150              services.AddSingleton<IStorageService, FirebaseStorageService>();
151              services.AddSingleton<IUserService, FirestoreUserService>();
152              services.AddSingleton<IListingService, FirestoreListingService>();
153              services.AddSingleton<IBidService, FirestoreBidService>();
154              services.AddSingleton<IChatService, FirestoreChatService>();
155              services.AddSingleton<IPaymentService, FunctionsPaymentService>();
156              services.AddSingleton<IOrderService, FirestoreOrderService>();
157              services.AddSingleton<IListingModerationService, FunctionsListingModerationService>();
158              services.AddSingleton<IEmailVerificationService, EmailVerificationService>();
159              services.AddSingleton<IRegistrationService, FunctionsRegistrationService>();
160              services.AddSingleton<IPasswordResetService, FunctionsPasswordResetService>();
161              services.AddSingleton<IDepositService, FunctionsDepositService>();
162              services.AddSingleton<IWalletService, FirestoreWalletService>();
163              services.AddSingleton<IPayoutModerationService, FunctionsPayoutModerationService>();
164          }
165  
166          private static void RegisterStubBackend(IServiceCollection services)
167          {
168              services.AddSingleton<IAuthService, StubAuthService>();
169              services.AddSingleton<IUserService, StubUserService>();
170              services.AddSingleton<IListingService, StubListingService>();
171              services.AddSingleton<IBidService, StubBidService>();
172              services.AddSingleton<IChatService, StubChatService>();
173              services.AddSingleton<IPaymentService, StubPaymentService>();
174              services.AddSingleton<IStorageService, StubStorageService>();
175              services.AddSingleton<IOrderService, StubOrderService>();
176              services.AddSingleton<IListingModerationService, StubListingModerationService>();
177              services.AddSingleton<IEmailVerificationService, StubEmailVerificationService>();
178              services.AddSingleton<IRegistrationService, StubRegistrationService>();
179              services.AddSingleton<IPasswordResetService, StubPasswordResetService>();
180  
181              // One instance serves both roles offline so an admin decision and the student
182              // balance it moves are the same in-memory state.
183              services.AddSingleton<IDepositService, StubDepositService>();
184              services.AddSingleton<StubWalletService>();
185              services.AddSingleton<IWalletService>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<StubWalletService>());
186              services.AddSingleton<IPayoutModerationService>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<StubWalletService>());
187          }
188  
189          private static void RegisterViewModels(IServiceCollection services)
190          {
191              services.AddTransient<WelcomeViewModel>();
192              services.AddTransient<LoginViewModel>();
193              services.AddTransient<RegisterViewModel>();
194              services.AddTransient<ForgotPasswordViewModel>();
195              services.AddTransient<VerifyEmailViewModel>();
196              services.AddTransient<ProfileSetupViewModel>();
197              services.AddTransient<FeedViewModel>();
198              services.AddTransient<ListingDetailViewModel>();
199              services.AddTransient<PostTradeViewModel>();
200              services.AddTransient<PaymentViewModel>();
201              services.AddTransient<OrderPaymentViewModel>();
202              services.AddTransient<OffersViewModel>();
203              services.AddTransient<ChatListViewModel>();
204              services.AddTransient<ChatRoomViewModel>();
205              services.AddTransient<ProfileViewModel>();
206              services.AddTransient<ListingApprovalsViewModel>();
207              services.AddTransient<WalletViewModel>();
208              services.AddTransient<BidDepositViewModel>();
209              services.AddTransient<PayoutsViewModel>();
210              services.AddTransient<PhotoViewerViewModel>();
211              services.AddTransient<ReviewListingViewModel>();
212          }
213  
214          private static void RegisterPages(IServiceCollection services)
215          {
216              services.AddTransient<WelcomePage>();
217              services.AddTransient<LoginPage>();
218              services.AddTransient<RegisterPage>();
219              services.AddTransient<ForgotPasswordPage>();
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/BottomNavBar.xaml.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Services;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// The floating bottom navigation from the mockups: five icon-only tabs. Drop it as the
 7  /// last child of a page-root <see cref="Grid"/> and set <see cref="Active"/> to the
 8  /// current tab.
 9  /// </summary>
10  public partial class BottomNavBar : ContentView
11  {
12      public BottomNavBar()
13      {
14          InitializeComponent();
15          Refresh();
16      }
17  
18      public static readonly BindableProperty ActiveProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
19          nameof(Active), typeof(string), typeof(BottomNavBar), "Home",
20          propertyChanged: (b, _, _) => ((BottomNavBar)b).Refresh());
21  
22      /// <summary>One of "Home", "Offers", "Post", "Chat", "Profile".</summary>
23      public string Active
24      {
25          get => (string)GetValue(ActiveProperty);
26          set => SetValue(ActiveProperty, value);
27      }
28  
29      public static readonly BindableProperty OffersBadgeProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
30          nameof(OffersBadge), typeof(int), typeof(BottomNavBar), 0,
31          propertyChanged: (b, _, _) => ((BottomNavBar)b).Refresh());
32  
33      public int OffersBadge
34      {
35          get => (int)GetValue(OffersBadgeProperty);
36          set => SetValue(OffersBadgeProperty, value);
37      }
38  
39      public static readonly BindableProperty ChatBadgeProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
40          nameof(ChatBadge), typeof(int), typeof(BottomNavBar), 0,
41          propertyChanged: (b, _, _) => ((BottomNavBar)b).Refresh());
42  
43      public int ChatBadge
44      {
45          get => (int)GetValue(ChatBadgeProperty);
46          set => SetValue(ChatBadgeProperty, value);
47      }
48  
49      private void Refresh()
50      {
51          ApplyState(Active == "Home", HomePill, HomeIcon);
52          ApplyState(Active == "Offers", OffersPill, OffersIcon);
53          ApplyState(Active == "Chat", ChatPill, ChatIcon);
54          ApplyState(Active == "Profile", ProfilePill, ProfileIcon);
55  
56          // "+" is dark ink when idle and a gold circle while you are posting.
57          var posting = Active == "Post";
58          PostPill.BackgroundColor = posting ? AppColor("NuGold", "NuGold") : Colors.Transparent;
59          PostIcon.Stroke = posting ? AppColor("NuNavy", "NuNavy") : AppColor("Ink", "InkDark");
60  
61          SetBadge(OffersBadgeView, OffersBadgeLabel, OffersBadge);
62          SetBadge(ChatBadgeView, ChatBadgeLabel, ChatBadge);
63      }
64  
65      private static void ApplyState(bool active, Border pill, Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Shapes.Path icon)
66      {
67          pill.BackgroundColor = active ? AppColor("NuNavy", "NuNavy") : Colors.Transparent;
68          icon.Stroke = active ? AppColor("White", "White") : AppColor("InkMuted", "InkMutedDark");
69      }
70  
71      private static void SetBadge(Border view, Label label, int count)
72      {
73          view.IsVisible = count > 0;
74          label.Text = count > 9 ? "9+" : count.ToString();
75      }
76  
77      private static Color AppColor(string lightKey, string darkKey)
78      {
79          var key = Application.Current?.RequestedTheme == AppTheme.Dark ? darkKey : lightKey;
80          return Application.Current?.Resources.TryGetValue(key, out var v) == true && v is Color c
81              ? c
82              : Colors.Gray;
83      }
84  
85      private static Task Go(string route) =>
86          Shell.Current?.GoToAsync(route) ?? Task.CompletedTask;
87  
88      private void OnHomeTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => _ = Go(Routes.FeedTab);
89      private void OnOffersTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => _ = Go(Routes.OffersTab);
90      private void OnChatTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => _ = Go(Routes.ChatsTab);
91      private void OnProfileTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => _ = Go(Routes.ProfileTab);
92      private void OnPostTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => _ = Go(Routes.PostTradeTab);
93  }
```

```xml
21                 TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" HorizontalOptions="Center"
22                 Text="{Binding Caption, Source={x:Reference Self}}"
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/LoadingDots.xaml.cs

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
  2  
  3  /// <summary>
  4  /// The app's loading indicator: three dots rising and fading in sequence, NU navy either
  5  /// side of gold, with an optional caption underneath.
  6  ///
  7  /// Replaces the platform <see cref="ActivityIndicator"/>, which drew an unbranded grey
  8  /// arc that was easy to miss and told the student nothing about what was happening. Bind
  9  /// <see cref="IsRunning"/> the way you would an ActivityIndicator — the control hides
 10  /// itself when it is not running, so there is no separate IsVisible to keep in step.
 11  /// </summary>
 12  public partial class LoadingDots : ContentView
 13  {
 14      private const uint CycleMs = 1000;
 15  
 16      /// <summary>Each dot starts a third of a cycle after the one before it.</summary>
 17      private static readonly uint[] DotDelays = [0, CycleMs / 3, CycleMs * 2 / 3];
 18  
 19      private bool _animating;
 20  
 21      public LoadingDots()
 22      {
 23          InitializeComponent();
 24          Unloaded += (_, _) => StopAnimation();
 25      }
 26  
 27      public static readonly BindableProperty IsRunningProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 28          nameof(IsRunning), typeof(bool), typeof(LoadingDots), false,
 29          propertyChanged: (b, _, v) => ((LoadingDots)b).OnIsRunningChanged((bool)v));
 30  
 31      public bool IsRunning
 32      {
 33          get => (bool)GetValue(IsRunningProperty);
 34          set => SetValue(IsRunningProperty, value);
 35      }
 36  
 37      public static readonly BindableProperty CaptionProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 38          nameof(Caption), typeof(string), typeof(LoadingDots), string.Empty,
 39          propertyChanged: (b, _, _) => ((LoadingDots)b).OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCaption)));
 40  
 41      /// <summary>Optional line under the dots, e.g. "Sending your code…".</summary>
 42      public string Caption
 43      {
 44          get => (string)GetValue(CaptionProperty);
 45          set => SetValue(CaptionProperty, value);
 46      }
 47  
 48      public bool HasCaption => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Caption);
 49  
 50      private void OnIsRunningChanged(bool running)
 51      {
 52          IsVisible = running;
 53          if (running) StartAnimation();
 54          else StopAnimation();
 55      }
 56  
 57      private void StartAnimation()
 58      {
 59          if (_animating) return;
 60          _animating = true;
 61  
 62          var dots = new View[] { Dot1, Dot2, Dot3 };
 63          for (var i = 0; i < dots.Length; i++) Pulse(dots[i], DotDelays[i]);
 64      }
 65  
 66      /// <summary>
 67      /// One dot's loop, as a repeating <see cref="Animation"/> rather than an async
 68      /// await-loop: the platform animation driver owns the timing, so it pauses with the
 69      /// app instead of spinning a task in the background.
 70      /// </summary>
 71      private void Pulse(View dot, uint delayMs)
 72      {
 73          var animation = new Animation();
 74  
 75          // Up and back down over the first two thirds, then rest — the pause is what makes
 76          // the three dots read as a wave rather than a jitter.
 77          animation.Add(0.00, 0.33, new Animation(v => dot.TranslationY = -5 * v, 0, 1, Easing.CubicOut));
 78          animation.Add(0.33, 0.66, new Animation(v => dot.TranslationY = -5 * (1 - v), 0, 1, Easing.CubicIn));
 79          animation.Add(0.00, 0.33, new Animation(v => dot.Opacity = 0.45 + (0.55 * v), 0, 1));
 80          animation.Add(0.33, 0.66, new Animation(v => dot.Opacity = 1 - (0.55 * v), 0, 1));
 81  
 82          var handle = $"nutrade.loading.{dot.Id}";
 83          if (delayMs == 0)
 84          {
 85              animation.Commit(this, handle, 16, CycleMs, repeat: () => _animating);
 86              return;
 87          }
 88  
 89          // Dispatcher rather than Task.Delay so the stagger cannot start after the control
 90          // has already been torn down.
 91          Dispatcher.DispatchDelayed(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMs), () =>
 92          {
 93              if (_animating) animation.Commit(this, handle, 16, CycleMs, repeat: () => _animating);
 94          });
 95      }
 96  
 97      private void StopAnimation()
 98      {
 99          _animating = false;
100          foreach (var dot in new View[] { Dot1, Dot2, Dot3 })
101          {
102              this.AbortAnimation($"nutrade.loading.{dot.Id}");
103              dot.TranslationY = 0;
104              dot.Opacity = 1;
105          }
106      }
107  }
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/NotificationHost.xaml.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Services;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>
  6  /// Draws <see cref="NotificationCenter"/>'s active notification at the top of its page.
  7  /// Every page carries one; only the page on screen shows the card, so a notification
  8  /// follows the student from screen to screen until they act on it or dismiss it.
  9  /// </summary>
 10  public partial class NotificationHost : ContentView
 11  {
 12      private const double HiddenOffset = -180;
 13  
 14      private Page? _page;
 15      private bool _pageVisible;
 16      private AppNotification? _shown;
 17  
 18      public NotificationHost()
 19      {
 20          InitializeComponent();
 21          Card.TranslationY = HiddenOffset;
 22          Card.Opacity = 0;
 23          Loaded += OnLoaded;
 24          Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
 25      }
 26  
 27      private void OnLoaded(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 28      {
 29          NotificationCenter.Current.Changed += OnCenterChanged;
 30  
 31          _page = FindPage();
 32          if (_page is not null)
 33          {
 34              _page.Appearing += OnPageAppearing;
 35              _page.Disappearing += OnPageDisappearing;
 36          }
 37          _pageVisible = true;
 38          _ = SyncAsync();
 39      }
 40  
 41      private void OnUnloaded(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 42      {
 43          NotificationCenter.Current.Changed -= OnCenterChanged;
 44          if (_page is not null)
 45          {
 46              _page.Appearing -= OnPageAppearing;
 47              _page.Disappearing -= OnPageDisappearing;
 48          }
 49      }
 50  
 51      private void OnPageAppearing(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 52      {
 53          _pageVisible = true;
 54          _ = SyncAsync();
 55      }
 56  
 57      private void OnPageDisappearing(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 58      {
 59          _pageVisible = false;
 60          _shown = null;
 61          IsVisible = false;
 62          Card.TranslationY = HiddenOffset;
 63          Card.Opacity = 0;
 64      }
 65  
 66      private void OnCenterChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => _ = SyncAsync();
 67  
 68      /// <summary>Brings the card in line with the centre: show, swap or hide.</summary>
 69      private async Task SyncAsync()
 70      {
 71          var active = _pageVisible ? NotificationCenter.Current.Active : null;
 72          if (ReferenceEquals(active, _shown)) return;
 73  
 74          if (_shown is not null) await HideAsync();
 75  
 76          _shown = active;
 77          if (active is null) return;
 78  
 79          TitleLabel.Text = active.Title;
 80          BodyLabel.Text = active.Body;
 81          ActionLabel.Text = active.ActionText;
 82          ActionButton.IsVisible = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(active.ActionText);
 83          SemanticScreenReader.Announce($"{active.Title}. {active.Body}");
 84  
 85          IsVisible = true;
 86          await Task.WhenAll(
 87              Card.TranslateToAsync(0, 0, 320, Easing.CubicOut),
 88              Card.FadeToAsync(1, 200));
 89      }
 90  
 91      private async Task HideAsync()
 92      {
 93          await Task.WhenAll(
 94              Card.TranslateToAsync(0, HiddenOffset, 220, Easing.CubicIn),
 95              Card.FadeToAsync(0, 220));
 96          IsVisible = false;
 97      }
 98  
 99      private void OnDismissTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e)
100      {
101          if (_shown is { } n) NotificationCenter.Current.Dismiss(n);
102      }
103  
104      private async void OnActionTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e)
105      {
106          if (_shown is not { } n) return;
107          NotificationCenter.Current.Dismiss(n);
108          if (n.Action is not null) await n.Action();
109      }
110  
111      private Page? FindPage()
112      {
113          Element? e = Parent;
114          while (e is not null and not Page) e = e.Parent;
115          return e as Page;
116      }
117  }
```

```csharp
  1  using System.Windows.Input;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>
  6  /// A selectable package row for the Post screen ("Free · ₱0"). Works like
  7  /// <see cref="SelectableChip"/>: bind <see cref="IsSelected"/> to the group's ViewModel
  8  /// property through a converter, and handle the write through <see cref="Command"/>,
  9  /// which fires with <see cref="Value"/> as its parameter.
 10  /// </summary>
 11  public partial class PackageOption : ContentView
 12  {
 13      public PackageOption()
 14      {
 15          InitializeComponent();
 16          Repaint();
 17      }
 18  
 19      public static readonly BindableProperty TitleProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 20          nameof(Title), typeof(string), typeof(PackageOption), string.Empty,
 21          propertyChanged: (b, _, v) =>

 45          nameof(Price), typeof(string), typeof(PackageOption), string.Empty,
 46          propertyChanged: (b, _, v) =>
 47          {

 54      {

 57      }
 58

 60          nameof(Value), typeof(string), typeof(PackageOption), string.Empty);
 61  
 62      /// <summary>The package this row represents; passed to <see cref="Command"/> on tap.</summary>
 63      public string Value
 64      {
 65          get => (string)GetValue(ValueProperty);
 66          set => SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
 67      }
 68  
 69      public static readonly BindableProperty IsSelectedProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 70          nameof(IsSelected), typeof(bool), typeof(PackageOption), false,
 71          propertyChanged: (b, _, _) => ((PackageOption)b).Repaint());
 72  
 73      public bool IsSelected
 74      {

 76          set => SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
 77      }

 80          nameof(Command), typeof(ICommand), typeof(PackageOption));

 83      {

 85          set => SetValue(CommandProperty, value);
 86      }

 88      private void OnTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e)
 89      {
 90          if (Command?.CanExecute(Value) == true)
 91              Command.Execute(Value);
 92      }
 93  
 94      private void Repaint()
 95      {
 96          // The mockup's selected row: a gold outline on the same white fill.
 97          Root.Stroke = IsSelected ? Res("NuGold", "NuGold") : Res("CardBorder", "CardBorderDark");
 98          Root.StrokeThickness = IsSelected ? 1.6 : 1;
 99          Root.BackgroundColor = Res("White", "CardBgDark");
100  
101          SemanticProperties.SetDescription(Root,
102              $"{Title} package, {Price}{(IsSelected ? ", selected" : string.Empty)}");
103      }
104  
105      private static Color Res(string lightKey, string darkKey)
106      {
107          var key = Application.Current?.RequestedTheme == AppTheme.Dark ? darkKey : lightKey;
108          return Application.Current?.Resources.TryGetValue(key, out var v) == true && v is Color c
109              ? c
110              : Colors.Gray;
111      }
112  }
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/PaymentQrView.xaml.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Core;
  2  using NUTrade1.Services;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// Draws a PayMongo QR Ph code and lets the student save or share it.
  8  ///
  9  /// Scanning only works when the QR is on a second screen. A student paying from the phone
 10  /// that shows it has to get the picture into GCash or Maya, whose "Upload QR" reads from the
 11  /// photo library — so Save writes it there, and Share hands it to any app directly.
 12  /// </summary>
 13  public partial class PaymentQrView : ContentView
 14  {
 15      // Only for the rare hosted-image case; PayMongo normally sends the QR inline.
 16      private static readonly HttpClient Http = new() { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20) };
 17  
 18      public static readonly BindableProperty ImageUrlProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 19          nameof(ImageUrl), typeof(string), typeof(PaymentQrView), propertyChanged: OnImageChanged);
 20  
 21      public static readonly BindableProperty ImageBase64Property = BindableProperty.Create(
 22          nameof(ImageBase64), typeof(string), typeof(PaymentQrView), propertyChanged: OnImageChanged);
 23  
 24      public static readonly BindableProperty FileNameProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 25          nameof(FileName), typeof(string), typeof(PaymentQrView), "nutrade-qr");
 26  
 27      private byte[]? _png;
 28      private bool _working;
 29  
 30      public PaymentQrView()
 31      {
 32          InitializeComponent();
 33      }
 34  
 35      /// <summary>PayMongo's <c>code.image_url</c> — usually a data URI, occasionally a web address.</summary>
 36      public string? ImageUrl
 37      {
 38          get => (string?)GetValue(ImageUrlProperty);
 39          set => SetValue(ImageUrlProperty, value);
 40      }
 41  
 42      /// <summary>PayMongo's <c>code.image</c>, bare base64, used when there is no data URI.</summary>
 43      public string? ImageBase64
 44      {
 45          get => (string?)GetValue(ImageBase64Property);
 46          set => SetValue(ImageBase64Property, value);
 47      }
 48  
 49      /// <summary>What the saved picture is called, so a student can find it in their gallery.</summary>
 50      public string FileName
 51      {
 52          get => (string)GetValue(FileNameProperty);
 53          set => SetValue(FileNameProperty, value);
 54      }
 55  
 56      private static void OnImageChanged(BindableObject bindable, object? oldValue, object? newValue) =>
 57          ((PaymentQrView)bindable).Render();
 58  
 59      private void Render()
 60      {
 61          _png = QrImageData.TryDecode(ImageUrl, ImageBase64);
 62          var remote = _png is null ? QrImageData.RemoteUri(ImageUrl) : null;
 63  
 64          if (_png is { } bytes)
 65              QrImage.Source = ImageSource.FromStream(() => new MemoryStream(bytes));
 66          else if (remote is not null)
 67              QrImage.Source = ImageSource.FromUri(remote);
 68          else
 69              QrImage.Source = null;
 70  
 71          var hasQr = _png is not null || remote is not null;
 72          Placeholder.IsVisible = !hasQr;
 73          Actions.IsVisible = hasQr;
 74          Hint.IsVisible = hasQr;
 75      }
 76  
 77      private async void OnSaveClicked(object? sender, EventArgs e) =>
 78          await RunAsync(async (saver, png) =>
 79          {
 80              var result = await saver.SaveToGalleryAsync(png, FileName);
 81              if (result.Succeeded) Toaster.Success($"QR code saved to {result.Value}.");
 82              else Toaster.Error(result.Error);
 83          });
 84  
 85      private async void OnShareClicked(object? sender, EventArgs e) =>
 86          await RunAsync(async (saver, png) =>
 87          {
 88              var result = await saver.ShareAsync(png, FileName, "Pay with QR Ph");
 89              if (!result.Succeeded) Toaster.Error(result.Error);
 90          });
 91  
 92      /// <summary>One action at a time, with the buttons off while it runs, so a double tap saves once.</summary>
 93      private async Task RunAsync(Func<IQrImageSaver, byte[], Task> action)
 94      {
 95          if (_working) return;
 96          var saver = Handler?.MauiContext?.Services.GetService<IQrImageSaver>();
 97          if (saver is null) return;
 98  
 99          _working = true;
100          SaveButton.IsEnabled = ShareButton.IsEnabled = false;
101          try
102          {
103              var png = _png ?? await DownloadAsync();
104              if (png is null)
105              {
106                  Toaster.Error("The QR code isn't ready yet.");
107                  return;
108              }
109              await action(saver, png);
110          }
111          finally
112          {
113              _working = false;
114              SaveButton.IsEnabled = ShareButton.IsEnabled = true;
115          }
116      }
117  
118      private async Task<byte[]?> DownloadAsync()
119      {
120          if (QrImageData.RemoteUri(ImageUrl) is not { } uri) return null;
121          try
122          {
123              return _png = await Http.GetByteArrayAsync(uri);
124          }
125          catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException)
126          {
127              return null;
128          }
129      }
130  }
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/PhotoCarousel.xaml.cs

```csharp
 1  using System.Collections;
 2  using System.Windows.Input;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
 5  
 6  /// <summary>
 7  /// A swipeable strip of a listing's photos with a "2 / 4" counter and page dots. Tapping a
 8  /// photo runs <see cref="PhotoTappedCommand"/> with that photo's index, which screens use to
 9  /// open the full-screen viewer at the same picture.
10  /// </summary>
11  public partial class PhotoCarousel : ContentView
12  {
13      public static readonly BindableProperty PhotosProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
14          nameof(Photos), typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(PhotoCarousel), propertyChanged: OnPhotosChanged);
15  
16      public static readonly BindableProperty PhotoTappedCommandProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
17          nameof(PhotoTappedCommand), typeof(ICommand), typeof(PhotoCarousel));
18  
19      /// <summary>A mouse can't swipe a carousel, so desktops get arrows as well.</summary>
20      private static readonly bool ShowArrows = DeviceInfo.Idiom == DeviceIdiom.Desktop;
21  
22      private int _count;
23  
24      public PhotoCarousel()
25      {
26          InitializeComponent();
27      }
28  
29      /// <summary>Image sources — download URLs for a posted listing, local files on the review screen.</summary>
30      public IEnumerable? Photos
31      {
32          get => (IEnumerable?)GetValue(PhotosProperty);
33          set => SetValue(PhotosProperty, value);
34      }
35  
36      /// <summary>Runs with the tapped photo's index (an <see cref="int"/>).</summary>
37      public ICommand? PhotoTappedCommand
38      {
39          get => (ICommand?)GetValue(PhotoTappedCommandProperty);
40          set => SetValue(PhotoTappedCommandProperty, value);
41      }
42  
43      private static void OnPhotosChanged(BindableObject bindable, object? oldValue, object? newValue)
44      {
45          var carousel = (PhotoCarousel)bindable;
46          // A snapshot, so a later change to the source list can't leave the counter wrong.
47          var photos = (newValue as IEnumerable)?.Cast<object>().ToList() ?? [];
48  
49          // A screen reloading the same listing (coming back from the viewer, say) hands
50          // over a new list with the same photos; keep the student's place in it.
51          if (carousel.Carousel.ItemsSource is List<object> shown && shown.SequenceEqual(photos)) return;
52  
53          carousel._count = photos.Count;
54          carousel.Carousel.ItemsSource = photos;
55          carousel.Refresh(0);
56      }
57  
58      private void OnPositionChanged(object? sender, PositionChangedEventArgs e) => Refresh(e.CurrentPosition);
59  
60      private void Refresh(int position)
61      {
62          var many = _count > 1;
63          EmptyIcon.IsVisible = _count == 0;
64          Counter.IsVisible = many;
65          Indicator.IsVisible = many;
66          CounterLabel.Text = $"{Math.Clamp(position + 1, 1, Math.Max(_count, 1))} / {_count}";
67          PreviousButton.IsVisible = ShowArrows && many && position > 0;
68          NextButton.IsVisible = ShowArrows && many && position < _count - 1;
69      }
70  
71      private void OnPhotoTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e)
72      {
73          var index = Carousel.Position;
74          if (PhotoTappedCommand?.CanExecute(index) == true) PhotoTappedCommand.Execute(index);
75      }
76  
77      private void OnPreviousTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => MoveBy(-1);
78  
79      private void OnNextTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e) => MoveBy(1);
80  
81      private void MoveBy(int delta)
82      {
83          var target = Math.Clamp(Carousel.Position + delta, 0, Math.Max(_count - 1, 0));
84          if (target != Carousel.Position) Carousel.Position = target;
85      }
86  }
```

```csharp
  8  /// group's ViewModel property via a converter and handle the write through

 70      {

 72              Command.Execute(Value);

 75      private void ApplyBlock()
 76      {
 77          if (Block)
 78          {
 79              Root.Padding = new Thickness(16, 14);
 80              Root.StrokeShape = new Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Shapes.RoundRectangle { CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(18) };
 81              Root.HorizontalOptions = LayoutOptions.Fill;

 87      {
 88          var navy = Res("NuNavy", "NuNavyLight");
 89          var border = Res("ChipBorder", "ChipBorderDark");
 90          var chipBg = Res("ChipBg", "ChipBgDark");
 91          var chipText = Res("ChipText", "ChipTextDark");
 92          var onNavy = Res("White", "NuNavy");
 93  
 94          Root.BackgroundColor = IsSelected ? navy : chipBg;
 95          Root.Stroke = IsSelected ? navy : border;
 96          ChipLabel.TextColor = IsSelected ? onNavy : chipText;
 97      }

 99      private static Color Res(string lightKey, string darkKey)
100      {
101          var key = Application.Current?.RequestedTheme == AppTheme.Dark ? darkKey : lightKey;
102          return Application.Current?.Resources.TryGetValue(key, out var v) == true && v is Color c
```
