```xml
10  
11      <!-- InputTransparent on the host with CascadeInputTransparent="False" lets taps fall
12           through everywhere except the pill itself, so a toast never blocks the screen
13           underneath — the point of a toast rather than a dialog. -->
14      <!-- No Shadow here on purpose. CardShadow is a semi-transparent brush, and on Android a
15           shadowed Border composites its children through that alpha layer — barely visible on
16           the app's white cards, but it washes white text on a saturated pill out to the point
17           of being unreadable. A hairline stroke gives the lift instead. -->
18      <Border x:Name="Pill" StrokeThickness="1" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 14"
19              Stroke="#22FFFFFF" Padding="15,12" Margin="14,0,14,0"
20              HorizontalOptions="Center" MaximumWidthRequest="520">
21          <Border.GestureRecognizers>
22              <TapGestureRecognizer Tapped="OnDismissRequested" />
23              <!-- Flick it away, the way every mobile toast behaves. -->
24              <SwipeGestureRecognizer Direction="Up" Swiped="OnDismissRequested" />
25          </Border.GestureRecognizers>
26  
27          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="10">
28              <Path x:Name="Glyph" Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="19" WidthRequest="19"
29                    Fill="{StaticResource White}" VerticalOptions="Start" Margin="0,1,0,0" />
30              <Label x:Name="MessageLabel" Grid.Column="1" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="14.5"
31                     LineHeight="1.35" TextColor="{StaticResource White}"
32                     MaxLines="3" LineBreakMode="WordWrap" VerticalOptions="Center" />
33          </Grid>
34      </Border>
35  </ContentView>
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/ToastHost.xaml.cs

```csharp
  1  using Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Shapes;
  2  using NUTrade1.Services;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// Draws <see cref="Toaster"/>'s active message as a pill at the top-centre of its page:
  8  /// the one place in the app where a success, a failure or an error shows up.
  9  ///
 10  /// Every page carries one, the same arrangement <see cref="NotificationHost"/> uses —
 11  /// only the page on screen draws anything, so a message raised during navigation lands on
 12  /// whichever page the student ends up on.
 13  /// </summary>
 14  public partial class ToastHost : ContentView
 15  {
 16      private const double HiddenOffset = -140;
 17  
 18      /// <summary>
 19      /// Clears the status bar and any notch. MAUI does not expose per-device insets to
 20      /// shared code, so this is the conservative constant the design already uses for the
 21      /// notification card, plus a little — a toast that tucks under a camera cutout is
 22      /// worse than one sitting slightly low.
 23      /// </summary>
 24      private static readonly Thickness TopInset = new(0, 14, 0, 0);
 25  
 26      private Page? _page;
 27      private bool _pageVisible;
 28      private Toast? _shown;
 29  
 30      public ToastHost()
 31      {
 32          InitializeComponent();
 33          Margin = TopInset;
 34          Pill.TranslationY = HiddenOffset;
 35          Pill.Opacity = 0;
 36          Loaded += OnLoaded;
 37          Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
 38      }
 39  
 40      private void OnLoaded(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 41      {
 42          Toaster.Current.Changed += OnToasterChanged;
 43  
 44          _page = FindPage();
 45          if (_page is not null)
 46          {
 47              _page.Appearing += OnPageAppearing;
 48              _page.Disappearing += OnPageDisappearing;
 49          }
 50          _pageVisible = true;
 51          _ = SyncAsync();
 52      }
 53  
 54      private void OnUnloaded(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 55      {
 56          Toaster.Current.Changed -= OnToasterChanged;
 57          if (_page is not null)
 58          {
 59              _page.Appearing -= OnPageAppearing;
 60              _page.Disappearing -= OnPageDisappearing;
 61          }
 62      }
 63  
 64      private void OnPageAppearing(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 65      {
 66          _pageVisible = true;
 67          _ = SyncAsync();
 68      }
 69  
 70      private void OnPageDisappearing(object? sender, EventArgs e)
 71      {
 72          // Snap rather than animate: this page is on its way off screen, and the host on
 73          // the incoming page picks the same toast up from the Toaster.
 74          _pageVisible = false;
 75          _shown = null;
 76          IsVisible = false;
 77          Pill.TranslationY = HiddenOffset;
 78          Pill.Opacity = 0;
 79      }
 80  
 81      private void OnToasterChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => _ = SyncAsync();
 82  
 83      private async Task SyncAsync()
 84      {
 85          var active = _pageVisible ? Toaster.Current.Active : null;
 86          if (ReferenceEquals(active, _shown)) return;
 87  
 88          if (_shown is not null) await HideAsync();
 89  
 90          _shown = active;
 91          if (active is null) return;
 92  
 93          Apply(active);
 94  
 95          // Screen readers get the message even though it is a purely visual overlay; an
 96          // assertive announcement interrupts, which is right for a failure.
 97          SemanticScreenReader.Announce(active.Message);
 98  
 99          IsVisible = true;
100          await Task.WhenAll(
101              Pill.TranslateToAsync(0, 0, 260, Easing.CubicOut),
102              Pill.FadeToAsync(1, 160));
103  
104          // An animation that is interrupted — by a second toast, or by the page going away
105          // mid-flight — can leave the pill a fraction short of opaque, which reads as a
106          // blurred, half-washed message rather than as a fade.
107          Pill.Opacity = 1;
108          Pill.TranslationY = 0;
109      }
110  
111      /// <summary>
112      /// Solid fills rather than tinted backgrounds: at a glance, from arm's length, colour
113      /// is the whole signal, and the icon carries it for anyone who cannot use the colour.
114      /// </summary>
115      private void Apply(Toast toast)
116      {
117          var (colourKey, glyphKey) = toast.Kind switch
118          {
119              ToastKind.Success => ("Success", "IconCheckCircle"),
120              ToastKind.Error => ("Danger", "IconAlertCircle"),
121              _ => ("NuNavy", "IconInfoCircle"),
122          };
123  
124          Pill.BackgroundColor = Resource<Color>(colourKey) ?? Colors.DimGray;
125          if (Resource<Style>(glyphKey) is { } style) Glyph.Style = style;
126          Glyph.Fill = Resource<Color>("White") is { } white ? new SolidColorBrush(white) : Brush.White;
127          MessageLabel.Text = toast.Message;
128      }
129  
130      private async Task HideAsync()
131      {
132          await Task.WhenAll(
133              Pill.TranslateToAsync(0, HiddenOffset, 180, Easing.CubicIn),
134              Pill.FadeToAsync(0, 180));
135          IsVisible = false;
136      }
137  
138      private void OnDismissRequested(object? sender, EventArgs e)
139      {
140          if (_shown is { } toast) Toaster.Current.Dismiss(toast);
141      }
142  
143      private static T? Resource<T>(string key) where T : class =>
144          Application.Current?.Resources.TryGetValue(key, out var value) == true ? value as T : null;
145  
146      private Page? FindPage()
147      {
148          Element? element = Parent;
149          while (element is not null and not Page) element = element.Parent;
150          return element as Page;
151      }
152  }
```

### NUTrade1/Controls/ZoomableImage.cs

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Controls;
  2  
  3  /// <summary>
  4  /// An image that can be pinched (or double-tapped) up to 4x and dragged around while
  5  /// zoomed, for reading the small print on a listing photo — a textbook's edition, a
  6  /// uniform's size tag.
  7  ///
  8  /// The drag gesture is only attached while zoomed. A pan recognizer that is always there
  9  /// swallows the horizontal swipe the surrounding carousel needs to change photo.
 10  /// </summary>
 11  public sealed class ZoomableImage : ContentView
 12  {
 13      private const double MaxScale = 4;
 14      private const double DoubleTapScale = 2.5;
 15  
 16      public static readonly BindableProperty SourceProperty = BindableProperty.Create(
 17          nameof(Source), typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ZoomableImage),
 18          propertyChanged: (b, _, n) => ((ZoomableImage)b).OnSourceChanged((ImageSource?)n));
 19  
 20      private readonly Image _image = new() { Aspect = Aspect.AspectFit, AnchorX = 0, AnchorY = 0 };
 21      private readonly PanGestureRecognizer _pan = new();
 22      private double _pinchStartScale = 1;
 23      private double _panStartX;
 24      private double _panStartY;
 25  
 26      /// <summary>Raised with true when the image zooms in from 1x, and false when it returns to 1x.</summary>
 27      public event EventHandler<bool>? ZoomChanged;
 28  
 29      public ZoomableImage()
 30      {
 31          Content = _image;
 32          IsClippedToBounds = true;
 33  
 34          var pinch = new PinchGestureRecognizer();
 35          pinch.PinchUpdated += OnPinchUpdated;
 36          GestureRecognizers.Add(pinch);
 37  
 38          var doubleTap = new TapGestureRecognizer { NumberOfTapsRequired = 2 };
 39          doubleTap.Tapped += OnDoubleTapped;
 40          GestureRecognizers.Add(doubleTap);
 41  
 42          _pan.PanUpdated += OnPanUpdated;
 43      }
 44  
 45      public ImageSource? Source
 46      {
 47          get => (ImageSource?)GetValue(SourceProperty);
 48          set => SetValue(SourceProperty, value);
 49      }
 50  
 51      public bool IsZoomed => _image.Scale > 1.01;
 52  
 53      /// <summary>Back to 1x — used when the carousel recycles this view for another photo.</summary>
 54      public void ResetZoom(bool animate = false)
 55      {
 56          if (animate)
 57          {
 58              _ = _image.ScaleToAsync(1, 180, Easing.CubicOut);
 59              _ = _image.TranslateToAsync(0, 0, 180, Easing.CubicOut);
 60          }
 61          else
 62          {
 63              _image.Scale = 1;
 64              _image.TranslationX = 0;
 65              _image.TranslationY = 0;
 66          }
 67          SetZoomed(false);
 68      }
 69  
 70      private void OnSourceChanged(ImageSource? source)
 71      {
 72          _image.Source = source;
 73          ResetZoom();
 74      }
 75  
 76      private void OnPinchUpdated(object? sender, PinchGestureUpdatedEventArgs e)
 77      {
 78          switch (e.Status)
 79          {
 80              case GestureStatus.Started:
 81                  _pinchStartScale = _image.Scale;
 82                  break;
 83  
 84              case GestureStatus.Running:
 85              {
 86                  var oldScale = _image.Scale;
 87                  var newScale = Math.Clamp(oldScale + (e.Scale - 1) * _pinchStartScale, 1, MaxScale);
 88  
 89                  // Keep the point under the fingers where it is: with the anchor at the
 90                  // top-left, that point sits at translation + origin * size * scale.
 91                  var originX = e.ScaleOrigin.X * Width;
 92                  var originY = e.ScaleOrigin.Y * Height;
 93                  var contentX = (originX - _image.TranslationX) / oldScale;
 94                  var contentY = (originY - _image.TranslationY) / oldScale;
 95  
 96                  _image.Scale = newScale;
 97                  MoveTo(originX - contentX * newScale, originY - contentY * newScale);
 98                  break;
 99              }
100  
101              case GestureStatus.Completed:
102              case GestureStatus.Canceled:
103                  if (_image.Scale <= 1.01) ResetZoom(animate: true);
104                  else SetZoomed(true);
105                  break;
106          }
107      }
108  
109      private void OnPanUpdated(object? sender, PanUpdatedEventArgs e)
110      {
111          switch (e.StatusType)
112          {
113              case GestureStatus.Started:
114                  _panStartX = _image.TranslationX;
115                  _panStartY = _image.TranslationY;
116                  break;
117              case GestureStatus.Running:
118                  MoveTo(_panStartX + e.TotalX, _panStartY + e.TotalY);
119                  break;
120          }
121      }
122  
123      /// <summary>Zooms into the middle, or back out — the only zoom a mouse user has.</summary>
124      private void OnDoubleTapped(object? sender, TappedEventArgs e)
125      {
126          if (IsZoomed)
127          {
128              ResetZoom(animate: true);
129              return;
130          }
131  
132          _image.Scale = DoubleTapScale;
133          MoveTo(-Width * (DoubleTapScale - 1) / 2, -Height * (DoubleTapScale - 1) / 2);
134          SetZoomed(true);
135      }
136  
137      /// <summary>Moves the zoomed image, never so far that an empty edge shows.</summary>
138      private void MoveTo(double x, double y)
139      {
140          _image.TranslationX = Math.Clamp(x, -Width * (_image.Scale - 1), 0);
141          _image.TranslationY = Math.Clamp(y, -Height * (_image.Scale - 1), 0);
142      }
143  
144      private bool _zoomed;
145  
146      private void SetZoomed(bool zoomed)
147      {
148          if (zoomed == _zoomed) return;
149          _zoomed = zoomed;
150  
151          if (zoomed) GestureRecognizers.Add(_pan);
152          else GestureRecognizers.Remove(_pan);
153  
154          ZoomChanged?.Invoke(this, zoomed);
155      }
156  }
```

### NUTrade1/Converters/Converters.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Globalization;
  2  using System.Text;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  
  5  namespace NUTrade1.Converters;
  6  
  7  /// <summary>PascalCase / enum member → spaced words. <c>LikeNew</c> → "Like New".</summary>
  8  public sealed class EnumDisplayConverter : IValueConverter
  9  {
 10      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 11      {
 12          if (value is null) return string.Empty;
 13          var s = value.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
 14          if (s is "Unknown" or "None") return parameter as string ?? string.Empty;
 15          return Humanize(s);
 16      }
 17  
 18      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 19          => throw new NotSupportedException();
 20  
 21      public static string Humanize(string s)
 22      {
 23          var sb = new StringBuilder(s.Length + 4);
 24          for (int i = 0; i < s.Length; i++)
 25          {
 26              var c = s[i];
 27              if (i > 0 && char.IsUpper(c) && !char.IsUpper(s[i - 1])) sb.Append(' ');
 28              sb.Append(c);
 29          }
 30          return sb.ToString();
 31      }
 32  }
 33  
 34  /// <summary>A display name → its first initial (or two), uppercased, for an avatar badge.</summary>
 35  public sealed class InitialsConverter : IValueConverter
 36  {
 37      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 38      {
 39          var name = value as string;
 40          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return parameter as string ?? "NU";
 41  
 42          var parts = name.Trim().Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
 43          var initials = parts.Length >= 2
 44              ? $"{parts[0][0]}{parts[^1][0]}"
 45              : parts[0][..Math.Min(2, parts[0].Length)];
 46          return initials.ToUpperInvariant();
 47      }
 48  
 49      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 50          => throw new NotSupportedException();
 51  }
 52  
 53  /// <summary>
 54  /// The line under a student's name. Bound to a whole <see cref="UserProfile"/>, the
 55  /// program picked at registration wins; accounts from before that fall back to their
 56  /// <see cref="CampusHub"/>. Bound to a <see cref="CampusHub"/>, just its label.
 57  /// </summary>
 58  public sealed class CampusHubProgramConverter : IValueConverter
 59  {
 60      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture) => value switch
 61      {
 62          UserProfile { Program.Length: > 0 } profile => profile.Program,
 63          UserProfile profile => Convert(profile.CampusHub, targetType, parameter, culture),
 64          CampusHub.Engineering => "BS Engineering",
 65          CampusHub.InformationTechnology => "BS Information Technology",
 66          CampusHub.Business => "BS Business Administration",
 67          CampusHub.Education => "Bachelor of Elementary Education",
 68          CampusHub.Nursing => "BS Nursing",
 69          CampusHub.ArtsAndSciences => "BS Arts & Sciences",
 70          _ => "NU–Lipa student",
 71      };
 72  
 73      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 74          => throw new NotSupportedException();
 75  }
 76  
 77  /// <summary><see cref="DateTimeOffset"/>? → "just now" / "18h ago" / "3d ago".</summary>
 78  public sealed class TimeAgoConverter : IValueConverter
 79  {
 80      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 81      {
 82          if (value is not DateTimeOffset when)
 83          {
 84              if (value is DateTime dt) when = new DateTimeOffset(dt.ToUniversalTime(), TimeSpan.Zero);
 85              else return string.Empty;
 86          }
 87  
 88          var delta = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - when;
 89          if (delta < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)) return "just now";
 90          if (delta < TimeSpan.FromHours(1)) return $"{(int)delta.TotalMinutes}m ago";
 91          if (delta < TimeSpan.FromDays(1)) return $"{(int)delta.TotalHours}h ago";
 92          if (delta < TimeSpan.FromDays(7)) return $"{(int)delta.TotalDays}d ago";
 93          return when.ToLocalTime().ToString("MMM d", culture);
 94      }
 95  
 96      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
 97          => throw new NotSupportedException();
 98  }
 99  
100  /// <summary>Inverts a bool.</summary>
101  public sealed class InverseBoolConverter : IValueConverter
102  {
103      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
104          => value is bool b ? !b : value is null;
105  
106      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
107          => value is bool b ? !b : true;
108  }
109  
110  /// <summary>True when the value is a non-empty string / non-null object / non-empty collection.</summary>
111  public sealed class HasValueConverter : IValueConverter
112  {
113      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
114      {
115          var has = value switch
116          {
117              null => false,
118              string s => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s),
119              System.Collections.ICollection c => c.Count > 0,
120              _ => true,
121          };
122          return parameter is "invert" ? !has : has;
123      }
124  
125      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
126          => throw new NotSupportedException();
127  }
128  
129  /// <summary>value.Equals(parameter) → bool, round-tripping the parameter on set (for pill radio groups).</summary>
130  public sealed class EnumEqualsConverter : IValueConverter
131  {
132      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
133      {
134          if (value is null || parameter is null) return false;
135          return string.Equals(value.ToString(), parameter.ToString(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
136      }
137  
138      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
139      {
140          if (value is true && parameter is not null)
141          {
142              var t = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(targetType) ?? targetType;
143              if (t.IsEnum) return Enum.Parse(t, parameter.ToString()!, ignoreCase: true);
144              return parameter;
145          }
146          return Binding.DoNothing;
147      }
148  }

152  {
153      public object? Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
154          => value is IEnumerable<string> items ? items.FirstOrDefault() : null;

193  /// <summary>
194  /// Maps a bool to one of two preset objects (colors, strings, styles). Set
195  /// <see cref="TrueObject"/> / <see cref="FalseObject"/> on the converter instance.
196  /// A non-bool value is treated as truthy when non-null.
197  /// </summary>
198  public sealed class BoolToObjectConverter : IValueConverter
199  {
200      public object? TrueObject { get; set; }
201      public object? FalseObject { get; set; }
202  
203      public object? Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
204          => (value is bool b ? b : value is not null) ? TrueObject : FalseObject;
205  
206      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
207          => Equals(value, TrueObject);

210  /// <summary><see cref="ListingStatus"/> → the seller-facing status line on My listings.</summary>
211  public sealed class ListingStatusTextConverter : IValueConverter
212  {
213      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture) => value switch
214      {
215          ListingStatus.Draft => "● Not posted yet — tap to finish",
216          ListingStatus.PendingPayment => "● Waiting for payment — tap to check",
217          ListingStatus.PendingApproval => "● Pending admin approval",
218          ListingStatus.Active => "● Accepting bids",
219          ListingStatus.Matched => "● Matched with a buyer",
220          ListingStatus.Completed => "● Sold",
221          ListingStatus.Expired => "● Ended",
222          ListingStatus.Cancelled => "● Cancelled",
223          ListingStatus.Rejected => "● Not approved",
224          _ => string.Empty,
225      };

230  
231  /// <summary>
232  /// <see cref="ListingStatus"/> → the colour of its status line: <see cref="Live"/> for an
233  /// auction taking bids, <see cref="Waiting"/> for anything not yet live, and
234  /// <see cref="Closed"/> for everything that has finished or been turned down. Each has a
235  /// <c>*Dark</c> twin picked when the app runs in dark mode — an AppThemeBinding cannot be
236  /// set on a converter's plain CLR properties, so the theme is resolved here instead.
237  /// </summary>
238  public sealed class ListingStatusColorConverter : IValueConverter
239  {
240      public Color Live { get; set; } = Colors.Green;
241      public Color LiveDark { get; set; } = Colors.LightGreen;
242      public Color Waiting { get; set; } = Colors.DarkGoldenrod;
243      public Color WaitingDark { get; set; } = Colors.Goldenrod;
244      public Color Closed { get; set; } = Colors.Gray;
245      public Color ClosedDark { get; set; } = Colors.LightGray;
246  
247      public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
248      {
249          var dark = Application.Current?.RequestedTheme == AppTheme.Dark;
250          return value switch
251          {
252              ListingStatus.Active => dark ? LiveDark : Live,
253              ListingStatus.Draft or ListingStatus.PendingPayment or ListingStatus.PendingApproval => dark ? WaitingDark : Waiting,
254              _ => dark ? ClosedDark : Closed,
255          };
256      }
257  
258      public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
259          => throw new NotSupportedException();
260  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/ImageCache.cs

```csharp
  1  using Microsoft.Maui.Graphics.Platform;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>
  6  /// Downsamples and re-encodes a picked photo into the app's cache directory before it's
  7  /// attached to a draft listing, so a multi-megabyte camera-resolution photo doesn't sit on
  8  /// disk untouched — a 1280px-max JPEG at 80% quality is typically an order of magnitude smaller.
  9  ///
 10  /// The cache is bounded: copies are dropped as soon as a draft is posted or a photo removed,
 11  /// and <see cref="TrimAsync"/> sweeps whatever an interrupted post left behind, so the folder
 12  /// can never grow without limit on a student's phone.
 13  /// </summary>
 14  public static class ImageCache
 15  {
 16      private const float MaxDimension = 1280f;
 17      private const float JpegQuality = 0.8f;
 18      private const string CacheFolderName = "listing-photos";
 19  
 20      /// <summary>Nothing here is needed once a draft is posted, so the sweep is aggressive.</summary>
 21      private static readonly TimeSpan MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);
 22  
 23      /// <summary>At ~200 KB a photo this is a hundred or so, far more than a draft ever holds.</summary>
 24      private const long MaxCacheBytes = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
 25  
 26      public static Task<string> CacheAsync(string sourcePath, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 27          Task.Run(() =>
 28          {
 29              ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
 30  
 31              var cacheDir = CacheDirectory();
 32              var destPath = Path.Combine(cacheDir, $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}.jpg");
 33  
 34              try
 35              {
 36                  using var sourceStream = File.OpenRead(sourcePath);
 37                  using var image = PlatformImage.FromStream(sourceStream);
 38  
 39                  var scale = Math.Min(1f, MaxDimension / Math.Max(image.Width, image.Height));
 40                  using var final = scale < 1f
 41                      ? image.Resize(image.Width * scale, image.Height * scale, ResizeMode.Fit, disposeOriginal: false)
 42                      : image;
 43  
 44                  using var destStream = File.Create(destPath);
 45                  final.Save(destStream, ImageFormat.Jpeg, JpegQuality);
 46              }
 47              catch
 48              {
 49                  // Platform image decoding isn't guaranteed everywhere; fall back to the
 50                  // original file rather than losing the photo the user just picked.
 51                  File.Copy(sourcePath, destPath, overwrite: true);
 52              }
 53  
 54              return destPath;
 55          }, ct);
 56  
 57      /// <summary>Best-effort cleanup when a photo is removed from a draft, or once it's uploaded.</summary>
 58      public static void Delete(string cachedPath)
 59      {
 60          try
 61          {
 62              if (File.Exists(cachedPath)) File.Delete(cachedPath);
 63          }
 64          catch
 65          {
 66              // Not worth surfacing to the user; TrimAsync will catch it later.
 67          }
 68      }
 69  
 70      public static void Delete(IEnumerable<string> cachedPaths)
 71      {
 72          foreach (var path in cachedPaths) Delete(path);
 73      }
 74  
 75      /// <summary>
 76      /// Drops cached photos older than a day, then the oldest of whatever is left until the
 77      /// folder is under the size cap. Runs at startup; failures are ignored on purpose.
 78      /// </summary>
 79      public static Task TrimAsync() => Task.Run(() =>
 80      {
 81          try
 82          {
 83              var files = new DirectoryInfo(CacheDirectory())
 84                  .GetFiles("*.jpg")
 85                  .OrderByDescending(f => f.LastWriteTimeUtc)
 86                  .ToList();
 87  
 88              var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow - MaxAge;
 89              long kept = 0;
 90  
 91              foreach (var file in files)
 92              {
 93                  var tooOld = file.LastWriteTimeUtc < cutoff;
 94                  var overCap = kept + file.Length > MaxCacheBytes;
 95  
 96                  if (tooOld || overCap)
 97                  {
 98                      try { file.Delete(); } catch { /* in use, or already gone */ }
 99                  }
100                  else
101                  {
102                      kept += file.Length;
103                  }
104              }
105          }
106          catch
107          {
108              // No cache directory yet, or the OS cleared it — nothing to do either way.
109          }
110      });
111  
112      private static string CacheDirectory()
113      {
114          var dir = Path.Combine(FileSystem.CacheDirectory, CacheFolderName);
115          Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
116          return dir;
117      }
118  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/NotificationCenter.cs

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>One in-app notification, drawn with the card from the design (image 7).</summary>
 4  public sealed record AppNotification(
 5      string Title,
 6      string Body,
 7      string? ActionText = null,
 8      Func<Task>? Action = null);
 9  
10  /// <summary>
11  /// App-wide queue behind the notification card. Anything can <see cref="Show"/> a
12  /// notification; every page hosts a <c>NotificationHost</c>, and whichever page is on
13  /// screen draws the current one until it is dismissed. Several arriving together are
14  /// shown one after another rather than stacked.
15  /// </summary>
16  public sealed class NotificationCenter
17  {
18      public static NotificationCenter Current { get; } = new();
19  
20      private readonly Queue<AppNotification> _queue = new();
21  
22      /// <summary>What should be on screen now, or null.</summary>
23      public AppNotification? Active { get; private set; }
24  
25      /// <summary>Raised on the UI thread whenever <see cref="Active"/> changes.</summary>
26      public event EventHandler? Changed;
27  
28      public void Show(AppNotification notification) => MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
29      {
30          if (Active is null) Active = notification;
31          else _queue.Enqueue(notification);
32          Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
33      });
34  
35      /// <summary>Closes <paramref name="notification"/> (if it is still the active one) and brings on the next.</summary>
36      public void Dismiss(AppNotification notification) => MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
37      {
38          if (!ReferenceEquals(Active, notification)) return;
39          Active = _queue.Count > 0 ? _queue.Dequeue() : null;
40          Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
41      });
42  
43      /// <summary>Drops everything — used on sign-out so one student never sees another's news.</summary>
44      public void Clear() => MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
45      {
46          _queue.Clear();
47          Active = null;
48          Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
49      });
50  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/QrImageSaver.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Core;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>
  6  /// Gets a payment QR off the screen and into the student's hands, so they can pay from the
  7  /// same phone that shows it: GCash, Maya and most bank apps have an "upload QR" option that
  8  /// reads a picture from the gallery.
  9  /// </summary>
 10  public interface IQrImageSaver
 11  {
 12      /// <summary>
 13      /// Writes the PNG where the platform's photo pickers look — Photos on iOS, the gallery
 14      /// (Pictures/NUTrade) on Android, Pictures\NUTrade on Windows. On success the value is
 15      /// where it went, in words for a toast.
 16      /// </summary>
 17      Task<OperationResult<string>> SaveToGalleryAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, CancellationToken ct = default);
 18  
 19      /// <summary>Opens the share sheet with the QR attached, so it can go straight to a payment app.</summary>
 20      Task<OperationResult> ShareAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, string title, CancellationToken ct = default);
 21  }
 22  
 23  public sealed partial class QrImageSaver : IQrImageSaver
 24  {
 25      private const string AlbumName = "NUTrade";
 26      private const string MimeType = "image/png";
 27  
 28      public async Task<OperationResult<string>> SaveToGalleryAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, CancellationToken ct = default)
 29      {
 30          try
 31          {
 32              return await SavePlatformAsync(png, SafeFileName(fileName), ct);
 33          }
 34          catch (OperationCanceledException)
 35          {
 36              throw;
 37          }
 38          catch (Exception ex)
 39          {
 40              System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"QrImageSaver.SaveToGalleryAsync: {ex}");
 41              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Couldn't save the QR code. Try Share instead.");
 42          }
 43      }
 44  
 45      public async Task<OperationResult> ShareAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, string title, CancellationToken ct = default)
 46      {
 47          try
 48          {
 49              // The share sheet needs a real file; the cache is fine, the OS copies it on send.
 50              var path = Path.Combine(FileSystem.CacheDirectory, SafeFileName(fileName));
 51              await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(path, png, ct);
 52              await MainThread.InvokeOnMainThreadAsync(() =>
 53                  Share.Default.RequestAsync(new ShareFileRequest { Title = title, File = new ShareFile(path, MimeType) }));
 54              return OperationResult.Ok();
 55          }
 56          catch (OperationCanceledException)
 57          {
 58              throw;
 59          }
 60          catch (Exception ex)
 61          {
 62              System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"QrImageSaver.ShareAsync: {ex}");
 63              return OperationResult.Fail("Couldn't open the share sheet.");
 64          }
 65      }
 66  
 67      /// <summary>A name every platform's file system accepts, always ending in .png.</summary>
 68      private static string SafeFileName(string fileName)
 69      {
 70          var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
 71          var cleaned = new string(fileName.Select(c => invalid.Contains(c) ? '-' : c).ToArray()).Trim();
 72          if (cleaned.Length == 0) cleaned = $"nutrade-qr-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}";
 73          return cleaned.EndsWith(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? cleaned : cleaned + ".png";
 74      }
 75  
 76  #if ANDROID
 77      private static async Task<OperationResult<string>> SavePlatformAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, CancellationToken ct)
 78      {
 79          var context = Platform.AppContext;
 80          var resolver = context.ContentResolver
 81              ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No content resolver.");
 82  
 83          if (OperatingSystem.IsAndroidVersionAtLeast(29))
 84          {
 85              // Scoped storage: MediaStore needs no permission for the app's own pictures.
 86              // IS_PENDING hides the entry until the bytes are all written, so a gallery
 87              // never shows a half-saved image.
 88              var values = new Android.Content.ContentValues();
 89              values.Put(Android.Provider.MediaStore.IMediaColumns.DisplayName, fileName);
 90              values.Put(Android.Provider.MediaStore.IMediaColumns.MimeType, MimeType);
 91              values.Put(Android.Provider.MediaStore.IMediaColumns.RelativePath,
 92                  $"{Android.OS.Environment.DirectoryPictures}/{AlbumName}");
 93              values.Put(Android.Provider.MediaStore.IMediaColumns.IsPending, 1);
 94  
 95              var uri = resolver.Insert(Android.Provider.MediaStore.Images.Media.ExternalContentUri!, values)
 96                  ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("MediaStore refused the insert.");
 97              try
 98              {
 99                  await using (var stream = resolver.OpenOutputStream(uri)
100                      ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No output stream."))
101                  {
102                      await stream.WriteAsync(png, ct);
103                  }
104  
105                  values.Clear();
106                  values.Put(Android.Provider.MediaStore.IMediaColumns.IsPending, 0);
107                  resolver.Update(uri, values, null, null);
108              }
109              catch
110              {
111                  resolver.Delete(uri, null, null);
112                  throw;
113              }
114  
115              return OperationResult<string>.Ok($"your gallery (Pictures/{AlbumName})");
116          }
117  
118          // Android 9 and older: the public Pictures folder, behind the storage permission
119          // (declared with maxSdkVersion 28 in the manifest, so newer phones never ask).
120          var status = await MainThread.InvokeOnMainThreadAsync(Permissions.RequestAsync<Permissions.StorageWrite>);
121          if (status != PermissionStatus.Granted)
122              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Allow storage access to save the QR code, or use Share.");
123  
124          var pictures = Android.OS.Environment.GetExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Android.OS.Environment.DirectoryPictures)!;
125          var dir = Path.Combine(pictures.AbsolutePath, AlbumName);
126          Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
127          var path = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
128          await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(path, png, ct);
129          Android.Media.MediaScannerConnection.ScanFile(context, [path], [MimeType], null);
130  
131          return OperationResult<string>.Ok($"your gallery (Pictures/{AlbumName})");
132      }
133  #elif IOS || MACCATALYST
134      private static async Task<OperationResult<string>> SavePlatformAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, CancellationToken ct)
135      {
136          // Add-only access is all saving needs, and is the least a student has to grant.
137          var access = await Photos.PHPhotoLibrary.RequestAuthorizationAsync(Photos.PHAccessLevel.AddOnly);
138          if (access is not (Photos.PHAuthorizationStatus.Authorized or Photos.PHAuthorizationStatus.Limited))
139              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Allow NUTrade to add photos in Settings to save the QR code, or use Share.");
140  
141          var image = UIKit.UIImage.LoadFromData(Foundation.NSData.FromArray(png))
142              ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The QR image couldn't be read.");
143  
144          var done = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
145          Photos.PHPhotoLibrary.SharedPhotoLibrary.PerformChanges(
146              () => Photos.PHAssetChangeRequest.FromImage(image),
147              (ok, error) =>
148              {
149                  if (ok) done.TrySetResult(true);
150                  else done.TrySetException(new InvalidOperationException(error?.LocalizedDescription ?? "Save failed."));
151              });
152  
153          await done.Task.WaitAsync(ct);
154          return OperationResult<string>.Ok("Photos");
155      }
156  #elif WINDOWS
157      private static async Task<OperationResult<string>> SavePlatformAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, CancellationToken ct)
158      {
159          var dir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyPictures), AlbumName);
160          Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
161          await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(Path.Combine(dir, fileName), png, ct);
162          return OperationResult<string>.Ok($@"Pictures\{AlbumName}");
163      }
164  #else
165      private static Task<OperationResult<string>> SavePlatformAsync(byte[] png, string fileName, CancellationToken ct) =>
166          Task.FromResult(OperationResult<string>.Fail("Saving isn't supported here. Use Share instead."));
167  #endif
168  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/StubAuthService.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// Offline stand-in for <see cref="IAuthService"/>, used only when
 7  /// <c>MauiProgram.UseStubServices</c> is on. Accepts any campus-domain email and
 8  /// reports the account as verified, so the UI can be clicked through with no network.
 9  /// </summary>
10  public sealed class StubAuthService : IAuthService
11  {
12      public string? CurrentUid { get; private set; }
13      public string? CurrentEmail { get; private set; }
14      public bool IsSignedIn => CurrentUid is not null;
15      public bool IsVerified { get; private set; }
16  
17      /// <summary>Offline there is only one person at the keyboard, so they review their own
18      /// listings — otherwise the post-an-auction flow could never finish.</summary>
19      public bool IsAdmin => IsSignedIn;
20  
21      public bool IsGoogleSignInAvailable => false;
22  
23      public event EventHandler? AuthStateChanged;
24  
25      public Task RestoreSessionAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => Task.CompletedTask;
26  
27      public Task<OperationResult> SignInWithEmailAsync(string email, string password, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
28          Task.FromResult(StartSession(email));
29  
30      public Task<OperationResult> SignUpWithEmailAsync(string email, string password, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
31          Task.FromResult(StartSession(email));
32  
33      public Task<OperationResult> SignInWithGoogleAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
34          Task.FromResult(OperationResult.Fail("Google sign-in needs a network. Use email and password offline."));
35  
36      public Task RefreshClaimsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default, bool force = false) => Task.CompletedTask;
37  
38      /// <summary>Stands in for verifyEmailOtp granting the claim. See StubEmailVerificationService.</summary>
39      internal void MarkVerified() => IsVerified = true;
40  
41      public Task SignOutAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
42      {
43          CurrentUid = null;
44          CurrentEmail = null;
45          IsVerified = false;
46          AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
47          return Task.CompletedTask;
48      }
49  
50      /// <summary>Emails that finished offline registration, so signing in with one is verified.</summary>
51      private static readonly HashSet<string> RegisteredEmails = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
52  
53      /// <summary>Stands in for completeSignup creating a verified account.</summary>
54      internal static void Register(string email) => RegisteredEmails.Add(email.Trim());
55  
56      /// <summary>The uid an offline session gets for <paramref name="email"/>.</summary>
57      internal static string OfflineUid(string email) => "offline-" + email.Trim().GetHashCode().ToString("x8");
58  
59      private OperationResult StartSession(string email)
60      {
61          if (!NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail(email))
62              return OperationResult.Fail("Enter a valid email address.");
63  
64          CurrentEmail = email.Trim();
65          CurrentUid = OfflineUid(CurrentEmail);
66          IsVerified = RegisteredEmails.Contains(CurrentEmail);
67          AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
68          return OperationResult.Ok();
69      }
70  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/StubDepositService.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// Offline stand-in for <see cref="IDepositService"/>. Mints a fake deposit with no QR and
 7  /// commits it on the second check, so the payment screen's "waiting, then paid" sequence
 8  /// can be clicked through with no network.
 9  /// </summary>
10  public sealed class StubDepositService : IDepositService
11  {
12      private const int DepositPercent = 15;
13  
14      private readonly List<BidDeposit> _deposits = [];
15      private readonly HashSet<string> _checkedOnce = [];
16  
17      public Task<OperationResult<BidDeposit>> RequestBidAsync(
18          string listingId, long amountCentavos, CancellationToken ct = default)
19      {
20          var deposit = new BidDeposit
21          {
22              Id = $"offline-deposit-{_deposits.Count + 1}",
23              ListingId = listingId,
24              ListingTitle = "Offline listing",
25              AmountCentavos = amountCentavos,
26              DepositCentavos = RoundUpToPeso(amountCentavos * DepositPercent / 100),
27              DepositPercent = DepositPercent,
28              Status = DepositStatus.AwaitingPayment,
29              QrExpiresAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(30),
30              CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
31          };
32          _deposits.Add(deposit);
33          return Task.FromResult(OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Ok(deposit));
34      }
35  
36      public Task<OperationResult<BidDeposit>> CheckDepositAsync(
37          string bidIntentId, CancellationToken ct = default)
38      {
39          if (_deposits.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Id == bidIntentId) is not { } deposit)
40              return Task.FromResult(OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Fail("That bid is no longer available."));
41  
42          // First check says "not yet", the second commits — enough to exercise both states.
43          if (deposit.IsAwaitingPayment && !_checkedOnce.Add(bidIntentId))
44          {
45              deposit.Status = DepositStatus.LockedInEscrow;
46              deposit.CommittedBidId = $"offline-bid-{bidIntentId}";
47          }
48  
49          return Task.FromResult(OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Ok(deposit));
50      }
51  
52      public Task<IReadOnlyList<BidDeposit>> GetMyDepositsAsync(int limit = 25, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
53          Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<BidDeposit>>(
54              _deposits.OrderByDescending(d => d.CreatedAt).Take(limit).ToArray());
55  
56      /// <summary>Mirrors depositFor() — students are never asked to scan for stray centavos.</summary>
57      private static long RoundUpToPeso(long centavos) => (long)Math.Ceiling(centavos / 100d) * 100;
58  }
```

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// Offline stand-in for <see cref="IEmailVerificationService"/>. There is no mail
 7  /// server behind it, so it accepts one fixed code — enough to walk the registration
 8  /// flow end to end with no network.
 9  /// </summary>
10  public sealed class StubEmailVerificationService : IEmailVerificationService
11  {
12      /// <summary>The code the offline build always expects.</summary>
13      public const string OfflineCode = "000000";
14  
15      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
16  
17      public StubEmailVerificationService(IAuthService auth) => _auth = auth;
18  
19      public Task<OperationResult<OtpChallenge>> SendCodeAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
20          Task.FromResult(OperationResult<OtpChallenge>.Ok(
21              new OtpChallenge($"{_auth.CurrentEmail} (offline — the code is {OfflineCode})", 600, 0)));
22  
23      public Task<OperationResult> VerifyCodeAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct = default)
24      {
25          if (code.Trim() != OfflineCode)
26              return Task.FromResult(OperationResult.Fail($"Offline builds only accept {OfflineCode}."));
27  
28          if (_auth is StubAuthService stub) stub.MarkVerified();
29          return Task.FromResult(OperationResult.Ok());
30      }
31  }
```

```csharp
14
```

```csharp
 16      public Task<ListingPage> GetActiveFeedAsync(

 23          if (category is { } c) query = query.Where(l => l.Category == c);
 24

 26              .OrderByDescending(l => l.IsPinned)
 27              .ThenByDescending(l => l.PublishedAt ?? l.CreatedAt)
 28              .Take(pageSize)

 38          CreateAuctionRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default)
 39      {

 41          var listing = new Listing
 42          {
 43              Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("n"),
 44              OwnerUid = _auth.CurrentUid ?? string.Empty,

 51              CampusZone = request.CampusZone,

 56              ReservePriceCentavos = request.ReservePriceCentavos,
 57              CurrentHighestBidCentavos = request.StartingBidCentavos,
 58              Status = ListingStatus.Draft,

 60          };

 71

 75              listing.Status = ListingStatus.Cancelled;

 85      /// <summary>Stands in for what <c>createQrPayment</c> does server-side: the fee is
 86      /// settled and the listing joins the admin queue.</summary>
 87      internal void SubmitForApproval(string listingId, ListingPackage package)
 88      {
 89          if (_listings.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Id == listingId) is not { } listing) return;
 90          listing.Status = ListingStatus.PendingApproval;
 91          listing.PaidPackage = package;
 92          listing.SubmittedForApprovalAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
 93      }
 94  
 95      internal IReadOnlyList<Listing> PendingApproval() =>
 96          _listings.Where(l => l.Status == ListingStatus.PendingApproval)
 97                   .OrderBy(l => l.SubmittedForApprovalAt ?? l.CreatedAt)
 98                   .ToArray();
 99  
100      /// <summary>Stands in for <c>approveListing</c>, so the offline post-an-auction flow
101      /// ends with something visible on the feed.</summary>
102      internal void Publish(string listingId)
103      {
104          if (_listings.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Id == listingId) is not { } listing) return;
105          var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
106          listing.Status = ListingStatus.Active;
107          listing.PublishedAt = now;
108          listing.IsPinned = listing.PaidPackage == ListingPackage.Priority;
109          listing.IsVisible = true;
110          listing.AuctionEndsAt = now.AddHours(NUTradeConstants.AuctionDurationHours);
111      }
112  
113      /// <summary>Stands in for <c>rejectListing</c>.</summary>
114      internal void Reject(string listingId, string? reason)
115      {
116          if (_listings.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Id == listingId) is not { } listing) return;
117          listing.Status = ListingStatus.Rejected;
118          listing.RejectionReason = reason;
119      }
120  
121      /// <summary>Mirrors <c>placeBid</c>'s update of the denormalized highest-bid fields.</summary>
122      internal void ApplyBid(string listingId, long amountCentavos, string bidderUid)
123      {
124          if (_listings.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Id == listingId) is not { } listing) return;
125          listing.CurrentHighestBidCentavos = amountCentavos;
126          listing.HighestBidderUid = bidderUid;
127          listing.BidCount++;
128      }
129  
130      private sealed class NoopDisposable : IDisposable
131      {
132          public void Dispose() { }
133      }
134  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/StubWalletService.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Core;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>
  6  /// Offline stand-in for <see cref="IWalletService"/>. Seeded with a balance and a couple
  7  /// of ledger rows so the wallet card, the ledger list and the payout form can all be
  8  /// clicked through with no network; a payout moves the balance in memory and nowhere else.
  9  /// </summary>
 10  public sealed class StubWalletService : IWalletService, IPayoutModerationService
 11  {
 12      private const long MinPayoutCentavos = 10_000;
 13  
 14      private long _balanceCentavos = 24_500;
 15      private readonly List<LedgerEntry> _ledger;
 16      private readonly List<PayoutRequest> _payouts = [];
 17  
 18      public StubWalletService()
 19      {
 20          var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
 21          _ledger =
 22          [
 23              new LedgerEntry
 24              {
 25                  Id = "offline-1", Kind = LedgerKind.DepositCredit, AmountCentavos = 15_000,
 26                  Note = "Handover confirmed", CreatedAt = now.AddDays(-1),
 27              },
 28              new LedgerEntry
 29              {
 30                  Id = "offline-2", Kind = LedgerKind.RefundCredit, AmountCentavos = 9_500,
 31                  Note = "Seller cancelled", CreatedAt = now.AddDays(-4),
 32              },
 33          ];
 34      }
 35  
 36      public Task<Wallet> GetWalletAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 37          Task.FromResult(new Wallet
 38          {
 39              Uid = "offline",
 40              BalanceCentavos = _balanceCentavos,
 41              UpdatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
 42          });
 43  
 44      public Task<IReadOnlyList<LedgerEntry>> GetLedgerAsync(int limit = 25, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 45          Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<LedgerEntry>>(
 46              _ledger.OrderByDescending(e => e.CreatedAt).Take(limit).ToArray());
 47  
 48      public Task<IReadOnlyList<PayoutRequest>> GetMyPayoutsAsync(int limit = 10, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 49          Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<PayoutRequest>>(
 50              _payouts.OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt).Take(limit).ToArray());
 51  
 52      public Task<OperationResult> RequestPayoutAsync(
 53          PayoutDestination destination, CancellationToken ct = default)
 54      {
 55          if (_balanceCentavos < MinPayoutCentavos)
 56          {
 57              return Task.FromResult(OperationResult.Fail(
 58                  $"You need at least {Money.ToDisplay(MinPayoutCentavos)} before you can cash out."));
 59          }
 60  
 61          var amount = _balanceCentavos;
 62          var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
 63  
 64          // Debited on request, as online — the offline build should show the same states.
 65          _balanceCentavos = 0;
 66          _payouts.Add(new PayoutRequest
 67          {
 68              Id = $"offline-payout-{_payouts.Count + 1}",
 69              AmountCentavos = amount,
 70              Method = destination.Method,
 71              AccountName = destination.AccountName,
 72              AccountNumber = destination.AccountNumber,
 73              Status = PayoutStatus.Requested,
 74              CreatedAt = now,
 75          });
 76          _ledger.Add(new LedgerEntry
 77          {
 78              Id = $"offline-ledger-{_ledger.Count + 1}",
 79              Kind = LedgerKind.Payout,
 80              AmountCentavos = -amount,
 81              Note = $"Payout to {destination.Method}",
 82              CreatedAt = now,
 83          });
 84  
 85          return Task.FromResult(OperationResult.Ok());
 86      }
 87  
 88      public Task<IReadOnlyList<PayoutRequest>> GetPendingPayoutsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 89          Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<PayoutRequest>>(
 90              _payouts.Where(p => p.IsPending).OrderBy(p => p.CreatedAt).ToArray());
 91  
 92      public Task<OperationResult> MarkPaidAsync(string payoutRequestId, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 93          Task.FromResult(Resolve(payoutRequestId, PayoutStatus.Paid, null));
 94  
 95      public Task<OperationResult> DeclineAsync(
 96          string payoutRequestId, string? reason, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 97          Task.FromResult(Resolve(payoutRequestId, PayoutStatus.Declined, reason));
 98  
 99      private OperationResult Resolve(string id, PayoutStatus status, string? reason)
100      {
101          if (_payouts.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == id) is not { IsPending: true } payout)
102              return OperationResult.Fail("That request has already been resolved.");
103  
104          payout.Status = status;
105          payout.DeclineReason = reason;
106          payout.ResolvedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
107  
108          if (status == PayoutStatus.Declined)
109          {
110              _balanceCentavos += payout.AmountCentavos;
111              _ledger.Add(new LedgerEntry
112              {
113                  Id = $"offline-ledger-{_ledger.Count + 1}",
114                  Kind = LedgerKind.RefundCredit,
115                  AmountCentavos = payout.AmountCentavos,
116                  Note = reason is { Length: > 0 } r ? $"Payout declined: {r}" : "Payout declined",
117                  CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
118              });
119          }
120  
121          return OperationResult.Ok();
122      }
123  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Toaster.cs

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
  2  
  3  public enum ToastKind
  4  {
  5      Success,
  6      Error,
  7      Info,
  8  }
  9  
 10  /// <summary>One transient message. <see cref="Duration"/> follows the usual mobile rule:
 11  /// something that went wrong stays long enough to read twice.</summary>
 12  public sealed record Toast(ToastKind Kind, string Message)
 13  {
 14      public TimeSpan Duration => Kind == ToastKind.Error
 15          ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)
 16          : TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);
 17  }
 18  
 19  /// <summary>
 20  /// App-wide queue behind the toast that slides in at the top of the screen. Every
 21  /// success, failure and error message in the app goes through here — the ViewModels
 22  /// still set <c>ErrorMessage</c> / <c>InfoMessage</c> as they always did, and
 23  /// <see cref="NUTrade1.ViewModels.BaseViewModel"/> forwards them.
 24  ///
 25  /// Distinct from <see cref="NotificationCenter"/>, which owns the persistent card with an
 26  /// action button — "you won an auction" waits for the student, "check your connection"
 27  /// does not.
 28  /// </summary>
 29  public sealed class Toaster
 30  {
 31      /// <summary>Beyond this a burst is dropped rather than trapping the student behind a
 32      /// queue of toasts they have to wait out.</summary>
 33      private const int MaxQueued = 2;
 34  
 35      public static Toaster Current { get; } = new();
 36  
 37      private readonly Queue<Toast> _queue = new();
 38      private CancellationTokenSource? _countdown;
 39  
 40      /// <summary>What should be on screen now, or null.</summary>
 41      public Toast? Active { get; private set; }
 42  
 43      /// <summary>Raised on the UI thread whenever <see cref="Active"/> changes.</summary>
 44      public event EventHandler? Changed;
 45  
 46      public static void Success(string? message) => Current.Show(ToastKind.Success, message);
 47      public static void Error(string? message) => Current.Show(ToastKind.Error, message);
 48      public static void Info(string? message) => Current.Show(ToastKind.Info, message);
 49  
 50      /// <summary>
 51      /// Queues a message. Null and blank are ignored, which is what makes the
 52      /// <c>ErrorMessage = null</c> that every command runs before its work a no-op rather
 53      /// than an empty toast.
 54      /// </summary>
 55      public void Show(ToastKind kind, string? message)
 56      {
 57          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message)) return;
 58          var toast = new Toast(kind, message.Trim());
 59  
 60          MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
 61          {
 62              // Tapping a failing button twice should re-arm the same toast, not line up a
 63              // second identical one behind it.
 64              if (Active is { } active && active.Kind == toast.Kind && active.Message == toast.Message)
 65              {
 66                  StartCountdown(active);
 67                  return;
 68              }
 69  
 70              if (Active is null)
 71              {
 72                  Active = toast;
 73                  StartCountdown(toast);
 74                  Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
 75                  return;
 76              }
 77  
 78              if (_queue.Count < MaxQueued) _queue.Enqueue(toast);
 79          });
 80      }
 81  
 82      /// <summary>Closes <paramref name="toast"/> if it is still showing, and brings on the next.</summary>
 83      public void Dismiss(Toast toast) => MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
 84      {
 85          if (!ReferenceEquals(Active, toast)) return;
 86  
 87          _countdown?.Cancel();
 88          _countdown = null;
 89  
 90          Active = _queue.Count > 0 ? _queue.Dequeue() : null;
 91          if (Active is { } next) StartCountdown(next);
 92          Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
 93      });
 94  
 95      /// <summary>Drops everything — used on sign-out so one student never sees another's messages.</summary>
 96      public void Clear() => MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
 97      {
 98          _countdown?.Cancel();
 99          _countdown = null;
100          _queue.Clear();
101          Active = null;
102          Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
103      });
104  
105      /// <summary>
106      /// Auto-dismiss lives here rather than in the host control so a toast expires on
107      /// schedule even if the student navigates to a page mid-countdown.
108      /// </summary>
109      private void StartCountdown(Toast toast)
110      {
111          _countdown?.Cancel();
112          var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
113          _countdown = cts;
114  
115          _ = Task.Delay(toast.Duration, cts.Token).ContinueWith(
116              task =>
117              {
118                  if (!task.IsCanceled) Dismiss(toast);
119              },
120              TaskScheduler.Default);
121      }
122  }
```
