### NUTrade1/Services/WinWatcher.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Core;
  2  
  3  namespace NUTrade1.Services;
  4  
  5  /// <summary>
  6  /// Announces won auctions with the notification card, to both sides:
  7  /// the buyer gets "Bid Approved! 🎉 … Pay Now", the seller "You Have a Winner! 🎉 … Open Chat".
  8  ///
  9  /// A won auction is exactly when an order is created (seller approves a bid, or the
 10  /// auction closes on its own), so this watches the signed-in student's orders — every
 11  /// 30 seconds while signed in — and announces each new one once. Which orders were
 12  /// already announced is remembered per account on the device, so nothing repeats
 13  /// across launches.
 14  /// </summary>
 15  public sealed class WinWatcher
 16  {
 17      private static readonly TimeSpan Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
 18  
 19      private readonly IChatService _chats;
 20      private readonly IUserService _users;
 21      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 22      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 23      private CancellationTokenSource? _cts;
 24  
 25      public WinWatcher(IChatService chats, IUserService users, IAuthService auth, INavigationService nav)
 26      {
 27          _chats = chats;
 28          _users = users;
 29          _auth = auth;
 30          _nav = nav;
 31      }
 32  
 33      public void Start()
 34      {
 35          if (_cts is not null) return;
 36          _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
 37          _ = RunAsync(_cts.Token);
 38      }
 39  
 40      public void Stop()
 41      {
 42          _cts?.Cancel();
 43          _cts?.Dispose();
 44          _cts = null;
 45      }
 46  
 47      private async Task RunAsync(CancellationToken ct)
 48      {
 49          while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
 50          {
 51              try
 52              {
 53                  await CheckAsync(ct);
 54              }
 55              catch (OperationCanceledException)
 56              {
 57                  return;
 58              }
 59              catch
 60              {
 61                  // A failed poll is retried next time round; never let it end the loop.
 62              }
 63  
 64              try
 65              {
 66                  await Task.Delay(Interval, ct);
 67              }
 68              catch (OperationCanceledException)
 69              {
 70                  return;
 71              }
 72          }
 73      }
 74  
 75      private async Task CheckAsync(CancellationToken ct)
 76      {
 77          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return;
 78  
 79          var key = $"nutrade.announcedWins.{uid}";
 80          var firstRun = !Preferences.ContainsKey(key);
 81          var announced = Preferences.Get(key, string.Empty)
 82              .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
 83              .ToHashSet();
 84  
 85          var fresh = (await _chats.GetMyChatsAsync(ct))
 86              .Where(c => !announced.Contains(c.Id))
 87              .OrderBy(c => c.LastMessageAt ?? DateTimeOffset.MinValue)
 88              .ToList();
 89          if (fresh.Count == 0) return;
 90  
 91          foreach (var chat in fresh)
 92          {
 93              announced.Add(chat.Id);
 94              // On a fresh install only trades still in progress are announced — not every
 95              // chat this account ever had.
 96              if (firstRun && chat.CompletedBy.Count > 0) continue;
 97              await AnnounceAsync(chat, uid, ct);
 98          }
 99  
100          Preferences.Set(key, string.Join(',', announced));
101      }
102  
103      private async Task AnnounceAsync(Chat chat, string uid, CancellationToken ct)
104      {
105          var openChat = () => _nav.GoToAsync(
106              Routes.ChatRoom, new Dictionary<string, object> { ["chatId"] = chat.Id });
107  
108          if (chat.BuyerUid == uid)
109          {
110              var seller = await _users.GetProfileAsync(chat.SellerUid, ct);
111              var sellerName = seller?.DisplayName is { Length: > 0 } n ? n : "The seller";
112              NotificationCenter.Current.Show(new AppNotification(
113                  "You Won! 🎉",
114                  $"You won {chat.ListingTitle} at {Money.ToDisplay(chat.WinningBidCentavos)}. Your deposit is held — " +
115                  $"agree a campus meetup with {sellerName} and pay the rest there.",
116                  "Open Chat",
117                  openChat));
118          }
119          else if (chat.SellerUid == uid)
120          {
121              var buyer = await _users.GetProfileAsync(chat.BuyerUid, ct);
122              var buyerName = buyer?.DisplayName is { Length: > 0 } b ? b : "A student";
123              NotificationCenter.Current.Show(new AppNotification(
124                  "You Have a Winner! 🎉",
125                  $"{buyerName} won {chat.ListingTitle} at {Money.ToDisplay(chat.WinningBidCentavos)}. Their deposit is " +
126                  "held and pays out to you once you both confirm the handover.",
127                  "Open Chat",
128                  openChat));
129          }
130      }
131  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/EmailVerificationService.cs

```csharp
 1  using System.Text.Json;
 2  using NUTrade1.Core;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 5  
 6  /// <summary>
 7  /// <see cref="IEmailVerificationService"/> over the <c>sendEmailOtp</c> /
 8  /// <c>verifyEmailOtp</c> callables.
 9  ///
10  /// Kept out of <see cref="FirebaseAuthService"/> on purpose: that class is the
11  /// <see cref="IFirebaseTokenProvider"/> every transport depends on, so having it depend
12  /// on <see cref="FunctionsClient"/> in turn would close a dependency cycle.
13  /// </summary>
14  public sealed class EmailVerificationService : IEmailVerificationService
15  {
16      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
17      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
18  
19      public EmailVerificationService(FunctionsClient functions, IAuthService auth)
20      {
21          _functions = functions;
22          _auth = auth;
23      }
24  
25      public async Task<OperationResult<OtpChallenge>> SendCodeAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
26      {
27          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("sendEmailOtp", new { }, ct);
28          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<OtpChallenge>.Fail(result.Error!);
29  
30          var payload = result.Value;
31          var sentTo = payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && payload.TryGetProperty("sentTo", out var to)
32              ? to.GetString() ?? "your email"
33              : "your email";
34  
35          return OperationResult<OtpChallenge>.Ok(new OtpChallenge(
36              sentTo,
37              ReadInt(payload, "expiresInSeconds", 600),
38              ReadInt(payload, "resendAfterSeconds", 60)));
39      }
40  
41      public async Task<OperationResult> VerifyCodeAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct = default)
42      {
43          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("verifyEmailOtp", new { code = code.Trim() }, ct);
44          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
45  
46          // The claim was granted server-side a moment ago, but this session is still
47          // holding the ID token it was issued at sign-in. Without this the app would keep
48          // believing the account is unverified until the token happened to expire.
49          await _auth.RefreshClaimsAsync(ct, force: true);
50  
51          return OperationResult.Ok();
52      }
53  
54      private static int ReadInt(JsonElement payload, string name, int fallback) =>
55          payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
56          && payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
57          && value.TryGetInt32(out var parsed)
58              ? parsed
59              : fallback;
60  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirebaseAuthService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Net.Http.Json;
  2  using System.Text;
  3  using System.Text.Json;
  4  using NUTrade1.Core;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>
  9  /// <see cref="IAuthService"/> over the Firebase Auth REST API (Identity Toolkit).
 10  ///
 11  /// Deliberately transport-level rather than a native SDK binding: the same code
 12  /// then runs on every head this app targets, Windows included, which keeps the
 13  /// desktop debug loop usable. The refresh token is the only thing persisted, in
 14  /// <see cref="SecureStorage"/>; ID tokens are short-lived and stay in memory.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  public sealed class FirebaseAuthService : IAuthService, IFirebaseTokenProvider
 17  {
 18      private const string RefreshTokenKey = "nutrade.refresh_token";
 19  
 20      /// <summary>Refresh this far ahead of expiry so an in-flight request can't age out mid-call.</summary>
 21      private static readonly TimeSpan RefreshSkew = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 22  
 23      /// <summary>
 24      /// How stale the claims may be before <see cref="RefreshClaimsAsync"/> goes to the
 25      /// network. Profile calls it on every appearance, and an unconditional refresh there
 26      /// meant a securetoken round trip — plus the AuthStateChanged it raises, which makes
 27      /// the Shell re-evaluate its gate — every single time the tab was opened. A minute is
 28      /// well inside how fast an admin revocation needs to land.
 29      /// </summary>
 30      private static readonly TimeSpan ClaimsFreshFor = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1);
 31  
 32      private readonly HttpClient _http;
 33      private readonly IGoogleAuthBroker _google;
 34      private readonly SemaphoreSlim _refreshLock = new(1, 1);
 35  
 36      private string? _idToken;
 37      private string? _refreshToken;
 38      private DateTimeOffset _expiresAt;
 39      private DateTimeOffset _claimsReadAt;
 40      private Dictionary<string, JsonElement> _claims = new();
 41  
 42      public FirebaseAuthService(HttpClient http, IGoogleAuthBroker google)
 43      {
 44          _http = http;
 45          _google = google;
 46      }
 47  
 48      public string? CurrentUid { get; private set; }
 49      public string? CurrentEmail { get; private set; }
 50      public bool IsSignedIn => CurrentUid is not null;
 51  
 52      public bool IsGoogleSignInAvailable => _google.IsConfigured;
 53  
 54      public bool IsVerified =>
 55          _claims.TryGetValue("verified", out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True;
 56  
 57      /// <summary>True when the signed-in account carries the admin role claim.</summary>
 58      public bool IsAdmin =>
 59          _claims.TryGetValue("role", out var r) && r.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String && r.GetString() == "admin";
 60  
 61      public event EventHandler? AuthStateChanged;
 62  
 63      public async Task RestoreSessionAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 64      {
 65          if (IsSignedIn) return;
 66  
 67          var stored = await ReadStoredRefreshTokenAsync();
 68          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stored)) return;
 69  
 70          _refreshToken = stored;
 71          try
 72          {
 73              await RefreshAsync(ct);
 74              AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
 75          }
 76          catch
 77          {
 78              // A revoked or expired refresh token just means "signed out" — clear it
 79              // and let the Shell gate route to Login.
 80              await ClearSessionAsync();
 81          }
 82      }
 83  
 84      public Task<OperationResult> SignInWithEmailAsync(string email, string password, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 85          AuthenticateAsync("signInWithPassword", email, password, ct);
 86  
 87      public async Task<OperationResult> SignUpWithEmailAsync(string email, string password, CancellationToken ct = default)
 88      {
 89          if (!NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail(email))
 90              return OperationResult.Fail("Enter a valid email address.");
 91  
 92          return await AuthenticateAsync("signUp", email, password, ct);
 93      }
 94  
 95      public async Task<OperationResult> SignInWithGoogleAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 96      {
 97          var token = await _google.GetIdTokenAsync(ct);
 98          if (!token.Succeeded) return OperationResult.Fail(token.Error!);
 99  
100          // Hand Google's assertion to Firebase, which mints its own session for it and
101          // links or creates the NUTrade account behind the same email.
102          var url = $"{FirebaseSettings.IdentityToolkit}:signInWithIdp?key={FirebaseSettings.ApiKey}";
103          var payload = new
104          {
105              postBody = $"id_token={token.Value}&providerId=google.com",
106              requestUri = "http://localhost",
107              returnSecureToken = true,
108          };
109  
110          try
111          {
112              using var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, payload, ct);
113              using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
114  
115              if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return OperationResult.Fail(DescribeError(doc.RootElement));
116  
117              var root = doc.RootElement;
118              ApplyTokens(
119                  root.GetProperty("idToken").GetString()!,
120                  root.GetProperty("refreshToken").GetString()!,
121                  int.Parse(root.GetProperty("expiresIn").GetString()!));
122  
123              await SaveRefreshTokenAsync(_refreshToken!);
124              AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
125              return OperationResult.Ok();
126          }
127          catch (HttpRequestException)
128          {
129              return OperationResult.Fail("Can't reach NUTrade right now. Check your connection.");
130          }
131      }
132  
133      /// <summary>
134      /// Re-reads the claims, skipping the network when they were read moments ago. Pass
135      /// <paramref name="force"/> when the caller has just changed them server-side and
136      /// needs the new value now — verifying an email, for instance.
137      /// </summary>
138      public async Task RefreshClaimsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default, bool force = false)
139      {
140          if (_refreshToken is null) return;
141          if (!force && DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - _claimsReadAt < ClaimsFreshFor) return;
142  
143          await RefreshAsync(ct);
144          AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
145      }
146  
147      public async Task SignOutAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
148      {
149          await ClearSessionAsync();
150          AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
151      }
152  
153      public async Task<string?> GetIdTokenAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
154      {
155          if (_refreshToken is null) return null;
156          if (_idToken is not null && DateTimeOffset.UtcNow < _expiresAt - RefreshSkew) return _idToken;
157  
158          await _refreshLock.WaitAsync(ct);
159          try
160          {
161              // Another caller may have refreshed while we waited.
162              if (_idToken is not null && DateTimeOffset.UtcNow < _expiresAt - RefreshSkew) return _idToken;
163              await RefreshAsync(ct);
164              return _idToken;
165          }
166          catch
167          {
168              return null;
169          }
170          finally
171          {
172              _refreshLock.Release();
173          }
174      }
175  
176      private async Task<OperationResult> AuthenticateAsync(
177          string endpoint, string email, string password, CancellationToken ct)
178      {
179          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
180              return OperationResult.Fail("Enter your email and password.");
181  
182          var url = $"{FirebaseSettings.IdentityToolkit}:{endpoint}?key={FirebaseSettings.ApiKey}";
183          var payload = new { email = email.Trim(), password, returnSecureToken = true };
184  
185          try
186          {
187              using var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, payload, ct);
188              using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
189  
190              if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
191                  return OperationResult.Fail(DescribeError(doc.RootElement));
192  
193              var root = doc.RootElement;
194              ApplyTokens(
195                  root.GetProperty("idToken").GetString()!,
196                  root.GetProperty("refreshToken").GetString()!,
197                  int.Parse(root.GetProperty("expiresIn").GetString()!));
198  
199              await SaveRefreshTokenAsync(_refreshToken!);
200              AuthStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
201              return OperationResult.Ok();
202          }
203          catch (HttpRequestException)
204          {
205              return OperationResult.Fail("Can't reach NUTrade right now. Check your connection.");
206          }
207      }
208  
209      /// <summary>Exchanges the refresh token for a fresh ID token. Throws if the token is dead.</summary>
210      private async Task RefreshAsync(CancellationToken ct)
211      {
212          var url = $"{FirebaseSettings.SecureTokenEndpoint}?key={FirebaseSettings.ApiKey}";
213          using var content = new FormUrlEncodedContent(new Dictionary<string, string>
214          {
215              ["grant_type"] = "refresh_token",
216              ["refresh_token"] = _refreshToken!,
217          });
218  
219          using var response = await _http.PostAsync(url, content, ct);
220          response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
221  
222          using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
223          var root = doc.RootElement;
224  
225          ApplyTokens(
226              root.GetProperty("id_token").GetString()!,
227              root.GetProperty("refresh_token").GetString()!,
228              int.Parse(root.GetProperty("expires_in").GetString()!));
229  
230          await SaveRefreshTokenAsync(_refreshToken!);
231      }
232  
233      private void ApplyTokens(string idToken, string refreshToken, int expiresInSeconds)
234      {
235          _idToken = idToken;
236          _refreshToken = refreshToken;
237          _expiresAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddSeconds(expiresInSeconds);
238          _claims = ReadClaims(idToken);
239          _claimsReadAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
240  
241          CurrentUid = _claims.TryGetValue("user_id", out var uid) ? uid.GetString()
242              : _claims.TryGetValue("sub", out var sub) ? sub.GetString()
243              : null;
244          CurrentEmail = _claims.TryGetValue("email", out var email) ? email.GetString() : null;
245      }
246  
247      private async Task ClearSessionAsync()
248      {
249          _idToken = null;
250          _refreshToken = null;
251          _expiresAt = default;
252          _claims = new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>();
253          _claimsReadAt = default;
254          CurrentUid = null;
255          CurrentEmail = null;
256          await SaveRefreshTokenAsync(null);
257      }
258  
259      /// <summary>
260      /// Reads the ID token's payload segment. The token was minted by Google and is
261      /// re-verified server-side on every call, so the client decodes it purely to know
262      /// which UI to show — it is never the basis of an authorisation decision here.
263      /// </summary>
264      private static Dictionary<string, JsonElement> ReadClaims(string idToken)
265      {
266          var parts = idToken.Split('.');
267          if (parts.Length < 2) return new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>();
268  
269          var payload = parts[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/');
270          payload = payload.PadRight(payload.Length + (4 - payload.Length % 4) % 4, '=');
271  
272          try
273          {
274              var json = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(payload));
275              return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, JsonElement>>(json)
276                     ?? new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>();
277          }
278          catch
279          {
280              return new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>();
281          }
282      }
283  
284      /// <summary>Turns Identity Toolkit's SCREAMING_SNAKE codes into something a student can act on.</summary>
285      private static string DescribeError(JsonElement root)
286      {
287          var code = root.TryGetProperty("error", out var error) && error.TryGetProperty("message", out var message)
288              ? message.GetString() ?? string.Empty
289              : string.Empty;
290  
291          // WEAK_PASSWORD arrives as "WEAK_PASSWORD : Password should be at least 6 characters".
292          var key = code.Split(':')[0].Trim();
293  
294          return key switch
295          {
296              "EMAIL_EXISTS" => "That email already has an account — sign in instead.",
297              "EMAIL_NOT_FOUND" or "INVALID_PASSWORD" or "INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS" =>
298                  "Email or password is incorrect.",
299              "INVALID_EMAIL" => "That doesn't look like a valid email address.",
300              "WEAK_PASSWORD" => "Password must be at least 6 characters.",
301              "USER_DISABLED" => "This account has been disabled. Contact the NUTrade admins.",
302              "TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS_TRY_LATER" => "Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.",
303              "OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED" or "CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND" =>
304                  "Email sign-in isn't enabled on this Firebase project yet.",
305              _ => string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) ? "Sign-in failed. Try again." : $"Sign-in failed ({key}).",
306          };
307      }
308  
309      /// <summary>
310      /// SecureStorage is unavailable on some desktop configurations; a failure there
311      /// costs the user a re-login on next launch, which is preferable to crashing.
312      /// </summary>
313      private static async Task SaveRefreshTokenAsync(string? token)
314      {
315          try
316          {
317              if (token is null) SecureStorage.Default.Remove(RefreshTokenKey);
318              else await SecureStorage.Default.SetAsync(RefreshTokenKey, token);
319          }
320          catch
321          {
322              // Ignored — session simply won't persist across launches.
323          }
324      }
325  
326      private static async Task<string?> ReadStoredRefreshTokenAsync()
327      {
328          try
329          {
330              return await SecureStorage.Default.GetAsync(RefreshTokenKey);
331          }
332          catch
333          {
334              return null;
335          }
336      }
337  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirebaseSettings.cs

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  2  
  3  /// <summary>
  4  /// Client configuration for the <c>nutrade-a25c7</c> Firebase project.
  5  ///
  6  /// None of these are secrets. A Firebase Web API key is a public project
  7  /// identifier — it authorises nothing on its own, and every read and write it
  8  /// fronts is gated by <c>firestore.rules</c> and the signed-in user's ID token.
  9  /// It is the same material Firebase ships inside <c>google-services.json</c>.
 10  /// The values that <em>are</em> secret (the PayMongo keys, the admin bootstrap
 11  /// secret) live in Secret Manager and are only ever read by Cloud Functions.
 12  /// </summary>
 13  public static class FirebaseSettings
 14  {
 15      public const string ProjectId = "nutrade-a25c7";
 16      public const string ApiKey = "AIzaSyDXWnLMuCkcnVUeNRnJLmeRVVXDZ7KXWXo";
 17      public const string StorageBucket = "nutrade-a25c7.firebasestorage.app";
 18  
 19      /// <summary>Region every Cloud Function in <c>functions/</c> deploys to.</summary>
 20      public const string FunctionsRegion = "asia-southeast1";
 21  
 22      /// <summary>Root of the Firestore REST surface, below which document paths are appended.</summary>
 23      public const string FirestoreDocuments =
 24          $"https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{ProjectId}/databases/(default)/documents";
 25  
 26      public const string IdentityToolkit = "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts";
 27  
 28      public const string SecureTokenEndpoint = "https://securetoken.googleapis.com/v1/token";
 29  
 30      public static string FunctionUrl(string name) =>
 31          $"https://{FunctionsRegion}-{ProjectId}.cloudfunctions.net/{name}";
 32  
 33      public static string StorageObjectUrl(string objectPath) =>
 34          $"https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/{StorageBucket}/o/{Uri.EscapeDataString(objectPath)}";
 35  
 36      /// <summary>
 37      /// How often a page-owned observer re-reads a document it is watching. The REST
 38      /// transport has no snapshot listener, so <c>ObserveListing</c> / <c>ObserveMessages</c>
 39      /// poll — short enough that a competing bid or an incoming message shows up while
 40      /// you are looking at the screen, long enough not to burn quota.
 41      /// </summary>
 42      public static readonly TimeSpan ObservePollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
 43  }
 44  
 45  /// <summary>
 46  /// Google OAuth client configuration for "Continue with Google".
 47  ///
 48  /// These are per-platform and are NOT created by enabling the Google provider in the
 49  /// Firebase console alone — the console makes a Web client for the JS SDK, which is not
 50  /// what a native app uses. Create the clients under
 51  /// APIs &amp; Services → Credentials in the Google Cloud console for project
 52  /// <c>nutrade-a25c7</c> and paste the ids here.
 53  ///
 54  /// Like the Firebase API key these are public identifiers, not secrets: the desktop
 55  /// client secret in particular is explicitly non-confidential in Google's installed-app
 56  /// flow, which is why PKCE carries the actual security.
 57  ///
 58  /// <para>
 59  /// <b>The desktop (Windows / Mac Catalyst) flow needs nothing but the id below</b> — it
 60  /// catches the redirect on a loopback socket. The mobile flows additionally need the
 61  /// redirect scheme registered with the OS, which cannot be added until the client ids
 62  /// exist because the scheme is derived from them:
 63  /// </para>
 64  /// <list type="bullet">
 65  /// <item><description>
 66  /// <b>Android</b> — add a <c>WebAuthenticatorCallbackActivity</c> subclass under
 67  /// <c>Platforms/Android/</c> carrying
 68  /// <c>[IntentFilter([Intent.ActionView], Categories = [Intent.CategoryDefault, Intent.CategoryBrowsable], DataScheme = "&lt;reversed client id&gt;")]</c>.
 69  /// <c>DataScheme</c> must be a compile-time constant, so paste the reversed id literally.
 70  /// </description></item>
 71  /// <item><description>
 72  /// <b>iOS</b> — add the same reversed id to <c>CFBundleURLSchemes</c> in
 73  /// <c>Platforms/iOS/Info.plist</c>.
 74  /// </description></item>
 75  /// </list>
 76  /// <para>
 77  /// Until an id is filled in for the running platform, <see cref="IsConfigured"/> is false
 78  /// and the app hides the Google button rather than offering a flow that cannot complete.
 79  /// </para>
 80  /// </summary>
 81  public static class GoogleOAuth
 82  {
 83      /// <summary>"Desktop app" client — used by the loopback flow on Windows and Mac Catalyst.</summary>
 84      public const string DesktopClientId = "";
 85      public const string DesktopClientSecret = "";
 86  
 87      /// <summary>"Android" client — needs the package name and your signing SHA-1.</summary>
 88      public const string AndroidClientId = "";
 89  
 90      /// <summary>"iOS" client — needs the bundle id.</summary>
 91      public const string IosClientId = "";
 92  
 93      public const string AuthorizationEndpoint = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth";
 94      public const string TokenEndpoint = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token";
 95  
 96      /// <summary>`openid` is the one that matters — it is what makes Google return an id_token.</summary>
 97      public const string Scopes = "openid email profile";
 98  
 99      public static bool IsConfigured =>
100  #if ANDROID
101          !string.IsNullOrEmpty(AndroidClientId);
102  #elif IOS
103          !string.IsNullOrEmpty(IosClientId);
104  #else
105          !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DesktopClientId);
106  #endif
107  
108      public static string ClientId =>
109  #if ANDROID
110          AndroidClientId;
111  #elif IOS
112          IosClientId;
113  #else
114          DesktopClientId;
115  #endif
116  
117      /// <summary>
118      /// Mobile clients redirect to their own reversed client id; the desktop flow uses a
119      /// loopback address chosen at runtime, so it supplies its own.
120      /// </summary>
121      public static string? MobileRedirectUri =>
122  #if ANDROID || IOS
123          $"{string.Join(".", ClientId.Split('.').Reverse())}:/oauth2redirect";
124  #else
125          null;
126  #endif
127  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirebaseStorageService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Net.Http.Headers;
  2  using System.Text.Json;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  
  5  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  6  
  7  /// <summary>
  8  /// <see cref="IStorageService"/> over the Firebase Storage REST API.
  9  ///
 10  /// Uploads land under <c>listings/{uid}/...</c> or <c>ids/{uid}/...</c> and are
 11  /// governed by <c>storage.rules</c>, which is what keeps one student from writing
 12  /// into another's folder or from uploading a 40MB "photo". The returned download URL
 13  /// carries the object's own access token, which is the form the listing document
 14  /// stores and the feed binds to.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  public sealed class FirebaseStorageService : IStorageService
 17  {
 18      /// <summary>Matches the ceiling enforced in storage.rules.</summary>
 19      private const long MaxUploadBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
 20  
 21      private readonly HttpClient _http;
 22      private readonly IFirebaseTokenProvider _tokens;
 23  
 24      public FirebaseStorageService(HttpClient http, IFirebaseTokenProvider tokens)
 25      {
 26          _http = http;
 27          _tokens = tokens;
 28      }
 29  
 30      public async Task<OperationResult<string>> UploadAsync(
 31          string folder, string localFilePath, CancellationToken ct = default)
 32      {
 33          var token = await _tokens.GetIdTokenAsync(ct);
 34          if (token is null) return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
 35  
 36          if (!File.Exists(localFilePath))
 37              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("That photo is no longer on this device.");
 38  
 39          var info = new FileInfo(localFilePath);
 40          if (info.Length > MaxUploadBytes)
 41              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("That photo is too large — keep it under 8 MB.");
 42  
 43          var extension = Path.GetExtension(localFilePath);
 44          var objectPath = $"{folder.Trim('/')}/{Guid.NewGuid():n}{extension}";
 45  
 46          var url = $"https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/{FirebaseSettings.StorageBucket}/o"
 47                    + $"?uploadType=media&name={Uri.EscapeDataString(objectPath)}";
 48  
 49          try
 50          {
 51              await using var stream = File.OpenRead(localFilePath);
 52              using var content = new StreamContent(stream);
 53              content.Headers.ContentType = new MediaTypeHeaderValue(ContentTypeFor(extension));
 54  
 55              using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, url) { Content = content };
 56              request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
 57  
 58              using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
 59              if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
 60              {
 61                  return OperationResult<string>.Fail(
 62                      response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden
 63                          ? "You don't have permission to upload that yet."
 64                          : "Could not upload your photo. Try again.");
 65              }
 66  
 67              using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
 68  
 69              // Firebase mints a per-object download token; the public URL is only usable
 70              // with it, which is why it has to be read back off the upload response.
 71              var downloadToken = doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("downloadTokens", out var t)
 72                  ? t.GetString()
 73                  : null;
 74  
 75              var downloadUrl = FirebaseSettings.StorageObjectUrl(objectPath) + "?alt=media"
 76                                + (downloadToken is null ? string.Empty : $"&token={downloadToken}");
 77  
 78              return OperationResult<string>.Ok(downloadUrl);
 79          }
 80          catch (HttpRequestException)
 81          {
 82              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Can't reach NUTrade right now. Check your connection.");
 83          }
 84          catch (IOException)
 85          {
 86              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Could not read that photo from your device.");
 87          }
 88      }
 89  
 90      public async Task<OperationResult> DeleteAsync(string downloadUrl, CancellationToken ct = default)
 91      {
 92          var token = await _tokens.GetIdTokenAsync(ct);
 93          if (token is null) return OperationResult.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
 94  
 95          // Strip the query string: the object endpoint is the same URL without ?alt=media.
 96          var objectUrl = downloadUrl.Split('?')[0];
 97  
 98          using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Delete, objectUrl);
 99          request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
100  
101          try
102          {
103              using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
104              return response.IsSuccessStatusCode
105                  ? OperationResult.Ok()
106                  : OperationResult.Fail("Could not delete that photo.");
107          }
108          catch (HttpRequestException)
109          {
110              return OperationResult.Fail("Can't reach NUTrade right now.");
111          }
112      }
113  
114      private static string ContentTypeFor(string extension) => extension.ToLowerInvariant() switch
115      {
116          ".png" => "image/png",
117          ".gif" => "image/gif",
118          ".webp" => "image/webp",
119          ".heic" => "image/heic",
120          _ => "image/jpeg",
121      };
122  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreBidService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Text.Json;
  2  using NUTrade1.Core;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// <see cref="IBidService"/> split across both transports, and that split is the
  8  /// whole point: reads come straight from the <c>listings/{id}/bids</c> subcollection,
  9  /// while every mutation is a Cloud Function call. firestore.rules denies all client
 10  /// writes to that subcollection, because a bid has to be validated against the current
 11  /// highest bid inside a transaction — something a client can never do honestly.
 12  /// </summary>
 13  public sealed class FirestoreBidService : IBidService
 14  {
 15      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 16      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
 17      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 18  
 19      public FirestoreBidService(FirestoreClient firestore, FunctionsClient functions, IAuthService auth)
 20      {
 21          _firestore = firestore;
 22          _functions = functions;
 23          _auth = auth;
 24      }
 25  
 26      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Bid>> GetBidsForListingAsync(
 27          string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 28      {
 29          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listingId)) return Array.Empty<Bid>();
 30  
 31          var query = Q.Build(
 32              Q.From("bids"),
 33              orderBy: new[] { Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true) },
 34              limit: 50);
 35  
 36          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync($"listings/{listingId}", query, ct);
 37          return documents.Select(d => Map(d, listingId)).ToArray();
 38      }
 39  
 40      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Bid>> GetMyBidsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 41      {
 42          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return Array.Empty<Bid>();
 43  
 44          // A collection-group query: my bids live one per listing, scattered across
 45          // every listings/{id}/bids subcollection.
 46          var query = Q.Build(
 47              Q.From("bids", allDescendants: true),
 48              Q.Equal("bidderUid", Fs.Str(uid)),
 49              new[] { Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true) },
 50              limit: 50);
 51  
 52          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 53          return documents.Select(d => Map(d, null)).ToArray();
 54      }
 55  
 56      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Bid>> GetIncomingBidsAsync(
 57          string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 58      {
 59          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listingId)) return Array.Empty<Bid>();
 60  
 61          var query = Q.Build(
 62              Q.From("bids"),
 63              Q.Equal("status", FsLower.Enum(BidStatus.Pending)),
 64              new[] { Q.OrderBy("amountCentavos", descending: true) },
 65              limit: 20);
 66  
 67          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync($"listings/{listingId}", query, ct);
 68          return documents.Select(d => Map(d, listingId)).ToArray();
 69      }
 70  
 71      public Task<OperationResult> ApproveBidAsync(string listingId, string bidId, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 72          CallBidActionAsync("approveBid", listingId, bidId, ct);
 73  
 74      public Task<OperationResult> DeclineBidAsync(string listingId, string bidId, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 75          CallBidActionAsync("declineBid", listingId, bidId, ct);
 76  
 77      public Task<OperationResult> WithdrawBidAsync(string listingId, string bidId, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 78          CallBidActionAsync("withdrawBid", listingId, bidId, ct);
 79  
 80      private async Task<OperationResult> CallBidActionAsync(
 81          string function, string listingId, string bidId, CancellationToken ct)
 82      {
 83          var result = await _functions.CallAsync(function, new { listingId, bidId }, ct);
 84          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
 85      }
 86  
 87      /// <summary>
 88      /// Maps a bid document. <paramref name="listingId"/> is supplied when the caller
 89      /// already knows it; a collection-group result instead carries it as a denormalized
 90      /// field, written by <c>placeBid</c> precisely so My Bids can join back to listings.
 91      /// </summary>
 92      internal static Bid Map(JsonElement document, string? listingId)
 93      {
 94          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
 95          return new Bid
 96          {
 97              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
 98              ListingId = listingId ?? Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingId"),
 99              BidderUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "bidderUid"),
100              BidderName = Fs.StringOr(fields, "bidderName", "NU student"),
101              AmountCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "amountCentavos"),
102              Status = Fs.Enum(fields, "status", BidStatus.Pending),
103              ChatId = Fs.String(fields, "chatId"),
104              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt") ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
105          };
106      }
107  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreChatService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Text.Json;
  2  using NUTrade1.Core;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// <see cref="IChatService"/> over <c>chats/{chatId}</c> and its <c>messages</c>
  8  /// subcollection.
  9  ///
 10  /// A chat room is never created by this class — <c>awardListing</c> opens one when an
 11  /// auction is won, which is why the chat document itself is read-only to clients.
 12  /// Participants may append their own messages; <c>onChatMessageCreated</c> mirrors the
 13  /// latest one onto the parent for the chat-list preview, and only a Function may post
 14  /// as <c>system</c> or close the trade out.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  public sealed class FirestoreChatService : IChatService
 17  {
 18      /// <summary>Messages poll faster than the rest — a conversation at 5s intervals feels broken.</summary>
 19      private static readonly TimeSpan MessagePollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);
 20  
 21      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 22      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
 23      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 24  
 25      public FirestoreChatService(FirestoreClient firestore, FunctionsClient functions, IAuthService auth)
 26      {
 27          _firestore = firestore;
 28          _functions = functions;
 29          _auth = auth;
 30      }
 31  
 32      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Chat>> GetMyChatsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 33      {
 34          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return Array.Empty<Chat>();
 35  
 36          var query = Q.Build(
 37              Q.From("chats"),
 38              Q.ArrayContains("participantUids", Fs.Str(uid)),
 39              new[] { Q.OrderBy("lastMessageAt", descending: true) },
 40              limit: 50);
 41  
 42          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 43          return documents.Select(Map).ToArray();
 44      }
 45  
 46      public async Task<Chat?> GetChatAsync(string chatId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 47      {
 48          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chatId)) return null;
 49          var document = await _firestore.GetDocumentAsync($"chats/{chatId}", ct);
 50          return document is { } doc ? Map(doc) : null;
 51      }
 52  
 53      public async Task<OperationResult> SendMessageAsync(
 54          string chatId, string text, CancellationToken ct = default)
 55      {
 56          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return OperationResult.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
 57  
 58          var trimmed = text.Trim();
 59          if (trimmed.Length == 0) return OperationResult.Fail("Type a message first.");
 60          if (trimmed.Length > 2000) return OperationResult.Fail("That message is too long.");
 61  
 62          var fields = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 63          {
 64              ["senderUid"] = Fs.Str(uid),
 65              ["text"] = Fs.Str(trimmed),
 66              ["type"] = FsLower.Enum(ChatMessageType.Text),
 67              ["sentAt"] = Fs.Ts(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow),
 68          };
 69  
 70          try
 71          {
 72              await _firestore.CreateDocumentAsync($"chats/{chatId}/messages", null, fields, ct);
 73              return OperationResult.Ok();
 74          }
 75          catch (FirestoreException ex)
 76          {
 77              return OperationResult.Fail(ex.Message);
 78          }
 79      }
 80  
 81      public IDisposable ObserveMessages(string chatId, Action<IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>> onChanged) =>
 82          new PollingObserver<IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>>(
 83              read: ct => ReadMessagesAsync(chatId, ct),
 84              signature: messages => $"{messages.Count}:{(messages.Count > 0 ? messages[^1].Id : string.Empty)}",
 85              onChanged: onChanged,
 86              interval: MessagePollInterval);
 87  
 88      public async Task<OperationResult> MarkTradeCompletedAsync(string chatId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 89      {
 90          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("markTradeCompleted", new { chatId }, ct);
 91          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
 92      }
 93  
 94      private async Task<IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>> ReadMessagesAsync(string chatId, CancellationToken ct)
 95      {
 96          var query = Q.Build(
 97              Q.From("messages"),
 98              orderBy: new[] { Q.OrderBy("sentAt") },
 99              limit: 200);
100  
101          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync($"chats/{chatId}", query, ct);
102          return documents.Select(MapMessage).ToArray();
103      }
104  
105      internal static Chat Map(JsonElement document)
106      {
107          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
108          return new Chat
109          {
110              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
111              ListingId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingId"),
112              ListingTitle = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingTitle"),
113              ParticipantUids = Fs.StringList(fields, "participantUids"),
114              SellerUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "sellerUid"),
115              BuyerUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "buyerUid"),
116              WinningBidCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "winningBidCentavos"),
117              CompletedBy = Fs.StringList(fields, "completedBy"),
118              LastMessage = Fs.StringOr(fields, "lastMessage"),
119              LastMessageAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "lastMessageAt"),
120              Status = Fs.Enum(fields, "status", ChatStatus.Active),
121          };
122      }
123  
124      internal static ChatMessage MapMessage(JsonElement document)
125      {
126          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
127          return new ChatMessage
128          {
129              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
130              SenderUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "senderUid"),
131              Text = Fs.StringOr(fields, "text"),
132              SentAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "sentAt") ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
133              Type = Fs.Enum(fields, "type", ChatMessageType.Text),
134          };
135      }
136  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreClient.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Net;
  2  using System.Net.Http.Headers;
  3  using System.Net.Http.Json;
  4  using System.Text.Json;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>Raised when Firestore rejects a read or write; carries a message fit to show a student.</summary>
  9  public sealed class FirestoreException : Exception
 10  {
 11      public FirestoreException(string message, HttpStatusCode? status = null) : base(message) => Status = status;
 12      public HttpStatusCode? Status { get; }
 13  }
 14  
 15  /// <summary>
 16  /// A thin client over the Firestore REST API, authenticated as the signed-in user.
 17  ///
 18  /// Every call carries that user's ID token, so <c>firestore.rules</c> applies exactly
 19  /// as it would to a native SDK — this is a different transport, not a way around the
 20  /// security model. What REST does not give us is a snapshot listener, so the
 21  /// <c>Observe*</c> methods on the services above poll instead.
 22  /// </summary>
 23  public sealed class FirestoreClient
 24  {
 25      private readonly HttpClient _http;
 26      private readonly IFirebaseTokenProvider _tokens;
 27  
 28      private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions SerializerOptions = new()
 29      {
 30          DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.Never,
 31      };
 32  
 33      public FirestoreClient(HttpClient http, IFirebaseTokenProvider tokens)
 34      {
 35          _http = http;
 36          _tokens = tokens;
 37      }
 38  
 39      /// <summary>Reads one document. Returns null when it does not exist (a 404 is not an error here).</summary>
 40      public async Task<JsonElement?> GetDocumentAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
 41      {
 42          using var request = await BuildAsync(HttpMethod.Get, $"{FirebaseSettings.FirestoreDocuments}/{path}", null, ct);
 43          using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
 44  
 45          if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NotFound) return null;
 46          await ThrowIfFailedAsync(response, ct);
 47  
 48          using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
 49          return doc.RootElement.Clone();
 50      }
 51  
 52      /// <summary>
 53      /// Runs a structured query below <paramref name="parentPath"/> (empty for the database
 54      /// root) and returns the matching documents. Rows without a <c>document</c> — Firestore
 55      /// emits those as keep-alives — are skipped.
 56      /// </summary>
 57      public async Task<List<JsonElement>> RunQueryAsync(
 58          string parentPath, object structuredQuery, CancellationToken ct = default)
 59      {
 60          var url = string.IsNullOrEmpty(parentPath)
 61              ? $"{FirebaseSettings.FirestoreDocuments}:runQuery"
 62              : $"{FirebaseSettings.FirestoreDocuments}/{parentPath}:runQuery";
 63  
 64          var body = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["structuredQuery"] = structuredQuery };
 65  
 66          using var request = await BuildAsync(HttpMethod.Post, url, body, ct);
 67          using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
 68          await ThrowIfFailedAsync(response, ct);
 69  
 70          using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
 71          var results = new List<JsonElement>();
 72  
 73          if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array) return results;
 74  
 75          foreach (var row in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
 76          {
 77              if (row.TryGetProperty("document", out var document))
 78                  results.Add(document.Clone());
 79          }
 80          return results;
 81      }
 82  
 83      /// <summary>Creates a document, letting Firestore allocate the id unless one is supplied.</summary>
 84      public async Task<string> CreateDocumentAsync(
 85          string collectionPath,
 86          string? documentId,
 87          Dictionary<string, object?> fields,
 88          CancellationToken ct = default)
 89      {
 90          var url = $"{FirebaseSettings.FirestoreDocuments}/{collectionPath}";
 91          if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(documentId))
 92              url += $"?documentId={Uri.EscapeDataString(documentId)}";
 93  
 94          var body = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["fields"] = fields };
 95  
 96          using var request = await BuildAsync(HttpMethod.Post, url, body, ct);
 97          using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
 98          await ThrowIfFailedAsync(response, ct);
 99  
100          using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct));
101          return Fs.IdFromName(doc.RootElement);
102      }
103  
104      /// <summary>
105      /// Patches only the named fields. The update mask matters: without it Firestore
106      /// treats the write as a full replace and silently drops every field left out.
107      /// </summary>
108      public async Task PatchAsync(string path, Dictionary<string, object?> fields, CancellationToken ct = default)
109      {
110          var mask = string.Join("&", fields.Keys.Select(k => $"updateMask.fieldPaths={Uri.EscapeDataString(k)}"));
111          var url = $"{FirebaseSettings.FirestoreDocuments}/{path}?{mask}";
112          var body = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["fields"] = fields };
113  
114          using var request = await BuildAsync(HttpMethod.Patch, url, body, ct);
115          using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
116          await ThrowIfFailedAsync(response, ct);
117      }
118  
119      public async Task DeleteAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
120      {
121          using var request = await BuildAsync(HttpMethod.Delete, $"{FirebaseSettings.FirestoreDocuments}/{path}", null, ct);
122          using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
123          await ThrowIfFailedAsync(response, ct);
124      }
125  
126      private async Task<HttpRequestMessage> BuildAsync(
127          HttpMethod method, string url, object? body, CancellationToken ct)
128      {
129          var request = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url);
130  
131          var token = await _tokens.GetIdTokenAsync(ct);
132          if (token is not null)
133              request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
134  
135          if (body is not null)
136              request.Content = JsonContent.Create(body, options: SerializerOptions);
137  
138          return request;
139      }
140  
141      private static async Task ThrowIfFailedAsync(HttpResponseMessage response, CancellationToken ct)
142      {
143          if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return;
144  
145          var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
146          var detail = TryReadErrorMessage(raw);
147  
148          throw new FirestoreException(
149              response.StatusCode switch
150              {
151                  HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized => "Your session expired. Sign in again.",
152                  HttpStatusCode.Forbidden =>
153                      "You don't have permission for that yet — your student ID may still be awaiting review.",
154                  HttpStatusCode.NotFound => "That item no longer exists.",
155                  HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests => "NUTrade is busy right now. Try again in a moment.",
156                  _ => string.IsNullOrEmpty(detail) ? "Something went wrong talking to NUTrade." : detail,
157              },
158              response.StatusCode);
159      }
160  
161      /// <summary>
162      /// Pulls <c>error.message</c> out of a Google API error body. A failed index lookup
163      /// reports itself here with a console link to create the index, which is worth
164      /// surfacing rather than swallowing.
165      /// </summary>
166      private static string? TryReadErrorMessage(string raw)
167      {
168          try
169          {
170              using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
171              var root = doc.RootElement;
172  
173              // runQuery returns a single-element array wrapping the error.
174              if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array && root.GetArrayLength() > 0)
175                  root = root[0];
176  
177              return root.TryGetProperty("error", out var error) && error.TryGetProperty("message", out var message)
178                  ? message.GetString()
179                  : null;
180          }
181          catch (JsonException)
182          {
183              return null;
184          }
185      }
186  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreListingService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Globalization;
  2  using System.Text.Json;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  
  5  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  6  
  7  /// <summary>
  8  /// <see cref="IListingService"/> over <c>listings/{listingId}</c>.
  9  ///
 10  /// Reads are direct Firestore queries; the one write this class makes is a *draft*.
 11  /// Publishing, pinning and every auction counter belong to the Cloud Functions —
 12  /// firestore.rules denies a client update outright. Settling the fee — through
 13  /// <c>createQrPayment</c> (free first post) or the PayMongo webhook (paid post) — only
 14  /// moves a listing to <see cref="ListingStatus.PendingApproval"/>; it reaches the feed
 15  /// once an admin's <c>approveListing</c> has moved it to <see cref="ListingStatus.Active"/>.
 16  /// </summary>
 17  public sealed class FirestoreListingService : IListingService
 18  {
 19      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 20      private readonly IStorageService _storage;
 21      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 22  
 23      public FirestoreListingService(FirestoreClient firestore, IStorageService storage, IAuthService auth)
 24      {
 25          _firestore = firestore;
 26          _storage = storage;
 27          _auth = auth;
 28      }
 29  
 30      public async Task<ListingPage> GetActiveFeedAsync(
 31          ItemCategory? category = null,
 32          int pageSize = 20,
 33          string? cursor = null,
 34          CancellationToken ct = default)
 35      {
 36          var offset = int.TryParse(cursor, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var parsed)
 37              ? parsed
 38              : 0;
 39  
 40          var filters = new List<Dictionary<string, object?>>
 41          {
 42              Q.Equal("status", Fs.Str(WireCodec.ToWire(ListingStatus.Active))),
 43              // Regular listings sit out of the feed until publishScheduledListings
 44              // releases them on the hour; Priority is published already visible.
 45              Q.Equal("isVisible", Fs.Bool(true)),
 46          };
 47          if (category is { } c)
 48              filters.Add(Q.Equal("category", Fs.Enum(c)));
 49  
 50          var query = Q.Build(
 51              Q.From("listings"),
 52              Q.And(filters.ToArray()),
 53              new[]
 54              {
 55                  // Paid Priority pins ride at the top of the feed; everything else is newest-first.
 56                  Q.OrderBy("isPinned", descending: true),
 57                  Q.OrderBy("publishedAt", descending: true),
 58              },
 59              limit: pageSize,
 60              offset: offset);
 61  
 62          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 63          var items = documents.Select(Map).ToArray();
 64  
 65          // A short page means we reached the end — stop offering a cursor.
 66          var next = items.Length == pageSize ? (offset + items.Length).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : null;
 67          return new ListingPage(items, next);
 68      }
 69  
 70      public async Task<Listing?> GetListingAsync(string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 71      {
 72          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listingId)) return null;
 73          var document = await _firestore.GetDocumentAsync($"listings/{listingId}", ct);
 74          return document is { } doc ? Map(doc) : null;
 75      }
 76  
 77      public async Task<OperationResult<string>> CreateDraftAsync(
 78          CreateAuctionRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default)
 79      {
 80          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
 81          if (!_auth.IsVerified)
 82              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Your student ID is still being reviewed — you can't post auctions yet.");
 83  
 84          // Photos go to Storage first: the listing document stores download URLs, and a
 85          // half-written draft is better than a draft pointing at files that never landed.
 86          var photoUrls = new List<string>();
 87          foreach (var localPath in request.PhotoLocalPaths)
 88          {
 89              var upload = await _storage.UploadAsync($"listings/{uid}", localPath, ct);
 90              if (!upload.Succeeded)
 91                  return OperationResult<string>.Fail(upload.Error ?? "Could not upload your photos.");
 92              photoUrls.Add(upload.Value!);
 93          }
 94  
 95          var fields = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 96          {
 97              ["ownerUid"] = Fs.Str(uid),
 98              // The web admin panel shares this database and names the seller `sellerUid`;
 99              // its rules check that field on create. Written alongside ownerUid, which is
100              // what the app and the Functions use.
101              ["sellerUid"] = Fs.Str(uid),
102              ["title"] = Fs.Str(request.Title),
103              ["description"] = Fs.Str(request.Description),
104              ["condition"] = Fs.Enum(request.Condition),
105              ["category"] = Fs.Enum(request.Category),
106              ["categoryOther"] = Fs.Str(request.CategoryOther),
107              ["photos"] = Fs.Arr(photoUrls),
108              ["campusZone"] = Fs.Enum(request.CampusZone),
109              ["campusZoneOther"] = Fs.Str(request.CampusZoneOther),
110              ["package"] = Fs.Enum(request.Package),
111              ["startingBidCentavos"] = Fs.Int(request.StartingBidCentavos),
112              ["minIncrementCentavos"] = Fs.Int(request.MinIncrementCentavos),
113              ["reservePriceCentavos"] = Fs.Int(request.ReservePriceCentavos),
114              ["currentHighestBidCentavos"] = Fs.Int(request.StartingBidCentavos),
115              ["createdAt"] = Fs.Ts(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow),
116  
117              // Everything below is what firestore.rules pins on create. The server owns
118              // all of it from here on; the client never writes these again.
119              ["status"] = Fs.Str(WireCodec.ToWire(ListingStatus.Draft)),
120              ["isPinned"] = Fs.Bool(false),
121              ["isVisible"] = Fs.Bool(false),
122              ["visibleFrom"] = Fs.Null(),
123              ["bidCount"] = Fs.Int(0),
124              ["highestBidderUid"] = Fs.Null(),
125              ["winningBidId"] = Fs.Null(),
126              ["auctionEndsAt"] = Fs.Null(),
127              ["publishedAt"] = Fs.Null(),
128          };
129  
130          try
131          {
132              var id = await _firestore.CreateDocumentAsync("listings", null, fields, ct);
133              return OperationResult<string>.Ok(id);
134          }
135          catch (FirestoreException ex)
136          {
137              return OperationResult<string>.Fail(ex.Message);
138          }
139      }
140  
141      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Listing>> GetMyListingsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
142      {
143          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return Array.Empty<Listing>();
144  
145          var query = Q.Build(
146              Q.From("listings"),
147              Q.Equal("ownerUid", Fs.Str(uid)),
148              new[] { Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true) },
149              limit: 50);
150  
151          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
152          return documents.Select(Map).ToArray();
153      }
154  
155      /// <summary>Every status that uses the free post, spelled as Firestore stores it.</summary>
156      private static readonly Dictionary<string, object?>[] FreePostUsedStatuses =
157          Enum.GetValues<ListingStatus>()
158              .Where(NUTradeConstants.UsesFreePost)
159              .Select(s => Fs.Str(WireCodec.ToWire(s)))
160              .ToArray();
161  
162      public async Task<bool> HasUsedFreePostAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
163      {
164          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return false;
165  
166          // The same question createQrPayment asks before it waives the fee: does this
167          // student own any listing that was submitted and not rejected?
168          var query = Q.Build(
169              Q.From("listings"),
170              Q.And(Q.Equal("ownerUid", Fs.Str(uid)), Q.In("status", FreePostUsedStatuses)),
171              limit: 1);
172  
173          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
174          return documents.Count > 0;
175      }
176  
177      public async Task<OperationResult> CancelListingAsync(string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
178      {
179          // Only an unpublished draft can be deleted client-side; rules forbid touching
180          // anything else, and pulling a live auction out from under its bidders has to
181          // be a server decision.
182          var listing = await GetListingAsync(listingId, ct);
183          if (listing is null) return OperationResult.Fail("That listing no longer exists.");
184          if (listing.Status != ListingStatus.Draft)
185              return OperationResult.Fail("A published auction can't be cancelled from the app.");
186  
187          try
188          {
189              await _firestore.DeleteAsync($"listings/{listingId}", ct);
190              return OperationResult.Ok();
191          }
192          catch (FirestoreException ex)
193          {
194              return OperationResult.Fail(ex.Message);
195          }
196      }
197  
198      public IDisposable ObserveListing(string listingId, Action<Listing?> onChanged) =>
199          new PollingObserver<Listing?>(
200              read: ct => GetListingAsync(listingId, ct),
201              // The payment screen is watching status (paid → approved → on the feed), and
202              // the detail page for the bid to move; those are the only fields worth a repaint.
203              signature: l => l is null
204                  ? "none"
205                  : $"{l.Status}|{l.IsVisible}|{l.CurrentHighestBidCentavos}|{l.BidCount}|{l.IsPinned}|{l.AuctionEndsAt:O}",
206              onChanged: onChanged,
207              interval: FirebaseSettings.ObservePollInterval);
208  
209      internal static Listing Map(JsonElement document)
210      {
211          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
212          var listing = new Listing
213          {
214              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
215              OwnerUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "ownerUid"),
216              Title = Fs.StringOr(fields, "title"),
217              Description = Fs.StringOr(fields, "description"),
218              Condition = Fs.Enum(fields, "condition", ItemCondition.Unknown),
219              Category = Fs.Enum(fields, "category", ItemCategory.Unknown),
220              CategoryOther = Fs.StringOr(fields, "categoryOther"),
221              Photos = Fs.StringList(fields, "photos"),
222              CampusZone = Fs.Enum(fields, "campusZone", CampusZone.Unknown),
223              CampusZoneOther = Fs.StringOr(fields, "campusZoneOther"),
224              Package = Fs.Enum(fields, "package", ListingPackage.Free),
225              IsPinned = Fs.Bool(fields, "isPinned"),
226              Status = WireCodec.ToListingStatus(Fs.String(fields, "status")),
227              StartingBidCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "startingBidCentavos"),
228              MinIncrementCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "minIncrementCentavos"),
229              ReservePriceCentavos = Fs.LongOrNull(fields, "reservePriceCentavos"),
230              IsVisible = Fs.Bool(fields, "isVisible"),
231              VisibleFrom = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "visibleFrom"),
232              CurrentHighestBidCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "currentHighestBidCentavos"),
233              HighestBidderUid = Fs.String(fields, "highestBidderUid"),
234              BidCount = Fs.Int32(fields, "bidCount"),
235              AuctionEndsAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "auctionEndsAt"),
236              WinningBidId = Fs.String(fields, "winningBidId"),
237              OrderId = Fs.String(fields, "orderId"),
238              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt") ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
239              PublishedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "publishedAt"),
240              PaidPackage = Enum.TryParse<ListingPackage>(Fs.String(fields, "paidPackage"), out var paid) ? paid : null,
241              SubmittedForApprovalAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "submittedForApprovalAt"),
242              RejectionReason = Fs.String(fields, "rejectionReason"),
243          };
244  
245          // Prime the countdown so a card paints with real text on its first frame,
246          // rather than blank until the page's dispatcher timer's first tick.
247          listing.TickCountdown(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
248          return listing;
249      }
250  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreOrderService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Text.Json;
  2  using NUTrade1.Core;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// <see cref="IOrderService"/> over <c>orders/{orderId}</c>.
  8  ///
  9  /// Reads come straight from Firestore; every mutation is a Cloud Function, because
 10  /// the order's status transitions are the sale itself. A client that could write
 11  /// <c>status: 'paid'</c> could walk off with an item it never paid for, which is why
 12  /// firestore.rules denies all client writes here.
 13  /// </summary>
 14  public sealed class FirestoreOrderService : IOrderService
 15  {
 16      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 17      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
 18      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 19  
 20      public FirestoreOrderService(FirestoreClient firestore, FunctionsClient functions, IAuthService auth)
 21      {
 22          _firestore = firestore;
 23          _functions = functions;
 24          _auth = auth;
 25      }
 26  
 27      public async Task<Order?> GetOrderAsync(string orderId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 28      {
 29          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(orderId)) return null;
 30          var document = await _firestore.GetDocumentAsync($"orders/{orderId}", ct);
 31          return document is { } doc ? Map(doc) : null;
 32      }
 33  
 34      public async Task<Order?> GetOrderForListingAsync(string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 35      {
 36          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listingId)) return null;
 37  
 38          // Scoped by participant because that is what the read rule allows — an
 39          // unscoped listingId query would be rejected outright.
 40          var query = Q.Build(
 41              Q.From("orders"),
 42              Q.And(
 43                  Q.ArrayContains("participantUids", Fs.Str(uid)),
 44                  Q.Equal("listingId", Fs.Str(listingId))),
 45              new[] { Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true) },
 46              limit: 1);
 47  
 48          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 49          return documents.Count == 0 ? null : Map(documents[0]);
 50      }
 51  
 52      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Order>> GetMyOrdersAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 53      {
 54          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return Array.Empty<Order>();
 55  
 56          var query = Q.Build(
 57              Q.From("orders"),
 58              Q.ArrayContains("participantUids", Fs.Str(uid)),
 59              new[] { Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true) },
 60              limit: 50);
 61  
 62          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 63          return documents.Select(Map).ToArray();
 64      }
 65  
 66      public async Task<OperationResult<Order>> CreateQrPaymentAsync(
 67          string orderId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 68      {
 69          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("createOrderQrPayment", new { orderId }, ct);
 70          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<Order>.Fail(result.Error!);
 71  
 72          // The callable returns the QR, but the order document is the source of truth
 73          // for status — re-read it so the screen never shows a code for an order the
 74          // webhook has already settled.
 75          var order = await GetOrderAsync(orderId, ct);
 76          return order is null
 77              ? OperationResult<Order>.Fail("That order no longer exists.")
 78              : OperationResult<Order>.Ok(order);
 79      }
 80      public IDisposable ObserveOrder(string orderId, Action<Order?> onChanged) =>
 81          new PollingObserver<Order?>(
 82              read: ct => GetOrderAsync(orderId, ct),
 83              // Status and method are the only things the screen reacts to; the rest of
 84              // the order never changes after creation.
 85              signature: o => o is null ? "none" : $"{o.Status}|{o.QrExpiresAt:O}",
 86              onChanged: onChanged,
 87              interval: FirebaseSettings.ObservePollInterval);
 88  
 89      internal static OrderStatus StatusFromWire(string? wire) => wire switch
 90      {
 91          "awaiting_payment" => OrderStatus.AwaitingPayment,
 92          "paid" => OrderStatus.Paid,
 93          "released" => OrderStatus.Released,
 94          "cancelled" => OrderStatus.Cancelled,
 95          _ => OrderStatus.AwaitingPayment,
 96      };
 97  
 98      internal static Order Map(JsonElement document)
 99      {
100          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
101          return new Order
102          {
103              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
104              ListingId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingId"),
105              ListingTitle = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingTitle"),
106              ListingPhoto = Fs.String(fields, "listingPhoto"),
107              BidId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "bidId"),
108              ChatId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "chatId"),
109              SellerUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "sellerUid"),
110              BuyerUid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "buyerUid"),
111              BuyerName = Fs.StringOr(fields, "buyerName"),
112              AmountCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "amountCentavos"),
113              Reference = Fs.StringOr(fields, "reference"),
114              Status = StatusFromWire(Fs.String(fields, "status")),
115              DueAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "dueAt"),
116              QrImageUrl = Fs.String(fields, "qrImageUrl"),
117              QrImageBase64 = Fs.String(fields, "qrImageBase64"),
118              QrPayload = Fs.String(fields, "qrPayload"),
119              QrExpiresAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "qrExpiresAt"),
120              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt") ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
121          };
122      }
123  }
```
