### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreQuery.cs

```csharp
  1  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  2  
  3  /// <summary>
  4  /// Builders for Firestore <c>structuredQuery</c> bodies. Plain dictionaries rather
  5  /// than a typed model — the shapes are small, used in one place each, and this keeps
  6  /// them readable next to the REST reference.
  7  /// </summary>
  8  public static class Q
  9  {
 10      public static Dictionary<string, object?> From(string collectionId, bool allDescendants = false) =>
 11          new()
 12          {
 13              ["collectionId"] = collectionId,
 14              ["allDescendants"] = allDescendants,
 15          };
 16  
 17      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Equal(string fieldPath, Dictionary<string, object?> value) =>
 18          FieldFilter(fieldPath, "EQUAL", value);
 19  
 20      public static Dictionary<string, object?> LessThanOrEqual(string fieldPath, Dictionary<string, object?> value) =>
 21          FieldFilter(fieldPath, "LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL", value);
 22  
 23      public static Dictionary<string, object?> ArrayContains(string fieldPath, Dictionary<string, object?> value) =>
 24          FieldFilter(fieldPath, "ARRAY_CONTAINS", value);
 25  
 26      public static Dictionary<string, object?> In(string fieldPath, IEnumerable<Dictionary<string, object?>> values) =>
 27          new()
 28          {
 29              ["fieldFilter"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 30              {
 31                  ["field"] = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["fieldPath"] = fieldPath },
 32                  ["op"] = "IN",
 33                  ["value"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 34                  {
 35                      ["arrayValue"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 36                      {
 37                          ["values"] = values.Cast<object>().ToArray(),
 38                      },
 39                  },
 40              },
 41          };
 42  
 43      private static Dictionary<string, object?> FieldFilter(
 44          string fieldPath, string op, Dictionary<string, object?> value) =>
 45          new()
 46          {
 47              ["fieldFilter"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 48              {
 49                  ["field"] = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["fieldPath"] = fieldPath },
 50                  ["op"] = op,
 51                  ["value"] = value,
 52              },
 53          };
 54  
 55      /// <summary>Combines filters with AND. A single filter is passed through unwrapped.</summary>
 56      public static Dictionary<string, object?> And(params Dictionary<string, object?>[] filters) =>
 57          filters.Length == 1
 58              ? filters[0]
 59              : new Dictionary<string, object?>
 60              {
 61                  ["compositeFilter"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 62                  {
 63                      ["op"] = "AND",
 64                      ["filters"] = filters.Cast<object>().ToArray(),
 65                  },
 66              };
 67  
 68      public static Dictionary<string, object?> OrderBy(string fieldPath, bool descending = false) =>
 69          new()
 70          {
 71              ["field"] = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["fieldPath"] = fieldPath },
 72              ["direction"] = descending ? "DESCENDING" : "ASCENDING",
 73          };
 74  
 75      /// <summary>
 76      /// Assembles the query. <paramref name="offset"/> drives feed paging: Firestore also
 77      /// supports keyset cursors, but an offset keeps <see cref="Core.ListingPage.NextCursor"/>
 78      /// a plain string, and a campus feed never runs deep enough for the extra read cost
 79      /// of skipping to matter.
 80      /// </summary>
 81      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Build(
 82          Dictionary<string, object?> from,
 83          Dictionary<string, object?>? where = null,
 84          IEnumerable<Dictionary<string, object?>>? orderBy = null,
 85          int? limit = null,
 86          int? offset = null)
 87      {
 88          var query = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 89          {
 90              ["from"] = new object[] { from },
 91          };
 92  
 93          if (where is not null) query["where"] = where;
 94          if (orderBy is not null) query["orderBy"] = orderBy.Cast<object>().ToArray();
 95          if (limit is { } l) query["limit"] = l;
 96          if (offset is { } o and > 0) query["offset"] = o;
 97  
 98          return query;
 99      }
100  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreUserService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Collections.Concurrent;
  2  using System.Text.Json;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  
  5  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  6  
  7  /// <summary>
  8  /// <see cref="IUserService"/> over <c>users/{uid}</c>.
  9  ///
 10  /// Note what this class deliberately cannot do: <c>verificationStatus</c>, <c>role</c>,
 11  /// <c>tradesCompleted</c> and <c>rating</c> are all rejected by firestore.rules on a
 12  /// client update, so <see cref="UpdateProfileAsync"/> patches only the presentational
 13  /// fields. Verification is granted by <c>setUserVerification</c> after an admin reviews
 14  /// the Student ID photo.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  public sealed class FirestoreUserService : IUserService
 17  {
 18      /// <summary>Fields a student is allowed to change about themselves.</summary>
 19      private static readonly string[] SelfEditableFields =
 20          { "displayName", "studentId", "campusHub", "photoUrl", "fcmTokens", "program" };
 21  
 22      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 23      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 24  
 25      // Seller rows on the feed and detail pages would otherwise re-read the same few
 26      // profiles constantly; profiles change rarely, so hold them for the session.
 27      private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, UserProfile> _cache = new();
 28  
 29      public FirestoreUserService(FirestoreClient firestore, IAuthService auth)
 30      {
 31          _firestore = firestore;
 32          _auth = auth;
 33      }
 34  
 35      public async Task<UserProfile?> GetProfileAsync(string uid, CancellationToken ct = default)
 36      {
 37          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uid)) return null;
 38          if (_cache.TryGetValue(uid, out var cached)) return cached;
 39  
 40          var document = await _firestore.GetDocumentAsync($"users/{uid}", ct);
 41          if (document is not { } doc) return null;
 42  
 43          var profile = Map(doc);
 44          _cache[uid] = profile;
 45          return profile;
 46      }
 47  
 48      public Task<UserProfile?> GetCurrentProfileAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
 49          _auth.CurrentUid is { } uid ? GetProfileAsync(uid, ct) : Task.FromResult<UserProfile?>(null);
 50  
 51      public async Task<OperationResult> CreateProfileAsync(UserProfile profile, CancellationToken ct = default)
 52      {
 53          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return OperationResult.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
 54          if (!NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail(profile.Email))
 55              return OperationResult.Fail("Enter a valid email address.");
 56  
 57          profile.Uid = uid;
 58  
 59          var fields = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 60          {
 61              ["uid"] = Fs.Str(uid),
 62              ["email"] = Fs.Str(profile.Email),
 63              ["displayName"] = Fs.Str(profile.DisplayName),
 64              ["firstName"] = Fs.Str(profile.FirstName),
 65              ["lastName"] = Fs.Str(profile.LastName),
 66              ["studentId"] = Fs.Str(profile.StudentId),
 67              ["campusHub"] = Fs.Enum(profile.CampusHub),
 68              ["photoUrl"] = Fs.Str(profile.PhotoUrl),
 69              ["tradesCompleted"] = Fs.Int(0),
 70              ["rating"] = Fs.Null(),
 71              // The two fields firestore.rules pins on create: a new account is an
 72              // unprivileged student awaiting ID review, whatever the client claims.
 73              ["role"] = Fs.Str("student"),
 74              ["verificationStatus"] = Fs.Str("pending"),
 75              ["program"] = Fs.Str(profile.Program),
 76              ["fcmTokens"] = Fs.Arr(Array.Empty<string>()),
 77              ["createdAt"] = Fs.Ts(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow),
 78          };
 79  
 80          try
 81          {
 82              await _firestore.CreateDocumentAsync("users", uid, fields, ct);
 83              _cache.TryRemove(uid, out _);
 84              return OperationResult.Ok();
 85          }
 86          catch (FirestoreException ex)
 87          {
 88              return OperationResult.Fail(ex.Message);
 89          }
 90      }
 91  
 92      public async Task<OperationResult> UpdateProfileAsync(UserProfile profile, CancellationToken ct = default)
 93      {
 94          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return OperationResult.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
 95  
 96          var fields = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 97          {
 98              ["displayName"] = Fs.Str(profile.DisplayName),
 99              ["studentId"] = Fs.Str(profile.StudentId),
100              ["campusHub"] = Fs.Enum(profile.CampusHub),
101              ["photoUrl"] = Fs.Str(profile.PhotoUrl),
102              ["fcmTokens"] = Fs.Arr(profile.FcmTokens),
103              ["program"] = Fs.Str(profile.Program),
104          };
105  
106          // Belt and braces: the rules enforce this too, but failing here gives a clearer
107          // error than a 403 if someone adds a field to the dictionary above.
108          var disallowed = fields.Keys.Except(SelfEditableFields).ToArray();
109          if (disallowed.Length > 0)
110              return OperationResult.Fail($"Can't change {string.Join(", ", disallowed)} from the app.");
111  
112          try
113          {
114              await _firestore.PatchAsync($"users/{uid}", fields, ct);
115              _cache.TryRemove(uid, out _);
116              return OperationResult.Ok();
117          }
118          catch (FirestoreException ex)
119          {
120              return OperationResult.Fail(ex.Message);
121          }
122      }
123  
124      public async Task<OperationResult> SetProgramAsync(string program, CancellationToken ct = default)
125      {
126          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return OperationResult.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
127          if (!NUTradeConstants.Programs.Contains(program)) return OperationResult.Fail("Choose your program.");
128  
129          try
130          {
131              await _firestore.PatchAsync($"users/{uid}", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["program"] = Fs.Str(program) }, ct);
132              _cache.TryRemove(uid, out _);
133              return OperationResult.Ok();
134          }
135          catch (FirestoreException ex)
136          {
137              return OperationResult.Fail(ex.Message);
138          }
139      }
140  
141      internal static UserProfile Map(JsonElement document)
142      {
143          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
144          return new UserProfile
145          {
146              Uid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "uid", Fs.IdFromName(document)),
147              DisplayName = Fs.StringOr(fields, "displayName"),
148              FirstName = Fs.StringOr(fields, "firstName"),
149              LastName = Fs.StringOr(fields, "lastName"),
150              StudentId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "studentId"),
151              Email = Fs.StringOr(fields, "email"),
152              CampusHub = Fs.Enum(fields, "campusHub", CampusHub.Unknown),
153              PhotoUrl = Fs.String(fields, "photoUrl"),
154              TradesCompleted = Fs.Int32(fields, "tradesCompleted"),
155              Rating = Fs.DoubleOrNull(fields, "rating"),
156              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt") ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
157              Program = Fs.StringOr(fields, "program"),
158              FcmTokens = Fs.StringList(fields, "fcmTokens"),
159          };
160      }
161  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FirestoreValue.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Globalization;
  2  using System.Text.Json;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// Conversion between .NET values and Firestore's REST wire format, where every
  8  /// field is wrapped in a one-key type envelope — <c>{"stringValue":"x"}</c>,
  9  /// <c>{"integerValue":"42"}</c> (a string, not a number — 64-bit ints do not survive
 10  /// JSON), <c>{"timestampValue":"...Z"}</c>, and so on.
 11  ///
 12  /// Writers return dictionaries ready to serialize; readers take a document's
 13  /// <c>fields</c> element and never throw on a missing or unexpectedly typed field,
 14  /// because a document written by an older build of the app must still render.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  public static class Fs
 17  {
 18      // ---- Writers -------------------------------------------------------------
 19  
 20      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Str(string? value) =>
 21          value is null ? Null() : new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["stringValue"] = value };
 22  
 23      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Int(long value) =>
 24          new() { ["integerValue"] = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) };
 25  
 26      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Int(long? value) => value is { } v ? Int(v) : Null();
 27  
 28      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Dbl(double value) =>
 29          new() { ["doubleValue"] = value };
 30  
 31      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Bool(bool value) =>
 32          new() { ["booleanValue"] = value };
 33  
 34      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Ts(DateTimeOffset value) =>
 35          new() { ["timestampValue"] = value.UtcDateTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffffffZ", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) };
 36  
 37      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Ts(DateTimeOffset? value) => value is { } v ? Ts(v) : Null();
 38  
 39      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Null() =>
 40          new() { ["nullValue"] = null };
 41  
 42      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Arr(IEnumerable<string> values) =>
 43          new()
 44          {
 45              ["arrayValue"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 46              {
 47                  ["values"] = values.Select(v => (object)Str(v)).ToArray(),
 48              },
 49          };
 50  
 51      /// <summary>Enums travel as their member name, matching the strings the Functions write.</summary>
 52      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Enum<T>(T value) where T : struct, System.Enum =>
 53          Str(value.ToString());
 54  
 55      // ---- Readers -------------------------------------------------------------
 56  
 57      private static JsonElement? Field(JsonElement fields, string name) =>
 58          fields.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && fields.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
 59              ? value
 60              : null;
 61  
 62      public static string? String(JsonElement fields, string name) =>
 63          Field(fields, name) is { } v && v.TryGetProperty("stringValue", out var s)
 64              ? s.GetString()
 65              : null;
 66  
 67      public static string StringOr(JsonElement fields, string name, string fallback = "") =>
 68          String(fields, name) ?? fallback;
 69  
 70      public static long? LongOrNull(JsonElement fields, string name)
 71      {
 72          if (Field(fields, name) is not { } v) return null;
 73  
 74          if (v.TryGetProperty("integerValue", out var i))
 75          {
 76              return i.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
 77                  ? long.TryParse(i.GetString(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var parsed) ? parsed : null
 78                  : i.TryGetInt64(out var direct) ? direct : null;
 79          }
 80  
 81          // Firestore hands back a whole number written as a double as doubleValue.
 82          return v.TryGetProperty("doubleValue", out var d) && d.TryGetDouble(out var dv)
 83              ? (long)dv
 84              : null;
 85      }
 86  
 87      public static long Long(JsonElement fields, string name, long fallback = 0) =>
 88          LongOrNull(fields, name) ?? fallback;
 89  
 90      public static int Int32(JsonElement fields, string name, int fallback = 0) =>
 91          (int)Long(fields, name, fallback);
 92  
 93      public static double? DoubleOrNull(JsonElement fields, string name)
 94      {
 95          if (Field(fields, name) is not { } v) return null;
 96          if (v.TryGetProperty("doubleValue", out var d) && d.TryGetDouble(out var dv)) return dv;
 97          return LongOrNull(fields, name);
 98      }
 99  
100      public static bool Bool(JsonElement fields, string name, bool fallback = false) =>
101          Field(fields, name) is { } v && v.TryGetProperty("booleanValue", out var b)
102              ? b.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True
103              : fallback;
104  
105      public static DateTimeOffset? Timestamp(JsonElement fields, string name)
106      {
107          if (Field(fields, name) is not { } v) return null;
108          if (!v.TryGetProperty("timestampValue", out var t)) return null;
109  
110          return DateTimeOffset.TryParse(
111              t.GetString(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
112              DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal, out var parsed)
113              ? parsed
114              : null;
115      }
116  
117      public static List<string> StringList(JsonElement fields, string name)
118      {
119          var result = new List<string>();
120          if (Field(fields, name) is not { } v) return result;
121          if (!v.TryGetProperty("arrayValue", out var array)) return result;
122          if (!array.TryGetProperty("values", out var values) || values.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array) return result;
123  
124          foreach (var item in values.EnumerateArray())
125          {
126              if (item.TryGetProperty("stringValue", out var s) && s.GetString() is { } str)
127                  result.Add(str);
128          }
129          return result;
130      }
131  
132      /// <summary>
133      /// Parses an enum member name. An unrecognised value (a status written by a newer
134      /// backend, say) falls back rather than throwing, so one odd document can't blank
135      /// out a whole feed page.
136      /// </summary>
137      public static T Enum<T>(JsonElement fields, string name, T fallback) where T : struct, System.Enum =>
138          System.Enum.TryParse<T>(String(fields, name), ignoreCase: true, out var parsed) ? parsed : fallback;
139  
140      /// <summary>Last path segment of a document's <c>name</c> — its document id.</summary>
141      public static string IdFromName(JsonElement document) =>
142          document.TryGetProperty("name", out var name) && name.GetString() is { } path
143              ? path[(path.LastIndexOf('/') + 1)..]
144              : string.Empty;
145  }
146  
147  /// <summary>
148  /// The backend is TypeScript and spells three of the enums in lower case on the wire
149  /// — bid status, chat status and message type. <c>firestore.rules</c> matches those
150  /// literals exactly (a message must have <c>type == 'text'</c>), so a write that used
151  /// the .NET member name verbatim would be rejected.
152  /// </summary>
153  public static class FsLower
154  {
155      public static Dictionary<string, object?> Enum<T>(T value) where T : struct, System.Enum =>
156          Fs.Str(value.ToString()!.ToLowerInvariant());
157  }
```

```csharp
  1  using System.Text.Json;

  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// <see cref="IWalletService"/> over <c>wallets/{uid}</c>, <c>ledgerEntries</c> and
  8  /// <c>payoutRequests</c>.
  9  ///
 10  /// Reads are direct Firestore queries — firestore.rules scopes each of them to the
 11  /// signed-in student. The one write, raising a payout, goes through the
 12  /// <c>requestPayout</c> callable, because it has to debit the balance in the same
 13  /// transaction that records the request and no client may touch a balance.
 14  /// </summary>
 15  public sealed class FirestoreWalletService : IWalletService
 16  {
 17      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 18      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
 19      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 20  
 21      public FirestoreWalletService(FirestoreClient firestore, FunctionsClient functions, IAuthService auth)
 22      {
 23          _firestore = firestore;
 24          _functions = functions;
 25          _auth = auth;
 26      }
 27  
 28      public async Task<Wallet> GetWalletAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 29      {
 30          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return new Wallet();
 31  
 32          // A student who has never been credited has no wallet document at all, which is
 33          // a zero balance rather than an error.
 34          var document = await _firestore.GetDocumentAsync($"wallets/{uid}", ct);
 35          if (document is not { } doc) return new Wallet { Uid = uid };
 36  
 37          var fields = doc.GetProperty("fields");
 38          return new Wallet
 39          {
 40              Uid = uid,
 41              BalanceCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "balanceCentavos"),
 42              UpdatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "updatedAt"),
 43          };
 44      }
 45  
 46      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<LedgerEntry>> GetLedgerAsync(int limit = 25, CancellationToken ct = default)
 47      {
 48          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return [];
 49  
 50          var query = Q.Build(
 51              Q.From("ledgerEntries"),
 52              Q.Equal("uid", Fs.Str(uid)),
 53              [Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true)],
 54              limit: limit);
 55  
 56          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 57          return documents.Select(MapEntry).ToArray();
 58      }
 59  
 60      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PayoutRequest>> GetMyPayoutsAsync(int limit = 10, CancellationToken ct = default)
 61      {
 62          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return [];
 63  
 64          var query = Q.Build(
 65              Q.From("payoutRequests"),
 66              Q.Equal("uid", Fs.Str(uid)),
 67              [Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true)],
 68              limit: limit);
 69  
 70          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 71          return documents.Select(MapPayout).ToArray();
 72      }
 73  
 74      public async Task<OperationResult> RequestPayoutAsync(
 75          PayoutDestination destination, CancellationToken ct = default)
 76      {
 77          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("requestPayout", new
 78          {
 79              method = WireCodec.ToWire(destination.Method),
 80              accountName = destination.AccountName.Trim(),
 81              accountNumber = destination.AccountNumber.Trim(),
 82          }, ct);
 83  
 84          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
 85      }
 86

 88      {
 89          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
 90          return new LedgerEntry
 91          {
 92              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
 93              Uid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "uid"),
 94              Kind = WireCodec.ToLedgerKind(Fs.String(fields, "kind")),
 95              AmountCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "amountCentavos"),
 96              ListingId = Fs.String(fields, "listingId"),
 97              BidId = Fs.String(fields, "bidId"),
 98              PayoutRequestId = Fs.String(fields, "payoutRequestId"),
 99              Note = Fs.String(fields, "note"),
100              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt"),
101          };
102      }
103  
104      internal static PayoutRequest MapPayout(JsonElement document)
105      {
106          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
107          return new PayoutRequest
108          {
109              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
110              Uid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "uid"),
111              AmountCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "amountCentavos"),
112              Method = WireCodec.ToPayoutMethod(Fs.String(fields, "method")),
113              AccountName = Fs.StringOr(fields, "accountName"),
114              AccountNumber = Fs.StringOr(fields, "accountNumber"),
115              Status = WireCodec.ToPayoutStatus(Fs.String(fields, "status")),
116              DeclineReason = Fs.String(fields, "declineReason"),
117              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt"),

123  /// <summary>
124  /// <see cref="IPayoutModerationService"/> over the admin payout callables. The queue read
125  /// is a plain query — firestore.rules lets an admin read every request — and both
126  /// decisions go through Functions, which re-check the admin claim.
127  /// </summary>
128  public sealed class FunctionsPayoutModerationService : IPayoutModerationService
129  {
130      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
131      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
132  
133      public FunctionsPayoutModerationService(FirestoreClient firestore, FunctionsClient functions)
134      {
135          _firestore = firestore;
136          _functions = functions;
137      }
138  
139      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PayoutRequest>> GetPendingPayoutsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
140      {
141          // Oldest first: a payout queue worked newest-first is one where somebody waits
142          // forever.
143          var query = Q.Build(
144              Q.From("payoutRequests"),
145              Q.Equal("status", Fs.Str("requested")),
146              [Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: false)],
147              limit: 50);
148  
149          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
150          return documents.Select(FirestoreWalletService.MapPayout).ToArray();
151      }

153      public async Task<OperationResult> MarkPaidAsync(string payoutRequestId, CancellationToken ct = default)
154      {
155          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("markPayoutPaid", new { payoutRequestId }, ct);
156          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
157      }
158  
159      public async Task<OperationResult> DeclineAsync(
160          string payoutRequestId, string? reason, CancellationToken ct = default)
161      {
162          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("declinePayout", new { payoutRequestId, reason }, ct);
163          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
164      }
165  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FunctionsClient.cs

```csharp
 1  using System.Net.Http.Headers;
 2  using System.Net.Http.Json;
 3  using System.Text.Json;
 4  using NUTrade1.Core;
 5  
 6  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 7  
 8  /// <summary>
 9  /// Invokes Firebase callable Cloud Functions over plain HTTPS.
10  ///
11  /// The callable protocol is simple enough to speak directly: POST
12  /// <c>{"data": {...}}</c> with the user's ID token as a bearer, and read back either
13  /// <c>{"result": {...}}</c> or <c>{"error": {"message": "...", "status": "..."}}</c>.
14  /// Doing it here rather than through a native SDK is what lets the Windows head
15  /// exercise the same payment, bidding and matching paths as the mobile heads.
16  /// </summary>
17  public sealed class FunctionsClient
18  {
19      private readonly HttpClient _http;
20      private readonly IFirebaseTokenProvider _tokens;
21  
22      public FunctionsClient(HttpClient http, IFirebaseTokenProvider tokens)
23      {
24          _http = http;
25          _tokens = tokens;
26      }
27  
28      /// <summary>
29      /// Calls <paramref name="name"/> and returns its <c>result</c> payload. Failures come
30      /// back as a failed <see cref="OperationResult{T}"/> carrying the Function's own
31      /// message — those are written to be shown to the student (for example
32      /// "Your bid must be at least ₱480.00").
33      /// </summary>
34      /// <param name="signedOut">
35      /// True for the few Functions a signed-out student may call (registration). The call
36      /// goes out with no ID token rather than failing with "Sign in to continue."
37      /// </param>
38      public async Task<OperationResult<JsonElement>> CallAsync(
39          string name, object data, CancellationToken ct = default, bool signedOut = false)
40      {
41          string? token = null;
42          if (!signedOut)
43          {
44              token = await _tokens.GetIdTokenAsync(ct);
45              if (token is null) return OperationResult<JsonElement>.Fail("Sign in to continue.");
46          }
47  
48          using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, FirebaseSettings.FunctionUrl(name))
49          {
50              Content = JsonContent.Create(new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["data"] = data }),
51          };
52          if (token is not null)
53              request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
54  
55          try
56          {
57              using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, ct);
58              var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
59  
60              using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
61              var root = doc.RootElement;
62  
63              if (root.TryGetProperty("error", out var error))
64              {
65                  var message = error.TryGetProperty("message", out var m) ? m.GetString() : null;
66                  return OperationResult<JsonElement>.Fail(message ?? "That didn't work. Try again.");
67              }
68  
69              if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
70                  return OperationResult<JsonElement>.Fail("That didn't work. Try again.");
71  
72              return OperationResult<JsonElement>.Ok(
73                  root.TryGetProperty("result", out var result) ? result.Clone() : default);
74          }
75          catch (HttpRequestException)
76          {
77              return OperationResult<JsonElement>.Fail("Can't reach NUTrade right now. Check your connection.");
78          }
79          catch (JsonException)
80          {
81              return OperationResult<JsonElement>.Fail("NUTrade sent back something unexpected. Try again.");
82          }
83      }
84  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FunctionsDepositService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Text.Json;
  2  using NUTrade1.Core;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// <see cref="IDepositService"/> over the <c>requestBid</c> / <c>checkBidDeposit</c>
  8  /// callables, with the deposit history read straight from <c>bidIntents</c>.
  9  ///
 10  /// Both writes are Functions calls because a bid is server-owned: the deposit has to be
 11  /// minted with our PayMongo key, and the bid itself is only written once PayMongo confirms
 12  /// the money. firestore.rules denies the client either.
 13  /// </summary>
 14  public sealed class FunctionsDepositService : IDepositService
 15  {
 16      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
 17      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 18      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 19  
 20      public FunctionsDepositService(FunctionsClient functions, FirestoreClient firestore, IAuthService auth)
 21      {
 22          _functions = functions;
 23          _firestore = firestore;
 24          _auth = auth;
 25      }
 26  
 27      public async Task<OperationResult<BidDeposit>> RequestBidAsync(
 28          string listingId, long amountCentavos, CancellationToken ct = default)
 29      {
 30          var result = await _functions.CallAsync(
 31              "requestBid", new { listingId, amountCentavos }, ct);
 32          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Fail(result.Error!);
 33  
 34          var payload = result.Value;
 35          var id = ReadString(payload, "bidIntentId");
 36          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
 37              return OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Fail("NUTrade sent back something unexpected. Try again.");
 38  
 39          return OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Ok(new BidDeposit
 40          {
 41              Id = id,
 42              ListingId = listingId,
 43              AmountCentavos = ReadLong(payload, "amountCentavos"),
 44              DepositCentavos = ReadLong(payload, "depositCentavos"),
 45              DepositPercent = (int)ReadLong(payload, "depositPercent"),
 46              Status = DepositStatus.AwaitingPayment,
 47              QrImageUrl = ReadString(payload, "qrImageUrl"),
 48              QrImageBase64 = ReadString(payload, "qrImageBase64"),
 49              QrPayload = ReadString(payload, "qrPayload"),
 50              QrExpiresAt = ReadEpochMillis(payload, "expiresAt"),
 51              CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
 52          });
 53      }
 54  
 55      public async Task<OperationResult<BidDeposit>> CheckDepositAsync(
 56          string bidIntentId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 57      {
 58          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("checkBidDeposit", new { bidIntentId }, ct);
 59          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Fail(result.Error!);
 60  
 61          // The callable answers with the state only; the full record is read back so the
 62          // screen keeps its amounts and QR without the Function having to resend them.
 63          var document = await _firestore.GetDocumentAsync($"bidIntents/{bidIntentId}", ct);
 64          if (document is not { } doc)
 65              return OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Fail("That bid is no longer available.");
 66  
 67          return OperationResult<BidDeposit>.Ok(Map(doc, bidIntentId));
 68      }
 69  
 70      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<BidDeposit>> GetMyDepositsAsync(
 71          int limit = 25, CancellationToken ct = default)
 72      {
 73          if (_auth.CurrentUid is not { } uid) return [];
 74  
 75          var query = Q.Build(
 76              Q.From("bidIntents"),
 77              Q.Equal("bidderUid", Fs.Str(uid)),
 78              [Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true)],
 79              limit: limit);
 80  
 81          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 82          return documents.Select(d => Map(d, Fs.IdFromName(d))).ToArray();
 83      }
 84  
 85      private static BidDeposit Map(JsonElement document, string id)
 86      {
 87          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
 88          return new BidDeposit
 89          {
 90              Id = id,
 91              ListingId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingId"),
 92              ListingTitle = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingTitle"),
 93              AmountCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "amountCentavos"),
 94              DepositCentavos = Fs.Long(fields, "depositCentavos"),
 95              DepositPercent = Fs.Int32(fields, "depositPercent"),
 96              Status = WireCodec.ToDepositStatus(Fs.String(fields, "status")),
 97              QrImageUrl = Fs.String(fields, "qrImageUrl"),
 98              QrImageBase64 = Fs.String(fields, "qrImageBase64"),
 99              QrPayload = Fs.String(fields, "qrPayload"),
100              QrExpiresAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "qrExpiresAt"),
101              CommittedBidId = Fs.String(fields, "committedBidId"),
102              RefundReason = Fs.String(fields, "refundReason"),
103              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt"),
104              ResolvedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "resolvedAt"),
105          };
106      }
107  
108      private static string? ReadString(JsonElement payload, string name) =>
109          payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
110          && payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
111          && value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
112              ? value.GetString()
113              : null;
114  
115      private static long ReadLong(JsonElement payload, string name) =>
116          payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
117          && payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
118          && value.TryGetInt64(out var parsed)
119              ? parsed
120              : 0;
121  
122      private static DateTimeOffset? ReadEpochMillis(JsonElement payload, string name) =>
123          payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
124          && payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
125          && value.TryGetInt64(out var ms)
126              ? DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(ms)
127              : null;
128  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FunctionsListingModerationService.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// <see cref="IListingModerationService"/> over the <c>approveListing</c> /
 7  /// <c>rejectListing</c> callables.
 8  ///
 9  /// The queue itself is a plain Firestore read — listings are readable by any signed-in
10  /// student — but both decisions are Functions: firestore.rules forbids every client
11  /// update to a listing, and the Functions re-check the admin claim rather than trusting
12  /// that only admins can reach this screen.
13  /// </summary>
14  public sealed class FunctionsListingModerationService : IListingModerationService
15  {
16      /// <summary>Plenty for a campus queue; beyond this the oldest are shown first anyway.</summary>
17      private const int QueueLimit = 100;
18  
19      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
20      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
21  
22      public FunctionsListingModerationService(FirestoreClient firestore, FunctionsClient functions)
23      {
24          _firestore = firestore;
25          _functions = functions;
26      }
27  
28      public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Listing>> GetPendingListingsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
29      {
30          // Equality only, sorted here: an orderBy on a second field would need its own
31          // composite index for a queue that never holds more than a handful of items.
32          var query = Q.Build(
33              Q.From("listings"),
34              Q.Equal("status", Fs.Str(WireCodec.ToWire(ListingStatus.PendingApproval))),
35              limit: QueueLimit);
36  
37          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
38          return documents
39              .Select(FirestoreListingService.Map)
40              .OrderBy(l => l.SubmittedForApprovalAt ?? l.CreatedAt)
41              .ToArray();
42      }
43  
44      public async Task<OperationResult> ApproveListingAsync(string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
45      {
46          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("approveListing", new { listingId }, ct);
47          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
48      }
49  
50      public async Task<OperationResult> RejectListingAsync(string listingId, string? reason, CancellationToken ct = default)
51      {
52          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("rejectListing", new { listingId, reason = reason ?? string.Empty }, ct);
53          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
54      }
55  }
```

```csharp
 6  /// <summary>
 7  /// <see cref="IPasswordResetService"/> over the <c>startPasswordReset</c> /
 8  /// <c>verifyPasswordResetCode</c> / <c>completePasswordReset</c> callables. All three are
 9  /// called signed out — a student who could sign in would not be here.
10  /// </summary>
11  public sealed class FunctionsPasswordResetService : IPasswordResetService
12  {
13      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
14  
15      public FunctionsPasswordResetService(FunctionsClient functions) => _functions = functions;
16  
17      public async Task<OperationResult<OtpChallenge>> StartAsync(string email, CancellationToken ct = default)
18      {
19          var result = await _functions.CallAsync(
20              "startPasswordReset", new { email = email.Trim() }, ct, signedOut: true);
21          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<OtpChallenge>.Fail(result.Error!);
22  
23          var payload = result.Value;
24          return OperationResult<OtpChallenge>.Ok(new OtpChallenge(
25              ReadString(payload, "sentTo") ?? email.Trim(),
26              ReadInt(payload, "expiresInSeconds", 600),
27              ReadInt(payload, "resendAfterSeconds", 60)));
28      }
29  
30      public async Task<OperationResult<string>> VerifyCodeAsync(string email, string code, CancellationToken ct = default)
31      {
32          var result = await _functions.CallAsync(
33              "verifyPasswordResetCode", new { email = email.Trim(), code = code.Trim() }, ct, signedOut: true);
34          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<string>.Fail(result.Error!);
35  
36          return ReadString(result.Value, "resetToken") is { Length: > 0 } token
37              ? OperationResult<string>.Ok(token)
38              : OperationResult<string>.Fail("NUTrade sent back something unexpected. Try again.");
39      }
40  
41      public async Task<OperationResult> CompleteAsync(PasswordResetDetails details, CancellationToken ct = default)
42      {
43          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("completePasswordReset", new
44          {
45              email = details.Email.Trim(),
46              resetToken = details.ResetToken,
47              password = details.Password,
48          }, ct, signedOut: true);
49  
50          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
51      }
52  
53      private static string? ReadString(JsonElement payload, string name) =>
54          payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
55          && payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
56          && value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
57              ? value.GetString()
58              : null;
59  
60      private static int ReadInt(JsonElement payload, string name, int fallback) =>
61          payload.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
62          && payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value)
63          && value.TryGetInt32(out var parsed)
64              ? parsed
65              : fallback;
66  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/FunctionsPaymentService.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Text.Json;
  2  using NUTrade1.Core;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// <see cref="IPaymentService"/> against the <c>createQrPayment</c> callable.
  8  ///
  9  /// The app never touches PayMongo. It asks the Function for a QR, renders it, and
 10  /// then watches its own listing document: the money's arrival is reported by
 11  /// PayMongo to <c>paymongoWebhook</c>, which is what actually publishes the auction.
 12  /// Nothing the client does can shortcut that.
 13  /// </summary>
 14  public sealed class FunctionsPaymentService : IPaymentService
 15  {
 16      private readonly FunctionsClient _functions;
 17      private readonly FirestoreClient _firestore;
 18      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 19  
 20      public FunctionsPaymentService(FunctionsClient functions, FirestoreClient firestore, IAuthService auth)
 21      {
 22          _functions = functions;
 23          _firestore = firestore;
 24          _auth = auth;
 25      }
 26  
 27      public async Task<OperationResult<QrPaymentResult>> CreateQrPaymentAsync(
 28          string listingId, ListingPackage package, CancellationToken ct = default)
 29      {
 30          var result = await _functions.CallAsync(
 31              "createQrPayment",
 32              new { listingId, package = package.ToString() },
 33              ct);
 34  
 35          if (!result.Succeeded) return OperationResult<QrPaymentResult>.Fail(result.Error!);
 36  
 37          var payload = result.Value;
 38          if (payload.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
 39              return OperationResult<QrPaymentResult>.Fail("NUTrade sent back something unexpected. Try again.");
 40  
 41          var requiresPayment = !payload.TryGetProperty("requiresPayment", out var rp)
 42                                || rp.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.False;
 43  
 44          if (!requiresPayment)
 45          {
 46              return OperationResult<QrPaymentResult>.Ok(new QrPaymentResult
 47              {
 48                  RequiresPayment = false,
 49                  AmountCentavos = 0,
 50              });
 51          }
 52  
 53          return OperationResult<QrPaymentResult>.Ok(new QrPaymentResult
 54          {
 55              RequiresPayment = true,
 56              PaymentId = ReadString(payload, "paymentId") ?? string.Empty,
 57              QrImageUrl = ReadString(payload, "qrImageUrl"),
 58              QrImageBase64 = ReadString(payload, "qrImageBase64"),
 59              QrPayload = ReadString(payload, "qrPayload"),
 60              RedirectUrl = ReadString(payload, "redirectUrl"),
 61              AmountCentavos = payload.TryGetProperty("amountCentavos", out var amount) && amount.TryGetInt64(out var a)
 62                  ? a
 63                  : NUTradeConstants.FeeForPackage(package),
 64              ExpiresAt = payload.TryGetProperty("expiresAt", out var expires) && expires.TryGetInt64(out var ms)
 65                  ? DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(ms)
 66                  : DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(NUTradeConstants.QrExpiryMinutes),
 67          });
 68      }
 69  
 70      public async Task<OperationResult> CheckListingPaymentAsync(string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 71      {
 72          var result = await _functions.CallAsync("checkListingPayment", new { listingId }, ct);
 73          return result.Succeeded ? OperationResult.Ok() : OperationResult.Fail(result.Error!);
 74      }
 75  
 76      public async Task<Payment?> GetPaymentForListingAsync(string listingId, CancellationToken ct = default)
 77      {
 78          if (_auth.CurrentUid is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listingId)) return null;
 79  
 80          var query = Q.Build(
 81              Q.From("payments"),
 82              Q.Equal("listingId", Fs.Str(listingId)),
 83              new[] { Q.OrderBy("createdAt", descending: true) },
 84              limit: 1);
 85  
 86          var documents = await _firestore.RunQueryAsync(string.Empty, query, ct);
 87          return documents.Count == 0 ? null : Map(documents[0]);
 88      }
 89  
 90      /// <summary>Reads a string that the Function may legitimately have returned as JSON null.</summary>
 91      private static string? ReadString(JsonElement payload, string name) =>
 92          payload.TryGetProperty(name, out var value) && value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
 93              ? value.GetString()
 94              : null;
 95  
 96      internal static Payment Map(JsonElement document)
 97      {
 98          var fields = document.GetProperty("fields");
 99          return new Payment
100          {
101              Id = Fs.IdFromName(document),
102              ListingId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "listingId"),
103              Uid = Fs.StringOr(fields, "uid"),
104              Package = Fs.Enum(fields, "package", ListingPackage.Additional),
105              Amount = Fs.Long(fields, "amount"),
106              PaymongoIntentId = Fs.StringOr(fields, "paymongoIntentId"),
107              Status = WireCodec.ToPaymentStatus(Fs.String(fields, "status")),
108              QrExpiresAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "qrExpiresAt"),
109              CreatedAt = Fs.Timestamp(fields, "createdAt") ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
110          };
111      }
112  }
```

### NUTrade1/Services/Firebase/GoogleAuthBroker.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Net;
  2  using System.Net.Http.Json;
  3  using System.Security.Cryptography;
  4  using System.Text;
  5  using System.Text.Json;
  6  using NUTrade1.Core;
  7  
  8  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
  9  
 10  /// <summary>Obtains a Google ID token to hand to Firebase's <c>signInWithIdp</c>.</summary>
 11  public interface IGoogleAuthBroker
 12  {
 13      bool IsConfigured { get; }
 14  
 15      /// <summary>Runs the OAuth flow and returns a Google-issued ID token (a JWT).</summary>
 16      Task<OperationResult<string>> GetIdTokenAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
 17  }
 18  
 19  /// <summary>
 20  /// OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE against Google, in the two shapes the
 21  /// platforms actually support:
 22  ///
 23  /// • Desktop (Windows, Mac Catalyst) — the loopback flow. The system browser is opened
 24  ///   and a one-shot <see cref="HttpListener"/> on 127.0.0.1 catches the redirect. This is
 25  ///   what makes Google sign-in work on the unpackaged Windows head, where MAUI's
 26  ///   <c>WebAuthenticator</c> cannot round-trip a custom URI scheme.
 27  ///
 28  /// • Mobile (Android, iOS) — <c>WebAuthenticator</c> with the reversed-client-id scheme.
 29  ///
 30  /// PKCE does the real work in both: the client secret in an installed app is not secret,
 31  /// so the <c>code_verifier</c> is what stops an intercepted authorization code being
 32  /// redeemed by anything but this process.
 33  /// </summary>
 34  public sealed class GoogleAuthBroker : IGoogleAuthBroker
 35  {
 36      private readonly HttpClient _http;
 37  
 38      public GoogleAuthBroker(HttpClient http) => _http = http;
 39  
 40      public bool IsConfigured => GoogleOAuth.IsConfigured;
 41  
 42      public async Task<OperationResult<string>> GetIdTokenAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
 43      {
 44          if (!IsConfigured)
 45          {
 46              return OperationResult<string>.Fail(
 47                  "Google sign-in isn't set up yet. Use your email and password for now.");
 48          }
 49  
 50          var verifier = CreateCodeVerifier();
 51          var challenge = CreateCodeChallenge(verifier);
 52          var state = CreateCodeVerifier();
 53  
 54          try
 55          {
 56  #if ANDROID || IOS
 57              return await RunMobileFlowAsync(verifier, challenge, state, ct);
 58  #else
 59              return await RunLoopbackFlowAsync(verifier, challenge, state, ct);
 60  #endif
 61          }
 62          catch (TaskCanceledException)
 63          {
 64              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google sign-in was cancelled.");
 65          }
 66          catch (HttpRequestException)
 67          {
 68              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Can't reach Google right now. Check your connection.");
 69          }
 70      }
 71  
 72  #if ANDROID || IOS
 73      private async Task<OperationResult<string>> RunMobileFlowAsync(
 74          string verifier, string challenge, string state, CancellationToken ct)
 75      {
 76          var redirectUri = GoogleOAuth.MobileRedirectUri!;
 77          var authorizeUrl = BuildAuthorizeUrl(redirectUri, challenge, state);
 78  
 79          WebAuthenticatorResult result;
 80          try
 81          {
 82              result = await WebAuthenticator.Default.AuthenticateAsync(
 83                  new Uri(authorizeUrl), new Uri(redirectUri));
 84          }
 85          catch (TaskCanceledException)
 86          {
 87              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google sign-in was cancelled.");
 88          }
 89  
 90          if (!result.Properties.TryGetValue("state", out var returnedState) || returnedState != state)
 91              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google sign-in failed a security check. Try again.");
 92  
 93          if (!result.Properties.TryGetValue("code", out var code))
 94              return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google didn't return a sign-in code.");
 95  
 96          return await ExchangeCodeAsync(code, verifier, redirectUri, ct);
 97      }
 98  #else
 99      private async Task<OperationResult<string>> RunLoopbackFlowAsync(
100          string verifier, string challenge, string state, CancellationToken ct)
101      {
102          // Port 0 lets the OS pick a free one; localhost needs no URL ACL on Windows,
103          // so this works without elevation.
104          var listenerPort = GetFreePort();
105          var redirectUri = $"http://127.0.0.1:{listenerPort}/";
106  
107          using var listener = new HttpListener();
108          listener.Prefixes.Add(redirectUri);
109          listener.Start();
110  
111          try
112          {
113              await Launcher.Default.OpenAsync(new Uri(BuildAuthorizeUrl(redirectUri, challenge, state)));
114  
115              // Don't leave a listener and a browser tab open forever if the user wanders off.
116              using var timeout = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
117              timeout.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3));
118  
119              var contextTask = listener.GetContextAsync();
120              var completed = await Task.WhenAny(contextTask, Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, timeout.Token));
121              if (completed != contextTask)
122                  return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google sign-in timed out.");
123  
124              var context = await contextTask;
125              var query = context.Request.QueryString;
126  
127              await RespondAsync(context, query["error"] is null);
128  
129              if (query["error"] is { } error)
130                  return OperationResult<string>.Fail($"Google sign-in was declined ({error}).");
131              if (query["state"] != state)
132                  return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google sign-in failed a security check. Try again.");
133              if (query["code"] is not { } code)
134                  return OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google didn't return a sign-in code.");
135  
136              return await ExchangeCodeAsync(code, verifier, redirectUri, ct);
137          }
138          finally
139          {
140              listener.Stop();
141          }
142      }
143  
144      private static int GetFreePort()
145      {
146          var probe = new System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, 0);
147          probe.Start();
148          var port = ((IPEndPoint)probe.LocalEndpoint).Port;
149          probe.Stop();
150          return port;
151      }
152  
153      /// <summary>Writes the page the browser lands on, so the user isn't left staring at a blank tab.</summary>
154      private static async Task RespondAsync(HttpListenerContext context, bool succeeded)
155      {
156          var message = succeeded
157              ? "You're signed in. You can close this tab and go back to NUTrade."
158              : "Sign-in was cancelled. You can close this tab.";
159  
160          var html = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes($"""
161              <!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>NUTrade</title></head>
162              <body style="margin:0;display:grid;place-items:center;height:100vh;background:#F4F6FB;
163                           font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:#1C2C58;">
164                <p style="font-size:16px;">{message}</p>
165              </body></html>
166              """);
167  
168          context.Response.ContentType = "text/html; charset=utf-8";
169          context.Response.ContentLength64 = html.Length;
170          await context.Response.OutputStream.WriteAsync(html);
171          context.Response.Close();
172      }
173  #endif
174  
175      private static string BuildAuthorizeUrl(string redirectUri, string challenge, string state)
176      {
177          var query = new Dictionary<string, string>
178          {
179              ["client_id"] = GoogleOAuth.ClientId,
180              ["redirect_uri"] = redirectUri,
181              ["response_type"] = "code",
182              ["scope"] = GoogleOAuth.Scopes,
183              ["code_challenge"] = challenge,
184              ["code_challenge_method"] = "S256",
185              ["state"] = state,
186              // Without this Google skips the account chooser when one session is already
187              // live, which defeats the point of "use your saved Google account".
188              ["prompt"] = "select_account",
189          };
190  
191          var encoded = string.Join("&", query.Select(kv =>
192              $"{Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Key)}={Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Value)}"));
193  
194          return $"{GoogleOAuth.AuthorizationEndpoint}?{encoded}";
195      }
196  
197      /// <summary>Redeems the authorization code for the <c>id_token</c> Firebase needs.</summary>
198      private async Task<OperationResult<string>> ExchangeCodeAsync(
199          string code, string verifier, string redirectUri, CancellationToken ct)
200      {
201          var form = new Dictionary<string, string>
202          {
203              ["code"] = code,
204              ["client_id"] = GoogleOAuth.ClientId,
205              ["redirect_uri"] = redirectUri,
206              ["grant_type"] = "authorization_code",
207              ["code_verifier"] = verifier,
208          };
209  
210  #if !ANDROID && !IOS
211          // Google's desktop client type still wants a secret on the token request. It is
212          // shipped inside the binary and Google treats it as non-confidential; PKCE is the
213          // control that actually matters here.
214          if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GoogleOAuth.DesktopClientSecret))
215              form["client_secret"] = GoogleOAuth.DesktopClientSecret;
216  #endif
217  
218          using var content = new FormUrlEncodedContent(form);
219          using var response = await _http.PostAsync(GoogleOAuth.TokenEndpoint, content, ct);
220          var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct);
221  
222          if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
223          {
224              var detail = TryReadError(raw);
225              return OperationResult<string>.Fail(
226                  detail is null ? "Google refused the sign-in. Try again." : $"Google refused the sign-in ({detail}).");
227          }
228  
229          using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
230          return doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("id_token", out var idToken) && idToken.GetString() is { } token
231              ? OperationResult<string>.Ok(token)
232              : OperationResult<string>.Fail("Google didn't return an identity token.");
233      }
234  
235      private static string? TryReadError(string raw)
236      {
237          try
238          {
239              using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
240              return doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("error_description", out var description)
241                  ? description.GetString()
242                  : doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("error", out var error) ? error.GetString() : null;
243          }
244          catch (JsonException)
245          {
246              return null;
247          }
248      }
249  
250      /// <summary>A high-entropy random string, base64url-encoded without padding (RFC 7636).</summary>
251      private static string CreateCodeVerifier() =>
252          Base64Url(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32));
253  
254      private static string CreateCodeChallenge(string verifier) =>
255          Base64Url(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(verifier)));
256  
257      private static string Base64Url(byte[] bytes) =>
258          Convert.ToBase64String(bytes).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+', '-').Replace('/', '_');
259  }
```

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Hands out a currently-valid Firebase ID token for the signed-in user, refreshing
 5  /// it when it is close to expiry. Every other Firebase-backed service depends on this
 6  /// rather than on <see cref="Core.IAuthService"/> so that the token plumbing stays
 7  /// inside the Firebase implementation and never leaks into Core.
 8  /// </summary>
 9  public interface IFirebaseTokenProvider
10  {
11      /// <summary>
12      /// A valid ID token, or null when nobody is signed in. Callers put this in an
13      /// <c>Authorization: Bearer</c> header.
14      /// </summary>
15      Task<string?> GetIdTokenAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
16  
17      /// <summary>UID of the signed-in user, or null.</summary>
18      string? CurrentUid { get; }
19  }
```

```csharp
 1  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 2  
 3  /// <summary>
 4  /// Stands in for a Firestore snapshot listener over the REST transport, which has no
 5  /// streaming equivalent: re-reads on an interval and raises the callback on the UI
 6  /// thread whenever the result changed.
 7  ///
 8  /// It fires once immediately so a page paints without waiting out the first interval,
 9  /// suppresses repeats by comparing a caller-supplied signature, and swallows transient
10  /// read failures — a dropped poll should not tear down the page, the next one recovers.
11  /// Disposing stops the loop; every caller does that in <c>OnDisappearing</c>.
12  /// </summary>
13  internal sealed class PollingObserver<T> : IDisposable
14  {
15      private readonly CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();
16  
17      public PollingObserver(
18          Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> read,
19          Func<T, string> signature,
20          Action<T> onChanged,
21          TimeSpan interval)
22      {
23          _ = RunAsync(read, signature, onChanged, interval, _cts.Token);
24      }
25  
26      private static async Task RunAsync(
27          Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> read,
28          Func<T, string> signature,
29          Action<T> onChanged,
30          TimeSpan interval,
31          CancellationToken ct)
32      {
33          string? previous = null;
34  
35          while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
36          {
37              try
38              {
39                  var value = await read(ct);
40                  var current = signature(value);
41  
42                  if (current != previous)
43                  {
44                      previous = current;
45                      MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread(() =>
46                      {
47                          if (!ct.IsCancellationRequested) onChanged(value);
48                      });
49                  }
50              }
51              catch (OperationCanceledException)
52              {
53                  return;
54              }
55              catch
56              {
57                  // Transient — try again on the next tick.
58              }
59  
60              try
61              {
62                  await Task.Delay(interval, ct);
63              }
64              catch (OperationCanceledException)
65              {
66                  return;
67              }
68          }
69      }
70  
71      public void Dispose()
72      {
73          _cts.Cancel();
74          _cts.Dispose();
75      }
76  }
```

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  
 3  namespace NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 4  
 5  /// <summary>
 6  /// Maps the two enums whose Firestore spellings are not just their .NET member names.
 7  ///
 8  /// The backend is TypeScript and stores these as snake_case strings
 9  /// (<c>pending_payment</c>, <c>pending_approval</c>, <c>awaiting_payment</c>) — they are part of the wire
10  /// contract in <c>functions/src/constants.ts</c> and in <c>firestore.rules</c>, which
11  /// matches on the literal values, so the client bends to them rather than the reverse.
12  ///
13  /// The wallet enums (ledger kind, payout status, payout method) are snake_case or lower
14  /// case on the wire for the same reason and are mapped here too.
15  ///
16  /// Every other enum on the wire (category, condition, campus zone, package, bid status,
17  /// chat status, message type) already round-trips through its member name and is read
18  /// with <see cref="Fs.Enum{T}"/> directly.
19  /// </summary>
20  public static class WireCodec
21  {
22      public static string ToWire(ListingStatus status) => status switch
23      {
24          ListingStatus.Draft => "draft",
25          ListingStatus.PendingPayment => "pending_payment",
26          ListingStatus.PendingApproval => "pending_approval",
27          ListingStatus.Active => "active",
28          ListingStatus.Matched => "matched",
29          ListingStatus.Completed => "completed",
30          ListingStatus.Expired => "expired",
31          ListingStatus.Cancelled => "cancelled",
32          ListingStatus.Rejected => "rejected",
33          _ => "draft",
34      };
35  
36      public static ListingStatus ToListingStatus(string? wire) => wire switch
37      {
38          "draft" => ListingStatus.Draft,
39          "pending_payment" => ListingStatus.PendingPayment,
40          "pending_approval" => ListingStatus.PendingApproval,
41          "active" => ListingStatus.Active,
42          "matched" => ListingStatus.Matched,
43          "completed" => ListingStatus.Completed,
44          "expired" => ListingStatus.Expired,
45          "cancelled" => ListingStatus.Cancelled,
46          "rejected" => ListingStatus.Rejected,
47          _ => ListingStatus.Draft,
48      };
49  
50      public static DepositStatus ToDepositStatus(string? wire) => wire switch
51      {
52          "awaiting_payment" => DepositStatus.AwaitingPayment,
53          "locked_in_escrow" => DepositStatus.LockedInEscrow,
54          "credited_to_seller" => DepositStatus.CreditedToSeller,
55          "refunded_to_buyer" => DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer,
56          "forfeited" => DepositStatus.Forfeited,
57          "expired" => DepositStatus.Expired,
58          _ => DepositStatus.Unknown,
59      };
60  
61      public static LedgerKind ToLedgerKind(string? wire) => wire switch
62      {
63          "deposit_credit" => LedgerKind.DepositCredit,
64          "forfeit" => LedgerKind.Forfeit,
65          "refund_credit" => LedgerKind.RefundCredit,
66          "payout" => LedgerKind.Payout,
67          _ => LedgerKind.Unknown,
68      };
69  
70      public static PayoutStatus ToPayoutStatus(string? wire) => wire switch
71      {
72          "requested" => PayoutStatus.Requested,
73          "paid" => PayoutStatus.Paid,
74          "declined" => PayoutStatus.Declined,
75          _ => PayoutStatus.Unknown,
76      };
77  
78      public static string ToWire(PayoutMethod method) => method switch
79      {
80          PayoutMethod.Maya => "maya",
81          _ => "gcash",
82      };
83  
84      public static PayoutMethod ToPayoutMethod(string? wire) => wire switch
85      {
86          "maya" => PayoutMethod.Maya,
87          "gcash" => PayoutMethod.GCash,
88          _ => PayoutMethod.Unknown,
89      };
90  
91      public static PaymentStatus ToPaymentStatus(string? wire) => wire switch
92      {
93          "awaiting_payment" => PaymentStatus.AwaitingPayment,
94          "paid" => PaymentStatus.Paid,
95          "failed" => PaymentStatus.Failed,
96          "expired" => PaymentStatus.Expired,
97          _ => PaymentStatus.AwaitingPayment,
98      };
99  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/BaseViewModel.cs

```csharp
 1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
 2  using NUTrade1.Services;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
 5  
 6  /// <summary>Common state for every ViewModel: a title, a busy flag and the three message channels.</summary>
 7  public abstract partial class BaseViewModel : ObservableObject
 8  {
 9      [ObservableProperty]
10      private string _title = string.Empty;
11  
12      [ObservableProperty]
13      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsNotBusy))]
14      private bool _isBusy;
15  
16      public bool IsNotBusy => !IsBusy;
17  
18      // ---- Messages ------------------------------------------------------------
19      // These used to live on each ViewModel and were drawn as a coloured label wedged
20      // into whichever form raised them, so the same failure looked different on every
21      // screen and could scroll out of sight. They now live here, and setting any of them
22      // slides a toast in at the top-centre of the screen instead — one place, one
23      // treatment, wherever the message comes from.
24      //
25      // Every existing `ErrorMessage = "..."` still works untouched, and the blanket
26      // `ErrorMessage = null` that commands run before their work is a no-op, because
27      // Toaster ignores empty messages.
28  
29      /// <summary>Something failed. Shown in red, and held on screen longer than the rest.</summary>
30      [ObservableProperty] private string? _errorMessage;
31  
32      /// <summary>Something worked. Shown in green.</summary>
33      [ObservableProperty] private string? _infoMessage;
34  
35      /// <summary>Progress worth reporting but not a failure — an admin decision landing, say.</summary>
36      [ObservableProperty] private string? _statusMessage;
37  
38      partial void OnErrorMessageChanged(string? value)
39      {
40          Toaster.Error(value);
41          OnErrorMessageChangedCore(value);
42      }
43  
44      partial void OnInfoMessageChanged(string? value) => Toaster.Success(value);
45      partial void OnStatusMessageChanged(string? value) => Toaster.Success(value);
46  
47      /// <summary>Hook for a ViewModel with state of its own that depends on the error.</summary>
48      protected virtual void OnErrorMessageChangedCore(string? value) { }
49  
50      /// <summary>Called by the page in <c>OnAppearing</c>. Override to load data.</summary>
51      public virtual Task OnAppearingAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;
52  
53      /// <summary>Called by the page in <c>OnDisappearing</c>. Override to detach listeners.</summary>
54      public virtual Task OnDisappearingAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;
55  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/BidDepositViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  using NUTrade1.Services;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>
  9  /// Scan to place your bid: the QR for a commitment deposit, and the wait for it to land.
 10  ///
 11  /// The polling here is not a convenience — it is how bids get placed. PayMongo's webhook
 12  /// has never arrived in this project, so `checkBidDeposit` asking PayMongo directly is
 13  /// what writes the bid. Leaving this screen does not lose the bid: the server's expiry
 14  /// sweep asks PayMongo too, so a deposit paid after the student walked away still commits.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  [QueryProperty(nameof(BidIntentId), "bidIntentId")]
 17  public partial class BidDepositViewModel : BaseViewModel
 18  {
 19      private static readonly TimeSpan PollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
 20  
 21      private readonly IDepositService _deposits;
 22      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 23      private CancellationTokenSource? _polling;
 24      private bool _announced;
 25  
 26      public BidDepositViewModel(IDepositService deposits, INavigationService nav)
 27      {
 28          _deposits = deposits;
 29          _nav = nav;
 30          Title = "Confirm your bid";
 31      }
 32  
 33      [ObservableProperty] private string? _bidIntentId;
 34  
 35      [ObservableProperty]
 36      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(DepositDisplay))]
 37      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(BidDisplay))]
 38      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ItemTitle))]
 39      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsAwaiting))]
 40      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsCommitted))]
 41      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsReturned))]
 42      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(StatusText))]
 43      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(DepositExplainer))]
 44      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ExpiryText))]
 45      private BidDeposit? _deposit;
 46  
 47      public string ItemTitle => Deposit?.ListingTitle ?? string.Empty;
 48      public string DepositDisplay => Deposit?.DepositDisplay ?? "₱0.00";
 49      public string BidDisplay => Deposit?.AmountDisplay ?? "₱0.00";
 50      /// <summary>What "Save QR" calls the picture, so it is easy to find in the gallery.</summary>
 51      public string QrFileName => $"nutrade-bid-deposit-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmm}";
 52  
 53      public bool IsAwaiting => Deposit?.IsAwaitingPayment ?? true;
 54      public bool IsCommitted => Deposit?.IsCommitted ?? false;
 55  
 56      /// <summary>The money came straight back — usually a bid that went stale while unpaid.</summary>
 57      public bool IsReturned => Deposit?.Status == DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer;
 58  
 59      public string StatusText => Deposit?.Status switch
 60      {
 61          DepositStatus.LockedInEscrow => "Your bid is live. We'll hold the deposit until the auction ends.",
 62          DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer => Deposit.StatusDisplay,
 63          DepositStatus.Expired => "The code expired before it was paid, so no bid was placed.",
 64          _ => "Scan the code with GCash, Maya or any bank app. Your bid goes live the moment it clears.",
 65      };
 66  
 67      /// <summary>
 68      /// Said plainly and before they pay: this is a deposit, not a fee, and there is exactly
 69      /// one way to lose it.
 70      /// </summary>
 71      public string DepositExplainer => Deposit is { } d
 72          ? $"{d.DepositDisplay} is {d.DepositPercent}% of your {d.AmountDisplay} bid. You get it back if you're " +
 73            "outbid or don't win. If you win, it comes off the price — you only lose it by winning and not showing up."
 74          : string.Empty;
 75  
 76      public string ExpiryText => Deposit?.QrExpiresAt is { } at
 77          ? $"This code works until {at.ToLocalTime():h:mm tt}."
 78          : "QR codes expire about 30 minutes after they're generated.";
 79  
 80      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 81      {
 82          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(BidIntentId)) return;
 83  
 84          await CheckAsync();
 85          StartPolling();
 86      }
 87  
 88      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
 89      {
 90          StopPolling();
 91          return Task.CompletedTask;
 92      }
 93  
 94      /// <summary>"I've paid — check now", and the tick behind the automatic poll.</summary>
 95      [RelayCommand]
 96      private async Task CheckAsync()
 97      {
 98          if (BidIntentId is not { Length: > 0 } id || IsBusy) return;
 99          IsBusy = true;
100          try
101          {
102              var result = await _deposits.CheckDepositAsync(id);
103              if (!result.Succeeded)
104              {
105                  ErrorMessage = result.Error;
106                  return;
107              }
108  
109              Deposit = result.Value;
110              if (Deposit is { IsResolved: true } or { IsCommitted: true }) StopPolling();
111              if (Deposit is { IsCommitted: true }) Announce();
112          }
113          finally
114          {
115              IsBusy = false;
116          }
117      }
118  
119      [RelayCommand]
120      private Task BackToListingAsync() => _nav.GoBackAsync();
121  
122      private void Announce()
123      {
124          if (_announced || Deposit is not { } d) return;
125          _announced = true;
126          InfoMessage = $"Bid placed at {d.AmountDisplay}.";
127      }
128  
129      private void StartPolling()
130      {
131          if (_polling is not null || Deposit is { IsAwaitingPayment: false }) return;
132          _polling = new CancellationTokenSource();
133          _ = PollAsync(_polling.Token);
134      }
135  
136      private async Task PollAsync(CancellationToken ct)
137      {
138          while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
139          {
140              try
141              {
142                  await Task.Delay(PollInterval, ct);
143                  await CheckAsync();
144              }
145              catch (OperationCanceledException)
146              {
147                  return;
148              }
149              catch
150              {
151                  // A failed poll is retried on the next tick; never let it end the loop.
152              }
153          }
154      }
155  
156      private void StopPolling()
157      {
158          _polling?.Cancel();
159          _polling?.Dispose();
160          _polling = null;
161      }
162  }
```

```csharp
  1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
```

```csharp
  8  public partial class ChatRoomViewModel : BaseViewModel
```
