```csharp
 13  
 14      public ChatRoomViewModel(IChatService chats, IAuthService auth)
 15      {
 16          _chats = chats;
 17          _auth = auth;
 18          Title = "Chat";
 19      }
 20  
 21      [ObservableProperty] private string? _chatId;
 22      [ObservableProperty] private string _draft = string.Empty;
 23  
 24      [ObservableProperty]
 25      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HeaderTitle))]
 26      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(WinningBidDisplay))]
 27      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(CanMarkCompleted))]
 28      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(CompletionStatusText))]
 29      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowCompletionBar))]
 30      private Chat? _chat;
 31  
 32      public ObservableCollection<ChatMessage> Messages { get; } = new();
 33  
 34      public bool HasMessages => Messages.Count > 0;
 35  
 36      public string HeaderTitle => string.IsNullOrEmpty(Chat?.ListingTitle) ? "Trade partner" : Chat!.ListingTitle;
 37  
 38      public string WinningBidDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Chat?.WinningBidCentavos ?? 0);
 39  
 40      /// <summary>Hidden until the chat document has loaded, so the bar can't flash empty.</summary>
 41      public bool ShowCompletionBar => Chat is not null;
 42  
 43      public bool CanMarkCompleted =>
 44          Chat is { IsClosed: false } chat && !chat.HasConfirmed(_auth.CurrentUid);
 45  
 46      public string CompletionStatusText
 47      {
 48          get
 49          {
 50              if (Chat is not { } chat) return string.Empty;
 51              if (chat.IsClosed) return "Trade completed — both of you confirmed the handover.";
 52              if (chat.HasConfirmed(_auth.CurrentUid)) return "You marked this done. Waiting on the other student.";
 53              return "Met up and swapped? Mark it completed — the trade closes once you both do.";
 54          }
 55      }
 56  
 57      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 58      {
 59          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ChatId)) return;
 60  
 61          Chat = await _chats.GetChatAsync(ChatId);
 62          Title = HeaderTitle;
 63  
 64          _messagesSubscription = _chats.ObserveMessages(ChatId, msgs =>
 65          {
 66              Messages.Clear();
 67              foreach (var m in msgs) Messages.Add(m);
 68              OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasMessages));
 69          });
 70      }
 71  
 72      [RelayCommand]
 73      private async Task SendAsync()
 74      {
 75          var text = Draft.Trim();
 76          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(ChatId)) return;
 77  
 78          Draft = string.Empty;
 79          ErrorMessage = null;
 80  
 81          var result = await _chats.SendMessageAsync(ChatId, text);
 82          if (!result.Succeeded)
 83          {
 84              ErrorMessage = result.Error;
 85              Draft = text;   // hand the text back rather than losing what they typed
 86              return;
 87          }
 88  
 89          // No optimistic append: the observer re-reads within a couple of seconds and
 90          // replaces the list wholesale, so adding it here would only risk a duplicate.
 91      }
 92  
 93      [RelayCommand]
 94      private async Task MarkCompletedAsync()
 95      {
 96          if (IsBusy || string.IsNullOrEmpty(ChatId) || !CanMarkCompleted) return;
 97          IsBusy = true;
 98          ErrorMessage = null;
 99          try
100          {
101              var result = await _chats.MarkTradeCompletedAsync(ChatId);
102              if (!result.Succeeded)
103              {
104                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not mark the trade completed.";
105                  return;
106              }
107  
108              // Re-read rather than guess: whether the trade actually closed depends on
109              // the other participant, and only the server knows that.
110              Chat = await _chats.GetChatAsync(ChatId);
111          }
112          finally
113          {
114              IsBusy = false;
115          }
116      }
117  
118      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
119      {
120          _messagesSubscription?.Dispose();
121          _messagesSubscription = null;
122          return Task.CompletedTask;
123      }
124  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/FeedViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  3  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  4  using NUTrade1.Core;
  5  using NUTrade1.Services;
  6  
  7  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  8  
  9  public partial class FeedViewModel : BaseViewModel
 10  {
 11      private readonly IListingService _listings;
 12      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 13      private string? _cursor;
 14      private IDispatcherTimer? _countdownTimer;
 15  
 16      /// <summary>
 17      /// Everything fetched for the current category, before <see cref="SearchText"/> is
 18      /// applied. Search is a client-side Contains over these, so typing costs nothing —
 19      /// it used to re-run the Firestore query on every keystroke and throw most of the
 20      /// results away, which is what made the search box feel like it was lagging.
 21      /// </summary>
 22      private readonly List<Listing> _fetched = new();
 23  
 24      /// <summary>
 25      /// How long a loaded feed is reused when the tab is reopened. OnAppearing fires on
 26      /// every Shell tab switch, so refetching there unconditionally meant Home → Profile →
 27      /// Home cost two full Firestore queries and showed an empty list in between. Regular
 28      /// listings only join the feed on the hour anyway (publishScheduledListings), so a
 29      /// minute of staleness hides nothing; pull-to-refresh and the filter button still
 30      /// force a read.
 31      /// </summary>
 32      private static readonly TimeSpan FeedFreshFor = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);
 33  
 34      private DateTimeOffset _loadedAt;
 35  
 36      public FeedViewModel(IListingService listings, INavigationService nav)
 37      {
 38          _listings = listings;
 39          _nav = nav;
 40          Title = "Home";
 41      }
 42  
 43      public ObservableRangeCollection<Listing> Listings { get; } = new();
 44  
 45      [ObservableProperty] private ItemCategory? _selectedCategory;
 46      [ObservableProperty] private string _searchText = string.Empty;
 47  
 48      public bool HasListings => Listings.Count > 0;
 49  
 50      public IReadOnlyList<ItemCategory> Categories { get; } =
 51          Enum.GetValues<ItemCategory>().Where(c => c != ItemCategory.Unknown).ToArray();
 52  
 53      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 54      {
 55          if (Listings.Count == 0 || DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - _loadedAt >= FeedFreshFor)
 56              await RefreshAsync();
 57  
 58          StartCountdownTimer();
 59      }
 60  
 61      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
 62      {
 63          StopCountdownTimer();
 64          return Task.CompletedTask;
 65      }
 66  
 67      [RelayCommand]
 68      private async Task RefreshAsync()
 69      {
 70          if (IsBusy) return;
 71          IsBusy = true;
 72          try
 73          {
 74              var page = await _listings.GetActiveFeedAsync(SelectedCategory);
 75              _cursor = page.NextCursor;
 76              _loadedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
 77              _fetched.Clear();
 78              _fetched.AddRange(page.Items);
 79              ApplySearch();
 80          }
 81          finally
 82          {
 83              IsBusy = false;
 84          }
 85      }
 86  
 87      [RelayCommand]
 88      private async Task LoadMoreAsync()
 89      {
 90          if (IsBusy || _cursor is null) return;
 91          IsBusy = true;
 92          try
 93          {
 94              var page = await _listings.GetActiveFeedAsync(SelectedCategory, cursor: _cursor);
 95              _cursor = page.NextCursor;
 96              _fetched.AddRange(page.Items);
 97              ApplySearch();
 98          }
 99          finally
100          {
101              IsBusy = false;
102          }
103      }
104  
105      [RelayCommand]
106      private void SelectCategory(string? key)
107      {
108          SelectedCategory = string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || key == "All"
109              ? null
110              : Enum.Parse<ItemCategory>(key);
111      }
112  
113      [RelayCommand]
114      private Task OpenListingAsync(Listing? listing) =>
115          listing is null
116              ? Task.CompletedTask
117              : _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ListingDetail, new Dictionary<string, object> { ["listingId"] = listing.Id });
118  
119      /// <summary>
120      /// Rebuilds the bound collection from <see cref="_fetched"/> in one notification —
121      /// see <see cref="ObservableRangeCollection{T}"/> for why that matters here.
122      /// </summary>
123      private void ApplySearch()
124      {
125          var q = SearchText.Trim();
126          var matches = q.Length == 0
127              ? (IEnumerable<Listing>)_fetched
128              : _fetched.Where(l =>
129                  l.Title.Contains(q, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
130                  l.Description.Contains(q, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
131  
132          Listings.ReplaceAll(matches);
133          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasListings));
134          TickCountdowns();
135      }
136  
137      private void StartCountdownTimer()
138      {
139          if (_countdownTimer is not null) return;
140          _countdownTimer = Application.Current?.Dispatcher.CreateTimer();
141          if (_countdownTimer is null) return;
142          _countdownTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
143          _countdownTimer.Tick += (_, _) => TickCountdowns();
144          _countdownTimer.Start();
145      }
146  
147      private void StopCountdownTimer()
148      {
149          _countdownTimer?.Stop();
150          _countdownTimer = null;
151      }
152  
153      private void TickCountdowns()
154      {
155          var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
156          foreach (var listing in Listings) listing.TickCountdown(now);
157      }
158  
159      /// <summary>The category is part of the Firestore query, so changing it refetches.</summary>
160      partial void OnSelectedCategoryChanged(ItemCategory? value) => _ = RefreshAsync();
161  
162      /// <summary>Search filters what is already loaded. No network, no dropped keystrokes.</summary>
163      partial void OnSearchTextChanged(string value) => ApplySearch();
164  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/ForgotPasswordViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  using NUTrade1.Services;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>
  9  /// Forgot password, code first: email → six-digit code → new password. On success the
 10  /// student is sent back to sign in with the new password, which is the only session left —
 11  /// completing a reset signs every other device out.
 12  /// </summary>
 13  [QueryProperty(nameof(PrefilledEmail), "email")]
 14  public partial class ForgotPasswordViewModel : BaseViewModel
 15  {
 16      public enum Step { Email, Code, Password }
 17  
 18      private const int MinPasswordLength = 8;
 19  
 20      private readonly IPasswordResetService _reset;
 21      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 22      private IDispatcherTimer? _cooldownTimer;
 23      private string _resetToken = string.Empty;
 24  
 25      public ForgotPasswordViewModel(IPasswordResetService reset, INavigationService nav)
 26      {
 27          _reset = reset;
 28          _nav = nav;
 29          Title = "Reset your password";
 30      }
 31  
 32      [ObservableProperty]
 33      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsEmailStep))]
 34      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsCodeStep))]
 35      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsPasswordStep))]
 36      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowEmailForm))]
 37      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(StepLabel))]
 38      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Heading))]
 39      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Subheading))]
 40      private Step _currentStep = Step.Email;
 41  
 42      [ObservableProperty] private string _email = string.Empty;
 43      [ObservableProperty] private string _code = string.Empty;
 44      [ObservableProperty] private string _password = string.Empty;
 45      [ObservableProperty] private string _confirmPassword = string.Empty;
 46      [ObservableProperty] private string _sentTo = string.Empty;
 47  
 48      /// <summary>Whatever was already typed on the sign-in screen, so it isn't typed twice.</summary>
 49      [ObservableProperty] private string? _prefilledEmail;
 50  
 51      partial void OnPrefilledEmailChanged(string? value)
 52      {
 53          if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) Email = value;
 54      }
 55  
 56      [ObservableProperty]
 57      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ResendText))]
 58      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(CanResend))]
 59      private int _resendInSeconds;
 60  
 61      public bool IsEmailStep => CurrentStep == Step.Email;
 62  
 63      /// <summary>The email form stays on screen behind the code modal, so the page does not jump.</summary>
 64      public bool ShowEmailForm => CurrentStep is Step.Email or Step.Code;
 65      public bool IsCodeStep => CurrentStep == Step.Code;
 66      public bool IsPasswordStep => CurrentStep == Step.Password;
 67  
 68      public string StepLabel => $"Step {(int)CurrentStep + 1} of 3";
 69  
 70      public string Heading => CurrentStep switch
 71      {
 72          Step.Code => "Check your email",
 73          Step.Password => "Choose a new password",
 74          _ => "Forgot your password?",
 75      };
 76  
 77      public string Subheading => CurrentStep switch
 78      {
 79          // Deliberately "if there's an account": startPasswordReset answers the same way
 80          // whether or not the address is registered, so the screen must not promise mail.
 81          Step.Code => $"If there's a NUTrade account for {SentTo}, we sent it a 6-digit code.",
 82          Step.Password => "Signing in again with the new password will be the only session left.",
 83          _ => "Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send a code to reset your password.",
 84      };
 85  
 86      public bool CanResend => ResendInSeconds <= 0;
 87      public string ResendText => CanResend ? "Send another code" : $"Send another code in {ResendInSeconds}s";
 88  
 89      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
 90      {
 91          StopCooldown();
 92          return Task.CompletedTask;
 93      }
 94  
 95      /// <summary>Step 1 → 2, and "Send another code" on step 2.</summary>
 96      [RelayCommand]
 97      private async Task SendCodeAsync()
 98      {
 99          if (IsBusy) return;
100          ErrorMessage = null;
101  
102          if (!NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail(Email))
103          {
104              ErrorMessage = "Enter a valid email address.";
105              return;
106          }
107          if (IsCodeStep && !CanResend) return;
108  
109          IsBusy = true;
110          try
111          {
112              var result = await _reset.StartAsync(Email.Trim());
113              if (!result.Succeeded)
114              {
115                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not send the code. Try again.";
116                  return;
117              }
118  
119              SentTo = result.Value!.SentTo;
120              Code = string.Empty;
121              CurrentStep = Step.Code;
122              OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Subheading));
123              StartCooldown(result.Value.ResendAfterSeconds);
124          }
125          finally
126          {
127              IsBusy = false;
128          }
129      }
130  
131      /// <summary>Step 2 → 3.</summary>
132      [RelayCommand]
133      private async Task VerifyCodeAsync()
134      {
135          if (IsBusy) return;
136          ErrorMessage = null;
137  
138          var entered = Code.Trim();
139          if (entered.Length != 6 || !entered.All(char.IsDigit))
140          {
141              ErrorMessage = "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.";
142              return;
143          }
144  
145          IsBusy = true;
146          try
147          {
148              var result = await _reset.VerifyCodeAsync(Email.Trim(), entered);
149              if (!result.Succeeded)
150              {
151                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "That code isn't right.";
152                  Code = string.Empty;
153                  return;
154              }
155  
156              _resetToken = result.Value!;
157              StopCooldown();
158              CurrentStep = Step.Password;
159          }
160          finally
161          {
162              IsBusy = false;
163          }
164      }
165  
166      /// <summary>Step 3: set the new password, then go sign in with it.</summary>
167      [RelayCommand]
168      private async Task ResetPasswordAsync()
169      {
170          if (IsBusy) return;
171          ErrorMessage = null;
172  
173          if (Password.Length < MinPasswordLength)
174          {
175              ErrorMessage = $"Use at least {MinPasswordLength} characters for your password.";
176              return;
177          }
178          if (Password != ConfirmPassword)
179          {
180              ErrorMessage = "The two passwords don't match.";
181              return;
182          }
183  
184          IsBusy = true;
185          try
186          {
187              var result = await _reset.CompleteAsync(
188                  new PasswordResetDetails(Email.Trim(), _resetToken, Password));
189              if (!result.Succeeded)
190              {
191                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not reset your password. Try again.";
192                  return;
193              }
194  
195              var email = Email.Trim();
196              Password = ConfirmPassword = string.Empty;
197              _resetToken = string.Empty;
198              await _nav.GoToAsync($"//{Routes.Login}", new Dictionary<string, object> { ["resetEmail"] = email });
199          }
200          finally
201          {
202              IsBusy = false;
203          }
204      }
205  
206      /// <summary>One step back; from the first step, back to sign in.</summary>
207      [RelayCommand]
208      private async Task BackAsync()
209      {
210          ErrorMessage = null;
211          switch (CurrentStep)
212          {
213              case Step.Email:
214                  await _nav.GoBackAsync();
215                  break;
216              case Step.Code:
217                  StopCooldown();
218                  CurrentStep = Step.Email;
219                  break;
220              case Step.Password:
221                  // The code is spent once verified, so going back means starting over.
222                  _resetToken = string.Empty;
223                  CurrentStep = Step.Email;
224                  break;
225          }
226      }
227  
228      private void StartCooldown(int seconds)
229      {
230          StopCooldown();
231          if (seconds <= 0) return;
232  
233          ResendInSeconds = seconds;
234          _cooldownTimer = Application.Current?.Dispatcher.CreateTimer();
235          if (_cooldownTimer is null) return;
236  
237          _cooldownTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
238          _cooldownTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
239          {
240              ResendInSeconds--;
241              if (ResendInSeconds <= 0) StopCooldown();
242          };
243          _cooldownTimer.Start();
244      }
245  
246      private void StopCooldown()
247      {
248          _cooldownTimer?.Stop();
249          _cooldownTimer = null;
250          ResendInSeconds = 0;
251      }
252  }
```

```csharp
  1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  3  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  4  using NUTrade1.Core;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>One listing in the admin queue, with its seller's name resolved for display.</summary>
  9  public sealed class PendingListingViewModel
 10  {
 11      public PendingListingViewModel(Listing listing, string sellerName)
 12      {
 13          Listing = listing;
 14          SellerName = sellerName;
 15      }
 16  
 17      public Listing Listing { get; }
 18      public string SellerName { get; }
 19  
 20      public string Title => Listing.Title;
 21      public string Description => Listing.Description;
 22      public string? CoverPhoto => Listing.Photos.FirstOrDefault();
 23      public int PhotoCount => Listing.Photos.Count;
 24      public string StartingBidDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Listing.StartingBidCentavos);
 25  
 26      public string PackageDisplay
 27      {
 28          get
 29          {
 30              var package = Listing.PaidPackage ?? Listing.Package;
 31              var fee = NUTradeConstants.FeeForPackage(package);
 32              return fee == 0 ? $"{package} · free" : $"{package} · {Money.ToDisplay(fee)} paid";
 33          }
 34      }
 35  
 36      public DateTimeOffset SubmittedAt => Listing.SubmittedForApprovalAt ?? Listing.CreatedAt;
 37  }
 38  
 39  /// <summary>
 40  /// The admin approval queue: every listing whose fee has cleared waits here until an
 41  /// admin puts it live or turns it down. Reached from the admin card on Profile.
 42  /// </summary>
 43  public partial class ListingApprovalsViewModel : BaseViewModel
 44  {
 45      private readonly IListingModerationService _moderation;
 46      private readonly IUserService _users;
 47      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 48  
 49      public ListingApprovalsViewModel(IListingModerationService moderation, IUserService users, IAuthService auth)
 50      {
 51          _moderation = moderation;
 52          _users = users;
 53          _auth = auth;
 54          Title = "Listing approvals";
 55      }
 56  
 57      public ObservableCollection<PendingListingViewModel> Pending { get; } = new();
 58  
 59      public bool HasPending => Pending.Count > 0;
 60  
 61      /// <summary>"All caught up" — only once a load has finished, so it never flashes up mid-fetch.</summary>
 62      public bool ShowEmptyState => !HasPending && !IsBusy && ErrorMessage is null;
 63  
 64      /// <summary>ErrorMessage lives on BaseViewModel now, so the empty state is re-evaluated here.</summary>
 65      protected override void OnErrorMessageChangedCore(string? value) => OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowEmptyState));
 66  
 67      public override Task OnAppearingAsync() => LoadAsync();
 68  
 69      [RelayCommand]
 70      private async Task LoadAsync()
 71      {
 72          if (!_auth.IsAdmin)
 73          {
 74              ErrorMessage = "Only NUTrade admins can review listings.";
 75              return;
 76          }
 77  
 78          IsBusy = true;
 79          RaiseListState();
 80          try
 81          {
 82              var listings = await _moderation.GetPendingListingsAsync();
 83  
 84              // One profile read per seller, not per listing — a student often has several queued.
 85              var names = new Dictionary<string, string>();
 86              foreach (var uid in listings.Select(l => l.OwnerUid).Distinct())
 87                  names[uid] = (await _users.GetProfileAsync(uid))?.DisplayName ?? "NU student";
 88  
 89              Pending.Clear();
 90              foreach (var listing in listings)
 91                  Pending.Add(new PendingListingViewModel(listing, names.GetValueOrDefault(listing.OwnerUid, "NU student")));
 92  
 93              ErrorMessage = null;
 94          }
 95          catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 96          {
 97              ErrorMessage = "Couldn't load the approval queue. Tap Refresh to try again.";
 98          }
 99          finally
100          {
101              IsBusy = false;
102              RaiseListState();
103          }
104      }
105  
106      [RelayCommand]
107      private Task ApproveAsync(PendingListingViewModel? item) =>
108          DecideAsync(item, i => _moderation.ApproveListingAsync(i.Listing.Id), $"Approved “{item?.Title}”.");
109  
110      [RelayCommand]
111      private async Task RejectAsync(PendingListingViewModel? item)
112      {
113          if (item is null || Shell.Current is not { } shell) return;
114  
115          // Null means the admin backed out; an empty string is a rejection with no note.
116          var reason = await shell.DisplayPromptAsync(
117              "Reject listing",
118              $"Tell the seller why “{item.Title}” wasn't approved (optional).",
119              accept: "Reject",
120              cancel: "Cancel",
121              placeholder: "e.g. Photos don't show the item",
122              maxLength: 300);
123          if (reason is null) return;
124  
125          await DecideAsync(item, i => _moderation.RejectListingAsync(i.Listing.Id, reason.Trim()), $"Rejected “{item.Title}”.");
126      }
127  
128      private async Task DecideAsync(
129          PendingListingViewModel? item,
130          Func<PendingListingViewModel, Task<OperationResult>> decide,
131          string doneMessage)
132      {
133          if (item is null || IsBusy) return;
134          IsBusy = true;
135          try
136          {
137              var result = await decide(item);
138              if (!result.Succeeded)
139              {
140                  ErrorMessage = result.Error;
141                  return;
142              }
143  
144              Pending.Remove(item);
145              ErrorMessage = null;
146              RaiseListState();
147              StatusMessage = doneMessage;
148          }
149          finally
150          {
151              IsBusy = false;
152          }
153      }
154  
155      private void RaiseListState()
156      {
157          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasPending));
158          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowEmptyState));
159      }
160  }
```

```csharp
 20      public ListingDetailViewModel(
 21          IListingService listings,
 22          IBidService bids,
 23          IDepositService deposits,
 24          IUserService users,
 25          IAuthService auth,
 26          INavigationService nav)
 27      {
 28          _listings = listings;
 29          _bids = bids;
 30          _deposits = deposits;
 31          _nav = nav;
 32          _users = users;
 33          _auth = auth;
 34          Title = "Auction";
 35      }
 36  
 37      [ObservableProperty] private string? _listingId;
 38      [ObservableProperty] private Listing? _listing;
 39      [ObservableProperty] private UserProfile? _seller;
 40      [ObservableProperty] private string _bidAmountText = string.Empty;
 41      [ObservableProperty] private bool _bidPlaced;
 42  
 43      public ObservableCollection<Bid> BidHistory { get; } = new();
 44  
 45      public bool IsOwnListing => BidEligibility.IsSeller(Listing, _auth.CurrentUid);
 46  
 47      /// <summary>
 48      /// The bid form is for buyers only. It stays hidden until the listing has loaded, so a
 49      /// seller never sees it flash up on their own item while the page is fetching.
 50      /// </summary>
 51      public bool ShowBidForm => Listing is not null && !IsOwnListing;
 52  
 53      /// <summary>Why the current student can't bid right now, or null if they can. Mirrors `requestBid`.</summary>
 54      private string? WhyCantBid() =>
 55          BidEligibility.WhyNot(Listing, _auth.CurrentUid, _auth.IsVerified, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
 56  
 57      public string CurrentBidDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Listing?.CurrentHighestBidCentavos ?? 0);
 58

 62  
 63      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 64      {
 65          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ListingId) || IsBusy) return;
 66          IsBusy = true;
 67          try
 68          {
 69              Listing = await _listings.GetListingAsync(ListingId);
 70              Title = Listing?.Title ?? "Auction";
 71              Seller = Listing is null ? null : await _users.GetProfileAsync(Listing.OwnerUid);
 72              RaiseListingDependentProps();
 73  
 74              BidHistory.Clear();
 75              foreach (var bid in await _bids.GetBidsForListingAsync(ListingId))
 76                  BidHistory.Add(bid);
 77  
 78              StartCountdownTimer();
 79          }
 80          finally
 81          {
 82              IsBusy = false;
 83          }
 84      }
 85  
 86      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
 87      {
 88          StopCountdownTimer();
 89          return Task.CompletedTask;
 90      }
 91  
 92      /// <summary>
 93      /// What bidding actually costs, shown on the form. Mirrors BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT — the
 94      /// exact peso amount depends on the bid, so this states the rule rather than a figure.
 95      /// </summary>
 96      public string DepositHint =>
 97          $"Bidding holds a {NUTradeConstants.BidDepositPercent}% deposit by QR Ph. " +
 98          "You get it back if you're outbid or don't win.";
 99  
100      [RelayCommand]
101      private async Task PlaceBidAsync()
102      {
103          ErrorMessage = null;
104  
105          if (Listing is null || ListingId is null) return;
106  
107          // Checked before anything else, and before any money is asked for. The form is
108          // hidden from the seller anyway; this is the guard for every other way in.
109          if (WhyCantBid() is { } reason)
110          {
111              ErrorMessage = reason;
112              return;
113          }
114  
115          if (!long.TryParse(BidAmountText.Trim(), out var pesos) || pesos <= 0)
116          {
117              ErrorMessage = "Enter a valid bid amount.";
118              return;
119          }
120  
121          var amountCentavos = Money.FromPesos(pesos);
122          if (IsBusy) return;
123          IsBusy = true;
124          try
125          {
126              // No bid is written here. requestBid validates the amount and mints a QR for
127              // the commitment deposit; the bid appears on the listing only once that
128              // deposit is confirmed paid, which the next screen waits for.
129              var result = await _deposits.RequestBidAsync(ListingId, amountCentavos);
130  
131              if (!result.Succeeded)
132              {
133                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not start your bid.";
134                  return;
135              }
136  
137              BidAmountText = string.Empty;
138              await _nav.GoToAsync(
139                  Routes.BidDeposit,
140                  new Dictionary<string, object> { ["bidIntentId"] = result.Value!.Id });
141          }
142          finally
143          {
144              IsBusy = false;
145          }
146      }
147  
148      /// <summary>Opens the full-screen viewer at the photo that was tapped.</summary>
149      [RelayCommand]
150      private Task OpenPhotoAsync(int index)
151      {
152          if (Listing is not { Photos.Count: > 0 } listing) return Task.CompletedTask;
153          return _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.PhotoViewer, new Dictionary<string, object>
154          {
155              [PhotoViewerViewModel.PhotosKey] = listing.Photos.ToList(),
156              [PhotoViewerViewModel.IndexKey] = index,
157              [PhotoViewerViewModel.TitleKey] = listing.Title,
158          });
159      }
160  
161      private void RaiseListingDependentProps()
162      {
163          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsOwnListing));
164          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowBidForm));
165          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentBidDisplay));
166          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(MinNextBidDisplay));
167          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(BidCountDisplay));
168      }
169  
170      private void StartCountdownTimer()
171      {
172          if (_countdownTimer is not null || Listing is null) return;
173          _countdownTimer = Application.Current?.Dispatcher.CreateTimer();
174          if (_countdownTimer is null) return;
175          _countdownTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
176          _countdownTimer.Tick += (_, _) => Listing?.TickCountdown(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
177          _countdownTimer.Start();
178          Listing.TickCountdown(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
179      }
180  
181      private void StopCountdownTimer()
182      {
183          _countdownTimer?.Stop();
184          _countdownTimer = null;
185      }
186  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/ListingSubmittedMessage.cs

```csharp
1  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
2  
3  /// <summary>
4  /// Sent once a reviewed listing has been saved as a draft and handed to payment. The Post
5  /// tab clears its form on it, so the next listing starts blank rather than as a copy of the
6  /// last one waiting to be posted twice.
7  /// </summary>
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/ObservableRangeCollection.cs

```csharp
 1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
 2  using System.Collections.Specialized;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
 5  
 6  /// <summary>
 7  /// An <see cref="ObservableCollection{T}"/> that can be refilled in one notification.
 8  ///
 9  /// <c>Clear()</c> followed by an <c>Add</c> per item raises N+1 CollectionChanged events,
10  /// and a bound <see cref="Microsoft.Maui.Controls.CollectionView"/> re-measures its layout
11  /// on each one — which is what makes a feed refresh visibly stutter on a phone once the
12  /// list is a couple of pages deep. <see cref="ReplaceAll"/> mutates the backing list and
13  /// raises a single Reset instead.
14  /// </summary>
15  public sealed class ObservableRangeCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>
16  {
17      public void ReplaceAll(IEnumerable<T> items)
18      {
19          CheckReentrancy();
20  
21          Items.Clear();
22          foreach (var item in items) Items.Add(item);
23  
24          OnPropertyChanged(new System.ComponentModel.PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(Count)));
25          OnPropertyChanged(new System.ComponentModel.PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
26          OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
27      }
28  }
```

```csharp
  1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;

  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>
  9  /// "Pay Now" from the Bid Approved notification: the winning bidder pays the seller by
 10  /// QR Ph. The order is marked paid only by PayMongo's signed webhook, so this screen
 11  /// shows the code and watches the order; it never claims payment on its own.
 12  /// </summary>
 13  [QueryProperty(nameof(OrderId), "orderId")]
 14  public partial class OrderPaymentViewModel : BaseViewModel
 15  {
 16      private readonly IOrderService _orders;
 17      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 18      private IDisposable? _subscription;
 19      private bool _paidNoticeShown;
 20  
 21      public OrderPaymentViewModel(IOrderService orders, INavigationService nav)
 22      {
 23          _orders = orders;
 24          _nav = nav;
 25          Title = "Pay for your item";
 26      }
 27  
 28      [ObservableProperty] private string? _orderId;
 29  
 30      [ObservableProperty]
 31      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(AmountDisplay))]
 32      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ItemTitle))]
 33      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Reference))]
 34      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(QrImageSource))]
 35      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasQrImage))]
 36      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsOpen))]
 37      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsPaid))]
 38      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(StatusText))]
 39      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ExpiryText))]
 40      private Order? _order;
 41  
 42  
 43      public string ItemTitle => Order?.ListingTitle ?? string.Empty;
 44      public string AmountDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Order?.AmountCentavos ?? 0);
 45      public string Reference => Order?.Reference ?? string.Empty;
 46      public string? QrImageSource => Order?.QrImageUrl;
 47      public bool HasQrImage => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Order?.QrImageUrl);
 48      public bool IsOpen => Order?.IsOpen ?? true;
 49      public bool IsPaid => Order?.IsSettled ?? false;
 50  
 51      public string StatusText => Order?.Status switch
 52      {
 53          OrderStatus.Paid => "Paid — arrange the handover in your chat.",
 54          OrderStatus.Released => "The payment window closed and the bid was released.",
 55          OrderStatus.Cancelled => "This order was cancelled.",
 56          _ => Order?.DueAt is { } due ? $"Pay by {due.ToLocalTime():MMM d, h:mm tt} to keep your win." : "Waiting for your payment.",
 57      };
 58  
 59      public string ExpiryText => Order?.QrExpiresAt is { } at
 60          ? $"This code works until {at.ToLocalTime():h:mm tt}. Generate a new one after that."
 61          : "QR codes expire about 30 minutes after they're generated.";
 62  
 63      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 64      {
 65          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(OrderId)) return;
 66  
 67          Order = await _orders.GetOrderAsync(OrderId);
 68          if (Order is { IsOpen: true, NeedsFreshQr: true }) await GenerateAsync();
 69  
 70          _subscription = _orders.ObserveOrder(OrderId, order =>
 71          {
 72              if (order is null) return;
 73              Order = order;
 74              if (order.IsSettled) AnnouncePaid(order);
 75          });
 76      }
 77  
 78      [RelayCommand]
 79      private async Task GenerateAsync()
 80      {
 81          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(OrderId) || IsBusy) return;
 82          IsBusy = true;
 83          try
 84          {
 85              ErrorMessage = null;
 86              var result = await _orders.CreateQrPaymentAsync(OrderId);
 87              if (!result.Succeeded)
 88              {
 89                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not start the payment. Try again.";
 90                  return;
 91              }
 92              Order = result.Value;
 93          }
 94          finally
 95          {
 96              IsBusy = false;
 97          }
 98      }
 99  
100      [RelayCommand]
101      private Task OpenChatAsync() =>
102          Order is { ChatId.Length: > 0 } o
103              ? _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ChatRoom, new Dictionary<string, object> { ["chatId"] = o.ChatId })
104              : Task.CompletedTask;
105  
106      private void AnnouncePaid(Order order)
107      {
108          if (_paidNoticeShown) return;
109          _paidNoticeShown = true;
110          NotificationCenter.Current.Show(new AppNotification(
111              "Payment Received! 🎉",
112              $"You paid {Money.ToDisplay(order.AmountCentavos)} for {order.ListingTitle}. Arrange the handover with the seller in your chat.",
113              "Open Chat",
114              () => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ChatRoom, new Dictionary<string, object> { ["chatId"] = order.ChatId })));
115      }
116  
117      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
118      {
119          _subscription?.Dispose();
120          _subscription = null;
121          return Task.CompletedTask;
122      }
123  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/PaymentViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  using NUTrade1.Services;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  7  
  8  [QueryProperty(nameof(ListingId), "listingId")]
  9  [QueryProperty(nameof(Package), "package")]
 10  public partial class PaymentViewModel : BaseViewModel
 11  {
 12      /// <summary>Where the listing is on its way to the feed, as far as this screen is concerned.</summary>
 13      public enum Stage
 14      {
 15          /// <summary>The QR is up (or loading) and the fee hasn't cleared.</summary>
 16          AwaitingPayment,
 17          /// <summary>Paid, or free — sitting in the admin queue.</summary>
 18          AwaitingApproval,
 19          /// <summary>An admin approved it; it is live or queued for the next hourly refresh.</summary>
 20          Approved,
 21          Rejected,
 22      }
 23  
 24      private readonly IPaymentService _payments;
 25      private readonly IListingService _listings;
 26      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 27      private IDisposable? _listingSubscription;
 28      private CancellationTokenSource? _paymentChecks;
 29      private bool _postedNoticeShown;
 30  
 31      /// <summary>How often the QR screen asks the backend to check with PayMongo.</summary>
 32      private static readonly TimeSpan PaymentCheckInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
 33  
 34      public PaymentViewModel(IPaymentService payments, IListingService listings, INavigationService nav)
 35      {
 36          _payments = payments;
 37          _listings = listings;
 38          _nav = nav;
 39          Title = "Pay listing fee";
 40      }
 41  
 42      [ObservableProperty] private string? _listingId;
 43      [ObservableProperty] private ListingPackage _package = ListingPackage.Additional;
 44  
 45      [ObservableProperty]
 46      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(AmountDisplay))]
 47      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasQrImage))]
 48      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(QrFileName))]
 49      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ExpiryText))]
 50      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowQr))]
 51      private QrPaymentResult? _qr;
 52  
 53      [ObservableProperty]
 54      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowQr))]
 55      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsAwaitingApproval))]
 56      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsApproved))]
 57      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsRejected))]
 58      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsSubmitted))]
 59      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Kicker))]
 60      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Heading))]
 61      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Subheading))]
 62      private Stage _currentStage = Stage.AwaitingPayment;
 63  
 64  
 65      /// <summary>Reply to "I've paid — check now" when PayMongo hasn't seen the money yet.</summary>
 66      [ObservableProperty] private string? _paymentCheckMessage;
 67  
 68      [ObservableProperty]
 69      [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor(nameof(CheckNowCommand))]
 70      private bool _isCheckingPayment;
 71  
 72      [ObservableProperty] private string _approvedText = string.Empty;
 73      [ObservableProperty] private string _rejectedText = string.Empty;
 74  
 75      public string PackageName => Package switch
 76      {
 77          ListingPackage.Priority => "Priority",
 78          ListingPackage.Additional => "Additional",
 79          _ => "Free",
 80      };
 81      public string AmountDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Qr?.AmountCentavos ?? NUTradeConstants.FeeForPackage(Package));
 82      public bool HasQrImage => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Qr?.QrImageUrl) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Qr?.QrImageBase64);
 83  
 84      /// <summary>What "Save QR" calls the picture, so it is easy to find in the gallery.</summary>
 85      public string QrFileName => $"nutrade-listing-fee-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmm}";
 86  
 87      /// <summary>PayMongo's own expiry for the code on screen (about 30 minutes).</summary>
 88      public string ExpiryText => Qr is { RequiresPayment: true } qr
 89          ? $"This code works until {qr.ExpiresAt.ToLocalTime():h:mm tt}. Generate a new one after that."
 90          : "QR codes expire about 30 minutes after they're generated.";
 91  
 92      /// <summary>The QR card — hidden for a free first post, which has nothing to pay.</summary>
 93      public bool ShowQr => CurrentStage == Stage.AwaitingPayment && (Qr?.RequiresPayment ?? true);
 94  
 95      public bool IsAwaitingApproval => CurrentStage == Stage.AwaitingApproval;
 96      public bool IsApproved => CurrentStage == Stage.Approved;
 97      public bool IsRejected => CurrentStage == Stage.Rejected;
 98  
 99      /// <summary>The fee is settled one way or another, so the "leave this screen" actions show.</summary>
100      public bool IsSubmitted => CurrentStage != Stage.AwaitingPayment;
101  
102      public string Kicker => CurrentStage switch
103      {
104          Stage.AwaitingApproval => "Posted",
105          Stage.Approved => "Approved",
106          Stage.Rejected => "Not approved",
107          _ => "Almost there",
108      };
109  
110      public string Heading => CurrentStage switch
111      {
112          Stage.AwaitingApproval => "Waiting for admin approval",
113          Stage.Approved => "Your auction is approved",
114          Stage.Rejected => "Your listing wasn't approved",
115          _ => "Scan to pay the listing fee",
116      };
117  
118      public string Subheading => CurrentStage switch
119      {
120          Stage.AwaitingApproval =>
121              "An admin reviews every new listing before it goes on the campus feed. Your 24-hour auction starts the moment it's approved.",
122          Stage.Approved => "An admin approved your listing and its 24-hour countdown has started.",
123          Stage.Rejected => "Nothing was published. You can post a corrected listing any time.",
124          _ => "Pay with any QR Ph banking or e-wallet app. Once the fee clears, your listing goes to an admin for approval.",
125      };
126  
127      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
128      {
129          await GenerateAsync();
130  
131          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ListingId)) return;
132          _listingSubscription = _listings.ObserveListing(ListingId, Apply);
133          StartPaymentChecks();
134      }
135  
136      /// <summary>
137      /// While the QR is up, asks the backend every few seconds to check with PayMongo.
138      /// The webhook is the fast path, but when it is late or missing this is what moves a
139      /// paid listing on — the listing observer then picks up the new status.
140      /// </summary>
141      private void StartPaymentChecks()
142      {
143          StopPaymentChecks();
144          _paymentChecks = new CancellationTokenSource();
145          _ = CheckPaymentLoopAsync(_paymentChecks.Token);
146      }
147  
148      private void StopPaymentChecks()
149      {
150          _paymentChecks?.Cancel();
151          _paymentChecks?.Dispose();
152          _paymentChecks = null;
153      }
154  
155      private async Task CheckPaymentLoopAsync(CancellationToken ct)
156      {
157          try
158          {
159              while (CurrentStage == Stage.AwaitingPayment)
160              {
161                  await Task.Delay(PaymentCheckInterval, ct);
162                  if (ShowQr && Qr is not null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ListingId))
163                      await _payments.CheckListingPaymentAsync(ListingId, ct);
164              }
165          }
166          catch (OperationCanceledException)
167          {
168              // Left the screen.
169          }
170      }
171  
172      /// <summary>"I've paid — check now": the same PayMongo check, on demand, with an answer.</summary>
173      [RelayCommand(CanExecute = nameof(CanCheckNow))]
174      private async Task CheckNowAsync()
175      {
176          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ListingId)) return;
177          IsCheckingPayment = true;
178          PaymentCheckMessage = null;
179          try
180          {
181              var result = await _payments.CheckListingPaymentAsync(ListingId);
182              if (!result.Succeeded)
183              {
184                  ErrorMessage = result.Error;
185                  return;
186              }
187  
188              Apply(await _listings.GetListingAsync(ListingId));
189              if (CurrentStage == Stage.AwaitingPayment)
190                  PaymentCheckMessage = "PayMongo hasn't confirmed this payment yet. If you just paid, give it a minute — this screen keeps checking.";
191          }
192          finally
193          {
194              IsCheckingPayment = false;
195          }
196      }
197  
198      private bool CanCheckNow() => !IsCheckingPayment;
199  
200      [RelayCommand]
201      private async Task GenerateAsync()
202      {
203          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ListingId) || IsBusy || CurrentStage != Stage.AwaitingPayment) return;
204          IsBusy = true;
205          try
206          {
207              ErrorMessage = null;
208              var result = await _payments.CreateQrPaymentAsync(ListingId, Package);
209              if (!result.Succeeded)
210              {
211                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not start the payment. Try again.";
212                  return;
213              }
214  
215              Qr = result.Value;
216  
217              // A free first auction is already in the admin queue by the time this
218              // returns — there is no QR to wait on.
219              if (Qr is { RequiresPayment: false }) MarkPosted();
220          }
221          finally
222          {
223              IsBusy = false;
224          }
225      }
226  
227      /// <summary>Follows the listing document: paid → approved (or rejected) by an admin.</summary>
228      private void Apply(Listing? listing)
229      {
230          switch (listing?.Status)
231          {
232              case ListingStatus.PendingApproval:
233                  MarkPosted();
234                  break;
235  
236              case ListingStatus.Active:
237                  // Approval can land between two polls, so the "posted" moment may never
238                  // be observed on its own — still tell the seller it went through.
239                  MarkPosted();
240                  ApprovedText = listing.IsVisible || listing.VisibleFrom is null
241                      ? "Your listing is now live on the campus feed."
242                      : $"It joins the campus feed at the next hourly refresh, {listing.VisibleFrom.Value.ToLocalTime():h:mm tt}.";
243                  CurrentStage = Stage.Approved;
244                  break;
245  
246              case ListingStatus.Rejected:
247                  RejectedText = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listing.RejectionReason)
248                      ? "An admin reviewed this listing and didn't approve it."
249                      : $"Admin's note: {listing.RejectionReason}";
250                  CurrentStage = Stage.Rejected;
251                  break;
252          }
253      }
254  
255      /// <summary>The fee is settled: show the notification once and move to the approval wait.</summary>
256      private void MarkPosted()
257      {
258          ErrorMessage = null;
259          PaymentCheckMessage = null;
260          if (CurrentStage == Stage.AwaitingPayment) CurrentStage = Stage.AwaitingApproval;
261  
262          if (_postedNoticeShown) return;
263          _postedNoticeShown = true;
264          NotificationCenter.Current.Show(new AppNotification(
265              "Item Successfully Posted! 🎉",
266              "Your listing was sent to an admin for approval. It appears on the campus feed once it's approved.",
267              "View Listings",
268              () => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ProfileTab)));
269      }
270  
271      [RelayCommand]
272      private Task DoneAsync() => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.FeedTab);
273  
274      [RelayCommand]
275      private Task ViewMyListingsAsync() => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ProfileTab);
276  
277      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
278      {
279          StopPaymentChecks();
280          _listingSubscription?.Dispose();
281          _listingSubscription = null;
282          return Task.CompletedTask;
283      }
284  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/PayoutsViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  
  5  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  6  
  7  /// <summary>
  8  /// The admin payout queue: every student who has asked for their balance, oldest first.
  9  ///
 10  /// NUTrade does not move money itself — an admin sends it through GCash or Maya by hand
 11  /// and then records that here. The balance was already debited when the student asked, so
 12  /// "Mark sent" only closes the record; declining is what puts the money back.
 13  /// </summary>
 14  public partial class PayoutsViewModel : BaseViewModel
 15  {
 16      private readonly IPayoutModerationService _payouts;
 17      private readonly IUserService _users;
 18      private readonly IAuthService _auth;
 19  
 20      public PayoutsViewModel(IPayoutModerationService payouts, IUserService users, IAuthService auth)
 21      {
 22          _payouts = payouts;
 23          _users = users;
 24          _auth = auth;
 25          Title = "Payout requests";
 26      }
 27  
 28      public ObservableCollection<PendingPayoutViewModel> Pending { get; } = new();
 29  
 30      public bool HasPending => Pending.Count > 0;
 31  
 32      /// <summary>"All caught up" — only once a load has finished, so it never flashes up mid-fetch.</summary>
 33      public bool ShowEmptyState => !HasPending && !IsBusy && ErrorMessage is null;
 34  
 35      protected override void OnErrorMessageChangedCore(string? value) => OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowEmptyState));
 36  
 37      public override Task OnAppearingAsync() => LoadAsync();
 38  
 39      [RelayCommand]
 40      private async Task LoadAsync()
 41      {
 42          if (!_auth.IsAdmin)
 43          {
 44              ErrorMessage = "Only NUTrade admins can review payouts.";
 45              return;
 46          }
 47  
 48          IsBusy = true;
 49          RaiseListState();
 50          try
 51          {
 52              var requests = await _payouts.GetPendingPayoutsAsync();
 53  
 54              // One profile read per student, not per request.
 55              var names = new Dictionary<string, string>();
 56              foreach (var uid in requests.Select(r => r.Uid).Distinct())
 57                  names[uid] = (await _users.GetProfileAsync(uid))?.DisplayName ?? "NU student";
 58  
 59              Pending.Clear();
 60              foreach (var request in requests)
 61                  Pending.Add(new PendingPayoutViewModel(request, names.GetValueOrDefault(request.Uid, "NU student")));
 62  
 63              ErrorMessage = null;
 64          }
 65          catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 66          {
 67              ErrorMessage = "Couldn't load the payout queue. Tap Refresh to try again.";
 68          }
 69          finally
 70          {
 71              IsBusy = false;
 72              RaiseListState();
 73          }
 74      }
 75  
 76      [RelayCommand]
 77      private async Task MarkPaidAsync(PendingPayoutViewModel? item)
 78      {
 79          if (item is null || Shell.Current is not { } shell) return;
 80  
 81          // Worth one confirmation: this is the admin asserting real money has left their
 82          // own GCash, and there is no way to un-assert it.
 83          var confirmed = await shell.DisplayAlert(
 84              "Mark as sent",
 85              $"Confirm you have sent {item.AmountDisplay} to {item.Request.AccountName} ({item.Request.AccountNumber}).",
 86              "I've sent it",
 87              "Cancel");
 88          if (!confirmed) return;
 89  
 90          await DecideAsync(item, i => _payouts.MarkPaidAsync(i.Request.Id), $"Marked {item.AmountDisplay} as sent.");
 91      }
 92  
 93      [RelayCommand]
 94      private async Task DeclineAsync(PendingPayoutViewModel? item)
 95      {
 96          if (item is null || Shell.Current is not { } shell) return;
 97  
 98          // Null means the admin backed out; an empty string is a decline with no note.
 99          var reason = await shell.DisplayPromptAsync(
100              "Decline payout",
101              $"Tell {item.StudentName} why (optional). The {item.AmountDisplay} goes back to their balance.",
102              accept: "Decline",
103              cancel: "Cancel",
104              placeholder: "e.g. Account name doesn't match",
105              maxLength: 200);
106          if (reason is null) return;
107  
108          await DecideAsync(
109              item,
110              i => _payouts.DeclineAsync(i.Request.Id, reason.Trim()),
111              $"Declined — {item.AmountDisplay} returned.");
112      }
113  
114      private async Task DecideAsync(
115          PendingPayoutViewModel? item,
116          Func<PendingPayoutViewModel, Task<OperationResult>> decide,
117          string doneMessage)
118      {
119          if (item is null || IsBusy) return;
120          IsBusy = true;
121          try
122          {
123              var result = await decide(item);
124              if (!result.Succeeded)
125              {
126                  ErrorMessage = result.Error;
127                  return;
128              }
129  
130              Pending.Remove(item);
131              ErrorMessage = null;
132              RaiseListState();
133              StatusMessage = doneMessage;
134          }
135          finally
136          {
137              IsBusy = false;
138          }
139      }
140  
141      private void RaiseListState()
142      {
143          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasPending));
144          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowEmptyState));
145      }
146  }
147  
148  /// <summary>One request in the admin queue, with the student's name resolved for display.</summary>
149  public sealed class PendingPayoutViewModel
150  {
151      public PendingPayoutViewModel(PayoutRequest request, string studentName)
152      {
153          Request = request;
154          StudentName = studentName;
155      }
156  
157      public PayoutRequest Request { get; }
158      public string StudentName { get; }
159  
160      public string AmountDisplay => Request.AmountDisplay;
161      public string MethodDisplay => Request.Method == PayoutMethod.Maya ? "Maya" : "GCash";
162      public string DestinationDisplay => $"{MethodDisplay} · {Request.AccountNumber} · {Request.AccountName}";
163      public DateTimeOffset RequestedAt => Request.CreatedAt ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
164  }
```

```csharp
 1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

 6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
 7  
 8  /// <summary>
 9  /// Full-screen photo viewer. Takes the photo list and the index to open at as navigation
10  /// parameters (passed as objects, not query strings, so the URLs arrive intact).
11  /// </summary>
12  public partial class PhotoViewerViewModel : BaseViewModel, IQueryAttributable
13  {
14      public const string PhotosKey = "photos";
15      public const string IndexKey = "index";
16      public const string TitleKey = "title";
17  
18      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
19  
20      public PhotoViewerViewModel(INavigationService nav)
21      {
22          _nav = nav;
23      }
24  
25      public ObservableCollection<string> Photos { get; } = new();
26  
27      [ObservableProperty]
28      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(CounterText))]
29      private int _position;
30  
31      /// <summary>True while the photo on screen is zoomed; swiping to the next one is off meanwhile.</summary>
32      [ObservableProperty]
33      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsSwipeEnabled))]
34      private bool _isZoomed;
35  
36      /// <summary>The index the viewer opened at, applied once the carousel has its items.</summary>
37      public int StartIndex { get; private set; }
38  
39      public bool IsSwipeEnabled => !IsZoomed;
40  
41      public bool HasMany => Photos.Count > 1;
42  
43      public string CounterText => Photos.Count == 0 ? string.Empty : $"{Position + 1} / {Photos.Count}";
44  
45      public void ApplyQueryAttributes(IDictionary<string, object> query)
46      {
47          Photos.Clear();
48          if (query.TryGetValue(PhotosKey, out var value) && value is IEnumerable<string> photos)
49              foreach (var photo in photos.Where(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p)))
50                  Photos.Add(photo);
51  
52          Title = query.TryGetValue(TitleKey, out var title) ? title as string ?? "Photos" : "Photos";
53          StartIndex = query.TryGetValue(IndexKey, out var index) && index is int i
54              ? Math.Clamp(i, 0, Math.Max(Photos.Count - 1, 0))
55              : 0;
56          // Start at 0: the page moves to StartIndex once the carousel is drawn, because a
57          // CarouselView only scrolls on a real change of Position, not on its first value.
58          Position = 0;
59  
60          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasMany));
61          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CounterText));
62      }
63  
64      [RelayCommand]
65      private Task CloseAsync() => _nav.GoBackAsync();
66  
67      [RelayCommand]
68      private void Previous()
69      {
70          if (!IsZoomed && Position > 0) Position--;
71      }
72  
73      [RelayCommand]
74      private void Next()
75      {
76          if (!IsZoomed && Position < Photos.Count - 1) Position++;
77      }
78  }
```

```csharp
120      {
121          if (!Enum.TryParse<ListingPackage>(key, out var p)) return;
122          if (p == ListingPackage.Free && !IsFreeAvailable) return;

128      /// <summary>
129      /// Re-checked every time the tab opens: posting the first listing, or having it
130      /// rejected, changes the answer. createQrPayment enforces the same rule, so this only
131      /// decides what the student is offered.
132      /// </summary>
133      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
134      {
135          bool used;
136          try
137          {
138              used = await _listings.HasUsedFreePostAsync();
139          }
140          catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
141          {
142              // Offline or a failed read: offer Free and let the server decide at checkout.
143              used = false;
144          }
145  
146          IsFreeAvailable = !used;
147          ShowFreeUsedNote = used;
148  
149          if (used && SelectedPackage == ListingPackage.Free)
150              SelectedPackage = ListingPackage.Additional;
151          else if (!used && !_packageChosenByUser)
152              SelectedPackage = ListingPackage.Free;
153      }

157      {
158          if (!CanAddPhoto) return;
159          try
160          {
161              var photos = await MediaPicker.Default.PickPhotosAsync();
162              if (photos is null) return;
163              foreach (var photo in photos)
164              {
165                  if (!CanAddPhoto) break;
166                  var cachedPath = await ImageCache.CacheAsync(photo.FullPath);
167                  PhotoPaths.Add(cachedPath);
168                  RaisePhotoState();
169              }
170          }
171          catch (FeatureNotSupportedException)
172          {
173              ErrorMessage = "Photo picker isn't available on this device.";
174          }
175          catch (PermissionException)
176          {
177              ErrorMessage = "Allow photo access to attach pictures.";
178          }
179      }

183      {

188          }
189          RaisePhotoState();
190      }

192      private void RaisePhotoState()
193      {
194          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanAddPhoto));
195          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasPhotos));
196      }
197  
198      /// <summary>
199      /// Checks the form and opens the review screen. Nothing is written yet — the draft is
200      /// only created when the student taps Post Listing there.
201      /// </summary>
202      [RelayCommand]
203      private async Task ContinueToReviewAsync()
204      {
205          ErrorMessage = null;
206  
207          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ItemTitle))
208          {
209              ErrorMessage = "Give your item a name.";
210              return;
211          }
212          if (PhotoPaths.Count < NUTradeConstants.MinListingPhotos)
213          {
214              ErrorMessage = "Add at least one photo.";
215              return;
216          }
217          if (Category == ItemCategory.Unknown)
218          {
219              ErrorMessage = "Pick a category.";
220              return;
221          }
222          if (IsCategoryOther && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CategoryOther))
223          {
224              ErrorMessage = "Say which category your item belongs to.";
225              return;
226          }
227          if (!long.TryParse(StartingBidText.Trim(), out var startingPesos) || startingPesos <= 0)
228          {
229              ErrorMessage = "Enter a valid starting bid.";
230              return;
231          }
232          if (!long.TryParse(BidIncrementText.Trim(), out var incrementPesos) || incrementPesos <= 0)
233          {
234              ErrorMessage = "Enter a valid bid increment.";
235              return;
236          }
237          if (CampusZone == CampusZone.Unknown)
238          {
239              ErrorMessage = "Pick a meetup location.";
240              return;
241          }
242          if (IsMeetupOther && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CampusZoneOther))
243          {
244              ErrorMessage = "Say where on campus you want to meet.";
245              return;
246          }
247  
248          var request = new CreateAuctionRequest
249          {
250              Title = ItemTitle.Trim(),
251              Description = Description.Trim(),
252              Condition = Condition,
253              Category = Category,
254              CategoryOther = IsCategoryOther ? CategoryOther.Trim() : string.Empty,
255              PhotoLocalPaths = PhotoPaths.ToList(),
256              CampusZone = CampusZone,
257              CampusZoneOther = IsMeetupOther ? CampusZoneOther.Trim() : string.Empty,
258              Package = SelectedPackage,
259              StartingBidCentavos = Money.FromPesos(startingPesos),
260              MinIncrementCentavos = Money.FromPesos(incrementPesos),
261          };
262  
263          // Guards a double tap, which would otherwise stack two review screens.
264          if (IsBusy) return;
265          IsBusy = true;
266          try
267          {
268              await _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ReviewListing, new Dictionary<string, object>
269              {
270                  [ReviewListingViewModel.RequestKey] = request,
271              });
272          }
273          finally
274          {
275              IsBusy = false;
276          }
277      }
278  
279      /// <summary>
280      /// Clears the form once its listing has been saved, so the next one starts blank. The
281      /// local photos are not deleted here: the review screen already removed them after upload.
282      /// </summary>
283      private void Reset()
284      {
285          ItemTitle = string.Empty;
286          Description = string.Empty;
287          StartingBidText = string.Empty;
288          BidIncrementText = string.Empty;
289          CategoryOther = string.Empty;
290          CampusZoneOther = string.Empty;
291          SelectedCategoryOption = null;
292          SelectedZoneOption = null;
293          SelectedConditionOption = ConditionOptions[1];
294          PhotoPaths.Clear();
295          RaisePhotoState();
296          _packageChosenByUser = false;
297      }
298  }
```

```csharp
38          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FirstName) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(LastName))
39          {
40              ErrorMessage = "Enter your first and last name.";
41              return;
42          }
43          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedProgram))
44          {
45              ErrorMessage = "Choose your program.";
46              return;

50          try

54              var profile = new UserProfile
55              {
56                  Uid = _auth.CurrentUid ?? string.Empty,
57                  Email = _auth.CurrentEmail ?? string.Empty,
58                  FirstName = first,
59                  LastName = last,
60                  DisplayName = $"{first} {last}",
61                  Program = SelectedProgram,
62                  CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
63              };
64  
65              var result = await _users.CreateProfileAsync(profile);
66              if (!result.Succeeded)
67              {
68                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not save your profile.";
69                  return;
70              }
71  
72              await _nav.ResetToRootAsync();
73          }
74          finally
75          {
76              IsBusy = false;
77          }
```

```csharp
 70  
 71      public bool HasListings => MyListings.Count > 0;
 72      public bool HasIncomingBids => IncomingBids.Count > 0;
 73  
 74  
 75      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 76      {
 77          // An admin may have revoked this account since the session started, and a token
 78          // refresh is the only way that reaches the client. Not forced: RefreshClaimsAsync
 79          // skips the network if it already refreshed within the last minute, so reopening
 80          // this tab is not a round trip every time.
 81          await _auth.RefreshClaimsAsync();
 82          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsVerified));
 83          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsAdmin));
 84  
 85          // The profile, the listings and the approval queue do not depend on each other, so
 86          // they go out together rather than as three round trips in a row.
 87          var profileTask = _users.GetCurrentProfileAsync();
 88          var listingsTask = _listings.GetMyListingsAsync();
 89          var walletTask = _wallet.GetWalletAsync();
 90          var pendingTask = IsAdmin ? _moderation.GetPendingListingsAsync() : null;
 91          var payoutsTask = IsAdmin ? _payouts.GetPendingPayoutsAsync() : null;
 92  
 93          Profile = await profileTask;
 94          RatingText = Profile?.Rating is { } r ? r.ToString("0.0") : "New";
 95  
 96          var mine = await listingsTask;
 97          MyListings.ReplaceAll(mine);
 98          ActiveCount = mine.Count(l => l.Status is ListingStatus.Active or ListingStatus.PendingPayment
 99              or ListingStatus.PendingApproval or ListingStatus.Matched);
100          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasListings));
101  
102          // Bids live in a subcollection per listing, so this is one query per listing and
103          // there is no way around that from the client. Awaiting them in the loop made it
104          // N *sequential* round trips, though — a seller with eight listings sat on a blank
105          // Profile for eight times the latency. Fanned out, it costs one.
106          var bidQueries = mine.Select(listing => _bids.GetIncomingBidsAsync(listing.Id)).ToArray();
107          var bidResults = await Task.WhenAll(bidQueries);
108  
109          // WhenAll keeps the input order, so bids stay grouped under their own listing.
110          IncomingBids.ReplaceAll(
111              mine.Zip(bidResults, (listing, bids) => bids.Select(bid => new IncomingBidViewModel(bid, listing)))
112                  .SelectMany(x => x));
113          BidsReceivedCount = IncomingBids.Count;
114          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasIncomingBids));
115  
116          // The wallet and the admin queues are extras on this page, so they are read last:
117          // if one of them fails, the profile, listings and bids above are already on screen
118          // and only the balance or a queue count is missing.
119          WalletBalanceDisplay = (await walletTask).BalanceDisplay;
120          if (pendingTask is not null) PendingApprovalCount = (await pendingTask).Count;
121          if (payoutsTask is not null) PendingPayoutCount = (await payoutsTask).Count;
122      }
123  
124      /// <summary>
125      /// Registration asks for the program, but accounts made before it did — and Google
126      /// sign-ins — have none, and anyone can pick the wrong one. This is where it's fixed.
127      /// </summary>
128      [RelayCommand]
129      private async Task ChooseProgramAsync()
130      {
131          if (IsBusy || Shell.Current is not { } shell) return;
132  
133          var choice = await shell.DisplayActionSheetAsync(
134              "Your program", "Cancel", null, NUTradeConstants.Programs.ToArray());
135          if (choice is null || !NUTradeConstants.Programs.Contains(choice) || choice == Profile?.Program) return;
136  
137          IsBusy = true;
138          try
139          {
140              var result = await _users.SetProgramAsync(choice);
141              if (!result.Succeeded)
142              {
143                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Couldn't save your program.";
144                  return;
145              }
146              Profile = await _users.GetCurrentProfileAsync();
147              InfoMessage = $"Program set to {choice}.";
148          }
149          finally
150          {
151              IsBusy = false;
152          }
153      }
154  
155      [RelayCommand]
156      private Task NewListingAsync() => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.PostTradeTab);
157  
158      [RelayCommand]
159      private Task OpenApprovalsAsync() => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.ListingApprovals);
160  
161      [RelayCommand]
162      private Task OpenWalletAsync() => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.Wallet);
163  
164      [RelayCommand]
165      private Task OpenPayoutsAsync() => _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.Payouts);
166  
167      /// <summary>
168      /// Reopens the payment screen for a listing that never finished posting — a draft, or
169      /// one waiting on its fee. createQrPayment asks PayMongo first, so a fee that was paid
170      /// but never confirmed is settled rather than charged again.
171      /// </summary>
172      [RelayCommand]
173      private async Task OpenListingAsync(Listing? listing)
174      {
175          if (listing is null || listing.Status is not (ListingStatus.Draft or ListingStatus.PendingPayment)) return;
176  
177          var package = listing.Package;
178          if (package == ListingPackage.Free && await _listings.HasUsedFreePostAsync())
179              package = ListingPackage.Additional;
180  
181          await _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.Payment, new Dictionary<string, object>
182          {
183              ["listingId"] = listing.Id,
184              ["package"] = package,
185          });
186      }
187  
188      // Both actions take the whole row, not just a bid id: bids live in a subcollection,
189      // so the Function needs the listing id to address one.
190      [RelayCommand]
191      private Task ApproveAsync(IncomingBidViewModel? item) => ActOnBidAsync(item, _bids.ApproveBidAsync);
192  
193      [RelayCommand]
194      private Task DeclineAsync(IncomingBidViewModel? item) => ActOnBidAsync(item, _bids.DeclineBidAsync);
195  
196      private async Task ActOnBidAsync(
197          IncomingBidViewModel? item,
198          Func<string, string, CancellationToken, Task<OperationResult>> action)
199      {
200          if (item is null || IsBusy) return;
201          IsBusy = true;
202          try
203          {
204              var result = await action(item.Listing.Id, item.Bid.Id, CancellationToken.None);
205              ErrorMessage = result.Succeeded ? null : result.Error;
206          }
207          finally
208          {
209              IsBusy = false;
210          }
211  
212          await OnAppearingAsync();
213      }
214  
215      [RelayCommand]
216      private async Task SignOutAsync()
217      {
218          await _auth.SignOutAsync();
219          await _nav.ResetToRootAsync();
220      }
221  }
```
