### NUTrade1/ViewModels/RegisterViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3  using NUTrade1.Core;
  4  using NUTrade1.Services;
  5  
  6  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  7  
  8  /// <summary>
  9  /// Create account, code first: email → six-digit code → first name, last name, program
 10  /// and password. On success the student is sent back to sign in with the new account,
 11  /// which is already verified — no further steps.
 12  /// </summary>
 13  public partial class RegisterViewModel : BaseViewModel
 14  {
 15      public enum Step { Email, Code, Details }
 16  
 17      private const int MinPasswordLength = 8;
 18  
 19      private readonly IRegistrationService _registration;
 20      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 21      private IDispatcherTimer? _cooldownTimer;
 22      private string _signupToken = string.Empty;
 23  
 24      public RegisterViewModel(IRegistrationService registration, INavigationService nav)
 25      {
 26          _registration = registration;
 27          _nav = nav;
 28          Title = "Create an account";
 29      }
 30  
 31      [ObservableProperty]
 32      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsEmailStep))]
 33      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsCodeStep))]
 34      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsDetailsStep))]
 35      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowEmailForm))]
 36      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(StepLabel))]
 37      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Heading))]
 38      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(Subheading))]
 39      private Step _currentStep = Step.Email;
 40  
 41      [ObservableProperty] private string _email = string.Empty;
 42      [ObservableProperty] private string _code = string.Empty;
 43      [ObservableProperty] private string _firstName = string.Empty;
 44      [ObservableProperty] private string _lastName = string.Empty;
 45      [ObservableProperty] private string? _selectedProgram;
 46      [ObservableProperty] private string _password = string.Empty;
 47  
 48      public IReadOnlyList<string> Programs => NUTradeConstants.Programs;
 49      [ObservableProperty] private string _confirmPassword = string.Empty;
 50      [ObservableProperty] private string _sentTo = string.Empty;
 51  
 52      [ObservableProperty]
 53      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ResendText))]
 54      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(CanResend))]
 55      private int _resendInSeconds;
 56  
 57      public bool IsEmailStep => CurrentStep == Step.Email;
 58  
 59      /// <summary>The email form stays on screen behind the code modal, so the page does not jump.</summary>
 60      public bool ShowEmailForm => CurrentStep is Step.Email or Step.Code;
 61      public bool IsCodeStep => CurrentStep == Step.Code;
 62      public bool IsDetailsStep => CurrentStep == Step.Details;
 63  
 64      public string StepLabel => $"Step {(int)CurrentStep + 1} of 3";
 65  
 66      public string Heading => CurrentStep switch
 67      {
 68          Step.Code => "Check your email",
 69          Step.Details => "Almost done",
 70          _ => "Create your account",
 71      };
 72  
 73      public string Subheading => CurrentStep switch
 74      {
 75          Step.Code => $"We sent a 6-digit code to {SentTo}.",
 76          Step.Details => "Tell other students who you are, and choose a password.",
 77          _ => "Any email works. We'll send a code to confirm it's yours.",
 78      };
 79  
 80      public bool CanResend => ResendInSeconds <= 0;
 81      public string ResendText => CanResend ? "Send another code" : $"Send another code in {ResendInSeconds}s";
 82  
 83      public override Task OnDisappearingAsync()
 84      {
 85          StopCooldown();
 86          return Task.CompletedTask;
 87      }
 88  
 89      /// <summary>Step 1 → 2, and "Send another code" on step 2.</summary>
 90      [RelayCommand]
 91      private async Task SendCodeAsync()
 92      {
 93          if (IsBusy) return;
 94          ErrorMessage = null;
 95  
 96          if (!NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail(Email))
 97          {
 98              ErrorMessage = "Enter a valid email address.";
 99              return;
100          }
101          if (IsCodeStep && !CanResend) return;
102  
103          IsBusy = true;
104          try
105          {
106              var result = await _registration.StartAsync(Email.Trim());
107              if (!result.Succeeded)
108              {
109                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not send the code. Try again.";
110                  return;
111              }
112  
113              SentTo = result.Value!.SentTo;
114              Code = string.Empty;
115              CurrentStep = Step.Code;
116              OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Subheading));
117              StartCooldown(result.Value.ResendAfterSeconds);
118          }
119          finally
120          {
121              IsBusy = false;
122          }
123      }
124  
125      /// <summary>Step 2 → 3.</summary>
126      [RelayCommand]
127      private async Task VerifyCodeAsync()
128      {
129          if (IsBusy) return;
130          ErrorMessage = null;
131  
132          var entered = Code.Trim();
133          if (entered.Length != 6 || !entered.All(char.IsDigit))
134          {
135              ErrorMessage = "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.";
136              return;
137          }
138  
139          IsBusy = true;
140          try
141          {
142              var result = await _registration.VerifyCodeAsync(Email.Trim(), entered);
143              if (!result.Succeeded)
144              {
145                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "That code isn't right.";
146                  Code = string.Empty;
147                  return;
148              }
149  
150              _signupToken = result.Value!;
151              StopCooldown();
152              CurrentStep = Step.Details;
153          }
154          finally
155          {
156              IsBusy = false;
157          }
158      }
159  
160      /// <summary>Step 3: create the account, then go sign in with it.</summary>
161      [RelayCommand]
162      private async Task RegisterAsync()
163      {
164          if (IsBusy) return;
165          ErrorMessage = null;
166  
167          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FirstName) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(LastName))
168          {
169              ErrorMessage = "Enter your first and last name.";
170              return;
171          }
172          if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedProgram))
173          {
174              ErrorMessage = "Choose your program.";
175              return;
176          }
177          if (Password.Length < MinPasswordLength)
178          {
179              ErrorMessage = $"Use at least {MinPasswordLength} characters for your password.";
180              return;
181          }
182          if (Password != ConfirmPassword)
183          {
184              ErrorMessage = "The two passwords don't match.";
185              return;
186          }
187  
188          IsBusy = true;
189          try
190          {
191              var result = await _registration.CompleteAsync(new SignupDetails(
192                  Email.Trim(), _signupToken, FirstName.Trim(), LastName.Trim(), SelectedProgram, Password));
193              if (!result.Succeeded)
194              {
195                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not create your account. Try again.";
196                  return;
197              }
198  
199              var email = Email.Trim();
200              Password = ConfirmPassword = string.Empty;
201              // Straight to Sign In, whether registration was opened from Welcome or from Login.
202              await _nav.GoToAsync($"//{Routes.Login}", new Dictionary<string, object> { ["registeredEmail"] = email });
203          }
204          finally
205          {
206              IsBusy = false;
207          }
208      }
209  
210      /// <summary>One step back; from the first step, back to sign in.</summary>
211      [RelayCommand]
212      private async Task BackAsync()
213      {
214          ErrorMessage = null;
215          switch (CurrentStep)
216          {
217              case Step.Email:
218                  await _nav.GoBackAsync();
219                  break;
220              case Step.Code:
221                  StopCooldown();
222                  CurrentStep = Step.Email;
223                  break;
224              case Step.Details:
225                  // The code is spent once verified, so going back means starting over.
226                  _signupToken = string.Empty;
227                  CurrentStep = Step.Email;
228                  break;
229          }
230      }
231  
232      private void StartCooldown(int seconds)
233      {
234          StopCooldown();
235          if (seconds <= 0) return;
236  
237          ResendInSeconds = seconds;
238          _cooldownTimer = Application.Current?.Dispatcher.CreateTimer();
239          if (_cooldownTimer is null) return;
240  
241          _cooldownTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
242          _cooldownTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
243          {
244              ResendInSeconds--;
245              if (ResendInSeconds <= 0) StopCooldown();
246          };
247          _cooldownTimer.Start();
248      }
249  
250      private void StopCooldown()
251      {
252          _cooldownTimer?.Stop();
253          _cooldownTimer = null;
254          ResendInSeconds = 0;
255      }
256  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/ReviewListingViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  3  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Messaging;
  4  using NUTrade1.Core;
  5  using NUTrade1.Services;
  6  
  7  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  8  
  9  /// <summary>
 10  /// "Review Listing": the last look before anything is written or paid for.
 11  ///
 12  /// Nothing reaches Firestore until the student taps Post Listing — the form hands this
 13  /// screen the finished request, and backing out from here leaves no draft behind. Posting
 14  /// saves the draft and replaces this screen with the payment one, so Back from payment
 15  /// returns to the (now cleared) form, never to a second Post button for the same listing.
 16  /// </summary>
 17  public partial class ReviewListingViewModel : BaseViewModel, IQueryAttributable
 18  {
 19      public const string RequestKey = "request";
 20  
 21      private readonly IListingService _listings;
 22      private readonly INavigationService _nav;
 23      private CreateAuctionRequest? _request;
 24      private bool _posted;
 25  
 26      public ReviewListingViewModel(IListingService listings, INavigationService nav)
 27      {
 28          _listings = listings;
 29          _nav = nav;
 30          Title = "Review Listing";
 31      }
 32  
 33      /// <summary>The request, shaped as the listing a buyer will see, so labels match the detail page.</summary>
 34      [ObservableProperty]
 35      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(StartingBidDisplay))]
 36      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IncrementDisplay))]
 37      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(PackageDisplay))]
 38      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(PaymentDisplay))]
 39      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsFree))]
 40      private Listing? _preview;
 41  
 42      public string StartingBidDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Preview?.StartingBidCentavos ?? 0);
 43  
 44      public string IncrementDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(Preview?.MinIncrementCentavos ?? 0);
 45  
 46      private long FeeCentavos => NUTradeConstants.FeeForPackage(Preview?.Package ?? ListingPackage.Free);
 47  
 48      public bool IsFree => FeeCentavos == 0;
 49  
 50      public string PackageDisplay => $"{Preview?.Package ?? ListingPackage.Free} – {Money.ToDisplay(FeeCentavos)}";
 51  
 52      public string PaymentDisplay => IsFree ? "None — first post is free" : "PayMongo (QR Ph)";
 53  
 54      public void ApplyQueryAttributes(IDictionary<string, object> query)
 55      {
 56          if (!query.TryGetValue(RequestKey, out var value) || value is not CreateAuctionRequest request) return;
 57  
 58          _request = request;
 59          _posted = false;
 60          Preview = new Listing
 61          {
 62              Title = request.Title,
 63              Description = request.Description,
 64              Condition = request.Condition,
 65              Category = request.Category,
 66              CategoryOther = request.CategoryOther,
 67              Photos = request.PhotoLocalPaths.ToList(),
 68              CampusZone = request.CampusZone,
 69              CampusZoneOther = request.CampusZoneOther,
 70              Package = request.Package,
 71              StartingBidCentavos = request.StartingBidCentavos,
 72              MinIncrementCentavos = request.MinIncrementCentavos,
 73          };
 74      }
 75  
 76      public override async Task OnAppearingAsync()
 77      {
 78          // Reached with nothing to review (the OS restored this page on its own): go back
 79          // to the form rather than show an empty listing with a live Post button.
 80          if (_request is null) await _nav.GoBackAsync();
 81      }
 82  
 83      [RelayCommand]
 84      private async Task PostAsync()
 85      {
 86          if (_request is null || _posted || IsBusy) return;
 87  
 88          ErrorMessage = null;
 89          IsBusy = true;
 90          try
 91          {
 92              var result = await _listings.CreateDraftAsync(_request);
 93              if (!result.Succeeded || string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Value))
 94              {
 95                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not create the auction.";
 96                  return;
 97              }
 98  
 99              _posted = true;
100  
101              // The photos are in Firebase Storage now; the local copies are just clutter.
102              ImageCache.Delete(_request.PhotoLocalPaths);
103              WeakReferenceMessenger.Default.Send(new ListingSubmittedMessage(result.Value));
104  
105              // Every package goes through the payment screen, free included. What was saved
106              // is a draft, and only createQrPayment can move it on: for a first free auction
107              // it queues it for approval straight away and the screen just confirms;
108              // otherwise it mints the QR Ph code to pay. "../" swaps this screen out.
109              await _nav.GoToAsync($"../{Routes.Payment}", new Dictionary<string, object>
110              {
111                  ["listingId"] = result.Value,
112                  ["package"] = _request.Package,
113              });
114          }
115          finally
116          {
117              IsBusy = false;
118          }
119      }
120  
121      [RelayCommand]
122      private Task EditAsync() => _nav.GoBackAsync();
123  
124      /// <summary>Opens the full-screen viewer, the same one buyers get, at the tapped photo.</summary>
125      [RelayCommand]
126      private Task OpenPhotoAsync(int index)
127      {
128          if (Preview is not { Photos.Count: > 0 } preview) return Task.CompletedTask;
129          return _nav.GoToAsync(Routes.PhotoViewer, new Dictionary<string, object>
130          {
131              [PhotoViewerViewModel.PhotosKey] = preview.Photos.ToList(),
132              [PhotoViewerViewModel.IndexKey] = index,
133              [PhotoViewerViewModel.TitleKey] = preview.Title,
134          });
135      }
136  }
```

```csharp
145      private void StartCooldown(int seconds)
146      {
147          StopCooldown();
148          if (seconds <= 0) return;
149  
150          ResendInSeconds = seconds;
151          _cooldownTimer = Application.Current?.Dispatcher.CreateTimer();
152          if (_cooldownTimer is null) return;
153  
154          _cooldownTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
155          _cooldownTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
156          {
157              ResendInSeconds--;
158              if (ResendInSeconds <= 0) StopCooldown();
159          };
160          _cooldownTimer.Start();
161      }
162  
163      private void StopCooldown()
164      {
165          _cooldownTimer?.Stop();
166          _cooldownTimer = null;
167          ResendInSeconds = 0;
168      }
169  
170      partial void OnCodeChanged(string value) => OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanSubmit));
171  }
```

### NUTrade1/ViewModels/WalletViewModel.cs

```csharp
  1  using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
  2  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
  3  using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
  4  using NUTrade1.Core;
  5  using NUTrade1.Services;
  6  
  7  namespace NUTrade1.ViewModels;
  8  
  9  /// <summary>
 10  /// The student's balance, the ledger behind it, and cashing out.
 11  ///
 12  /// Nothing here can move money: the balance changes as a consequence of a trade settling,
 13  /// server-side. The one action is a payout request, and it takes the whole balance —
 14  /// partial payouts are more states for an admin to reconcile by hand than they are worth.
 15  /// </summary>
 16  public partial class WalletViewModel : BaseViewModel
 17  {
 18      /// <summary>Mirrors MIN_PAYOUT_CENTAVOS in functions/src/constants.ts.</summary>
 19      private const long MinPayoutCentavos = 10_000;
 20  
 21      private readonly IWalletService _wallet;
 22  
 23      public WalletViewModel(IWalletService wallet)
 24      {
 25          _wallet = wallet;
 26          Title = "Wallet";
 27      }
 28  
 29      [ObservableProperty]
 30      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(BalanceDisplay))]
 31      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(CanRequestPayout))]
 32      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(PayoutHint))]
 33      private long _balanceCentavos;
 34  
 35      public ObservableRangeCollection<LedgerEntry> Ledger { get; } = new();
 36      public ObservableRangeCollection<PayoutRequest> Payouts { get; } = new();
 37  
 38      public bool HasLedger => Ledger.Count > 0;
 39      public bool HasPayouts => Payouts.Count > 0;
 40  
 41      public string BalanceDisplay => Money.ToDisplay(BalanceCentavos);
 42  
 43      public bool CanRequestPayout => BalanceCentavos >= MinPayoutCentavos;
 44  
 45      public string PayoutHint => BalanceCentavos >= MinPayoutCentavos
 46          ? "An admin sends this to your GCash or Maya by hand, usually within a day."
 47          : $"You need at least {Money.ToDisplay(MinPayoutCentavos)} to cash out.";
 48  
 49      // ---- The payout form -----------------------------------------------------
 50      [ObservableProperty]
 51      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsFormOpen))]
 52      private bool _isRequestingPayout;
 53  
 54      [ObservableProperty] private string _accountName = string.Empty;
 55      [ObservableProperty] private string _accountNumber = string.Empty;
 56  
 57      [ObservableProperty]
 58      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsGCash))]
 59      [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsMaya))]
 60      private PayoutMethod _method = PayoutMethod.GCash;
 61  
 62      public bool IsFormOpen => IsRequestingPayout;
 63      public bool IsGCash => Method == PayoutMethod.GCash;
 64      public bool IsMaya => Method == PayoutMethod.Maya;
 65  
 66      public override Task OnAppearingAsync() => LoadAsync();
 67  
 68      [RelayCommand]
 69      private async Task LoadAsync()
 70      {
 71          IsBusy = true;
 72          try
 73          {
 74              // Three independent reads — no reason to make the student wait for them in turn.
 75              var walletTask = _wallet.GetWalletAsync();
 76              var ledgerTask = _wallet.GetLedgerAsync();
 77              var payoutsTask = _wallet.GetMyPayoutsAsync();
 78  
 79              BalanceCentavos = (await walletTask).BalanceCentavos;
 80              Ledger.ReplaceAll(await ledgerTask);
 81              Payouts.ReplaceAll(await payoutsTask);
 82              RaiseListState();
 83          }
 84          catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 85          {
 86              ErrorMessage = "Couldn't load your wallet. Pull to refresh to try again.";
 87          }
 88          finally
 89          {
 90              IsBusy = false;
 91          }
 92      }
 93  
 94      [RelayCommand]
 95      private void SelectMethod(string? key)
 96      {
 97          if (Enum.TryParse<PayoutMethod>(key, ignoreCase: true, out var method)) Method = method;
 98      }
 99  
100      [RelayCommand]
101      private void OpenPayoutForm()
102      {
103          if (!CanRequestPayout) return;
104          IsRequestingPayout = true;
105      }
106  
107      [RelayCommand]
108      private void CancelPayout()
109      {
110          IsRequestingPayout = false;
111          AccountName = AccountNumber = string.Empty;
112      }
113  
114      [RelayCommand]
115      private async Task SubmitPayoutAsync()
116      {
117          if (IsBusy) return;
118  
119          if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(AccountName))
120          {
121              ErrorMessage = "Enter the name on the account.";
122              return;
123          }
124  
125          // Shape-check here so an obvious typo doesn't cost a round trip; the Function
126          // re-checks it properly, including the +63 form.
127          var digits = new string(AccountNumber.Where(char.IsDigit).ToArray());
128          if (!(digits.Length == 11 && digits.StartsWith("09")))
129          {
130              ErrorMessage = "Enter the 11-digit mobile number, starting 09.";
131              return;
132          }
133  
134          IsBusy = true;
135          try
136          {
137              var result = await _wallet.RequestPayoutAsync(
138                  new PayoutDestination(Method, AccountName.Trim(), digits));
139              if (!result.Succeeded)
140              {
141                  ErrorMessage = result.Error ?? "Could not request the payout. Try again.";
142                  return;
143              }
144  
145              IsRequestingPayout = false;
146              AccountName = AccountNumber = string.Empty;
147              InfoMessage = "Payout requested. An admin will send it shortly.";
148          }
149          finally
150          {
151              IsBusy = false;
152          }
153  
154          // Outside the busy block: the balance has moved to zero and a request has
155          // appeared, and both need re-reading.
156          await LoadAsync();
157      }
158  
159      private void RaiseListState()
160      {
161          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasLedger));
162          OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasPayouts));
163      }
164  }
```

### NUTrade1/Views/AppContentPage.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Services.Firebase;
 2  using NUTrade1.ViewModels;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.Views;
 5  
 6  /// <summary>
 7  /// ContentPage that relays MAUI's appearing / disappearing lifecycle to its
 8  /// <see cref="BaseViewModel"/> so ViewModels can load data and detach listeners.
 9  /// </summary>
10  public abstract class AppContentPage : ContentPage
11  {
12      // Both handlers are async void, so anything a ViewModel throws out of them is an
13      // unhandled exception and Android kills the app on the spot. A denied read or a
14      // dropped connection on one tab is not worth that: it becomes a toast instead.
15  
16      protected override async void OnAppearing()
17      {
18          base.OnAppearing();
19          if (BindingContext is not BaseViewModel vm) return;
20          try
21          {
22              await vm.OnAppearingAsync();
23          }
24          catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
25          {
26              vm.ErrorMessage = ex is FirestoreException
27                  ? ex.Message
28                  : "Couldn't load this screen. Check your connection and try again.";
29          }
30          catch (OperationCanceledException)
31          {
32          }
33      }
34  
35      protected override async void OnDisappearing()
36      {
37          base.OnDisappearing();
38          if (BindingContext is not BaseViewModel vm) return;
39          try
40          {
41              await vm.OnDisappearingAsync();
42          }
43          catch (Exception)
44          {
45              // Detaching listeners on the way out — nothing on screen to report it to.
46          }
47      }
48  }
```

```xml
 42                                  <Label Text="Find it. Bid it." FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="27" TextColor="{StaticResource White}" />
 43                                  <Label Text="Make it yours." FontFamily="Lobster" FontSize="30" TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}"
 44                                         Margin="0,-6,0,0" />
 45                                  <Label Text="New regular listings join after the hourly refresh. Priority listings appear immediately"
 46                                         FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="13.5" LineHeight="1.3" TextColor="{StaticResource HeroMuted}"
 47                                         Margin="0,4,0,0" />
 48                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 49                          </Border>
 50  
 51                          <!-- Search + filter -->
 52                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="10">
 53                              <Border Grid.Column="0" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource SearchBg}" StrokeThickness="0"
 54                                      StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" Padding="16,0" HeightRequest="46">
 55                                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="8">
 56                                      <Path Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource LineSearch}" HeightRequest="17" WidthRequest="17"
 57                                            Stroke="{StaticResource InkMuted}" StrokeThickness="2" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 58                                      <Entry Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Text="{Binding SearchText}"
 59                                             Placeholder="Search" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 60                                  </Grid>
 61                              </Border>
 62                              <Border Grid.Column="1" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource FilterBg}" StrokeThickness="0"
 63                                      StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" HeightRequest="46" WidthRequest="46">
 64                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource LineSliders}" HeightRequest="20" WidthRequest="20"
 65                                        Stroke="{StaticResource InkMuted}" HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 66                                  <Border.GestureRecognizers>
 67                                      <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding RefreshCommand}" />
 68                                  </Border.GestureRecognizers>
 69                              </Border>
 70                          </Grid>
 71  
 72                          <!-- Category filter chips -->
 73                          <ScrollView Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Never" Margin="0,-4,0,0">
 74                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="9">
 75                                  <controls:SelectableChip Text="All" Value="All" Command="{Binding SelectCategoryCommand}"
 76                                                           IsSelected="{Binding SelectedCategory, Converter={StaticResource IsNull}}" />
 77                                  <controls:SelectableChip Text="Uniforms" Value="Uniforms" Command="{Binding SelectCategoryCommand}"
 78                                                           IsSelected="{Binding SelectedCategory, Converter={StaticResource EnumEquals}, ConverterParameter=Uniforms}" />
 79                                  <controls:SelectableChip Text="Textbooks" Value="Textbooks" Command="{Binding SelectCategoryCommand}"
 80                                                           IsSelected="{Binding SelectedCategory, Converter={StaticResource EnumEquals}, ConverterParameter=Textbooks}" />
 81                                  <controls:SelectableChip Text="Supplies" Value="AcademicSupplies" Command="{Binding SelectCategoryCommand}"
 82                                                           IsSelected="{Binding SelectedCategory, Converter={StaticResource EnumEquals}, ConverterParameter=AcademicSupplies}" />
 83                                  <controls:SelectableChip Text="Other" Value="Other" Command="{Binding SelectCategoryCommand}"
 84                                                           IsSelected="{Binding SelectedCategory, Converter={StaticResource EnumEquals}, ConverterParameter=Other}" />
 85                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
 86                          </ScrollView>
 87                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 88                  </CollectionView.Header>
 89  
 90                  <CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
 91                      <DataTemplate x:DataType="core:Listing">
 92                          <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="6" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 16">
 93                              <Border.GestureRecognizers>
 94                                  <TapGestureRecognizer
 95                                      Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.OpenListingCommand}"
 96                                      CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
 97                              </Border.GestureRecognizers>
 98                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="0">
 99  
100                                  <!-- Cover -->
101                                  <Border StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 12" HeightRequest="124"
102                                          BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuNavyLight}">
103                                      <Grid>
104                                          <Image Aspect="AspectFill"
105                                                 Source="{Binding Photos, Converter={StaticResource FirstOrDefault}}" />
106  
107                                          <Border BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
108                                                  Padding="7,2" Margin="7" VerticalOptions="Start" HorizontalOptions="Start"
109                                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsPinned}">
110                                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="3">
111                                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource IconPin}" HeightRequest="10" WidthRequest="10" VerticalOptions="Center"
112                                                        Fill="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
113                                                  <Label Text="Priority" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="10" TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
114                                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
115                                          </Border>
116  
117                                          <Border BackgroundColor="{StaticResource OverlayDark}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
118                                                  Padding="8,2" Margin="7" VerticalOptions="Start" HorizontalOptions="End">
119                                              <Label FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="10" TextColor="{StaticResource White}"
120                                                     Text="{Binding Condition, Converter={StaticResource EnumDisplay}, ConverterParameter='Good'}" />
121                                          </Border>
122                                      </Grid>
123                                  </Border>
124  
125                                  <!-- Body -->
126                                  <VerticalStackLayout Padding="4,9,4,3" Spacing="2">
127                                      <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.4" TextTransform="Uppercase"
128                                             TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}"
129                                             Text="{Binding Category, Converter={StaticResource EnumDisplay}, ConverterParameter='Item'}" />
130                                      <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="13.5" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
131                                             MaxLines="2" LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" Text="{Binding Title}" />
132                                      <Label Text="HIGHEST BID" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.4"
133                                             TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" Margin="0,4,0,0" />
134                                      <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="16" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
135                                             Text="{Binding CurrentHighestBidCentavos, Converter={StaticResource Centavos}}" />
136                                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="4" Margin="0,5,0,0">
137                                          <Label Grid.Column="0" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="9.5" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}"
138                                                 LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" VerticalOptions="Center"
139                                                 Text="{Binding BidCount, StringFormat='{0} bids · refreshes hourly'}" />
140                                          <HorizontalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="3" VerticalOptions="Center">
141                                              <Path Style="{StaticResource LineTimer}" HeightRequest="10" WidthRequest="10"
142                                                    Stroke="{StaticResource InkMuted}" StrokeThickness="2" VerticalOptions="Center" />
143                                              <Label FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="9.5" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}"
144                                                     Text="{Binding CountdownText}" />
145                                          </HorizontalStackLayout>
146                                      </Grid>
147                                  </VerticalStackLayout>
148                              </VerticalStackLayout>
149                          </Border>
150                      </DataTemplate>
151                  </CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
152  
153                  <CollectionView.Footer>
154                      <VerticalStackLayout Padding="0,26,0,128" Spacing="8">
155                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8"
156                                               IsVisible="{Binding HasListings, Converter={StaticResource InvertBool}}">
157                              <Path Style="{StaticResource IconTag}" HeightRequest="34" WidthRequest="34" HorizontalOptions="Center"
158                                    Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
159                              <Label Text="No auctions yet" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
160                              <Label Text="Published auctions from around campus will show up here. Be the first — tap + to post one."
161                                     Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
162                          </VerticalStackLayout>
163                      </VerticalStackLayout>
164                  </CollectionView.Footer>
165              </CollectionView>
166          </RefreshView>
167  
168          <controls:BottomNavBar Grid.Row="1" Active="Home" VerticalOptions="End" />
169  
170          <!-- In-app notifications (posted, won, paid) draw over the page -->
171          <controls:NotificationHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
172          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
173      </Grid>
174  
175  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/ForgotPasswordPage.xaml

```xml
 1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
 2  <views:AppContentPage
 3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.ForgotPasswordPage"
 4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
 5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
 6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
 7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
 8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
 9      x:DataType="vm:ForgotPasswordViewModel"
10      Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False"
11      Title="Reset your password">
12  
13      <Grid>
14      <ScrollView>
15          <Grid Padding="26" RowDefinitions="*,Auto,*">
16  
17              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Row="1" Spacing="18" VerticalOptions="Center">
18  
19                  <Border HeightRequest="72" WidthRequest="72" StrokeThickness="1" Stroke="#D6DCE6" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
20                          BackgroundColor="{StaticResource White}" HorizontalOptions="Center">
21                      <Image Source="nutrade_mark.png" HeightRequest="46" WidthRequest="46" Aspect="AspectFit"
22                             HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
23                  </Border>
24  
25                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
26                      <Label Text="{Binding StepLabel}" Style="{StaticResource Kicker}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
27                      <Label Text="{Binding Heading}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenTitle}" FontSize="26"
28                             HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
29                      <Label Text="{Binding Subheading}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
30                  </VerticalStackLayout>
31  
32                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="18" Margin="0,10,0,0">
33                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14">
34  
35                          <!-- Step 1: email. Stays visible behind the code modal. -->
36                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14" IsVisible="{Binding ShowEmailForm}">
37                              <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
38                                  <Entry Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Placeholder="Your email address" Text="{Binding Email}"
39                                     Keyboard="Email" ReturnType="Go" ReturnCommand="{Binding SendCodeCommand}" />
40                              </Border>
41                              <Button Text="Send reset code" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}"
42                                      Command="{Binding SendCodeCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
43                          </VerticalStackLayout>
44  
45                          <!-- Step 2 lives in the OtpModal at the bottom of this file. -->
46  
47                          <!-- Step 3: the new password -->
48                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14" IsVisible="{Binding IsPasswordStep}">
49                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
50                                  <Label Text="New password" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
51                                  <controls:PasswordField Text="{Binding Password}" Placeholder="At least 8 characters" ReturnType="Next" />
52                              </VerticalStackLayout>
53                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
54                                  <Label Text="Confirm new password" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
55                                  <controls:PasswordField Text="{Binding ConfirmPassword}" Placeholder="Type it again"
56                                                          ReturnType="Go" ReturnCommand="{Binding ResetPasswordCommand}" />
57                              </VerticalStackLayout>
58                              <Button Text="Reset password" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}"
59                                      Command="{Binding ResetPasswordCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
60                          </VerticalStackLayout>
61  
62                          <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" />
63  
64                      </VerticalStackLayout>
65                  </Border>
66  
67                  <Button Text="Back" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}" Command="{Binding BackCommand}" />
68  
69              </VerticalStackLayout>
70          </Grid>
71      </ScrollView>
72  
73          <!-- Step 2: the emailed code, as a modal over the email form. -->
74          <controls:OtpModal IsOpen="{Binding IsCodeStep}" Code="{Binding Code}"
75                             Message="{Binding Subheading}" VerifyText="Verify code"
76                             VerifyCommand="{Binding VerifyCodeCommand}"
77                             ResendCommand="{Binding SendCodeCommand}"
78                             ResendText="{Binding ResendText}" CanResend="{Binding CanResend}"
79                             CloseCommand="{Binding BackCommand}"
80                             IsBusy="{Binding IsBusy}" />
81  
82          <controls:ToastHost />
83      </Grid>
84  
85  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/ListingApprovalsPage.xaml

```xml
  1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
  2  <views:AppContentPage
  3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.ListingApprovalsPage"
  4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
  5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
  6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
  7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
  8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
  9      x:Name="Page"
 10      x:DataType="vm:ListingApprovalsViewModel"
 11      Title="Listing approvals">
 12  
 13      <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,*">
 14  
 15          <controls:DetailBar Grid.Row="0" HeaderTitle="Listing approvals" />
 16  
 17          <ScrollView Grid.Row="1">
 18              <VerticalStackLayout Padding="20,6,20,28" Spacing="16">
 19  
 20                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="10">
 21                      <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="0" Spacing="3">
 22                          <Label Text="Admin" Style="{StaticResource Kicker}" />
 23                          <Label Text="Review new listings" Style="{StaticResource ScreenTitle}" FontSize="23" />
 24                          <Label Text="Nothing reaches the campus feed until you approve it. The seller's 24-hour auction starts at approval."
 25                                 Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" />
 26                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 27                      <Button Grid.Column="1" Text="Refresh" Style="{StaticResource GoldPillButton}" VerticalOptions="Start"
 28                              Command="{Binding LoadCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
 29                  </Grid>
 30  
 31  
 32  
 33                  <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" />
 34  
 35                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="12" BindableLayout.ItemsSource="{Binding Pending}">
 36                      <BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
 37                          <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:PendingListingViewModel">
 38                              <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
 39                                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="12">
 40                                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
 41                                          <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="72" WidthRequest="72" StrokeThickness="0"
 42                                                  StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 14" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuNavyLight}">
 43                                              <Grid>
 44                                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource IconImage}" HeightRequest="24" WidthRequest="24" Opacity="0.55"
 45                                                        HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" Fill="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
 46                                                  <Image Aspect="AspectFill" Source="{Binding CoverPhoto}" />
 47                                              </Grid>
 48                                          </Border>
 49                                          <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="3" VerticalOptions="Center">
 50                                              <Label Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" Text="{Binding Title}"
 51                                                     MaxLines="2" LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" />
 52                                              <Label Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" Text="{Binding SellerName, StringFormat='by {0}'}" />
 53                                              <Border Style="{StaticResource GoldBadge}" Padding="8,2">
 54                                                  <Label Text="{Binding PackageDisplay}" Style="{StaticResource GoldBadgeText}" FontSize="10" />
 55                                              </Border>
 56                                          </VerticalStackLayout>
 57                                      </Grid>
 58  
 59                                      <Label Text="{Binding Description}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" FontSize="13"
 60                                             MaxLines="4" LineBreakMode="TailTruncation"
 61                                             IsVisible="{Binding Description, Converter={StaticResource HasValue}}" />
 62  
 63                                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
 64                                          <Label Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" VerticalOptions="Center"
 65                                                 Text="{Binding StartingBidDisplay, StringFormat='Starting bid {0}'}" />
 66                                          <Label Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" VerticalOptions="Center"
 67                                                 Text="{Binding SubmittedAt, Converter={StaticResource TimeAgo}}" />
 68                                      </Grid>
 69  
 70                                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="10">
 71                                          <Button Grid.Column="0" Text="Reject" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}" HeightRequest="44"
 72                                                  Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.RejectCommand}"
 73                                                  CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
 74                                          <Button Grid.Column="1" Text="Approve" Style="{StaticResource NavyButton}" HeightRequest="44"
 75                                                  Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.ApproveCommand}"
 76                                                  CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
 77                                      </Grid>
 78                                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 79                              </Border>
 80                          </DataTemplate>
 81                      </BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
 82                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 83  
 84                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" IsVisible="{Binding ShowEmptyState}">
 85                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6" Padding="0,10">
 86                          <Path Style="{StaticResource IconCheck}" HeightRequest="26" WidthRequest="26" HorizontalOptions="Center"
 87                                Fill="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
 88                          <Label Text="All caught up" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 89                          <Label Text="No listings are waiting for approval." Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}"
 90                                 HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
 91                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 92                  </Border>
 93  
 94              </VerticalStackLayout>
 95          </ScrollView>
 96  
 97          <!-- In-app notifications (posted, won, paid) draw over the page -->
 98          <controls:NotificationHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
 99          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
100      </Grid>
101  
102  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/ListingDetailPage.xaml

```xml
  1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
  2  <views:AppContentPage
  3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.ListingDetailPage"
  4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
  5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
  6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
  7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
  8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
  9      xmlns:core="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Core;assembly=NUTrade1.Core"
 10      x:Name="Page"
 11      x:DataType="vm:ListingDetailViewModel"
 12      Title="Auction">
 13  
 14      <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto,*">
 15  
 16          <controls:TopBar Grid.Row="0" />
 17          <controls:BackLink Grid.Row="1" />
 18  
 19          <ScrollView Grid.Row="2">
 20              <VerticalStackLayout Padding="20,0,20,120" Spacing="14">
 21  
 22                  <!-- Photos: every one, whole and never cropped; tap for full screen and zoom -->
 23                  <Grid HeightRequest="250">
 24                      <controls:PhotoCarousel Photos="{Binding Listing.Photos}" PhotoTappedCommand="{Binding OpenPhotoCommand}" />
 25                      <Border BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
 26                              Padding="8,2" Margin="12" VerticalOptions="Start" HorizontalOptions="Start" InputTransparent="True"
 27                              IsVisible="{Binding Listing.IsPinned}">
 28                          <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="3">
 29                              <Path Style="{StaticResource IconPin}" HeightRequest="10" WidthRequest="10" VerticalOptions="Center"
 30                                    Fill="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
 31                              <Label Text="Priority" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="10.5" TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
 32                          </HorizontalStackLayout>
 33                      </Border>
 34                  </Grid>
 35  
 36                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="16">
 37                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="12">
 38  
 39                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="4">
 40                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="10">
 41                                  <Label FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="12" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}"
 42                                         Text="{Binding Listing.CategoryLabel, FallbackValue='Item'}" />
 43                                  <Label FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="12" TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}"
 44                                         Text="{Binding Listing.Condition, Converter={StaticResource EnumDisplay}, ConverterParameter='Good'}" />
 45                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
 46                              <Label Text="{Binding Listing.Title, FallbackValue='Auction'}" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="19"
 47                                     TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
 48                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="5" Margin="0,2,0,0"
 49                                                     IsVisible="{Binding Listing.MeetupLabel, Converter={StaticResource HasValue}}">
 50                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource IconMapMarker}" HeightRequest="13" WidthRequest="13"
 51                                        Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 52                                  <Label Text="{Binding Listing.MeetupLabel}" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="12"
 53                                         TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 54                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
 55                          </VerticalStackLayout>
 56  
 57                          <!-- Seller -->
 58                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="9">
 59                              <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="30" WidthRequest="30" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
 60                                      BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" VerticalOptions="Center">
 61                                  <Label Text="{Binding Seller.DisplayName, Converter={StaticResource Initials}}"
 62                                         FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="11" TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}"
 63                                         HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 64                              </Border>
 65                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="0" VerticalOptions="Center">
 66                                  <Label FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="13" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
 67                                         Text="{Binding Seller.DisplayName, FallbackValue='NU–Lipa student', TargetNullValue='NU–Lipa student'}" />
 68                                  <Label FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="11" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}"
 69                                         Text="{Binding Seller, Converter={StaticResource HubProgram}}" />
 70                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 71                          </Grid>
 72  
 73                          <BoxView HeightRequest="1" Color="{StaticResource CardBorder}" />
 74  
 75                          <!-- Stats -->
 76                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="8">
 77                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="0" Spacing="1">
 78                                  <Label Text="CURRENT BID" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.3"
 79                                         TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 80                                  <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="19" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
 81                                         Text="{Binding CurrentBidDisplay}" />
 82                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 83                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="1">
 84                                  <Label Text="MIN. NEXT BID" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.3"
 85                                         TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 86                                  <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="19" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
 87                                         Text="{Binding MinNextBidDisplay}" />
 88                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 89                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="2" Spacing="1" Margin="0,0,10,0">
 90                                  <Label Text="BIDS" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.3"
 91                                         TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 92                                  <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="19" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
 93                                         HorizontalOptions="Center" Text="{Binding BidCountDisplay}" />
 94                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 95                          </Grid>
 96  
 97                          <!-- Countdown pill -->
 98                          <Border StrokeThickness="1" Stroke="#F4DFA8" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" Padding="14,9"
 99                                  BackgroundColor="{StaticResource GoldSoft}">
100                              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="8">
101                                  <Label Grid.Column="0" Text="NEXT FEED REFRESH" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="11"
102                                         CharacterSpacing="0.3" TextColor="#919397" VerticalOptions="Center" />
103                                  <HorizontalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="6" VerticalOptions="Center">
104                                      <Path Style="{StaticResource LineTimer}" HeightRequest="15" WidthRequest="15"
105                                            Stroke="{StaticResource NuNavy}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
106                                      <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="12.5" TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" VerticalOptions="Center"
107                                             Text="{Binding Listing.CountdownText, StringFormat='{0} until refresh'}" />
108                                  </HorizontalStackLayout>
109                              </Grid>
110                          </Border>
111  
112                          <Label Text="{Binding Listing.Description}" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="13.5" LineHeight="1.35"
113                                 TextColor="#3F4A5E" IsVisible="{Binding Listing.Description, Converter={StaticResource HasValue}}" />
114  
115                          <!-- Place a bid -->
116                          <!-- Never drawn for the seller, and not until the listing has loaded — before
117                               that, whose listing it is isn't known yet. -->
118                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6" IsVisible="{Binding ShowBidForm}">
119                              <Label Text="Your maximum bid" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="11" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
120                              <Border StrokeThickness="1" Stroke="{StaticResource CardBorder}" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
121                                      BackgroundColor="{StaticResource White}" Padding="16,0,0,0" HeightRequest="46">
122                                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
123                                      <Entry Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Keyboard="Numeric"
124                                             Text="{Binding BidAmountText}" Placeholder="₱" VerticalOptions="Center" />
125                                      <Button Grid.Column="1" Text="Bid" Style="{StaticResource NavyButton}" FontSize="13"
126                                              HeightRequest="46" WidthRequest="112" Padding="0"
127                                              Command="{Binding PlaceBidCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
128                                  </Grid>
129                              </Border>
130                              <!-- Said before they tap, not after: bidding now costs money up front. -->
131                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="6" Margin="2,2,0,0">
132                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource IconInfoCircle}" HeightRequest="13" WidthRequest="13"
133                                        Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Start" Margin="0,1,0,0" />
134                                  <Label Text="{Binding DepositHint}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" HorizontalOptions="Fill" />
135                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
136                          </VerticalStackLayout>
137  
138                          <Border StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" Padding="14,10"
139                                  BackgroundColor="{StaticResource FilterBg}" IsVisible="{Binding IsOwnListing}">
140                              <Label Text="This is your listing. Sellers can't bid on their own items." FontSize="13"
141                                     TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
142                          </Border>
143  
144                          <!-- Bid history -->
145                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
146                              <Label Text="Bid history" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="14" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
147                              <Label Text="No bids yet — be the first." Style="{StaticResource MetaText}"
148                                     IsVisible="{Binding BidHistory.Count, Converter={StaticResource CountToBool}, ConverterParameter=invert}" />
149                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="0" BindableLayout.ItemsSource="{Binding BidHistory}">
150                                  <BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
151                                      <DataTemplate x:DataType="core:Bid">
152                                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="10" Padding="0,8">
153                                              <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="30" WidthRequest="30" StrokeThickness="0"
154                                                      StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuGold}">
155                                                  <Label Text="{Binding BidderName, Converter={StaticResource Initials}}"
156                                                         FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="11" TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}"
157                                                         HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
158                                              </Border>
159                                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" VerticalOptions="Center" Spacing="0">
160                                                  <Label FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="13" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" Text="{Binding BidderName}" />
161                                                  <Label Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" FontSize="11" Text="{Binding CreatedAt, Converter={StaticResource TimeAgo}}" />
162                                              </VerticalStackLayout>
163                                              <Label Grid.Column="2" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="14" VerticalOptions="Center"
164                                                     TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
165                                                     Text="{Binding AmountCentavos, Converter={StaticResource Centavos}}" />
166                                          </Grid>
167                                      </DataTemplate>
168                                  </BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
169                              </VerticalStackLayout>
170                          </VerticalStackLayout>
171                      </VerticalStackLayout>
172                  </Border>
173  
174              </VerticalStackLayout>
175          </ScrollView>
176  
177          <controls:BottomNavBar Grid.Row="2" Active="Offers" VerticalOptions="End" />
178  
179          <!-- In-app notifications (posted, won, paid) draw over the page -->
180          <controls:NotificationHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="3" />
181          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="3" />
182      </Grid>
183  
184  </views:AppContentPage>
```

```xml
 1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
 2  <views:AppContentPage
 3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.LoginPage"

12  
13      <Grid>
14      <ScrollView>
15          <Grid Padding="26" RowDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto,*">
16  
17              <HorizontalStackLayout Grid.Row="0" Spacing="6" HorizontalOptions="Start">
18                  <HorizontalStackLayout.GestureRecognizers>
19                      <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding BackToWelcomeCommand}" />
20                  </HorizontalStackLayout.GestureRecognizers>
21                  <Path Style="{StaticResource LineChevronLeft}" HeightRequest="18" WidthRequest="18"
22                        Stroke="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
23                  <Label Text="Back" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="15" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
24              </HorizontalStackLayout>
25  
26              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Row="2" Spacing="18" VerticalOptions="Center">
27  
28                  <Border HeightRequest="72" WidthRequest="72" StrokeThickness="1" Stroke="#D6DCE6" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
29                          BackgroundColor="{StaticResource White}" HorizontalOptions="Center">
30                      <Image Source="nutrade_mark.png" HeightRequest="46" WidthRequest="46" Aspect="AspectFit"
31                             HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
32                  </Border>
33  
34                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
35                      <Label HorizontalOptions="Center">
36                          <Label.FormattedText>
37                              <FormattedString>
38                                  <Span Text="NU" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="30"
39                                        TextColor="{AppThemeBinding Light={StaticResource NuNavy}, Dark={StaticResource InkDark}}" />
40                                  <Span Text="Trade" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="30" TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
41                              </FormattedString>
42                          </Label.FormattedText>
43                      </Label>
44                      <Label Text="Trade what you have for what you need — with verified National University–Lipa students."
45                             Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
46                  </VerticalStackLayout>
47  
48                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="18" Margin="0,10,0,0">

51                              <Entry Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Placeholder="Your email address" Text="{Binding Email}"
52                                 Keyboard="Email" ReturnType="Next" />
53                          </Border>
54                          <controls:PasswordField Placeholder="Password" Text="{Binding Password}"
55                                                  ReturnType="Go" ReturnCommand="{Binding SignInCommand}" />
56                          <Label Text="Forgot password?" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="13"
57                                 TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" HorizontalOptions="End">
58                              <Label.GestureRecognizers>
59                                  <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding ForgotPasswordCommand}" />
60                              </Label.GestureRecognizers>
61                          </Label>
62                          <Button Text="Sign in" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}"
63                                  Command="{Binding SignInCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
64                          <Button Text="New here? Create an account" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}"
65                                  Command="{Binding CreateAccountCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
66  
67                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="10" IsVisible="{Binding IsGoogleSignInAvailable}">
68                              <BoxView Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="1" VerticalOptions="Center"
69                                       Color="{StaticResource CardBorder}" />
70                              <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="or" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
71                              <BoxView Grid.Column="2" HeightRequest="1" VerticalOptions="Center"
72                                       Color="{StaticResource CardBorder}" />
73                          </Grid>
74  
75                          <Button Text="Continue with Google" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}"
76                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsGoogleSignInAvailable}"
77                                  Command="{Binding SignInWithGoogleCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
78                          <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" />
79                          <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="6" HorizontalOptions="Center">
80                              <Path Style="{StaticResource IconVerified}" HeightRequest="13" WidthRequest="13"
81                                    Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
82                              <Label Text="Any email works. We send a code to confirm it." Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
83                          </HorizontalStackLayout>
84                      </VerticalStackLayout>
85                  </Border>
86  
87              </VerticalStackLayout>
88          </Grid>
89      </ScrollView>
90  
91          <controls:ToastHost />
92      </Grid>
93  
94  </views:AppContentPage>
```

```xml
 1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
 2  <views:AppContentPage
 3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.OffersPage"

22                      <Label Text="Track the auctions you've bid on." Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" />
23                  </VerticalStackLayout>
24  
25                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="12" IsVisible="{Binding HasBids}" BindableLayout.ItemsSource="{Binding MyBids}">

36                                              StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 14" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuNavyLight}">

40                                                    Fill="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
41                                              <Image Aspect="AspectFill" Source="{Binding CoverPhoto}" />
42                                          </Grid>
43                                      </Border>
44                                      <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="3" VerticalOptions="Center">
45                                          <Label Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" MaxLines="1" LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" Text="{Binding Title}" />
46                                          <Label Style="{StaticResource MetaText}"
47                                                 Text="{Binding YourBidDisplay, StringFormat='Your bid: {0}'}" />
48                                          <Label Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" FontSize="11"
49                                                 Text="{Binding CreatedAt, Converter={StaticResource TimeAgo}}" />
50                                      </VerticalStackLayout>
51                                      <Border Grid.Column="2" VerticalOptions="Center" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" Padding="10,4"
52                                              BackgroundColor="{AppThemeBinding Light={StaticResource GoldSoft}, Dark={StaticResource GoldSoftDark}}">

54                                      </Border>
55                                  </Grid>
56                              </Border>
57                          </DataTemplate>
58                      </BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
59                  </VerticalStackLayout>
60  
61                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8" Padding="0,40" IsVisible="{Binding HasBids, Converter={StaticResource InvertBool}}">
62                      <Path Style="{StaticResource IconTag}" HeightRequest="32" WidthRequest="32" HorizontalOptions="Center"
63                            Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
64                      <Label Text="You haven't placed any bids" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
65                      <Label Text="Browse the campus feed and place a bid — your active and past bids will be tracked here."
```

```xml
41                                  Command="{Binding GenerateCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />

43                      </VerticalStackLayout>
44                  </Border>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/PaymentPage.xaml

```xml
  1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
  2  <views:AppContentPage
  3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.PaymentPage"
  4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
  5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
  6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
  7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
  8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
  9      x:DataType="vm:PaymentViewModel"
 10      Title="Pay listing fee">
 11  
 12      <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,*">
 13  
 14          <controls:DetailBar Grid.Row="0" HeaderTitle="Pay listing fee" />
 15  
 16          <ScrollView Grid.Row="1">
 17              <VerticalStackLayout Padding="20,6,20,28" Spacing="18">
 18  
 19                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="3">
 20                      <Label Text="{Binding Kicker}" Style="{StaticResource Kicker}" />
 21                      <Label Text="{Binding Heading}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenTitle}" FontSize="23" />
 22                      <Label Text="{Binding Subheading}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" />
 23                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 24  
 25                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="20" IsVisible="{Binding ShowQr}">
 26                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14">
 27                          <controls:PaymentQrView ImageUrl="{Binding Qr.QrImageUrl}" ImageBase64="{Binding Qr.QrImageBase64}"
 28                                                  FileName="{Binding QrFileName}" />
 29  
 30                          <Label Text="{Binding AmountDisplay}" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="26"
 31                                 TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 32                          <Label Text="{Binding PackageName, StringFormat='{0} listing'}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}"
 33                                 HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 34  
 35                          <Button Text="I've paid — check now" Style="{StaticResource NavyButton}"
 36                                  Command="{Binding CheckNowCommand}" IsVisible="{Binding HasQrImage}" />
 37                          <Label Text="{Binding PaymentCheckMessage}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center"
 38                                 IsVisible="{Binding PaymentCheckMessage, Converter={StaticResource HasValue}}" />
 39                          <Button Text="Generate a new code" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}"
 40                                  Command="{Binding GenerateCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
 41                          <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" Caption="Asking PayMongo…" />
 42                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 43                  </Border>
 44  
 45                  <!-- Paid (or free): sitting in the admin queue. -->
 46                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" IsVisible="{Binding IsAwaitingApproval}">
 47                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
 48                          <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="38" WidthRequest="38" StrokeThickness="0" VerticalOptions="Center"
 49                                  StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
 50                                  BackgroundColor="{AppThemeBinding Light={StaticResource GoldSoft}, Dark={StaticResource GoldSoftDark}}">
 51                              <Path Style="{StaticResource IconClock}" HeightRequest="19" WidthRequest="19"
 52                                    HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" Fill="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
 53                          </Border>
 54                          <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="2" VerticalOptions="Center">
 55                              <Label Text="Pending admin approval" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" FontSize="14" />
 56                              <Label Text="You can leave this screen — its status shows under My listings on your profile."
 57                                     Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
 58                          </VerticalStackLayout>
 59                      </Grid>
 60                  </Border>
 61  
 62                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" IsVisible="{Binding IsApproved}"
 63                          BackgroundColor="{AppThemeBinding Light={StaticResource GoldSoft}, Dark={StaticResource GoldSoftDark}}">
 64                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="10">
 65                          <Path Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource IconCheck}" HeightRequest="20" WidthRequest="20"
 66                                Fill="{StaticResource GoldSoftText}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 67                          <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding ApprovedText}" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" FontSize="13.5"
 68                                 VerticalOptions="Center" LineBreakMode="WordWrap" />
 69                      </Grid>
 70                  </Border>
 71  
 72                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" IsVisible="{Binding IsRejected}">
 73                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="10">
 74                          <Path Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource IconClose}" HeightRequest="20" WidthRequest="20" VerticalOptions="Center"
 75                                Fill="{AppThemeBinding Light={StaticResource Danger}, Dark={StaticResource DangerDark}}" />
 76                          <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding RejectedText}" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" FontSize="13.5"
 77                                 VerticalOptions="Center" LineBreakMode="WordWrap" />
 78                      </Grid>
 79                  </Border>
 80  
 81  
 82                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="10" IsVisible="{Binding IsSubmitted}">
 83                      <Button Text="Go to the feed" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}" Command="{Binding DoneCommand}" />
 84                      <Button Text="View my listings" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}" Command="{Binding ViewMyListingsCommand}" />
 85                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 86  
 87                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="6" IsVisible="{Binding ShowQr}">
 88                      <Path Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource IconClock}" HeightRequest="13" WidthRequest="13"
 89                            Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Start" Margin="0,2,0,0" />
 90                      <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding ExpiryText}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
 91                  </Grid>
 92  
 93              </VerticalStackLayout>
 94          </ScrollView>
 95  
 96          <!-- Last child, spanning both rows, so it draws over the header and content. -->
 97          <controls:NotificationHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
 98          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
 99      </Grid>
100  
101  </views:AppContentPage>
```
