### NUTrade1/Views/PayoutsPage.xaml

```xml
 1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
 2  <views:AppContentPage
 3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.PayoutsPage"
 4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
 5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
 6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
 7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
 8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
 9      x:DataType="vm:PayoutsViewModel"
10      x:Name="Page"
11      Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False"
12      Title="Payout requests">
13  
14      <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,*">
15  
16          <controls:DetailBar Grid.Row="0" HeaderTitle="Payout requests" />
17  
18          <RefreshView Grid.Row="1" Command="{Binding LoadCommand}" IsRefreshing="{Binding IsBusy}">
19              <ScrollView>
20                  <VerticalStackLayout Padding="18,10,18,28" Spacing="14">
21  
22                      <Label Text="NUTrade doesn't move money itself. Send each one from your own GCash or Maya, then mark it sent."
23                             Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
24  
25                      <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" Caption="Loading the queue…" />
26  
27                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="12" BindableLayout.ItemsSource="{Binding Pending}">
28                          <BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
29                              <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:PendingPayoutViewModel">
30                                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="16">
31                                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="10">
32                                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
33                                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="0" Spacing="2">
34                                                  <Label Text="{Binding StudentName}" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="15"
35                                                         TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
36                                                  <Label Text="{Binding DestinationDisplay}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
37                                                  <Label Text="{Binding RequestedAt, Converter={StaticResource TimeAgo}}"
38                                                         Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
39                                              </VerticalStackLayout>
40                                              <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding AmountDisplay}" FontFamily="InterBold"
41                                                     FontSize="19" VerticalOptions="Center" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
42                                          </Grid>
43  
44                                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="10">
45                                              <Button Grid.Column="0" Text="Mark sent" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}"
46                                                      Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.MarkPaidCommand}"
47                                                      CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
48                                              <Button Grid.Column="1" Text="Decline" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}"
49                                                      Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.DeclineCommand}"
50                                                      CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
51                                          </Grid>
52                                      </VerticalStackLayout>
53                                  </Border>
54                              </DataTemplate>
55                          </BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
56                      </VerticalStackLayout>
57  
58                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8" Margin="0,30,0,0" IsVisible="{Binding ShowEmptyState}">
59                          <Path Style="{StaticResource LineCheck}" HeightRequest="30" WidthRequest="30"
60                                HorizontalOptions="Center" Stroke="{StaticResource InkMuted}" StrokeThickness="2" />
61                          <Label Text="All caught up — nobody is waiting to be paid."
62                                 Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
63                      </VerticalStackLayout>
64  
65                  </VerticalStackLayout>
66              </ScrollView>
67          </RefreshView>
68  
69          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
70      </Grid>
71  
72  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/PhotoViewerPage.xaml.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Controls;
 2  using NUTrade1.ViewModels;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.Views;
 5  
 6  public partial class PhotoViewerPage : AppContentPage
 7  {
 8      private static readonly bool ShowArrows = DeviceInfo.Idiom == DeviceIdiom.Desktop;
 9  
10      private readonly PhotoViewerViewModel _vm;
11      private bool _positioned;
12  
13      public PhotoViewerPage(PhotoViewerViewModel vm)
14      {
15          InitializeComponent();
16          BindingContext = _vm = vm;
17      }
18  
19      protected override void OnAppearing()
20      {
21          base.OnAppearing();
22          if (_positioned) return;
23          _positioned = true;
24  
25          // The viewer opens at 0 and then moves to the tapped photo: a CarouselView only
26          // scrolls on a real change of Position, and ignores its first value while its
27          // items are still being created. (On WinUI an *animated* change also snapped
28          // back to 0 — hence IsScrollAnimated="False" in the XAML.)
29          var start = _vm.StartIndex;
30          Dispatcher.DispatchDelayed(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(150), () =>
31          {
32              if (start > 0 && start < _vm.Photos.Count) _vm.Position = start;
33              UpdateArrows();
34          });
35      }
36  
37      private void OnPositionChanged(object? sender, PositionChangedEventArgs e)
38      {
39          // Leaving a zoomed photo behind would leave swiping switched off.
40          _vm.IsZoomed = false;
41          UpdateArrows();
42      }
43  
44      /// <summary>Zooming locks the carousel so a drag moves around the photo instead of changing it.</summary>
45      private void OnZoomChanged(object? sender, bool zoomed)
46      {
47          if (sender is ZoomableImage image && image.BindingContext as string != _vm.Photos.ElementAtOrDefault(_vm.Position))
48              return; // A recycled view off screen resetting itself.
49  
50          _vm.IsZoomed = zoomed;
51          UpdateArrows();
52      }
53  
54      private void UpdateArrows()
55      {
56          var many = _vm.Photos.Count > 1 && ShowArrows && !_vm.IsZoomed;
57          PreviousButton.IsVisible = many && _vm.Position > 0;
58          NextButton.IsVisible = many && _vm.Position < _vm.Photos.Count - 1;
59      }
60  }
```

```xml
  2  <views:AppContentPage
  3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.PostTradePage"

  9      x:Name="Page"
 10      x:DataType="vm:PostTradeViewModel"
 11      Title="Create an auction">
 12  
 13      <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,*">
 14  
 15          <controls:TopBar Grid.Row="0" />

 25                          <!-- Photos: the whole picture, never cropped, once any are added -->

 27                              <Border StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 14" HeightRequest="180"
 28                                      BackgroundColor="{StaticResource PageTop}">

 30                                                Loop="False" PeekAreaInsets="0">

 35                                                  <Border BackgroundColor="{StaticResource OverlayDark}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
 36                                                          HeightRequest="26" WidthRequest="26" Margin="10" HorizontalOptions="End" VerticalOptions="Start">
 37                                                      <Path Style="{StaticResource LineClose}" HeightRequest="12" WidthRequest="12"
 38                                                            Stroke="{StaticResource White}" HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 39                                                      <Border.GestureRecognizers>
 40                                                          <TapGestureRecognizer
 41                                                              Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.RemovePhotoCommand}"
 42                                                              CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
 43                                                      </Border.GestureRecognizers>
 44                                                  </Border>

 55                          <Border StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 14" StrokeThickness="1.2" StrokeDashArray="4,3"
 56                                  Stroke="#B9C2D2" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource CardBg}" HeightRequest="112"
 57                                  IsVisible="{Binding CanAddPhoto}">
 58                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6" HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center">
 59                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource LineImagePlus}" HeightRequest="26" WidthRequest="26"
 60                                        Stroke="{StaticResource InkMuted}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 61                                  <Label Text="Add up to 4 photos" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="14"
 62                                         TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 63                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 64                              <Border.GestureRecognizers>
 65                                  <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding AddPhotoCommand}" />
 66                              </Border.GestureRecognizers>

 69                          <!-- Item name -->

 71                              <Label Text="Item name" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" />

 74                              </Border>
 75                          </VerticalStackLayout>

 77                          <!-- Description -->

 81                                  <Editor Style="{StaticResource ShellEditor}" Text="{Binding Description}" MinimumHeightRequest="42" />
 82                              </Border>
 83                          </VerticalStackLayout>

 85                          <!-- Category / Condition -->
 86                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="10">

 97                                      </Grid>
 98                                  </Border>
 99                              </VerticalStackLayout>
100                              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="5">
101                                  <Label Text="Condition" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" />
102                                  <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
103                                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
104                                          <Picker Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource ShellPicker}"
105                                                  ItemsSource="{Binding ConditionOptions}" ItemDisplayBinding="{Binding Label}"
106                                                  SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedConditionOption}" />
107                                          <Path Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}" HeightRequest="14" WidthRequest="14"
108                                                Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" InputTransparent="True"
109                                                IsVisible="{OnPlatform Default=True, WinUI=False}" />
110                                      </Grid>
111                                  </Border>
112                              </VerticalStackLayout>
113                          </Grid>
114  
115                          <!-- "Other" is not an answer on its own, so ask for one. -->
116                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="5" IsVisible="{Binding IsCategoryOther}">
117                              <Label Text="Which category?" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" />

121                              </Border>

134                                  <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">

136                                  </Border>
137                              </VerticalStackLayout>
138                          </Grid>
139  
140                          <!-- Meetup location -->
141                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="5">
142                              <Label Text="Meetup location *" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" />
143                              <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
144                                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
145                                      <Picker Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource ShellPicker}" Title="Select a location"
146                                              ItemsSource="{Binding ZoneOptions}" ItemDisplayBinding="{Binding Label}"
147                                              SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedZoneOption}" />
148                                      <Path Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}" HeightRequest="14" WidthRequest="14"
149                                            Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" InputTransparent="True"
150                                            IsVisible="{OnPlatform Default=True, WinUI=False}" />
151                                  </Grid>
152                              </Border>
153                          </VerticalStackLayout>
154  
155                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="5" IsVisible="{Binding IsMeetupOther}">
156                              <Label Text="Where exactly?" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" />
157                              <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">

160                              </Border>

163                          <BoxView HeightRequest="1" Color="{StaticResource CardBorder}" Margin="0,4" />
164

166                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8">
167                              <Label Text="CHOOSE A PACKAGE" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="11" CharacterSpacing="0.8"
168                                     TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" />

170                                     Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" IsVisible="{Binding ShowFreeUsedNote}" />
171  
172                              <controls:PackageOption Title="Free" Subtitle="First auction" Price="₱ 0" Value="Free"
173                                                      IsVisible="{Binding IsFreeAvailable}"
174                                                      Command="{Binding SelectPackageCommand}"
175                                                      IsSelected="{Binding SelectedPackage, Converter={StaticResource EnumEquals}, ConverterParameter=Free}" />
176                              <controls:PackageOption Title="Additional" Subtitle="Additional auction" Price="₱ 10" Value="Additional"
177                                                      Command="{Binding SelectPackageCommand}"

179                              <controls:PackageOption Title="Priority" Subtitle="Pin to top of feed" Price="₱ 20" Value="Priority"
180                                                      Command="{Binding SelectPackageCommand}"

182                          </VerticalStackLayout>

190              </VerticalStackLayout>

197          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
198      </Grid>
199  
200  </views:AppContentPage>
```

```xml
110                          <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="40" WidthRequest="40" StrokeThickness="0" VerticalOptions="Center"
111                                  StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" Background="{StaticResource HeroBrush}">
112                              <Path Style="{StaticResource IconSwapH}" HeightRequest="18" WidthRequest="18"
113                                    HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" Fill="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
114                          </Border>
115                          <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="1" VerticalOptions="Center">
116                              <Label Text="Payout requests" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="14" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
117                              <Label Text="{Binding PendingPayoutCount, StringFormat='{0} waiting to be paid'}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
118                          </VerticalStackLayout>
119                          <Path Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource IconChevronRight}" HeightRequest="20" WidthRequest="20"
120                                VerticalOptions="Center" Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
121                      </Grid>
122                      <Border.GestureRecognizers>
123                          <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding OpenPayoutsCommand}" />
124                      </Border.GestureRecognizers>
125                  </Border>
126  
127                  <!-- Admin only: the listing approval queue -->
128                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="14" IsVisible="{Binding IsAdmin}">
129                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="12">
130                          <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="40" WidthRequest="40" StrokeThickness="0" VerticalOptions="Center"
131                                  StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" Background="{StaticResource HeroBrush}">
132                              <Path Style="{StaticResource LineCheck}" HeightRequest="18" WidthRequest="18"
133                                    HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" Stroke="{StaticResource NuGold}" StrokeThickness="2.4" />
134                          </Border>
135                          <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="1" VerticalOptions="Center">
136                              <Label Text="Listing approvals" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="14" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
137                              <Label Text="{Binding PendingApprovalCount, StringFormat='{0} waiting for review'}" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
138                          </VerticalStackLayout>
139                          <Path Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource IconChevronRight}" HeightRequest="20" WidthRequest="20"
140                                VerticalOptions="Center" Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
141                      </Grid>
142                      <Border.GestureRecognizers>
143                          <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding OpenApprovalsCommand}" />
144                      </Border.GestureRecognizers>
145                  </Border>
146  
147                  <!-- My listings -->
148                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto" Margin="0,4,0,0">
149                      <Label Grid.Column="0" Text="My listings" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="15" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
150                             VerticalOptions="Center" />
151                      <Border Grid.Column="1" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
152                              Padding="14,3" VerticalOptions="Center">
153                          <Label Text="New" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="11.5" TextColor="{StaticResource NuNavy}" />
154                          <Border.GestureRecognizers>
155                              <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding NewListingCommand}" />
156                          </Border.GestureRecognizers>
157                      </Border>
158                  </Grid>
159  
160                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="10" IsVisible="{Binding HasListings}" BindableLayout.ItemsSource="{Binding MyListings}">
161                      <BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
162                          <DataTemplate x:DataType="core:Listing">
163                              <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="8">
164                                  <Border.GestureRecognizers>
165                                      <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.OpenListingCommand}"
166                                                            CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
167                                  </Border.GestureRecognizers>
168                                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
169                                      <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="80" WidthRequest="80" StrokeThickness="0"
170                                              StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 12" BackgroundColor="#A5B1C8">
171                                          <Image Aspect="AspectFill" Source="{Binding Photos, Converter={StaticResource FirstOrDefault}}" />
172                                      </Border>
173                                      <Grid Grid.Column="1" RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto,*,Auto" Padding="0,4">
174                                          <Label Grid.Row="0" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="14" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}"
175                                                 MaxLines="1" LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" Text="{Binding Title}" />
176                                          <HorizontalStackLayout Grid.Row="1" Spacing="6">
177                                              <Label Text="Priority Listing" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="11" TextColor="#9BA0AC"
178                                                     IsVisible="{Binding IsPinned}" />
179                                              <Label FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="11" TextColor="#9BA0AC"
180                                                     Text="{Binding CurrentHighestBidCentavos, Converter={StaticResource Centavos}, StringFormat='{0} current bid'}" />
181                                          </HorizontalStackLayout>
182                                          <Label Grid.Row="3" FontSize="11" FontFamily="InterMedium"
183                                                 TextColor="{Binding Status, Converter={StaticResource ListingStatusColor}}"
184                                                 Text="{Binding Status, Converter={StaticResource ListingStatusText}}" />
185                                          <Label Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" FontSize="11" VerticalOptions="End"
186                                                 Text="{Binding RejectionReason}"
187                                                 IsVisible="{Binding RejectionReason, Converter={StaticResource HasValue}}" />
188                                      </Grid>
189                                  </Grid>
190                              </Border>
191                          </DataTemplate>
192                      </BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
193                  </VerticalStackLayout>
194  
195                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" IsVisible="{Binding HasListings, Converter={StaticResource InvertBool}}">
196                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6" Padding="0,10">
197                          <Label Text="No listings yet" Style="{StaticResource CardTitle}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
198                          <Label Text="Post an item to start auctioning it off to campus." Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}"
199                                 HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
200                      </VerticalStackLayout>
201                  </Border>
202  
203                  <!-- Incoming bids -->
204                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="1" IsVisible="{Binding HasIncomingBids}" Margin="0,4,0,0">
205                      <Label Text="Incoming bids" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="15" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
206                      <Label Text="Approve one bid to confirm the buyer and start a chat." FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="11"
207                             TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
208                  </VerticalStackLayout>
209  
210                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="10" IsVisible="{Binding HasIncomingBids}" BindableLayout.ItemsSource="{Binding IncomingBids}">
211                      <BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
212                          <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:IncomingBidViewModel">
213                              <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="12">
214                                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="10">
215                                      <Border Grid.Column="0" HeightRequest="38" WidthRequest="38" StrokeThickness="0" VerticalOptions="Center"
216                                              StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999" BackgroundColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
217                                      <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" VerticalOptions="Center" Spacing="1">
218                                          <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="14" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" Text="{Binding BidderName}" />
219                                          <Label FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="10.5" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}"
220                                                 MaxLines="1" LineBreakMode="TailTruncation">
221                                              <Label.FormattedText>
222                                                  <FormattedString>
223                                                      <Span Text="{Binding ListingTitle}" />
224                                                      <Span Text=" • " />
225                                                      <Span Text="{Binding CreatedAt, Converter={StaticResource TimeAgo}}" />
226                                                  </FormattedString>
227                                              </Label.FormattedText>
228                                          </Label>
229                                          <Label FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="15" TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" Text="{Binding AmountDisplay}" />
230                                      </VerticalStackLayout>
231                                      <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="2" Spacing="6" VerticalOptions="Center">
232                                          <Border BackgroundColor="{StaticResource DeclineBg}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
233                                                  Padding="14,4" WidthRequest="72">
234                                              <Label Text="Decline" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="10.5" TextColor="{StaticResource DeclineText}"
235                                                     HorizontalOptions="Center" />
236                                              <Border.GestureRecognizers>
237                                                  <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.DeclineCommand}"
238                                                                        CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
239                                              </Border.GestureRecognizers>
240                                          </Border>
241                                          <Border BackgroundColor="{StaticResource ApproveBg}" StrokeThickness="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
242                                                  Padding="14,4" WidthRequest="72">
243                                              <Label Text="Approve" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="10.5" TextColor="{StaticResource ApproveText}"
244                                                     HorizontalOptions="Center" />
245                                              <Border.GestureRecognizers>
246                                                  <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding Source={x:Reference Page}, Path=BindingContext.ApproveCommand}"
247                                                                        CommandParameter="{Binding .}" />
248                                              </Border.GestureRecognizers>
249                                          </Border>
250                                      </VerticalStackLayout>
251                                  </Grid>
252                              </Border>
253                          </DataTemplate>
254                      </BindableLayout.ItemTemplate>
255                  </VerticalStackLayout>
256  
257  
258                  <Button Text="Sign out" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}" Command="{Binding SignOutCommand}" Margin="0,6,0,0" />
259  
260              </VerticalStackLayout>
261          </ScrollView>
262  
263          <controls:BottomNavBar Grid.Row="1" Active="Profile" VerticalOptions="End" />
264  
265          <!-- In-app notifications (posted, won, paid) draw over the page -->
266          <controls:NotificationHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
267          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" />
268      </Grid>
269  
270  </views:AppContentPage>
```

```xml
 1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
 2  <views:AppContentPage
 3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.ProfileSetupPage"
 4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"

23              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="12">

32                      <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
33                          <Entry Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Text="{Binding LastName}" Placeholder="dela Cruz" />
34                      </Border>
35                  </VerticalStackLayout>
36              </Grid>
37  
38              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8">
39                  <Label Text="Program" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" />
40                  <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
41                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
42                          <Picker Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource ShellPicker}" Title="Select your program"
43                                  ItemsSource="{Binding Programs}" SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedProgram}" />
44                          <Path Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}" HeightRequest="14" WidthRequest="14"
45                                Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" InputTransparent="True"
46                                IsVisible="{OnPlatform Default=True, WinUI=False}" />
47                      </Grid>
48                  </Border>
49              </VerticalStackLayout>
50  
51              <Button Text="Save and continue" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}" Margin="0,6,0,0"
52                      Command="{Binding SaveCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
53              <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" />
54  
55          </VerticalStackLayout>
56      </ScrollView>
57  
58          <controls:ToastHost />
59      </Grid>
60  
61  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/RegisterPage.xaml

```xml
  1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
  2  <views:AppContentPage
  3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.RegisterPage"
  4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
  5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
  6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
  7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
  8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
  9      x:DataType="vm:RegisterViewModel"
 10      Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False"
 11      Title="Create an account">
 12  
 13      <Grid>
 14      <ScrollView>
 15          <Grid Padding="26" RowDefinitions="*,Auto,*">
 16  
 17              <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Row="1" Spacing="18" VerticalOptions="Center">
 18  
 19                  <Border HeightRequest="72" WidthRequest="72" StrokeThickness="1" Stroke="#D6DCE6" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 999"
 20                          BackgroundColor="{StaticResource White}" HorizontalOptions="Center">
 21                      <Image Source="nutrade_mark.png" HeightRequest="46" WidthRequest="46" Aspect="AspectFit"
 22                             HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 23                  </Border>
 24  
 25                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
 26                      <Label Text="{Binding StepLabel}" Style="{StaticResource Kicker}" HorizontalOptions="Center" />
 27                      <Label Text="{Binding Heading}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenTitle}" FontSize="26"
 28                             HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
 29                      <Label Text="{Binding Subheading}" Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
 30                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 31  
 32                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="18" Margin="0,10,0,0">
 33                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14">
 34  
 35                          <!-- Step 1: email. Stays visible behind the code modal. -->
 36                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14" IsVisible="{Binding ShowEmailForm}">
 37                              <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
 38                                  <Entry Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Placeholder="Your email address" Text="{Binding Email}"
 39                                     Keyboard="Email" ReturnType="Go" ReturnCommand="{Binding SendCodeCommand}" />
 40                              </Border>
 41                              <Button Text="Send code" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}"
 42                                      Command="{Binding SendCodeCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
 43                          </VerticalStackLayout>
 44  
 45                          <!-- Step 2 lives in the OtpModal at the bottom of this file. -->
 46  
 47                          <!-- Step 3: name and password -->
 48                          <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="14" IsVisible="{Binding IsDetailsStep}">
 49                              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
 50                                  <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="0" Spacing="6">
 51                                      <Label Text="First name" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
 52                                      <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
 53                                          <Entry Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Text="{Binding FirstName}" Placeholder="Juan" ReturnType="Next" />
 54                                      </Border>
 55                                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 56                                  <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="6">
 57                                      <Label Text="Last name" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
 58                                      <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
 59                                          <Entry Style="{StaticResource ShellEntry}" Text="{Binding LastName}" Placeholder="dela Cruz" ReturnType="Next" />
 60                                      </Border>
 61                                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 62                              </Grid>
 63                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
 64                                  <Label Text="Program" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
 65                                  <Border Style="{StaticResource InputShell}">
 66                                      <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
 67                                          <Picker Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource ShellPicker}" Title="Select your program"
 68                                                  ItemsSource="{Binding Programs}" SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedProgram}" />
 69                                          <Path Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}" HeightRequest="14" WidthRequest="14"
 70                                                Fill="{StaticResource InkMuted}" VerticalOptions="Center" InputTransparent="True"
 71                                                IsVisible="{OnPlatform Default=True, WinUI=False}" />
 72                                      </Grid>
 73                                  </Border>
 74                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 75                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
 76                                  <Label Text="Password" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
 77                                  <controls:PasswordField Text="{Binding Password}" Placeholder="At least 8 characters" ReturnType="Next" />
 78                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 79                              <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
 80                                  <Label Text="Confirm password" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabel}" FontSize="14" />
 81                                  <controls:PasswordField Text="{Binding ConfirmPassword}" Placeholder="Type it again"
 82                                                          ReturnType="Go" ReturnCommand="{Binding RegisterCommand}" />
 83                              </VerticalStackLayout>
 84                              <Button Text="Register" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}"
 85                                      Command="{Binding RegisterCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
 86                          </VerticalStackLayout>
 87  
 88                          <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" />
 89  
 90                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 91                  </Border>
 92  
 93                  <Button Text="Back" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}" Command="{Binding BackCommand}" />
 94  
 95              </VerticalStackLayout>
 96          </Grid>
 97      </ScrollView>
 98  
 99          <!-- Step 2: the emailed code, as a modal over the email form. -->
100          <controls:OtpModal IsOpen="{Binding IsCodeStep}" Code="{Binding Code}"
101                             Message="{Binding Subheading}" VerifyText="Verify code"
102                             VerifyCommand="{Binding VerifyCodeCommand}"
103                             ResendCommand="{Binding SendCodeCommand}"
104                             ResendText="{Binding ResendText}" CanResend="{Binding CanResend}"
105                             CloseCommand="{Binding BackCommand}"
106                             IsBusy="{Binding IsBusy}" />
107  
108          <controls:ToastHost />
109      </Grid>
110  
111  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/ReviewListingPage.xaml

```xml
  1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
  2  <views:AppContentPage
  3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.ReviewListingPage"
  4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
  5      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
  6      xmlns:views="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Views"
  7      xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.Controls"
  8      xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:NUTrade1.ViewModels"
  9      x:DataType="vm:ReviewListingViewModel"
 10      Title="Review Listing">
 11  
 12      <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto,*">
 13  
 14          <controls:TopBar Grid.Row="0" />
 15          <controls:BackLink Grid.Row="1" />
 16  
 17          <ScrollView Grid.Row="2">
 18              <VerticalStackLayout Padding="20,0,20,120" Spacing="14">
 19  
 20                  <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="2">
 21                      <Label Text="Review Listing" Style="{StaticResource ScreenTitle}" FontSize="20" />
 22                      <Label Text="Double-check everything before going live" Style="{StaticResource ScreenSubtitle}" />
 23                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 24  
 25                  <!-- The listing as a buyer will see it -->
 26                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="0">
 27                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="0">
 28                          <controls:PhotoCarousel HeightRequest="200" Margin="5,5,5,0" Photos="{Binding Preview.Photos}"
 29                                                  PhotoTappedCommand="{Binding OpenPhotoCommand}" />
 30  
 31                          <VerticalStackLayout Padding="16,14,16,16" Spacing="10">
 32                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="6">
 33                                  <Label FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="12" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}"
 34                                         Text="{Binding Preview.CategoryLabel}" />
 35                                  <Label Text="•" FontSize="12" TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 36                                  <Label FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="12" TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}"
 37                                         Text="{Binding Preview.Condition, Converter={StaticResource EnumDisplay}}" />
 38                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
 39  
 40                              <Label Text="{Binding Preview.Title}" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="18"
 41                                     TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
 42  
 43                              <Label Text="{Binding Preview.Description}" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="13" LineHeight="1.3"
 44                                     TextColor="#3F4A5E" IsVisible="{Binding Preview.Description, Converter={StaticResource HasValue}}" />
 45  
 46                              <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,Auto" ColumnSpacing="28">
 47                                  <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="0" Spacing="1">
 48                                      <Label Text="STARTING BID" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.3"
 49                                             TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 50                                      <Label Text="{Binding StartingBidDisplay}" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="19"
 51                                             TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
 52                                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 53                                  <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="1">
 54                                      <Label Text="BID INCREMENT" FontFamily="InterMedium" FontSize="9.5" CharacterSpacing="0.3"
 55                                             TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 56                                      <Label Text="{Binding IncrementDisplay}" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="19"
 57                                             TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
 58                                  </VerticalStackLayout>
 59                              </Grid>
 60  
 61                              <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="5">
 62                                  <Path Style="{StaticResource IconMapMarker}" HeightRequest="13" WidthRequest="13"
 63                                        Fill="{StaticResource Ink}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 64                                  <Label Text="{Binding Preview.MeetupLabel}" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="11.5"
 65                                         CharacterSpacing="0.3" TextTransform="Uppercase"
 66                                         TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" VerticalOptions="Center" />
 67                              </HorizontalStackLayout>
 68                          </VerticalStackLayout>
 69                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 70                  </Border>
 71  
 72                  <!-- What posting costs, and how it's paid -->
 73                  <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="16">
 74                      <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="12">
 75                          <Label Text="LISTING DETAILS" FontFamily="InterBold" FontSize="11" CharacterSpacing="0.8"
 76                                 TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
 77                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
 78                              <Label Grid.Column="0" Text="Package" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="13"
 79                                     TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 80                              <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding PackageDisplay}" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="13"
 81                                     TextColor="{StaticResource Ink}" />
 82                          </Grid>
 83                          <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
 84                              <Label Grid.Column="0" Text="Payment" FontFamily="InterRegular" FontSize="13"
 85                                     TextColor="{StaticResource InkMuted}" />
 86                              <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding PaymentDisplay}" FontFamily="InterSemiBold" FontSize="13"
 87                                     TextColor="{StaticResource NuGold}" />
 88                          </Grid>
 89                          <Label Text="An admin approves every listing before it goes on the campus feed. The 24-hour auction starts when it's approved."
 90                                 Style="{StaticResource MetaText}" />
 91                      </VerticalStackLayout>
 92                  </Border>
 93  
 94                  <Button Text="Post Listing" Style="{StaticResource GoldButton}" FontSize="15" Margin="0,8,0,0"
 95                          Command="{Binding PostCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
 96                  <Button Text="Edit details" Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}"
 97                          Command="{Binding EditCommand}" IsEnabled="{Binding IsNotBusy}" />
 98                  <controls:LoadingDots IsRunning="{Binding IsBusy}" Caption="Uploading photos…" />
 99              </VerticalStackLayout>
100          </ScrollView>
101  
102          <controls:BottomNavBar Grid.Row="2" Active="Post" VerticalOptions="End" />
103  
104          <controls:NotificationHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="3" />
105          <controls:ToastHost Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="3" />
106      </Grid>
107  
108  </views:AppContentPage>
```

### NUTrade1/Views/VerifyEmailPage.xaml

```xml
 1  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
 2  <views:AppContentPage
 3      x:Class="NUTrade1.Views.VerifyEmailPage"
 4      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
```

## 3. Unit tests (NUTrade1.Tests)

### NUTrade1.Tests/BidDepositTests.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  using Xunit;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.Tests;
 5  
 6  /// <summary>
 7  /// How a deposit reads to the student. The state machine itself is server-side, so what
 8  /// matters here is that the app never tells someone their bid is live when it isn't, and
 9  /// never leaves a resolved deposit looking like it is still waiting.
10  /// </summary>
11  public class BidDepositTests
12  {
13      [Fact]
14      public void A_deposit_awaiting_payment_is_not_a_bid()
15      {
16          var deposit = new BidDeposit { Status = DepositStatus.AwaitingPayment };
17  
18          Assert.True(deposit.IsAwaitingPayment);
19          Assert.False(deposit.IsCommitted);
20          Assert.False(deposit.IsResolved);
21      }
22  
23      [Fact]
24      public void Only_locked_in_escrow_means_the_bid_is_live()
25      {
26          var deposit = new BidDeposit { Status = DepositStatus.LockedInEscrow };
27  
28          Assert.True(deposit.IsCommitted);
29          Assert.False(deposit.IsAwaitingPayment);
30          // Held is not resolved — the auction still has to play out.
31          Assert.False(deposit.IsResolved);
32      }
33  
34      [Theory]
35      [InlineData(DepositStatus.CreditedToSeller)]
36      [InlineData(DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer)]
37      [InlineData(DepositStatus.Forfeited)]
38      [InlineData(DepositStatus.Expired)]
39      public void Every_terminal_state_reports_itself_resolved(DepositStatus status)
40      {
41          var deposit = new BidDeposit { Status = status };
42  
43          Assert.True(deposit.IsResolved);
44          Assert.False(deposit.IsCommitted);
45          Assert.False(deposit.IsAwaitingPayment);
46      }
47  
48      // The reason is what turns "deposit returned" into something a student can act on,
49      // and every reason the Functions can send has to have a phrasing here.
50      [Theory]
51      [InlineData("outbid", "Outbid — deposit returned")]
52      [InlineData("auction_lost", "Auction lost — deposit returned")]
53      [InlineData("seller_cancelled", "Seller cancelled — deposit returned")]
54      [InlineData("withdrawn", "Bid withdrawn — deposit returned")]
55      [InlineData("no_show_dismissed", "Dispute resolved in your favour — deposit returned")]
56      [InlineData(null, "Deposit returned")]
57      [InlineData("something_new", "Deposit returned")]
58      public void A_returned_deposit_explains_why(string? reason, string expected)
59      {
60          var deposit = new BidDeposit { Status = DepositStatus.RefundedToBuyer, RefundReason = reason };
61  
62          Assert.Equal(expected, deposit.StatusDisplay);
63      }
64  
65      [Fact]
66      public void Forfeited_says_plainly_what_happened()
67      {
68          var deposit = new BidDeposit { Status = DepositStatus.Forfeited };
69  
70          Assert.Equal("Deposit forfeited — you didn't show up", deposit.StatusDisplay);
71      }
72  
73      // The deposit and the bid are different numbers and the screen shows both; mixing
74      // them up would have a student scanning for the wrong amount.
75      [Fact]
76      public void The_deposit_and_the_bid_are_reported_separately()
77      {
78          var deposit = new BidDeposit { AmountCentavos = 50_000, DepositCentavos = 7_500 };
79  
80          Assert.Equal("₱500.00", deposit.AmountDisplay);
81          Assert.Equal("₱75.00", deposit.DepositDisplay);
82      }
83  
84      [Fact]
85      public void A_deposit_with_no_qr_image_says_so()
86      {
87          Assert.False(new BidDeposit().HasQrImage);
88          Assert.True(new BidDeposit { QrImageUrl = "https://example.test/qr.png" }.HasQrImage);
89      }
90  }
```

### NUTrade1.Tests/BidEligibilityTests.cs

```csharp
  1  using NUTrade1.Core;
  2  using Xunit;
  3  
  4  namespace NUTrade1.Tests;
  5  
  6  /// <summary>
  7  /// Who may bid. The rule that matters most is the first one: a seller can never bid on
  8  /// their own listing, whatever else is true — it would let them bid their own price up.
  9  /// </summary>
 10  public class BidEligibilityTests
 11  {
 12      private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 9, 24, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
 13  
 14      private static Listing LiveListing(string ownerUid = "seller") => new()
 15      {
 16          Id = "l1",
 17          OwnerUid = ownerUid,
 18          Status = ListingStatus.Active,
 19          AuctionEndsAt = Now.AddHours(3),
 20      };
 21  
 22      [Fact]
 23      public void A_verified_student_may_bid_on_someone_elses_live_auction()
 24      {
 25          Assert.Null(BidEligibility.WhyNot(LiveListing(), "buyer", isVerified: true, Now));
 26      }
 27  
 28      [Fact]
 29      public void The_seller_can_never_bid_on_their_own_listing()
 30      {
 31          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.OwnListing,
 32              BidEligibility.WhyNot(LiveListing("seller"), "seller", isVerified: true, Now));
 33      }
 34  
 35      // Ownership is reported ahead of everything else: telling a seller to verify their
 36      // email, or that the auction ended, would suggest they could bid once that changed.
 37      [Theory]
 38      [InlineData(false, ListingStatus.Active)]
 39      [InlineData(true, ListingStatus.Matched)]
 40      [InlineData(false, ListingStatus.PendingApproval)]
 41      public void Ownership_is_the_reason_given_even_when_other_checks_also_fail(bool verified, ListingStatus status)
 42      {
 43          var listing = LiveListing("seller");
 44          listing.Status = status;
 45  
 46          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.OwnListing, BidEligibility.WhyNot(listing, "seller", verified, Now));
 47      }
 48  
 49      [Fact]
 50      public void Ownership_compares_uids_exactly()
 51      {
 52          // Firebase uids are case-sensitive; a near-miss is a different account.
 53          Assert.Null(BidEligibility.WhyNot(LiveListing("Seller"), "seller", isVerified: true, Now));
 54          Assert.False(BidEligibility.IsSeller(LiveListing("Seller"), "seller"));
 55      }
 56  
 57      [Theory]
 58      [InlineData(null)]
 59      [InlineData("")]
 60      public void A_signed_out_student_is_asked_to_sign_in(string? uid)
 61      {
 62          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.SignedOut, BidEligibility.WhyNot(LiveListing(), uid, isVerified: true, Now));
 63          Assert.False(BidEligibility.IsSeller(LiveListing(""), uid));
 64      }
 65  
 66      [Fact]
 67      public void An_unverified_student_is_asked_to_confirm_their_email()
 68      {
 69          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.Unverified, BidEligibility.WhyNot(LiveListing(), "buyer", isVerified: false, Now));
 70      }
 71  
 72      [Theory]
 73      [InlineData(ListingStatus.Draft)]
 74      [InlineData(ListingStatus.PendingPayment)]
 75      [InlineData(ListingStatus.PendingApproval)]
 76      [InlineData(ListingStatus.Matched)]
 77      [InlineData(ListingStatus.Completed)]
 78      [InlineData(ListingStatus.Expired)]
 79      [InlineData(ListingStatus.Rejected)]
 80      public void Only_an_active_listing_takes_bids(ListingStatus status)
 81      {
 82          var listing = LiveListing();
 83          listing.Status = status;
 84  
 85          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.NotAcceptingBids, BidEligibility.WhyNot(listing, "buyer", isVerified: true, Now));
 86      }
 87  
 88      [Fact]
 89      public void An_auction_past_its_end_time_takes_no_bids_even_before_the_sweep_closes_it()
 90      {
 91          var listing = LiveListing();
 92          listing.AuctionEndsAt = Now;
 93  
 94          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.Ended, BidEligibility.WhyNot(listing, "buyer", isVerified: true, Now));
 95      }
 96  
 97      [Fact]
 98      public void A_listing_that_has_not_loaded_takes_no_bids()
 99      {
100          Assert.Equal(BidEligibility.NotAcceptingBids, BidEligibility.WhyNot(null, "buyer", isVerified: true, Now));
101      }
102  }
```

### NUTrade1.Tests/DomainRuleTests.cs

```csharp
 1  using NUTrade1.Core;
 2  using Xunit;
 3  
 4  namespace NUTrade1.Tests;
 5  
 6  public class DomainRuleTests
 7  {
 8      // Registration is open to any personal email — the campus-domain restriction is gone.
 9      // Ownership of the address is proven by the emailed one-time code, and being a real
10      // NU – Lipa student by the Student ID photo an admin reviews. So all this needs to
11      // catch is a malformed address before the sign-up request leaves the device.
12      [Theory]
13      [InlineData("juan.delacruz@nu-lipa.edu.ph", true)]
14      [InlineData("JUAN.DELACRUZ@NU-LIPA.EDU.PH", true)]
15      [InlineData("  maria@nu-lipa.edu.ph  ", true)]
16      [InlineData("someone@gmail.com", true)]
17      [InlineData("student@yahoo.com.ph", true)]
18      [InlineData("no-at-sign.com", false)]
19      [InlineData("two@at@signs.com", false)]
20      [InlineData("@nodomain.com", false)]
21      [InlineData("missing@tld", false)]
22      [InlineData("trailing@dot.", false)]
23      [InlineData("has space@mail.com", false)]
24      [InlineData("", false)]
25      [InlineData(null, false)]
26      public void IsValidEmail_accepts_any_well_formed_address(string? email, bool expected)
27      {
28          Assert.Equal(expected, NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail(email));
29      }
30  
31      [Theory]
32      [InlineData(ListingPackage.Free, 0)]
33      [InlineData(ListingPackage.Additional, 1000)]
34      [InlineData(ListingPackage.Priority, 2000)]
```

### functions/src/adminActions.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, onRequest, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import { defineSecret } from "firebase-functions/params";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import * as crypto from "crypto";
  5  import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";
  6  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  7  import { db } from "./admin";
  8  import { REGION } from "./constants";
  9  
 10  export const adminBootstrapSecret = defineSecret("ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET");
 11  
 12  /** Constant-time compare so the bootstrap secret can't be recovered by timing the endpoint. */
 13  function secretMatches(supplied: string, expected: string): boolean {
 14    const a = Buffer.from(supplied, "utf8");
 15    const b = Buffer.from(expected, "utf8");
 16    if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
 17    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b);
 18  }
 19  
 20  /**
 21   * Chicken-and-egg breaker: `setUserVerification` is admin-only, but nothing can mint
 22   * the first admin from inside the app. This endpoint promotes one account to admin,
 23   * authorised by a Secret Manager value rather than by a claim.
 24   *
 25   * Operational, not a product feature — it stays deployed only as long as you need it,
 26   * and the secret should be rotated (or the function deleted) once the real admin
 27   * portal owns this. See docs/architecture-and-security.md §2.B.
 28   */
 29  export const bootstrapAdmin = onRequest(
 30    { secrets: [adminBootstrapSecret], region: REGION },
 31    async (req, res) => {
 32      const supplied = req.header("X-Bootstrap-Secret");
 33      if (!supplied || !secretMatches(supplied, adminBootstrapSecret.value())) {
 34        logger.warn("bootstrapAdmin: bad secret");
 35        res.status(401).send("Unauthorized.");
 36        return;
 37      }
 38  
 39      const email = (req.body?.email as string | undefined)?.trim();
 40      if (!email) {
 41        res.status(400).send("Body must be JSON with an `email` field.");
 42        return;
 43      }
 44  
 45      try {
 46        const user = await getAuth().getUserByEmail(email);
 47        await getAuth().setCustomUserClaims(user.uid, { role: "admin", verified: true });
 48        await db.collection("users").doc(user.uid).set(
 49          { role: "admin", verificationStatus: "verified", verifiedAt: Timestamp.now() },
 50          { merge: true }
 51        );
 52        logger.info("bootstrapAdmin: promoted", { uid: user.uid, email });
 53        res.status(200).json({ uid: user.uid, email, role: "admin", verified: true });
 54      } catch (err) {
 55        logger.error("bootstrapAdmin: failed", { email, err });
 56        res.status(404).send("No account with that email.");
 57      }
 58    }
 59  );
 60  
 61  /**
 62   * The decision the admin portal's ID-review queue makes: after eyeballing the
 63   * uploaded Student ID photo, flip the account's `verified` custom claim. Only a
 64   * verified account can create a listing or place a bid (see firestore.rules and
 65   * the guards in placeBid / createQrPayment).
 66   */
 67  export const setUserVerification = onCall(
 68    { region: REGION },
 69    async (request) => {
 70      const auth = request.auth;
 71      if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 72      if (auth.token.role !== "admin") {
 73        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Admins only.");
 74      }
 75  
 76      const { uid, verified, reason } = (request.data ?? {}) as {
 77        uid?: string;
 78        verified?: boolean;
 79        reason?: string;
 80      };
 81      if (!uid || typeof verified !== "boolean") {
 82        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "uid and a boolean `verified` are required.");
 83      }
 84  
 85      const existing = (await getAuth().getUser(uid)).customClaims ?? {};
 86      await getAuth().setCustomUserClaims(uid, { ...existing, verified });
 87      await db.collection("users").doc(uid).set(
 88        {
 89          verificationStatus: verified ? "verified" : "rejected",
 90          verificationReason: reason ?? null,
 91          verifiedAt: verified ? Timestamp.now() : null,
 92          reviewedBy: auth.uid,
 93        },
 94        { merge: true }
 95      );
 96  
 97      logger.info("setUserVerification", { uid, verified, reviewedBy: auth.uid });
 98      return { uid, verified };
 99    }
100  );
```

### functions/src/bidActions.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError, CallableRequest } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  3  import { db } from "./admin";
  4  import { BID_STATUS, LISTING_STATUS, REFUND_REASON, REGION } from "./constants";
  5  import { awardListing, recomputeTopBid } from "./matching";
  6  import { readDepositForBid, resolveDeposit } from "./depositResolution";
  7  
  8  interface BidActionData {
  9    listingId: string;
 10    bidId: string;
 11  }
 12  
 13  function readArgs(request: CallableRequest): { uid: string; listingId: string; bidId: string } {
 14    const auth = request.auth;
 15    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 16  
 17    const { listingId, bidId } = (request.data ?? {}) as Partial<BidActionData>;
 18    if (!listingId || !bidId) {
 19      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "listingId and bidId are required.");
 20    }
 21    return { uid: auth.uid, listingId, bidId };
 22  }
 23  
 24  /**
 25   * Seller accepts a bid and ends the auction early. The bid does not have to be the
 26   * top one — a seller may prefer a slightly lower bid from someone they can actually
 27   * meet — but it must still be live.
 28   */
 29  export const approveBid = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 30    const { uid, listingId, bidId } = readArgs(request);
 31    const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(listingId);
 32    const bidRef = listingRef.collection("bids").doc(bidId);
 33  
 34    const awarded = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 35      const [listingSnap, bidSnap] = await tx.getAll(listingRef, bidRef);
 36      if (!listingSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
 37      if (!bidSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Bid not found.");
 38  
 39      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
 40      const bid = bidSnap.data()!;
 41  
 42      if (listing.ownerUid !== uid) {
 43        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Only the seller can approve a bid.");
 44      }
 45      if (listing.status !== LISTING_STATUS.active) {
 46        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This auction is no longer running.");
 47      }
 48      if (bid.status !== BID_STATUS.pending && bid.status !== BID_STATUS.outbid) {
 49        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "That bid is no longer live.");
 50      }
 51  
 52      // Read before writing: approving one bid ends the auction for all the others, and
 53      // their deposits have to be returned here or they stay in escrow forever.
 54      const others = await tx.get(listingRef.collection("bids"));
 55      const losing: Array<{ ref: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentReference; data: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData }> = [];
 56      for (const doc of others.docs) {
 57        if (doc.id === bidId) continue;
 58        if (doc.data().status !== BID_STATUS.pending && doc.data().status !== BID_STATUS.outbid) continue;
 59        const held = await readDepositForBid(tx, doc.data());
 60        if (held) losing.push(held);
 61      }
 62  
 63      const approvedAt = Timestamp.now();
 64      for (const doc of others.docs) {
 65        if (doc.id === bidId) continue;
 66        if (doc.data().status !== BID_STATUS.pending && doc.data().status !== BID_STATUS.outbid) continue;
 67        tx.update(doc.ref, { status: BID_STATUS.declined, declinedAt: approvedAt });
 68      }
 69      for (const held of losing) {
 70        resolveDeposit(tx, held.ref, held.data, "refunded_to_buyer", { reason: REFUND_REASON.auctionLost });
 71      }
 72  
 73      return awardListing(tx, listingRef, listing, bidSnap, approvedAt);
 74    });
 75  
 76    return awarded;
 77  });
 78  
 79  /** Seller rejects one bid; the auction carries on with the next-highest promoted back to the top. */
 80  export const declineBid = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 81    const { uid, listingId, bidId } = readArgs(request);
 82    const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(listingId);
 83    const bidRef = listingRef.collection("bids").doc(bidId);
 84  
 85    await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 86      const [listingSnap, bidSnap] = await tx.getAll(listingRef, bidRef);
 87      if (!listingSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
 88      if (!bidSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Bid not found.");
 89  
 90      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
 91      const bid = bidSnap.data()!;
 92  
 93      if (listing.ownerUid !== uid) {
 94        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Only the seller can decline a bid.");
 95      }
 96      if (bid.status !== BID_STATUS.pending && bid.status !== BID_STATUS.outbid) {
 97        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "That bid is no longer live.");
 98      }
 99  
100      const held = await readDepositForBid(tx, bid);
101  
102      const now = Timestamp.now();
103      await recomputeTopBid(tx, listingRef, listing, now, bidId);
104      tx.update(bidRef, { status: BID_STATUS.declined, declinedAt: now });
105      if (held) {
106        resolveDeposit(tx, held.ref, held.data, "refunded_to_buyer", {
107          reason: REFUND_REASON.sellerCancelled,
108          note: "Bid declined — deposit returned",
109        });
110      }
111    });
112  
113    return { ok: true };
114  });
115  
116  /** Bidder pulls their own bid before the seller acts on it. */
117  export const withdrawBid = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
118    const { uid, listingId, bidId } = readArgs(request);
119    const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(listingId);
120    const bidRef = listingRef.collection("bids").doc(bidId);
121  
122    await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
123      const [listingSnap, bidSnap] = await tx.getAll(listingRef, bidRef);
124      if (!listingSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
125      if (!bidSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Bid not found.");
126  
127      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
128      const bid = bidSnap.data()!;
129  
130      if (bid.bidderUid !== uid) {
131        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "You can only withdraw your own bid.");
132      }
133      if (bid.status !== BID_STATUS.pending && bid.status !== BID_STATUS.outbid) {
134        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "That bid can no longer be withdrawn.");
135      }
136      if (listing.status !== LISTING_STATUS.active) {
137        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This auction has already closed.");
138      }
139  
140      const held = await readDepositForBid(tx, bid);
141  
142      const now = Timestamp.now();
143      await recomputeTopBid(tx, listingRef, listing, now, bidId);
144      tx.update(bidRef, { status: BID_STATUS.withdrawn, withdrawnAt: now });
145      if (held) {
146        resolveDeposit(tx, held.ref, held.data, "refunded_to_buyer", {
147          reason: "withdrawn",
148          note: "Bid withdrawn — deposit returned",
149        });
150      }
151    });
152  
153    return { ok: true };
154  });
```

### functions/src/brevo.ts

```typescript
 1  import { HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
 2  import { defineSecret } from "firebase-functions/params";
 3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
 4  import { brevoSender } from "./constants";
 5  
 6  /**
 7   * Every email NUTrade sends — verification codes and password-reset codes — goes out
 8   * through Brevo's transactional API.
 9   *
10   * Brevo replaced Gmail SMTP: an App Password on a personal Gmail account caps out around
11   * 500 messages a day, sends as that account's own address, and offers no delivery log to
12   * look at when a student swears no code arrived. Brevo sends from our own validated
13   * sender, allows far more, and shows every message in its dashboard.
14   *
15   * The API is one POST, so there is no SDK here — Node 20 has global `fetch`, and a
16   * dependency for a single endpoint is a dependency to keep patched for nothing.
17   */
18  export const brevoApiKey = defineSecret("BREVO_API_KEY");
19  
20  /** For the `secrets:` list of every function that mails a code. */
21  export const mailSecrets = [brevoApiKey];
22  
23  const BREVO_ENDPOINT = "https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email";
24  
25  /** Brevo is normally well under a second; past this the student is better off retrying. */
26  const SEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
27  
28  export interface MailMessage {
29    subject: string;
30    text: string;
31    html: string;
32  }
33  
34  /**
35   * Hands one message to Brevo. Throws an `HttpsError` the caller can surface
36   * as-is — the address belongs to the student, so a rejection is almost always ours (an
37   * unvalidated sender, a revoked key, or the plan's daily cap).
38   */
39  export async function sendMail(to: string, message: MailMessage): Promise<void> {
40    const key = brevoApiKey.value();
41    if (!key || key.startsWith("REPLACE_ME")) {
42      throw new HttpsError(
43        "failed-precondition",
44        "Email delivery isn't configured yet. Set the BREVO_API_KEY secret."
45      );
46    }
47  
48    const sender = brevoSender();
49    if (!sender) {
50      throw new HttpsError(
51        "failed-precondition",
52        "Email delivery isn't configured yet. Set BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL in functions/.env."
53      );
54    }
55  
56    let response: Response;
57    try {
58      response = await fetch(BREVO_ENDPOINT, {
59        method: "POST",
60        headers: {
61          "api-key": key,
62          "content-type": "application/json",
63          accept: "application/json",
64        },
65        body: JSON.stringify({
66          sender,
67          to: [{ email: to }],
68          subject: message.subject,
69          textContent: message.text,
70          htmlContent: message.html,
71        }),
72        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(SEND_TIMEOUT_MS),
73      });
74    } catch (err) {
75      logger.error("Brevo was unreachable", { err });
76      throw new HttpsError("unavailable", "Could not send the code. Try again in a moment.");
77    }
78  
79    if (response.ok) return;
80  
81    // Brevo answers a rejection with {"code": "...", "message": "..."} — worth logging in
82    // full, because `invalid_parameter` on the sender and an expired key read identically
83    // from the app's side.
84    const body = await response.text().catch(() => "");
85    logger.error("Brevo rejected the email", {
86      status: response.status,
87      body: body.slice(0, 500),
88      sender: sender.email,
89    });
90  
91    if (response.status === 401) {
92      throw new HttpsError(
93        "failed-precondition",
94        "Email delivery isn't configured correctly. The BREVO_API_KEY secret was rejected."
95      );
96    }
97    throw new HttpsError("internal", "Could not send the code. Try again in a moment.");
98  }
```

### functions/src/chat.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import { onDocumentCreated } from "firebase-functions/v2/firestore";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import { FieldValue, Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  5  import { db } from "./admin";
  6  import { readDepositForBid, resolveDeposit } from "./depositResolution";
  7  import { LISTING_STATUS, REGION } from "./constants";
  8  
  9  /**
 10   * Keeps `chats/{chatId}.lastMessage` / `lastMessageAt` current for the chat-list
 11   * preview row. The chat document itself is server-only in firestore.rules, so the
 12   * client writing its own message can't maintain this — a trigger does it instead.
 13   */
 14  export const onChatMessageCreated = onDocumentCreated(
 15    { document: "chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}", region: REGION },
 16    async (event) => {
 17      const message = event.data?.data();
 18      if (!message) return;
 19  
 20      await db.collection("chats").doc(event.params.chatId).update({
 21        lastMessage: (message.text as string) ?? "",
 22        lastMessageAt: (message.sentAt as Timestamp) ?? Timestamp.now(),
 23      });
 24    }
 25  );
 26  
 27  /**
 28   * One participant confirms the handover happened. The trade only closes out when
 29   * both sides have — a single tap from the buyer must not be able to credit the
 30   * seller with a completed trade that never took place.
 31   */
 32  export const markTradeCompleted = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 33    const auth = request.auth;
 34    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 35  
 36    const { chatId } = (request.data ?? {}) as { chatId?: string };
 37    if (!chatId) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "chatId is required.");
 38  
 39    const chatRef = db.collection("chats").doc(chatId);
 40  
 41    const result = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 42      const chatSnap = await tx.get(chatRef);
 43      if (!chatSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Chat not found.");
 44      const chat = chatSnap.data()!;
 45  
 46      const participants = (chat.participantUids as string[]) ?? [];
 47      if (!participants.includes(auth.uid)) {
 48        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "You're not in this chat.");
 49      }
 50  
 51      // Read the winning bid's deposit now: Firestore forbids a read after a write, and
 52      // the both-confirmed branch below has to resolve it.
 53      const winningBidId = chat.winningBidId as string | undefined;
 54      let deposit: { ref: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentReference; data: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData } | null = null;
 55      if (winningBidId) {
 56        const bidRef = db
 57          .collection("listings")
 58          .doc(chat.listingId as string)
 59          .collection("bids")
 60          .doc(winningBidId);
 61        const bidSnap = await tx.get(bidRef);
 62        if (bidSnap.exists) deposit = await readDepositForBid(tx, bidSnap.data()!);
 63      }
 64  
 65      const completedBy = new Set<string>((chat.completedBy as string[]) ?? []);
 66      if (completedBy.has(auth.uid)) {
 67        return { bothConfirmed: chat.status === "archived", alreadyConfirmed: true };
 68      }
 69      completedBy.add(auth.uid);
 70  
 71      const now = Timestamp.now();
 72      const bothConfirmed = participants.every((uid) => completedBy.has(uid));
 73  
 74      if (!bothConfirmed) {
 75        tx.update(chatRef, { completedBy: [...completedBy] });
 76        tx.set(chatRef.collection("messages").doc(), {
 77          senderUid: "system",
 78          text: "One side marked this trade completed. Waiting on the other.",
 79          type: "system",
 80          sentAt: now,
 81        });
 82        return { bothConfirmed: false, alreadyConfirmed: false };
 83      }
 84  
 85      const sellerUid = chat.sellerUid as string;
 86      const buyerUid = chat.buyerUid as string;
 87  
 88      // The handshake is what releases the money: the buyer's commitment deposit becomes
 89      // the seller's balance, and the rest of the price changed hands in person.
 90      if (deposit) {
 91        resolveDeposit(tx, deposit.ref, deposit.data, "credited_to_seller");
 92      }
 93  
 94      tx.update(chatRef, { completedBy: [...completedBy], status: "archived", completedAt: now });
 95      tx.update(db.collection("listings").doc(chat.listingId as string), {
 96        status: LISTING_STATUS.completed,
 97        completedAt: now,
 98      });
 99      tx.set(db.collection("trades").doc(), {
100        chatId,
101        listingId: chat.listingId,
102        listingTitle: chat.listingTitle ?? "",
103        sellerUid,
104        buyerUid,
105        participantUids: participants,
106        amountCentavos: chat.winningBidCentavos ?? 0,
107        completedAt: now,
108      });
109      for (const uid of [sellerUid, buyerUid]) {
110        tx.update(db.collection("users").doc(uid), {
111          tradesCompleted: FieldValue.increment(1),
112        });
113      }
114      tx.set(chatRef.collection("messages").doc(), {
115        senderUid: "system",
116        text: "Trade completed. Thanks for keeping it on campus!",
117        type: "system",
118        sentAt: now,
119      });
120  
121      return { bothConfirmed: true, alreadyConfirmed: false };
122    });
123  
124    logger.info("markTradeCompleted", { chatId, uid: auth.uid, ...result });
125    return result;
126  });
```

### functions/src/closeExpiredAuctions.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onSchedule } from "firebase-functions/v2/scheduler";
  2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  3  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  4  import { db } from "./admin";
  5  import { BID_STATUS, LISTING_STATUS, REFUND_REASON, REGION } from "./constants";
  6  import { awardListing } from "./matching";
  7  import { readDepositForBid, resolveDeposit } from "./depositResolution";
  8  
  9  /** Bids still in the running when the hammer falls. */
 10  const LIVE_BID_STATUSES = [BID_STATUS.pending, BID_STATUS.outbid];
 11  
 12  /**
 13   * The hammer. Every 5 minutes, sweeps auctions whose `auctionEndsAt` has passed
 14   * and settles each one: the highest live bid that clears any reserve wins and gets
 15   * a chat room; anything else (no bids, or a reserve nobody met) goes to `expired`.
 16   *
 17   * Deliberately server-side and time-driven — the client's `IDispatcherTimer`
 18   * countdown is cosmetic, and an app that is closed or asleep must not be able to
 19   * hold an auction open.
 20   */
 21  export const closeExpiredAuctions = onSchedule(
 22    { schedule: "every 5 minutes", region: REGION },
 23    async () => {
 24      const now = Timestamp.now();
 25  
 26      const dueSnap = await db
 27        .collection("listings")
 28        .where("status", "==", LISTING_STATUS.active)
 29        .where("auctionEndsAt", "<=", now)
 30        .limit(200)
 31        .get();
 32  
 33      if (dueSnap.empty) return;
 34      logger.info("closeExpiredAuctions: settling auctions", { count: dueSnap.size });
 35  
 36      let matched = 0;
 37      let expired = 0;
 38  
 39      for (const dueDoc of dueSnap.docs) {
 40        const listingRef = dueDoc.ref;
 41        try {
 42          const outcome = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 43            const listingSnap = await tx.get(listingRef);
 44            if (!listingSnap.exists) return "skipped";
 45            const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
 46  
 47            // Re-check inside the transaction: a seller may have approved a bid
 48            // manually between the sweep query and now.
 49            if (listing.status !== LISTING_STATUS.active) return "skipped";
 50            const endsAt = listing.auctionEndsAt as Timestamp | undefined;
 51            if (!endsAt || endsAt.toMillis() > now.toMillis()) return "skipped";
 52  
 53            const bidsSnap = await tx.get(listingRef.collection("bids"));
 54            const live = bidsSnap.docs
 55              .filter((d) => LIVE_BID_STATUSES.includes(d.data().status))
```
