```typescript
 56              .sort((a, b) => (b.data().amountCentavos as number) - (a.data().amountCentavos as number));
 57  
 58            // Every deposit still held on this auction, read before anything is written —
 59            // Firestore forbids a read after a write inside a transaction.
 60            const deposits = new Map<string, { ref: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentReference; data: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData }>();
 61            for (const doc of live) {
 62              const held = await readDepositForBid(tx, doc.data());
 63              if (held) deposits.set(doc.id, held);
 64            }
 65  
 66            const settledAt = Timestamp.now();
 67            const reserve = listing.reservePriceCentavos as number | null | undefined;
 68            const top = live[0];
 69  
 70            /** Hands a losing bidder their commitment deposit back. */
 71            const returnDeposit = (bidId: string) => {
 72              const held = deposits.get(bidId);
 73              if (held) {
 74                resolveDeposit(tx, held.ref, held.data, "refunded_to_buyer", {
 75                  reason: REFUND_REASON.auctionLost,
 76                });
 77              }
 78            };
 79  
 80            if (!top) {
 81              tx.update(listingRef, {
 82                status: LISTING_STATUS.expired,
 83                expiredAt: settledAt,
 84                expiredReason: "no_bids",
 85              });
 86              return "expired";
 87            }
 88  
 89            if (typeof reserve === "number" && (top.data().amountCentavos as number) < reserve) {
 90              tx.update(listingRef, {
 91                status: LISTING_STATUS.expired,
 92                expiredAt: settledAt,
 93                expiredReason: "reserve_not_met",
 94              });
 95              // Nobody met the reserve, so nobody won and every deposit goes back — the
 96              // top bidder's included.
 97              for (const doc of live) {
 98                tx.update(doc.ref, { status: BID_STATUS.declined, declinedAt: settledAt });
 99                returnDeposit(doc.id);
100              }
101              return "expired";
102            }
103  
104            // Losers first, then the winner — awardListing only writes. Without this every
105            // losing deposit would sit in escrow forever.
106            for (const doc of live.slice(1)) {
107              tx.update(doc.ref, { status: BID_STATUS.declined, declinedAt: settledAt });
108              returnDeposit(doc.id);
109            }
110            awardListing(tx, listingRef, listing, top, settledAt);
111            return "matched";
112          });
113  
114          if (outcome === "matched") matched++;
115          else if (outcome === "expired") expired++;
116        } catch (err) {
117          // One bad auction must not abort the sweep; the next run picks it up again.
118          logger.error("closeExpiredAuctions: failed to settle listing", {
119            listingId: listingRef.id,
120            err,
121          });
122        }
123      }
124  
125      logger.info("closeExpiredAuctions: done", { matched, expired });
126    }
127  );
```

### functions/src/constants.ts

```typescript
  1  /**
  2   * Cross-cutting constants shared with the client. Keep these in sync with
  3   * NUTrade1.Core/NUTradeConstants.cs and NUTrade1.Core/Enums/ListingPackage.cs —
  4   * there is intentionally no shared package between the .NET client and this
  5   * Node backend, so a change to pricing/enum members must be mirrored by hand.
  6   */
  7  
  8  import { randomInt } from "crypto";
  9  
 10  export type ListingPackage = "Free" | "Additional" | "Priority";
 11  
 12  /** Posting fee for every listing after a student's free first one, in centavos (₱10.00). */
 13  export const ADDITIONAL_FEE_CENTAVOS = 1_000;
 14  
 15  /** Featured Priority Pin upgrade fee, in centavos (₱20.00). */
 16  export const PRIORITY_FEE_CENTAVOS = 2_000;
 17  
 18  /** PayMongo QR Ph codes expire this many seconds after creation. */
 19  export const QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS = 600;
 20  
 21  export function feeForPackage(pkg: ListingPackage): number {
 22    switch (pkg) {
 23      case "Free":
 24        return 0;
 25      case "Additional":
 26        return ADDITIONAL_FEE_CENTAVOS;
 27      case "Priority":
 28        return PRIORITY_FEE_CENTAVOS;
 29      default:
 30        throw new Error(`Unknown listing package: ${pkg}`);
 31    }
 32  }
 33  
 34  /** Every function in this codebase deploys to the same Manila-adjacent region. */
 35  export const REGION = "asia-southeast1";
 36  
 37  /** Firestore string values for ListingStatus / BidStatus, mirrored from the .NET enums. */
 38  export const LISTING_STATUS = {
 39    draft: "draft",
 40    pendingPayment: "pending_payment",
 41    /** Paid (or free) and waiting on an admin before it may go live. */
 42    pendingApproval: "pending_approval",
 43    active: "active",
 44    matched: "matched",
 45    /** Won, but the two of them still have to meet and hand the item over. */
 46    pendingMeetup: "pending_meetup",
 47    completed: "completed",
 48    expired: "expired",
 49    cancelled: "cancelled",
 50    /** An admin turned it down. Terminal; `rejectionReason` says why. */
 51    rejected: "rejected",
 52  } as const;
 53  
 54  /**
 55   * The Free package is a student's first listing — once, ever. A listing has used it as
 56   * soon as it was submitted and not turned down: waiting for approval, live, or finished
 57   * in any way. A rejected listing gives the free post back, so a student whose first
 58   * attempt was refused can fix it and try again for free. Drafts and unpaid listings
 59   * never count.
 60   *
 61   * Mirrored by NUTradeConstants.UsesFreePost in NUTrade1.Core — the app hides the Free
 62   * option with the same rule, and createQrPayment enforces it.
 63   */
 64  export const FREE_POST_USED_STATUSES: string[] = [
 65    LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval,
 66    LISTING_STATUS.active,
 67    LISTING_STATUS.matched,
 68    LISTING_STATUS.completed,
 69    LISTING_STATUS.expired,
 70  ];
 71  
 72  export const BID_STATUS = {
 73    pending: "pending",
 74    approved: "approved",
 75    declined: "declined",
 76    outbid: "outbid",
 77    withdrawn: "withdrawn",
 78  } as const;
 79  
 80  // ---- Orders -----------------------------------------------------------------
 81  // What a won auction turns into: the winning bidder owes the seller the bid amount.
 82  // Mirrored by NUTrade1.Core/Enums/OrderStatus.cs (FirestoreOrderService maps the spellings).
 83  
 84  export const ORDER_STATUS = {
 85    /** Seller approved the bid; the buyer's payment window is running. */
 86    awaitingPayment: "awaiting_payment",
 87    /** Confirmed by PayMongo's signed webhook — never by either student. */
 88    paid: "paid",
 89    /** The window closed unpaid; the bid was struck out and the auction reopened. */
 90    released: "released",
 91    cancelled: "cancelled",
 92  } as const;
 93  
 94  /** How long the winning bidder has to pay before the bid is released. */
 95  export const ORDER_PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS = 24;
 96  
 97  /** No 0/O or 1/I, so a reference read aloud at a meetup can't be misheard. */
 98  const ORDER_REFERENCE_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
 99  
100  /** A short, human-friendly order reference such as `NUT-7K2QXM`. */
101  export function orderReference(): string {
102    let suffix = "";
103    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
104      suffix += ORDER_REFERENCE_ALPHABET[randomInt(ORDER_REFERENCE_ALPHABET.length)];
105    }
106    return `NUT-${suffix}`;
107  }
108  
109  // ---- Email one-time codes ---------------------------------------------------
110  // Registration is deliberately light: any email, a 6-digit code to prove the
111  // student owns it, and that is the whole gate. There is no Student ID review in
112  // the signup path — see docs/architecture-and-security.md and the note in
113  // verifyEmailOtp about what this trades away.
114  
115  /** How long a code stays usable. */
116  export const OTP_TTL_MINUTES = 10;
117  
118  /** Wrong guesses before the challenge is burned and a new code is required. */
119  export const OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
120  
121  /** Minimum gap between sends, so the endpoint can't be used to mail-bomb someone. */
122  export const OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60;
123  
124  /**
125   * Total codes one address may be mailed per window, across registration, verification and
126   * password reset. The cooldown above caps the rate; this caps the total, which is what
127   * stops a script parked on one address at a code a minute.
128   *
129   * Five is generous for the honest case — a student who mistypes their address, fixes it
130   * and still needs a resend or two — and cheap for everyone else.
131   */
132  export const OTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_WINDOW = 5;
133  export const OTP_SEND_WINDOW_MINUTES = 60;
134  
135  /** How long a password-reset code stays usable. */
136  export const PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES = 10;
137  
138  /** How long a proven reset code stays spendable for actually setting the new password. */
139  export const PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES = 15;
140  
141  /**
142   * Sender on every NUTrade email, in the shape Brevo's API wants.
143   *
144   * Brevo will only send from an address it has validated — a verified sender, or any
145   * address on an authenticated domain — so there is no sensible default to fall back to:
146   * a guess would fail every send with `invalid_parameter`. Returns null when unset, and
147   * the mailer turns that into a message naming the variable to set.
148   */
149  export function brevoSender(): { name: string; email: string } | null {
150    const email = process.env.BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL?.trim();
151    if (!email) return null;
152    return { name: process.env.BREVO_SENDER_NAME?.trim() || "NUTrade", email };
153  }
154  
155  // ---- Auctions ---------------------------------------------------------------
156  /**
157   * Every auction runs the same length. The create form no longer asks — the
158   * prototype dropped the 24/48/72 picker — so this is the single source of truth.
159   */
160  export const AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS = 24;
161  
162  /**
163   * Photos per listing, per the "Add up to 4 photos" dropzone. Only the app enforces it;
164   * mirrored by NUTradeConstants.MaxListingPhotos.
165   */
166  export const MAX_LISTING_PHOTOS = 4;
167  
168  // ---- Feed visibility --------------------------------------------------------
169  /**
170   * "New regular listings join after the hourly refresh. Priority listings appear
171   * immediately." Free and Additional listings are published with `isVisible: false`
172   * and a `visibleFrom` set to the next top of the hour; publishScheduledListings
173   * flips them. Priority skips the queue, which is most of what the fee buys.
174   *
175   * The feed filters on `isVisible == true` rather than on a `visibleFrom <= now`
176   * inequality on purpose: Firestore would force that inequality to be the first
177   * orderBy, which would break the pinned-first ordering.
178   */
179  export function nextHourlyRefresh(fromMillis: number): number {
180    const next = new Date(fromMillis);
181    next.setUTCMinutes(0, 0, 0);
182    next.setUTCHours(next.getUTCHours() + 1);
183    return next.getTime();
184  }
185  
186  /** A no-show report waiting on an admin. Only an admin can forfeit a deposit. */
187  export const DISPUTE_STATUS = {
188    open: "open",
189    resolved: "resolved",
190  } as const;
191  
192  // ---- Wallet payouts ---------------------------------------------------------
193  /**
194   * Below this, a payout costs more in admin time than it moves. Students accumulate
195   * rather than draining a balance twenty pesos at a time.
196   */
197  export const MIN_PAYOUT_CENTAVOS = 10_000;
198  
199  export const PAYOUT_STATUS = {
200    /** Student asked; the balance is already held back so it cannot be spent twice. */
201    requested: "requested",
202    /** An admin sent the money off-platform and said so. */
203    paid: "paid",
204    /** An admin refused it; the held balance goes back. */
205    declined: "declined",
206  } as const;
207  
208  /** The programs a student picks from at registration. Mirrored by NUTradeConstants.Programs. */
209  export const PROGRAMS = ["SACE", "SAHS", "SABM", "SHS"] as const;
210  
211  /** Where an admin is to send the money. The app only ever stores what the student typed. */
212  export const PAYOUT_METHODS = ["gcash", "maya"] as const;
213  export type PayoutMethod = (typeof PAYOUT_METHODS)[number];
214  
215  // ---- Bid commitment deposit -------------------------------------------------
216  /**
217   * Anti-ghosting: a bid is not live until the bidder has put money behind it.
218   *
219   * THE ONE KNOB. The deposit is this percentage of the bid, and it is **REFUNDABLE** —
220   * superseding the earlier non-refundable design (decided 2026-09-24). A deposit only
221   * ever ends in one of three places, and the student must be told which before they pay:
222   *
223   *   - handover confirmed  -> credited to the seller's wallet
224   *   - seller cancels      -> returned to the buyer
225   *   - outbid or lost      -> returned to the buyer
226   *
227   * So the deposit is a commitment, not a fee: the only way to lose it is to be the
228   * winning bidder and then fail to turn up.
229   *
230   * Set to the bottom of the agreed 15–20% band. Change this single value to move within
231   * it, or set DEPOSIT_IS_PERCENTAGE to false to charge FLAT_DEPOSIT_CENTAVOS instead.
232   */
233  export const BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT = 15;
234  
235  /** Used instead of the percentage when DEPOSIT_IS_PERCENTAGE is false. */
236  export const FLAT_DEPOSIT_CENTAVOS = 2_000;
237  export const DEPOSIT_IS_PERCENTAGE = true;
238  
239  /**
240   * Deposit owed for a bid of this size, in centavos, rounded up to the peso so students
241   * are never asked to scan a QR for an amount with stray centavos.
242   */
243  export function depositFor(bidAmountCentavos: number): number {
244    const raw = DEPOSIT_IS_PERCENTAGE
245      ? (bidAmountCentavos * BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT) / 100
246      : FLAT_DEPOSIT_CENTAVOS;
247    return Math.ceil(raw / 100) * 100;
248  }
249  
250  /**
251   * The life of one deposit. Every transition is written to the ledger, so a dispute can
252   * be settled by reading the entries rather than by argument.
253   *
254   * Note what "escrow" does and does not mean here. QR Ph captures immediately
255   * (`capture_type: "automatic"`), so the money genuinely leaves the student's wallet and
256   * sits in the NUTrade merchant account — there is no authorisation hold to release. The
257   * escrow is ours, in Firestore, and a return is a real refund or an in-app credit.
258   */
259  export const DEPOSIT_STATUS = {
260    /** QR issued, waiting on PayMongo to say the money landed. */
261    awaitingPayment: "awaiting_payment",
262    /** Paid and held against this bid. The bid it was raised for is live. */
263    lockedInEscrow: "locked_in_escrow",
264    /** Handover confirmed by both sides; the amount moved to the seller's wallet. */
265    creditedToSeller: "credited_to_seller",
266    /** Returned to the buyer — seller cancelled, or the bid was outbid or lost. */
267    refundedToBuyer: "refunded_to_buyer",
268    /** The winning bidder never turned up. The only path where the deposit is kept. */
269    forfeited: "forfeited",
270    /** The QR lapsed before payment, so the bid it was holding never went live. */
271    expired: "expired",
272  } as const;
273  
274  export type DepositStatus = (typeof DEPOSIT_STATUS)[keyof typeof DEPOSIT_STATUS];
275  
276  /** Why a deposit went back, which decides whether it is refunded or merely credited. */
277  export const REFUND_REASON = {
278    sellerCancelled: "seller_cancelled",
279    outbid: "outbid",
280    auctionLost: "auction_lost",
281  } as const;
282  
283  /** A bid intent whose deposit never arrives is swept after this long. */
284  export const DEPOSIT_INTENT_EXPIRY_MINUTES = 15;
```

### functions/src/createQrPayment.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import { defineSecret } from "firebase-functions/params";
  3  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  4  import { db } from "./admin";
  5  import { PayMongoClient, extractQrFromNextAction, paymentUnavailable } from "./paymongo";
  6  import {
  7    feeForPackage,
  8    FREE_POST_USED_STATUSES,
  9    QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS,
 10    ListingPackage,
 11    LISTING_STATUS,
 12    REGION,
 13  } from "./constants";
 14  import { pendingApprovalFields } from "./listingApproval";
 15  import { reconcileListingFees } from "./listingFees";
 16  
 17  export const paymongoSecretKey = defineSecret("PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY");
 18  
 19  interface CreateQrPaymentRequest {
 20    listingId: string;
 21    package: ListingPackage;
 22  }
 23  
 24  /**
 25   * Brokers the listing-posting fee. A verified student's first listing ever may use the
 26   * Free package, which goes straight to the admin queue with no PayMongo call; every
 27   * other case creates a PayMongo QR Ph payment and returns the code to render. Either
 28   * way nothing goes live here — an admin approves it first (see listingApproval.ts).
 29   * The client never talks to PayMongo directly — see docs/architecture-and-security.md §2.C.3.
 30   */
 31  export const createQrPayment = onCall(
 32    { secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: "asia-southeast1" },
 33    async (request) => {
 34      const auth = request.auth;
 35      if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 36      if (auth.token.verified !== true) {
 37        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Your account isn't verified yet.");
 38      }
 39  
 40      const { listingId, package: pkg } = (request.data ?? {}) as Partial<CreateQrPaymentRequest>;
 41      if (!listingId || !pkg) {
 42        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "listingId and package are required.");
 43      }
 44  
 45      const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(listingId);
 46      const listingSnap = await listingRef.get();
 47      if (!listingSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
 48      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
 49  
 50      if (listing.ownerUid !== auth.uid) {
 51        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "This isn't your listing.");
 52      }
 53      if (listing.status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval) {
 54        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This listing is already posted and waiting for admin approval.");
 55      }
 56      if (![LISTING_STATUS.draft, LISTING_STATUS.pendingPayment].includes(listing.status)) {
 57        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This listing is already published or closed.");
 58      }
 59  
 60      const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
 61  
 62      // A fee PayMongo already took for this listing — its webhook never arrived, or it
 63      // cleared after the QR sweep gave up on it — is honoured before anything else, so
 64      // reopening the payment screen never charges a student twice.
 65      if (await reconcileListingFees(client, listingId)) {
 66        return { requiresPayment: false, listingId, status: LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval, alreadyPaid: true };
 67      }
 68  
 69      // Free is a student's first listing, once ever (FREE_POST_USED_STATUSES). Checked
 70      // and claimed in one transaction so two drafts submitted at the same moment are far
 71      // less likely to both come through free.
 72      if (pkg === "Free") {
 73        await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 74          const used = await tx.get(
 75            db
 76              .collection("listings")
 77              .where("ownerUid", "==", auth.uid)
 78              .where("status", "in", FREE_POST_USED_STATUSES)
 79              .limit(1)
 80          );
 81          // Refuse explicitly rather than letting it fall through to PayMongo, which would
 82          // be asked to mint a QR code for zero pesos and would reject it with an error no
 83          // student could act on.
 84          if (!used.empty) {
 85            throw new HttpsError(
 86              "failed-precondition",
 87              "You've already used your free first post. Choose Additional (₱10) or Priority (₱20) for this one."
 88            );
 89          }
 90          tx.update(listingRef, pendingApprovalFields(pkg, Timestamp.now()));
 91        });
 92        return { requiresPayment: false, listingId, status: LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval };
 93      }
 94  
 95      const amountCentavos = feeForPackage(pkg);
 96  
 97      // Read the profile first so the try below wraps PayMongo and nothing else — a
 98      // Firestore failure reported as "the payment provider is down" would send whoever
 99      // debugs it to the wrong place.
100      const ownerProfileSnap = await db.collection("users").doc(auth.uid).get();
101      const ownerProfile = ownerProfileSnap.data() ?? {};
102  
103      let intent, qr;
104      try {
105        intent = await client.createPaymentIntent(
106          amountCentavos,
107          `NUTrade listing fee — ${listingId} (${pkg})`
108        );
109  
110        const method = await client.createQrPhPaymentMethod(
111          (ownerProfile.displayName as string) ?? "NUTrade student",
112          (ownerProfile.email as string) ?? auth.token.email ?? ""
113        );
114  
115        const clientKey = intent.data.attributes["client_key"] as string;
116        const attached = await client.attachPaymentMethod(intent.data.id, method.data.id, clientKey);
117        qr = extractQrFromNextAction(attached);
118      } catch (err) {
119        throw paymentUnavailable(err);
120      }
121  
122      // PayMongo says when the code stops working (about 30 minutes, seen live). Using its
123      // time rather than our own guess keeps expireStalePayments from giving up on a code
124      // the student can still pay.
125      const now = Timestamp.now();
126      const paymongoExpiry = qr.expiresAt ? Date.parse(qr.expiresAt) : NaN;
127      const expiresAt = Number.isNaN(paymongoExpiry)
128        ? Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS * 1000)
129        : Timestamp.fromMillis(paymongoExpiry);
130  
131      const paymentRef = db.collection("payments").doc();
132      await paymentRef.set({
133        listingId,
134        uid: auth.uid,
135        package: pkg,
136        amount: amountCentavos,
137        paymongoIntentId: intent.data.id,
138        status: "awaiting_payment",
139        qrExpiresAt: expiresAt,
140        createdAt: now,
141      });
142  
143      await listingRef.update({ status: "pending_payment" });
144  
145      return {
146        requiresPayment: true,
147        listingId,
148        paymentId: paymentRef.id,
149        qrImageUrl: qr.qrImageUrl ?? null,
150        qrImageBase64: qr.qrImageBase64 ?? null,
151        qrPayload: qr.qrPayload ?? null,
152        redirectUrl: qr.redirectUrl ?? null,
153        amountCentavos,
154        expiresAt: expiresAt.toMillis(),
155      };
156    }
157  );
158  
159  /**
160   * "Has my payment gone through yet?" — polled by the payment screen while the QR is up,
161   * and behind its "I've paid" button. Asks PayMongo about this listing's unsettled fee
162   * payments and settles one that was paid, so a student who paid is never left waiting
163   * on a webhook that is late, misconfigured or never comes. Returns the listing's status
164   * afterwards; the app follows the listing document either way.
165   */
166  export const checkListingPayment = onCall(
167    { secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: REGION },
168    async (request) => {
169      const auth = request.auth;
170      if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
171  
172      const { listingId } = (request.data ?? {}) as { listingId?: unknown };
173      if (typeof listingId !== "string" || listingId.length === 0) {
174        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "listingId is required.");
175      }
176  
177      const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(listingId);
178      const listingSnap = await listingRef.get();
179      if (!listingSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
180      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
181  
182      if (listing.ownerUid !== auth.uid && auth.token.role !== "admin") {
183        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "This isn't your listing.");
184      }
185  
186      if ([LISTING_STATUS.draft, LISTING_STATUS.pendingPayment].includes(listing.status)) {
187        await reconcileListingFees(new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value()), listingId);
188        return { listingId, status: (await listingRef.get()).data()?.status ?? listing.status };
189      }
190      return { listingId, status: listing.status };
191    }
192  );
```

### functions/src/depositResolution.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  2  import { DocumentData, DocumentReference, FieldValue, Timestamp, Transaction } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  3  import { db } from "./admin";
  4  import { PayMongoClient, paymentIdFromIntent } from "./paymongo";
  5  import { LEDGER_KIND, postToLedger } from "./wallet";
  6  import { DEPOSIT_STATUS, REFUND_REASON } from "./constants";
  7  
  8  /**
  9   * The one place a bid deposit changes state.
 10   *
 11   * Every path funnels through {@link resolveDeposit} so a deposit can only ever end in one
 12   * of three places, each of them written together with its ledger row in a single
 13   * transaction:
 14   *
 15   *   handover confirmed -> the seller's wallet
 16   *   outbid / lost / seller cancelled -> back to the buyer
 17   *   winning bidder no-show -> the platform treasury, plus a strike
 18   *
 19   * Forfeit is the only outcome that keeps the money, which is what makes the deposit a
 20   * commitment rather than a fee.
 21   *
 22   * **Why returns are in-app credit.** QR Ph captures immediately, so there is no
 23   * authorisation hold to release — the money really did leave the student's GCash. A
 24   * PayMongo refund takes days, costs a fee on every bid round, and is impossible outright
 25   * for QR Ph paid through Maya. Credit is instant, free and reliable, and a student who
 26   * wants real money cashes it out through the payout queue, which an admin settles by hand.
 27   * Only seller cancellation attempts a real refund, and it falls back to credit.
 28   */
 29  
 30  export type DepositOutcome = "credited_to_seller" | "refunded_to_buyer" | "forfeited";
 31  
 32  export interface ResolveOptions {
 33    /** Why, for the student-facing note and for disputes. One of REFUND_REASON, or free text. */
 34    reason?: string;
 35    /** How the money got back, when it was returned. */
 36    via?: "wallet_credit" | "paymongo_refund";
 37    note?: string;
 38  }
 39  
 40  /** Deposits that have been paid and not yet resolved. Only these can move. */
 41  export function isHeld(deposit: DocumentData): boolean {
 42    return deposit.status === DEPOSIT_STATUS.lockedInEscrow;
 43  }
 44  
 45  /**
 46   * Resolves one held deposit inside the caller's transaction. Returns false — writing
 47   * nothing — when the deposit is not held, which is what makes every caller idempotent.
 48   *
 49   * Write-only apart from the treasury counter, so callers must have finished all of their
 50   * transaction reads first.
 51   */
 52  export function resolveDeposit(
 53    tx: Transaction,
 54    intentRef: DocumentReference,
 55    deposit: DocumentData,
 56    outcome: DepositOutcome,
 57    options: ResolveOptions = {}
 58  ): boolean {
 59    if (!isHeld(deposit)) return false;
 60  
 61    const amount = deposit.depositCentavos as number;
 62    const now = Timestamp.now();
 63    const context = {
 64      listingId: (deposit.listingId as string) ?? null,
 65      bidId: (deposit.committedBidId as string) ?? null,
 66    };
 67  
 68    if (outcome === "credited_to_seller") {
 69      tx.update(intentRef, {
 70        status: DEPOSIT_STATUS.creditedToSeller,
 71        resolvedAt: now,
 72        refundReason: null,
 73      });
 74      postToLedger(tx, deposit.sellerUid as string, amount, LEDGER_KIND.depositCredit, {
 75        ...context,
 76        note: options.note ?? `Handover confirmed — ${deposit.listingTitle ?? "trade"}`,
 77      });
 78      return true;
 79    }
 80  
 81    if (outcome === "refunded_to_buyer") {
 82      const via = options.via ?? "wallet_credit";
 83      tx.update(intentRef, {
 84        status: DEPOSIT_STATUS.refundedToBuyer,
 85        resolvedAt: now,
 86        refundReason: options.reason ?? null,
 87        refundedVia: via,
 88      });
 89  
 90      // A PayMongo refund puts real money back at the source, so there is nothing to credit
 91      // — crediting as well would pay the student twice.
 92      if (via === "wallet_credit") {
 93        postToLedger(tx, deposit.bidderUid as string, amount, LEDGER_KIND.refundCredit, {
 94          ...context,
 95          note: options.note ?? refundNote(options.reason),
 96        });
 97      }
 98      return true;
 99    }
100  
101    // Forfeited. No ledger row: the ledger records wallet movements, and this money never
102    // reached the buyer's wallet — it went from their GCash straight to the merchant
103    // account. The forfeit is recorded on the deposit, which is the buyer's own record of
104    // it, and in the treasury counter.
105    tx.update(intentRef, {
106      status: DEPOSIT_STATUS.forfeited,
107      resolvedAt: now,
108      refundReason: options.reason ?? null,
109    });
110    tx.set(
111      db.collection("counters").doc("revenue"),
112      {
113        grossCentavos: FieldValue.increment(amount),
114        forfeitedDepositsCentavos: FieldValue.increment(amount),
115        updatedAt: now,
116      },
117      { merge: true }
118    );
119    return true;
120  }
121  
122  function refundNote(reason?: string): string {
123    switch (reason) {
124      case REFUND_REASON.outbid:
125        return "Outbid — deposit returned";
126      case REFUND_REASON.auctionLost:
127        return "Auction lost — deposit returned";
128      case REFUND_REASON.sellerCancelled:
129        return "Seller cancelled — deposit returned";
130      default:
131        return "Deposit returned";
132    }
133  }
134  
135  /**
136   * Tries to put a deposit back on the card or wallet it came from.
137   *
138   * Used only for seller cancellation, where the buyer gets nothing out of the trade and
139   * real money back is the fair outcome. Returns false on any failure — including the Maya
140   * case, which cannot be refunded at all — and the caller then credits the wallet instead.
141   * Never throws: a failed refund must not block the resolution.
142   */
143  export async function tryPayMongoRefund(
144    client: PayMongoClient,
145    deposit: DocumentData
146  ): Promise<boolean> {
147    const intentId = deposit.paymongoIntentId as string | undefined;
148    if (!intentId) return false;
149  
150    try {
151      const intent = await client.retrievePaymentIntent(intentId);
152      const paymentId = paymentIdFromIntent(intent);
153      if (!paymentId) {
154        logger.warn("tryPayMongoRefund: no captured payment on the intent", { intentId });
155        return false;
156      }
157  
158      await client.createRefund(paymentId, deposit.depositCentavos as number, "requested_by_customer");
159      logger.info("tryPayMongoRefund: refunded", { intentId, paymentId });
160      return true;
161    } catch (err) {
162      // Expected for QR Ph paid through Maya, which PayMongo refuses to refund. Not an
163      // error worth failing the cancellation over — the wallet credit is the fallback.
164      logger.warn("tryPayMongoRefund: refund refused, falling back to wallet credit", { intentId, err });
165      return false;
166    }
167  }
168  
169  /** Reads a bid's deposit, or null. Call during the read phase of a transaction. */
170  export async function readDepositForBid(
171    tx: Transaction,
172    bid: DocumentData
173  ): Promise<{ ref: DocumentReference; data: DocumentData } | null> {
174    const depositId = bid["depositIntentId"] as string | undefined;
175    if (!depositId) return null;
176  
177    const ref = db.collection("bidIntents").doc(depositId);
178    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
179    return snap.exists ? { ref, data: snap.data()! } : null;
180  }
```

### functions/src/deposits.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import { onSchedule } from "firebase-functions/v2/scheduler";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import { DocumentReference, Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  5  import { db } from "./admin";
  6  import { PayMongoClient, mintQrPhPayment, paymentUnavailable } from "./paymongo";
  7  import { paymongoSecretKey } from "./createQrPayment";
  8  import { checkIntentWithPayMongo } from "./listingFees";
  9  import { resolveDeposit } from "./depositResolution";
 10  import {
 11    BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT,
 12    BID_STATUS,
 13    DEPOSIT_INTENT_EXPIRY_MINUTES,
 14    DEPOSIT_STATUS,
 15    LISTING_STATUS,
 16    QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS,
 17    REFUND_REASON,
 18    REGION,
 19    depositFor,
 20  } from "./constants";
 21  
 22  /**
 23   * Anti-ghosting deposits.
 24   *
 25   * A bid is not a bid until money is behind it. `requestBid` validates the amount and mints
 26   * a QR Ph code; the bid itself is written only once the deposit is confirmed paid. Nothing
 27   * a client can say places a bid.
 28   *
 29   * The deposit is part-payment, not a fee. On a ₱500 winning bid with a ₱75 deposit the
 30   * buyer hands over ₱425 in person and the ₱75 we are holding is credited to the seller's
 31   * wallet when the handover is confirmed. The platform is a bridge, not the recipient.
 32   *
 33   * **Deposits are refundable** (decided 2026-09-24). Being outbid or losing the auction
 34   * returns the money; only the winning bidder who fails to turn up loses it. The return is
 35   * an **in-app credit**, not a PayMongo refund: QR Ph captures immediately so there is no
 36   * hold to release, a refund takes days and costs a fee on every bid round, and PayMongo
 37   * cannot refund QR Ph paid through Maya at all. A student who wants real money cashes the
 38   * credit out through the payout queue, which an admin settles by hand.
 39   *
 40   * `bidIntents/{id}` *is* the deposit record for its whole life — it is not thrown away
 41   * once the bid exists, because the deposit outlives the bid.
 42   */
 43  
 44  /** A deposit that has been paid and is being held against a live bid. */
 45  const HELD = DEPOSIT_STATUS.lockedInEscrow;
 46  
 47  interface RequestBidData {
 48    listingId: string;
 49    amountCentavos: number;
 50  }
 51  
 52  function intentRefFor(id: string): DocumentReference {
 53    return db.collection("bidIntents").doc(id);
 54  }
 55  
 56  /**
 57   * Step 1: validate the bid and mint the deposit QR. Writes no bid — see `commitDeposit`.
 58   */
 59  export const requestBid = onCall(
 60    { secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: REGION },
 61    async (request) => {
 62      const auth = request.auth;
 63      if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 64      if (auth.token.verified !== true) {
 65        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Confirm your email before bidding.");
 66      }
 67  
 68      const { listingId, amountCentavos } = (request.data ?? {}) as Partial<RequestBidData>;
 69      if (!listingId || typeof listingId !== "string") {
 70        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "listingId is required.");
 71      }
 72      if (
 73        typeof amountCentavos !== "number" ||
 74        !Number.isSafeInteger(amountCentavos) ||
 75        amountCentavos <= 0
 76      ) {
 77        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "amountCentavos must be a positive whole number.");
 78      }
 79  
 80      const listingSnap = await db.collection("listings").doc(listingId).get();
 81      if (!listingSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
 82      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
 83  
 84      if (listing.ownerUid === auth.uid) {
 85        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "You can't bid on your own listing.");
 86      }
 87      if (listing.status !== LISTING_STATUS.active) {
 88        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This auction isn't accepting bids.");
 89      }
 90  
 91      const now = Timestamp.now();
 92      const endsAt = listing.auctionEndsAt as Timestamp | undefined;
 93      if (endsAt && endsAt.toMillis() <= now.toMillis()) {
 94        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This auction has already ended.");
 95      }
 96  
 97      // Checked here so a student is never asked to pay a deposit for a bid that was never
 98      // going to be accepted. Checked *again* when the deposit lands, because the auction
 99      // moves while the QR is unscanned.
100      assertBidBeatsTheField(listing, amountCentavos);
101  
102      const depositCentavos = depositFor(amountCentavos);
103  
104      const bidderSnap = await db.collection("users").doc(auth.uid).get();
105      const bidder = bidderSnap.data() ?? {};
106  
107      const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
108      let minted;
109      try {
110        minted = await mintQrPhPayment(client, {
111          amountCentavos: depositCentavos,
112          description: `NUTrade bid deposit — ${listing.title} (₱${(amountCentavos / 100).toFixed(2)})`,
113          billingName: (bidder.displayName as string) ?? "NUTrade student",
114          billingEmail: (bidder.email as string) ?? auth.token.email ?? "",
115        });
116      } catch (err) {
117        // Nothing has been written yet, so there is nothing to unwind — the student simply
118        // gets told why, instead of a bare "INTERNAL".
119        throw paymentUnavailable(err);
120      }
121      const { intentId, qr } = minted;
122  
123      const intentRef = db.collection("bidIntents").doc();
124      await intentRef.set({
125        listingId,
126        listingTitle: listing.title ?? "",
127        sellerUid: listing.ownerUid,
128        bidderUid: auth.uid,
129        bidderName: (bidder.displayName as string) ?? "NU student",
130        amountCentavos,
131        depositCentavos,
132        depositPercent: BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT,
133        status: DEPOSIT_STATUS.awaitingPayment,
134        paymongoIntentId: intentId,
135        qrImageUrl: qr.qrImageUrl ?? null,
136        qrImageBase64: qr.qrImageBase64 ?? null,
137        qrPayload: qr.qrPayload ?? null,
138        qrExpiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS * 1000),
139        expiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + DEPOSIT_INTENT_EXPIRY_MINUTES * 60_000),
140        createdAt: now,
141        resolvedAt: null,
142        refundReason: null,
143        refundedVia: null,
144        committedBidId: null,
145      });
146  
147      logger.info("requestBid: deposit QR issued", { bidIntentId: intentRef.id, listingId });
148  
149      return {
150        bidIntentId: intentRef.id,
151        amountCentavos,
152        depositCentavos,
153        depositPercent: BID_DEPOSIT_PERCENT,
154        qrImageUrl: qr.qrImageUrl ?? null,
155        qrImageBase64: qr.qrImageBase64 ?? null,
156        qrPayload: qr.qrPayload ?? null,
157        expiresAt: now.toMillis() + QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS * 1000,
158      };
159    }
160  );
161  
162  /** Throws unless `amount` clears the listing's current bar. */
163  function assertBidBeatsTheField(listing: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData, amount: number): void {
164    const bidCount = (listing.bidCount as number) ?? 0;
165    const startingBid = (listing.startingBidCentavos as number) ?? 0;
166    const highest = (listing.currentHighestBidCentavos as number) ?? startingBid;
167    const increment = (listing.minIncrementCentavos as number) ?? 0;
168    const minNext = bidCount === 0 ? startingBid : highest + increment;
169  
170    if (amount < minNext) {
171      throw new HttpsError(
172        "failed-precondition",
173        `Your bid must be at least ₱${(minNext / 100).toFixed(2)}.`
174      );
175    }
176  }
177  
178  /**
179   * Step 2: the deposit has been paid, so write the bid it was raised for.
180   *
181   * Idempotent and race-safe — the webhook and every reconciler may call this for the same
182   * intent, and only the first does anything. Returns true when this call is the one that
183   * committed it.
184   *
185   * The bid is created here rather than in `placeBid`, and the previous leader's deposit is
186   * returned in the same transaction, so a listing never has two live bids and never has two
187   * deposits held at once.
188   */
189  export async function commitDeposit(
190    intentRef: DocumentReference,
191    source: "webhook" | "reconcile"
192  ): Promise<boolean> {
193    const outcome = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
194      // Every read first — Firestore forbids a read after a write in a transaction.
195      const intentSnap = await tx.get(intentRef);
196      const intent = intentSnap.data();
197      if (!intent || intent.status !== DEPOSIT_STATUS.awaitingPayment) return null;
198  
199      const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(intent.listingId as string);
200      const listingSnap = await tx.get(listingRef);
201      if (!listingSnap.exists) return null;
202      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
203  
204      const bidsRef = listingRef.collection("bids");
205      const leaders = await tx.get(bidsRef.where("status", "==", BID_STATUS.pending));
206  
207      // The deposit each displaced leader is holding, so it can go back in this same write.
208      const leaderDeposits: Array<{ ref: DocumentReference; data: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData }> = [];
209      for (const doc of leaders.docs) {
210        const depositId = doc.data()["depositIntentId"] as string | undefined;
211        if (!depositId) continue;
212        const ref = intentRefFor(depositId);
213        const snap = await tx.get(ref);
214        if (snap.exists) leaderDeposits.push({ ref, data: snap.data()! });
215      }
216  
217      const now = Timestamp.now();
218      const amount = intent.amountCentavos as number;
219  
220      // The auction moved while the QR sat unscanned: the money arrived, but this bid can
221      // no longer be placed. Take the deposit into escrow and hand it straight back, so the
222      // student is never charged for a bid that does not exist.
223      // The seller check repeats requestBid's on purpose: this is the one function that
224      // writes a bid, so it must never write one for the listing's own seller, whatever
225      // path the intent took to get here.
226      const endsAt = listing.auctionEndsAt as Timestamp | undefined;
227      const stale =
228        intent.bidderUid === listing.ownerUid ||
229        listing.status !== LISTING_STATUS.active ||
230        (endsAt !== undefined && endsAt.toMillis() <= now.toMillis()) ||
231        amount < minimumNextBid(listing);
232  
233      if (stale) {
234        tx.update(intentRef, { status: HELD, paidAt: now, settledBy: source });
235        resolveDeposit(tx, intentRef, { ...intent, status: HELD }, "refunded_to_buyer", {
236          reason: REFUND_REASON.auctionLost,
237          note: "Bid no longer valid — deposit returned",
238        });
239        return { committed: false, bidderUid: intent.bidderUid as string };
240      }
241  
242      const bidRef = bidsRef.doc();
243      tx.set(bidRef, {
244        listingId: intent.listingId,
245        bidderUid: intent.bidderUid,
246        bidderName: intent.bidderName ?? "NU student",
247        amountCentavos: amount,
248        depositCentavos: intent.depositCentavos,
249        depositIntentId: intentRef.id,
250        status: BID_STATUS.pending,
251        createdAt: now,
252      });
253  
254      tx.update(intentRef, {
255        status: HELD,
256        paidAt: now,
257        settledBy: source,
258        committedBidId: bidRef.id,
259      });
260  
261      // Demote the old leader and return its deposit — this is the outbid path, and it runs
262      // on every single bid, so it stays a wallet credit with no network call in it.
263      for (const doc of leaders.docs) {
264        tx.update(doc.ref, { status: BID_STATUS.outbid, outbidAt: now });
265      }
266      for (const { ref, data } of leaderDeposits) {
267        resolveDeposit(tx, ref, data, "refunded_to_buyer", { reason: REFUND_REASON.outbid });
268      }
269  
270      tx.update(listingRef, {
271        currentHighestBidCentavos: amount,
272        highestBidderUid: intent.bidderUid,
273        bidCount: ((listing.bidCount as number) ?? 0) + 1,
274      });
275  
276      return { committed: true, bidId: bidRef.id, bidderUid: intent.bidderUid as string };
277    });
278  
279    if (!outcome) return false;
280    logger.info("commitDeposit: settled", { intentId: intentRef.id, source, ...outcome });
281    return true;
282  }
283  
284  function minimumNextBid(listing: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData): number {
285    const bidCount = (listing.bidCount as number) ?? 0;
286    const startingBid = (listing.startingBidCentavos as number) ?? 0;
287    const highest = (listing.currentHighestBidCentavos as number) ?? startingBid;
288    const increment = (listing.minIncrementCentavos as number) ?? 0;
289    return bidCount === 0 ? startingBid : highest + increment;
290  }
291  
292  /**
293   * Asks PayMongo whether a deposit was actually paid, and commits it if so.
294   *
295   * This — not the webhook — is what actually places bids in this project: the PayMongo
296   * webhook has never arrived here, so the app polls this while the QR screen is open. The
297   * evidence is PayMongo's, fetched with our secret key; nothing the student says settles a
298   * deposit.
299   */
300  export const checkBidDeposit = onCall(
301    { secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: REGION },
302    async (request) => {
303      const auth = request.auth;
304      if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
305  
306      const { bidIntentId } = (request.data ?? {}) as { bidIntentId?: unknown };
307      if (typeof bidIntentId !== "string" || bidIntentId.length === 0) {
308        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "bidIntentId is required.");
309      }
310  
311      const intentRef = intentRefFor(bidIntentId);
312      const snap = await intentRef.get();
313      if (!snap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "No such bid.");
314      const intent = snap.data()!;
315  
316      if (intent.bidderUid !== auth.uid && auth.token.role !== "admin") {
317        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "This isn't your bid.");
318      }
319  
320      if (intent.status === DEPOSIT_STATUS.awaitingPayment) {
321        const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
322        if ((await checkIntentWithPayMongo(client, intent.paymongoIntentId as string)) === "paid") {
323          await commitDeposit(intentRef, "reconcile");
324        }
325      }
326  
327      const latest = (await intentRef.get()).data()!;
328      return {
329        bidIntentId,
330        status: latest.status,
331        bidId: latest.committedBidId ?? null,
332        refundReason: latest.refundReason ?? null,
333      };
334    }
335  );
336  
337  /**
338   * Sweeps deposit QRs nobody paid. Runs often enough that a student who walked away is not
339   * still holding the top-bid slot hostage — the bid was never created, so this only tidies
340   * the intent.
341   *
342   * It asks PayMongo before giving up on each one: a QR paid in the last second of the
343   * window must not be swept as unpaid.
344   */
345  export const expireDepositIntents = onSchedule(
346    { schedule: "every 5 minutes", secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: REGION },
347    async () => {
348      const now = Timestamp.now();
349      const stale = await db
350        .collection("bidIntents")
351        .where("status", "==", DEPOSIT_STATUS.awaitingPayment)
352        .where("expiresAt", "<=", now)
353        .limit(100)
354        .get();
355  
356      if (stale.empty) return;
357  
358      const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
359      let expired = 0;
360      let rescued = 0;
361  
362      for (const doc of stale.docs) {
363        const intentId = doc.data().paymongoIntentId as string | undefined;
364        const verdict = intentId ? await checkIntentWithPayMongo(client, intentId) : "unpaid";
365  
366        if (verdict === "paid") {
367          await commitDeposit(doc.ref, "reconcile");
368          rescued++;
369          continue;
370        }
371        // "unknown" means the lookup failed, not that it went unpaid — leave it for the
372        // next sweep rather than expiring a deposit that may have landed.
373        if (verdict === "unpaid") {
374          await doc.ref.update({ status: DEPOSIT_STATUS.expired, resolvedAt: now });
375          expired++;
376        }
377      }
378  
379      logger.info("expireDepositIntents: swept", { checked: stale.size, expired, rescued });
380    }
381  );
```

### functions/src/emailOtp.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as crypto from "crypto";
  2  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";
  5  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  6  import { db } from "./admin";
  7  import { mailSecrets, sendMail } from "./brevo";
  8  import { consumeMailAllowance } from "./mailRateLimit";
  9  import { otpEmail } from "./mailTemplates";
 10  import {
 11    OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
 12    OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
 13    OTP_TTL_MINUTES,
 14    REGION,
 15  } from "./constants";
 16  
 17  /** Six digits, uniformly distributed. `randomInt` is rejection-sampled, unlike `random() * n`. */
 18  export function generateCode(): string {
 19    return String(crypto.randomInt(0, 1_000_000)).padStart(6, "0");
 20  }
 21  
 22  /**
 23   * Codes are stored hashed, never in plaintext. A six-digit space is small enough to
 24   * brute-force offline, so the per-challenge salt is what stops a leaked Firestore
 25   * export from being reversed with a rainbow table.
 26   */
 27  export function hashCode(code: string, salt: string): string {
 28    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(`${salt}:${code}`).digest("hex");
 29  }
 30  
 31  export function timingSafeEquals(a: string, b: string): boolean {
 32    const bufA = Buffer.from(a, "utf8");
 33    const bufB = Buffer.from(b, "utf8");
 34    if (bufA.length !== bufB.length) return false;
 35    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB);
 36  }
 37  
 38  /** `juan.delacruz@gmail.com` -> `ju••••••••@gmail.com`, so the app can confirm where it went. */
 39  export function maskEmail(email: string): string {
 40    const [local, domain] = email.split("@");
 41    if (!domain) return email;
 42    const head = local.slice(0, 2);
 43    return `${head}${"•".repeat(Math.max(local.length - 2, 1))}@${domain}`;
 44  }
 45  
 46  /** Mails a verification code. The template and the transport both live elsewhere. */
 47  export async function sendOtpEmail(to: string, code: string): Promise<void> {
 48    await sendMail(to, otpEmail(code));
 49  }
 50  
 51  /**
 52   * An admin who revoked an account with setUserVerification would otherwise watch the
 53   * student walk straight back in through the OTP flow — it grants the same claim.
 54   * Rejected accounts are refused a code and refused a verification.
 55   */
 56  async function assertNotBlocked(uid: string): Promise<void> {
 57    const snapshot = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
 58    if (snapshot.data()?.["verificationStatus"] === "rejected") {
 59      throw new HttpsError(
 60        "permission-denied",
 61        "This account has been blocked by a NUTrade admin."
 62      );
 63    }
 64  }
 65  
 66  /**
 67   * Mails a fresh six-digit code to the signed-in account's own email address.
 68   *
 69   * The address is taken from the ID token, never from the request body — otherwise
 70   * this endpoint would happily mail codes to strangers on any signed-in user's say-so.
 71   */
 72  export const sendEmailOtp = onCall({ secrets: mailSecrets, region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 73    const auth = request.auth;
 74    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 75  
 76    const email = auth.token.email;
 77    if (!email) throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This account has no email address.");
 78  
 79    await assertNotBlocked(auth.uid);
 80  
 81    if (auth.token.verified === true) {
 82      return { alreadyVerified: true, sentTo: maskEmail(email) };
 83    }
 84  
 85    const challengeRef = db.collection("otpChallenges").doc(auth.uid);
 86    const existing = await challengeRef.get();
 87    const now = Timestamp.now();
 88  
 89    if (existing.exists) {
 90      const lastSentAt = existing.data()!.lastSentAt as Timestamp | undefined;
 91      if (lastSentAt) {
 92        const elapsedSeconds = (now.toMillis() - lastSentAt.toMillis()) / 1000;
 93        if (elapsedSeconds < OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) {
 94          throw new HttpsError(
 95            "resource-exhausted",
 96            `Wait ${Math.ceil(OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS - elapsedSeconds)}s before asking for another code.`
 97          );
 98        }
 99      }
100    }
101  
102    await consumeMailAllowance(email);
103  
104    const code = generateCode();
105    const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
106  
107    // Written before the send: a code that reached the inbox but was never recorded
108    // would be unusable, which is the worse of the two failure modes.
109    await challengeRef.set({
110      uid: auth.uid,
111      email,
112      salt,
113      codeHash: hashCode(code, salt),
114      attempts: 0,
115      createdAt: now,
116      lastSentAt: now,
117      expiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + OTP_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000),
118    });
119  
120    await sendOtpEmail(email, code);
121    logger.info("sendEmailOtp: code issued", { uid: auth.uid });
122  
123    return {
124      alreadyVerified: false,
125      sentTo: maskEmail(email),
126      expiresInSeconds: OTP_TTL_MINUTES * 60,
127      resendAfterSeconds: OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
128    };
129  });
130  
131  /**
132   * Checks a submitted code and, on success, marks the account verified.
133   *
134   * This is the whole verification gate. Registration asks for no Student ID — the
135   * `verified` claim granted here is what firestore.rules, placeBid and createQrPayment
136   * check before letting anyone post or bid. It proves the student controls the email
137   * address and nothing more; `setUserVerification` remains available to admins for
138   * revoking an account after the fact.
139   */
140  export const verifyEmailOtp = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
141    const auth = request.auth;
142    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
143  
144    const { code } = (request.data ?? {}) as { code?: string };
145    const submitted = (code ?? "").trim();
146    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(submitted)) {
147      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.");
148    }
149  
150    await assertNotBlocked(auth.uid);
151  
152    const challengeRef = db.collection("otpChallenges").doc(auth.uid);
153    const snapshot = await challengeRef.get();
154    if (!snapshot.exists) {
155      throw new HttpsError("not-found", "That code has expired. Ask for a new one.");
156    }
157  
158    const challenge = snapshot.data()!;
159    const now = Timestamp.now();
160  
161    if ((challenge.expiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis() <= now.toMillis()) {
162      await challengeRef.delete();
163      throw new HttpsError("deadline-exceeded", "That code has expired. Ask for a new one.");
164    }
165  
166    const attempts = (challenge.attempts as number) ?? 0;
167    if (attempts >= OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
168      await challengeRef.delete();
169      throw new HttpsError("resource-exhausted", "Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.");
170    }
171  
172    if (!timingSafeEquals(hashCode(submitted, challenge.salt as string), challenge.codeHash as string)) {
173      await challengeRef.update({ attempts: attempts + 1 });
174      const left = OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS - (attempts + 1);
175      throw new HttpsError(
176        "permission-denied",
177        left > 0 ? `That code isn't right. ${left} attempt${left === 1 ? "" : "s"} left.` : "That code isn't right."
178      );
179    }
180  
181    const existingClaims = (await getAuth().getUser(auth.uid)).customClaims ?? {};
182    await getAuth().setCustomUserClaims(auth.uid, { ...existingClaims, verified: true });
183    await getAuth().updateUser(auth.uid, { emailVerified: true });
184  
185    await db.collection("users").doc(auth.uid).set(
186      { verificationStatus: "verified", verifiedAt: now, verifiedVia: "email_otp" },
187      { merge: true }
188    );
189  
190    await challengeRef.delete();
191    logger.info("verifyEmailOtp: account verified", { uid: auth.uid });
192  
193    return { verified: true };
194  });
```

### functions/src/expireStalePayments.ts

```typescript
 1  import { onSchedule } from "firebase-functions/v2/scheduler";
 2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
 3  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
 4  import { db } from "./admin";
 5  import { paymongoSecretKey } from "./createQrPayment";
 6  import { reconcilePayment } from "./listingFees";
 7  import { PayMongoClient } from "./paymongo";
 8  
 9  /**
10   * A PayMongo QR Ph code stops working at its `qrExpiresAt` (PayMongo's own expiry,
11   * about 30 minutes after minting), but nothing tells us that on its own — there's no
12   * webhook event for it, just a payment that never arrives. Runs every 5 minutes and
13   * reverts any listing left stranded in `pending_payment` behind a dead QR back to
14   * `draft` so the seller can request a fresh one.
15   *
16   * Before giving up on a payment it asks PayMongo whether it was in fact paid. A student
17   * who paid while the webhook was late or missing gets their listing posted instead of
18   * silently reverted; a PayMongo lookup that fails leaves the payment for the next run
19   * rather than expiring money that may have arrived.
20   */
21  export const expireStalePayments = onSchedule(
22    { schedule: "every 5 minutes", region: "asia-southeast1", secrets: [paymongoSecretKey] },
23    async () => {
24      const now = Timestamp.now();
25      const staleSnap = await db
26        .collection("payments")
27        .where("status", "==", "awaiting_payment")
28        .where("qrExpiresAt", "<=", now)
29        .get();
30  
31      if (staleSnap.empty) return;
32  
33      logger.info("expireStalePayments: checking stale payments", { count: staleSnap.size });
34      const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
35  
36      for (const paymentDoc of staleSnap.docs) {
37        const payment = paymentDoc.data();
38  
39        if (payment.paymongoIntentId) {
40          const verdict = await reconcilePayment(client, paymentDoc.ref, payment.paymongoIntentId as string);
41          if (verdict !== "unpaid") continue; // settled, or PayMongo unreachable — try again next run
42        }
43  
44        const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(payment.listingId as string);
45        await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
46          const fresh = await tx.get(paymentDoc.ref);
47          if (fresh.data()?.status !== "awaiting_payment") return; // settled meanwhile
48          const listingSnap = await tx.get(listingRef);
49          tx.update(paymentDoc.ref, { status: "expired", expiredAt: now });
50          if (listingSnap.exists && listingSnap.data()!.status === "pending_payment") {
51            tx.update(listingRef, { status: "draft" });
52          }
53        });
54      }
55    }
56  );
```
