### functions/src/listingApproval.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError, CallableRequest } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  3  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  4  import { db } from "./admin";
  5  import { AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS, LISTING_STATUS, ListingPackage, REGION } from "./constants";
  6  import { visibilityFor } from "./listingVisibility";
  7  
  8  /**
  9   * Every new listing is moderated. Paying the posting fee — or qualifying for the free
 10   * first post — no longer publishes an auction; it hands it to an admin, and only
 11   * approveListing puts it on the feed.
 12   *
 13   * The auction clock and the hourly-refresh slot both start at approval, not at
 14   * payment, so time spent waiting in the queue never eats into a seller's 24 hours.
 15   */
 16  
 17  /** Hard cap on an admin's rejection note, which the seller sees verbatim. */
 18  const MAX_REJECTION_REASON_LENGTH = 300;
 19  
 20  /**
 21   * The fields that move a listing into the admin queue. Used by createQrPayment (free
 22   * post) and paymongoWebhook (paid post) — the two places a listing's fee is settled.
 23   */
 24  export function pendingApprovalFields(pkg: ListingPackage, now: Timestamp) {
 25    return {
 26      status: LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval,
 27      // What was actually paid for. The listing's own `package` is whatever the client
 28      // wrote on the draft; this is the one approval honours.
 29      paidPackage: pkg,
 30      submittedForApprovalAt: now,
 31    };
 32  }
 33  
 34  /** The fields that put an approved listing live: countdown, pin, and feed slot. */
 35  export function goLiveFields(pkg: ListingPackage, now: Timestamp) {
 36    return {
 37      status: LISTING_STATUS.active,
 38      publishedAt: now,
 39      auctionEndsAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS * 3_600_000),
 40      isPinned: pkg === "Priority",
 41      ...visibilityFor(pkg, now.toMillis()),
 42    };
 43  }
 44  
 45  function requireAdmin(request: CallableRequest): string {
 46    const auth = request.auth;
 47    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 48    // role: the app admin claim. admin: the web admin panel's, which shares this database.
 49    if (auth.token.role !== "admin" && auth.token.admin !== true) {
 50      throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Admins only.");
 51    }
 52    return auth.uid;
 53  }
 54  
 55  function requireListingId(request: CallableRequest): string {
 56    const { listingId } = (request.data ?? {}) as { listingId?: unknown };
 57    if (typeof listingId !== "string" || listingId.length === 0) {
 58      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "listingId is required.");
 59    }
 60    return listingId;
 61  }
 62  
 63  /**
 64   * Loads a listing inside `tx` and insists it is still waiting for review, so two
 65   * admins acting on the same listing cannot both win.
 66   */
 67  async function readPendingListing(tx: FirebaseFirestore.Transaction, listingId: string) {
 68    const ref = db.collection("listings").doc(listingId);
 69    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
 70    if (!snap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Listing not found.");
 71    const listing = snap.data()!;
 72    if (listing.status !== LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval) {
 73      throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This listing isn't waiting for approval any more.");
 74    }
 75    return { ref, listing };
 76  }
 77  
 78  /** Admin approves a queued listing: it goes live and its 24-hour auction starts now. */
 79  export const approveListing = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 80    const adminUid = requireAdmin(request);
 81    const listingId = requireListingId(request);
 82  
 83    const outcome = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 84      const { ref, listing } = await readPendingListing(tx, listingId);
 85      const now = Timestamp.now();
 86      const live = goLiveFields((listing.paidPackage as ListingPackage | undefined) ?? "Free", now);
 87  
 88      tx.update(ref, { ...live, approvedAt: now, approvedBy: adminUid });
 89      return { ownerUid: listing.ownerUid as string, isVisible: live.isVisible };
 90    });
 91  
 92    // The seller is told by onListingUpdated, which also covers approvals made in the
 93    // web admin panel.
 94    logger.info("approveListing", { listingId, approvedBy: adminUid });
 95  
 96    return { listingId, isVisible: outcome.isVisible };
 97  });
 98  
 99  /**
100   * Admin turns a queued listing down. Terminal — the seller posts a corrected listing
101   * rather than editing this one.
102   *
103   * A paid posting fee is NOT refunded automatically: PayMongo refunds are a manual
104   * step in the PayMongo dashboard for now.
105   */
106  export const rejectListing = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
107    const adminUid = requireAdmin(request);
108    const listingId = requireListingId(request);
109  
110    const { reason } = (request.data ?? {}) as { reason?: unknown };
111    const note = typeof reason === "string" ? reason.trim().slice(0, MAX_REJECTION_REASON_LENGTH) : "";
112  
113    const ownerUid = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
114      const { ref, listing } = await readPendingListing(tx, listingId);
115      tx.update(ref, {
116        status: LISTING_STATUS.rejected,
117        rejectionReason: note || null,
118        rejectedAt: Timestamp.now(),
119        rejectedBy: adminUid,
120      });
121      return listing.ownerUid as string;
122    });
123  
124    // The seller is told by onListingUpdated, as for approvals.
125    logger.info("rejectListing", { listingId, rejectedBy: adminUid, ownerUid });
126  
127    return { listingId };
128  });
```

### functions/src/listingFees.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  2  import { DocumentReference, FieldValue, Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  3  import { db } from "./admin";
  4  import { LISTING_STATUS, ListingPackage } from "./constants";
  5  import { pendingApprovalFields } from "./listingApproval";
  6  import { notifyUser } from "./notify";
  7  import { PayMongoClient, intentIsPaid } from "./paymongo";
  8  
  9  /**
 10   * Settling a listing fee, from whichever side learns about it first.
 11   *
 12   * PayMongo's webhook is the fast path, but it is not the only one: a webhook that is
 13   * misconfigured, delayed or dropped used to leave a student who had paid staring at the
 14   * QR code while the expiry sweep quietly reverted their listing to draft. So the payment
 15   * screen, createQrPayment and expireStalePayments also ask PayMongo directly
 16   * (reconcileListingFees). Either way the evidence is PayMongo's, fetched with our secret
 17   * key — nothing a student says can settle a fee.
 18   */
 19  
 20  /** Payment docs that may still turn out to have been paid. */
 21  const UNSETTLED_PAYMENT_STATUSES = ["awaiting_payment", "expired"];
 22  
 23  /**
 24   * Marks one listing-fee payment paid, posts its listing into the admin queue, and
 25   * records the revenue. Idempotent and race-safe: the webhook and every reconciler may
 26   * call it for the same payment, and only the first call writes anything.
 27   *
 28   * Returns true when this call is the one that settled it.
 29   */
 30  export async function settleListingFee(
 31    paymentRef: DocumentReference,
 32    source: "webhook" | "reconcile"
 33  ): Promise<boolean> {
 34    const outcome = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 35      const paymentSnap = await tx.get(paymentRef);
 36      const payment = paymentSnap.data();
 37      if (!payment || payment.status === "paid") return null;
 38  
 39      const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(payment.listingId as string);
 40      const listingSnap = await tx.get(listingRef);
 41      if (!listingSnap.exists) return null;
 42      const ownerSnap = await tx.get(db.collection("users").doc(payment.uid as string));
 43  
 44      const now = Timestamp.now();
 45      tx.update(paymentRef, { status: "paid", paidAt: now, settledBy: source });
 46  
 47      // Paying the fee posts the listing into the admin queue; it goes live only when an
 48      // admin approves it (approveListing). A payment that clears after the QR sweep
 49      // already reverted the listing to draft still counts — the money arrived. Anything
 50      // further along (a second payment for the same listing) is recorded but never moves
 51      // the listing backwards.
 52      // A listing already in the queue with no paidPackage was put there by the web admin
 53      // panel's paymongoWebhook, which moves the status and nothing else — this payment is
 54      // what it saw, so it still gets stamped here.
 55      const listing = listingSnap.data()!;
 56      const status = listing.status;
 57      const submitted = status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingPayment || status === LISTING_STATUS.draft
 58        || (status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval && !listing.paidPackage);
 59      if (submitted) {
 60        tx.update(listingRef, pendingApprovalFields(payment.package as ListingPackage, now));
 61      } else {
 62        logger.warn("settleListingFee: fee paid for a listing already past payment", {
 63          listingId: payment.listingId,
 64          status,
 65        });
 66      }
 67  
 68      // In the web admin panel's shape, which lists these as its revenue ledger: `amount`
 69      // in pesos and `timestamp`, the field names its own paymongoWebhook writes.
 70      tx.set(db.collection("transactions").doc(), {
 71        paymentId: paymentRef.id,
 72        payMongoIntentId: payment.paymongoIntentId,
 73        userId: payment.uid,
 74        userEmail: (ownerSnap.data()?.email as string | undefined) ?? "",
 75        listingId: payment.listingId,
 76        packageType: payment.package,
 77        amount: (payment.amount as number) / 100,
 78        amountCentavos: payment.amount,
 79        status: "paid",
 80        timestamp: now,
 81      });
 82  
 83      tx.set(
 84        db.collection("counters").doc("revenue"),
 85        {
 86          grossCentavos: FieldValue.increment(payment.amount as number),
 87          transactionCount: FieldValue.increment(1),
 88          updatedAt: now,
 89        },
 90        { merge: true }
 91      );
 92  
 93      return { uid: payment.uid as string, listingId: payment.listingId as string, submitted };
 94    });
 95  
 96    if (!outcome) return false;
 97    logger.info("settleListingFee: settled", { paymentId: paymentRef.id, source, ...outcome });
 98  
 99    if (outcome.submitted) {
100      await notifyUser(outcome.uid, {
101        title: "Item successfully posted",
102        body: "Payment confirmed — an admin will review your listing before it goes live.",
103        data: { listingId: outcome.listingId, type: "listing_submitted" },
104      });
105    }
106    return true;
107  }
108  
109  export type PaymentVerdict = "paid" | "unpaid" | "unknown";
110  
111  /**
112   * PayMongo's answer, fetched with our secret key, to "was this intent paid?". "unknown"
113   * means the lookup itself failed, so the caller should try again rather than decide.
114   */
115  export async function checkIntentWithPayMongo(client: PayMongoClient, intentId: string): Promise<PaymentVerdict> {
116    try {
117      return intentIsPaid(await client.retrievePaymentIntent(intentId)) ? "paid" : "unpaid";
118    } catch (err) {
119      logger.warn("checkIntentWithPayMongo: PayMongo lookup failed", { intentId, err });
120      return "unknown";
121    }
122  }
123  
124  /**
125   * Asks PayMongo about one payment doc and settles it if PayMongo says it was paid.
126   * A failed lookup comes back "unknown", so the caller can retry later.
127   */
128  export async function reconcilePayment(
129    client: PayMongoClient,
130    paymentRef: DocumentReference,
131    intentId: string,
132    source: "webhook" | "reconcile" = "reconcile"
133  ): Promise<PaymentVerdict> {
134    const verdict = await checkIntentWithPayMongo(client, intentId);
135    if (verdict === "paid") await settleListingFee(paymentRef, source);
136    return verdict;
137  }
138  
139  /**
140   * Checks every not-yet-settled fee payment for a listing with PayMongo, settling the
141   * first one that was actually paid. "paid" once one is settled; "unknown" if PayMongo
142   * couldn't be asked about at least one of them; otherwise "unpaid".
143   */
144  export async function verifyListingFees(client: PayMongoClient, listingId: string): Promise<PaymentVerdict> {
145    const payments = await db.collection("payments").where("listingId", "==", listingId).get();
146  
147    let verdict: PaymentVerdict = "unpaid";
148    for (const doc of payments.docs) {
149      const payment = doc.data();
150      if (!UNSETTLED_PAYMENT_STATUSES.includes(payment.status) || !payment.paymongoIntentId) continue;
151      const result = await reconcilePayment(client, doc.ref, payment.paymongoIntentId as string);
152      if (result === "paid") return "paid";
153      if (result === "unknown") verdict = "unknown";
154    }
155    return verdict;
156  }
157  
158  /** True if the listing's fee is now settled. See {@link verifyListingFees}. */
159  export async function reconcileListingFees(client: PayMongoClient, listingId: string): Promise<boolean> {
160    return (await verifyListingFees(client, listingId)) === "paid";
161  }
```

### functions/src/listingReview.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onDocumentUpdated } from "firebase-functions/v2/firestore";
  2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  3  import { DocumentReference, DocumentData, Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  4  import { db } from "./admin";
  5  import { AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS, LISTING_STATUS, ListingPackage, REGION } from "./constants";
  6  import { paymongoSecretKey } from "./createQrPayment";
  7  import { goLiveFields } from "./listingApproval";
  8  import { verifyListingFees } from "./listingFees";
  9  import { notifyUser } from "./notify";
 10  import { PayMongoClient } from "./paymongo";
 11  
 12  /**
 13   * What has to follow a listing's review or submission, whoever made the change.
 14   *
 15   * The web admin panel reviews listings through approveListing / rejectListing, but it
 16   * also has its own copies of those callables and runs its own paymongoWebhook, which
 17   * moves a listing into the queue on any "payment.paid" event — including one sent
 18   * without a signature. Neither knows about the feed slot, the Priority pin, the app's
 19   * notifications or the fee record. This trigger fills those in from the listing
 20   * itself, so an approval ends the same way whichever code made it, and a queued
 21   * listing only stays queued if PayMongo says it was paid.
 22   */
 23  export const onListingUpdated = onDocumentUpdated(
 24    { document: "listings/{listingId}", region: REGION, secrets: [paymongoSecretKey] },
 25    async (event) => {
 26      const before = event.data?.before.data();
 27      const after = event.data?.after.data();
 28      if (!before || !after) return;
 29  
 30      const ref = event.data!.after.ref;
 31      const listingId = event.params.listingId;
 32  
 33      if (before.status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval && after.status === LISTING_STATUS.active) {
 34        await onApproved(ref, listingId, after);
 35      } else if (before.status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval && after.status === LISTING_STATUS.rejected) {
 36        await onRejected(listingId, after);
 37      } else if (
 38        (before.status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingPayment || before.status === LISTING_STATUS.draft) &&
 39        after.status === LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval &&
 40        !after.paidPackage
 41      ) {
 42        // createQrPayment and settleListingFee always stamp paidPackage, so a listing that
 43        // reached the queue without one got there through the panel's webhook.
 44        await onUnverifiedSubmission(ref, listingId, before.status as string);
 45      }
 46    }
 47  );
 48  
 49  async function onApproved(ref: DocumentReference, listingId: string, listing: DocumentData) {
 50    let isVisible = listing.isVisible === true;
 51  
 52    // The app's approveListing always sets visibleFrom; the panel's own approveListing
 53    // doesn't, and without it publishScheduledListings can never put the listing on the feed.
 54    if (listing.visibleFrom == null) {
 55      const pkg = (listing.paidPackage as ListingPackage | undefined) ?? "Free";
 56      const approvedAt = (listing.approvedAt as Timestamp | undefined) ?? Timestamp.now();
 57      const live = goLiveFields(pkg, approvedAt);
 58  
 59      // The panel's own countdown is kept where it wrote one — the seller may already
 60      // have seen it — and the feed slot counts from the panel's approval, not from now.
 61      // It has written auctionEndsAt as an ISO string, which closeExpiredAuctions' range
 62      // query and the app both skip, so only a real timestamp is kept as-is.
 63      await ref.update({
 64        isPinned: live.isPinned,
 65        isVisible: live.isVisible,
 66        visibleFrom: live.visibleFrom,
 67        publishedAt: asTimestamp(listing.publishedAt) ?? approvedAt,
 68        auctionEndsAt: asTimestamp(listing.auctionEndsAt) ??
 69          Timestamp.fromMillis(approvedAt.toMillis() + AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS * 3_600_000),
 70      });
 71      isVisible = live.isVisible;
 72      logger.info("onListingUpdated: completed a web-panel approval", { listingId, pkg });
 73    }
 74  
 75    await notifyUser(listing.ownerUid as string, {
 76      title: "Your listing was approved",
 77      body: isVisible
 78        ? "Your auction is now live on the campus feed."
 79        : "Your auction joins the campus feed at the next hourly refresh.",
 80      data: { listingId, type: "listing_approved" },
 81    });
 82  }
 83  
 84  /** A Firestore timestamp, or an ISO string the panel wrote in its place; else undefined. */
 85  function asTimestamp(value: unknown): Timestamp | undefined {
 86    if (value instanceof Timestamp) return value;
 87    if (typeof value === "string") {
 88      const millis = Date.parse(value);
 89      if (!Number.isNaN(millis)) return Timestamp.fromMillis(millis);
 90    }
 91    return undefined;
 92  }
 93  
 94  async function onRejected(listingId: string, listing: DocumentData) {
 95    const note = typeof listing.rejectionReason === "string" ? listing.rejectionReason.trim() : "";
 96    await notifyUser(listing.ownerUid as string, {
 97      title: "Your listing wasn't approved",
 98      body: note || "An admin reviewed your listing and didn't approve it.",
 99      data: { listingId, type: "listing_rejected" },
100    });
101  }
102  
103  async function onUnverifiedSubmission(ref: DocumentReference, listingId: string, previousStatus: string) {
104    const verdict = await verifyListingFees(new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value()), listingId);
105  
106    // Paid: settleListingFee has already stamped paidPackage and recorded the fee.
107    if (verdict === "paid") return;
108  
109    // PayMongo couldn't be asked. Leave it for the admin rather than undo a real payment;
110    // expireStalePayments asks again about the payment doc on its next sweep.
111    if (verdict === "unknown") {
112      logger.error("onListingUpdated: queued by the panel's webhook, PayMongo unreachable", { listingId });
113      return;
114    }
115  
116    // PayMongo has no paid intent for this listing: the event was not a real payment.
117    // Put it back where it was, unless something has moved it on since.
118    const reverted = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
119      const current = (await tx.get(ref)).data();
120      if (current?.status !== LISTING_STATUS.pendingApproval || current.paidPackage) return false;
121      tx.update(ref, { status: previousStatus });
122      return true;
123    });
124    logger.warn("onListingUpdated: queued without a payment PayMongo recognises", { listingId, reverted });
125  }
```

### functions/src/listingVisibility.ts

```typescript
 1  import { onSchedule } from "firebase-functions/v2/scheduler";
 2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
 3  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
 4  import { db } from "./admin";
 5  import { LISTING_STATUS, ListingPackage, REGION, nextHourlyRefresh } from "./constants";
 6  
 7  /**
 8   * "New regular listings join after the hourly refresh. Priority listings appear
 9   * immediately."
10   *
11   * Decides, at publish time, whether a listing goes straight onto the feed or waits
12   * for the next top of the hour. This is the concrete thing the Priority fee buys, so
13   * it is enforced server-side at the moment of publication — a client cannot choose
14   * its own visibility because it cannot write these fields at all.
15   */
16  export function visibilityFor(pkg: ListingPackage, nowMillis: number) {
17    if (pkg === "Priority") {
18      return { isVisible: true, visibleFrom: Timestamp.fromMillis(nowMillis) };
19    }
20    return { isVisible: false, visibleFrom: Timestamp.fromMillis(nextHourlyRefresh(nowMillis)) };
21  }
22  
23  /**
24   * Flips queued listings onto the feed once their slot arrives.
25   *
26   * Runs every 15 minutes rather than hourly on purpose: `visibleFrom` is always a top
27   * of the hour, so the gate below is what decides when a listing appears, and a more
28   * frequent sweep simply means a single failed run delays a listing by minutes instead
29   * of by a full hour. Nothing can surface early.
30   */
31  export const publishScheduledListings = onSchedule(
32    { schedule: "every 15 minutes", region: REGION },
33    async () => {
34      const now = Timestamp.now();
35  
36      const due = await db
37        .collection("listings")
38        .where("status", "==", LISTING_STATUS.active)
39        .where("isVisible", "==", false)
40        .where("visibleFrom", "<=", now)
41        .limit(300)
42        .get();
43  
44      if (due.empty) return;
45  
46      const batch = db.batch();
47      for (const doc of due.docs) {
48        batch.update(doc.ref, { isVisible: true, becameVisibleAt: now });
49      }
50      await batch.commit();
51  
52      logger.info("publishScheduledListings: released to the feed", { count: due.size });
53    }
54  );
```

### functions/src/mailRateLimit.ts

```typescript
 1  import * as crypto from "crypto";
 2  import { HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
 3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
 4  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
 5  import { db } from "./admin";
 6  import { OTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_WINDOW, OTP_SEND_WINDOW_MINUTES } from "./constants";
 7  
 8  /**
 9   * A rolling-window cap on how many codes one address can be mailed, on top of the
10   * per-send cooldown.
11   *
12   * The cooldown alone only sets the *rate*: a script could still hold an address at one
13   * code a minute indefinitely, which is 1,440 emails a day into someone's inbox, all of
14   * them from us and all of them counting against the Brevo plan. This sets the *total*.
15   *
16   * Counters live in `mailRateLimits/{sha256(email)}`, separate from the challenge
17   * documents on purpose — those are deleted when a code is spent, expires or is burned by
18   * wrong guesses, which would hand the limit straight back. firestore.rules does not
19   * expose this collection to clients at all.
20   *
21   * Both signed-in and signed-out senders key on the address rather than the uid or the
22   * caller's IP: the address is what receives the mail, and it is the one identifier
23   * present in all three flows (sendEmailOtp, startSignup, startPasswordReset).
24   */
25  
26  const WINDOW_MS = OTP_SEND_WINDOW_MINUTES * 60_000;
27  
28  /**
29   * How long a spent counter is kept. A Firestore TTL policy on `expiresAt` sweeps these —
30   * without one the collection grows one document per address forever. See the README.
31   */
32  const RETENTION_MS = WINDOW_MS * 2;
33  
34  function rateLimitRef(email: string) {
35    const hash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(email).digest("hex");
36    return db.collection("mailRateLimits").doc(hash);
37  }
38  
39  /** Minutes, for a message a student can act on. */
40  function retryAfterText(windowEndsAt: number): string {
41    const minutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((windowEndsAt - Date.now()) / 60_000));
42    return minutes === 1 ? "a minute" : `${minutes} minutes`;
43  }
44  
45  /**
46   * Charges one send against `email`'s allowance, or throws `resource-exhausted`.
47   *
48   * Called *before* the send and in one transaction, so two requests racing cannot both
49   * see the last slot. A send that then fails is not refunded: retrying a mailer that just
50   * rejected us is not what we want to make cheap, and the window rolls off on its own.
51   */
52  export async function consumeMailAllowance(email: string): Promise<void> {
53    const ref = rateLimitRef(email);
54  
55    const exhaustedUntil = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
56      const snapshot = await tx.get(ref);
57      const now = Timestamp.now();
58      const data = snapshot.data();
59  
60      const startedAt = data?.["windowStartedAt"] as Timestamp | undefined;
61      const windowIsCurrent = startedAt !== undefined && now.toMillis() - startedAt.toMillis() < WINDOW_MS;
62      const sent = windowIsCurrent ? ((data?.["sent"] as number | undefined) ?? 0) : 0;
63  
64      if (sent >= OTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_WINDOW) {
65        // Reported by the caller, not thrown here: throwing inside a transaction would
66        // have it retried before the error surfaced.
67        return startedAt!.toMillis() + WINDOW_MS;
68      }
69  
70      const windowStartedAt = windowIsCurrent ? startedAt! : now;
71      tx.set(ref, {
72        windowStartedAt,
73        sent: sent + 1,
74        lastSentAt: now,
75        expiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(windowStartedAt.toMillis() + RETENTION_MS),
76      });
77      return null;
78    });
79  
80    if (exhaustedUntil !== null) {
81      logger.warn("mail rate limit hit", { challenge: ref.id });
82      throw new HttpsError(
83        "resource-exhausted",
84        `Too many codes requested for this email. Try again in ${retryAfterText(exhaustedUntil)}.`
85      );
86    }
87  }
```

```typescript
 1  import { MailMessage } from "./brevo";

 3  
 4  /**
 5   * The one card layout both code emails share, so a change to the NUTrade look lands in
 6   * both at once. Kept as inline-styled tables on purpose: Gmail and Outlook strip
 7   * <style> blocks, and a flex layout collapses into a single unreadable column.

 9  function codeCard(options: {
10    heading: string;
11    blurb: string;
12    code: string;
13    footer: string;
14  }): string {

22              <p style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8A93AD;">NUTrade</p>
23              <h1 style="margin:0 0 16px;font-size:21px;color:#1C2C58;">${options.heading}</h1>
24              <p style="margin:0 0 24px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;color:#41496A;">

26              </p>
27              <p style="margin:0 0 24px;font-size:34px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#1C2C58;">${options.code}</p>

29                ${options.footer}
30              </p>
31            </td></tr>
32          </table>
33        </td></tr>
34      </table>
35    </body>
36  </html>`;

38  
39  /** The registration / email-verification code. */
40  export function otpEmail(code: string): MailMessage {

42      subject: `${code} is your NUTrade code`,
43      text:
44        `Your NUTrade verification code is ${code}.\n\n` +
45        `It expires in ${OTP_TTL_MINUTES} minutes. If you didn't try to sign in to NUTrade, ` +
46        `you can ignore this email — nobody can use the code without your account.\n`,
47      html: codeCard({
48        heading: "Confirm your email",
49        blurb: "Enter this code in the app to finish setting up your account.",
50        code,
51        footer:
52          `The code expires in ${OTP_TTL_MINUTES} minutes. If you didn't try to sign in to ` +
53          `NUTrade, you can ignore this email.`,

57  
58  /**
59   * The password-reset code. Deliberately blunt about what to do if it was unexpected:
60   * this is the one email that, acted on by the wrong person, hands over an account.
61   */
62  export function passwordResetEmail(code: string): MailMessage {
63    return {
64      subject: `${code} is your NUTrade password reset code`,
65      text:
66        `Your NUTrade password reset code is ${code}.\n\n` +
67        `It expires in ${PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES} minutes. If you didn't ask to reset your ` +
68        `NUTrade password, ignore this email — your password has not changed.\n`,
69      html: codeCard({
70        heading: "Reset your password",
71        blurb: "Enter this code in the app, then choose a new password.",
72        code,
73        footer:
74          `The code expires in ${PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES} minutes. If you didn't ask to ` +
75          `reset your NUTrade password, ignore this email — your password has not changed.`,
76      }),
77    };
78  }
```

### functions/src/matching.ts

```typescript
  1  import {
  2    DocumentData,
  3    DocumentReference,
  4    DocumentSnapshot,
  5    QueryDocumentSnapshot,
  6    Timestamp,
  7    Transaction,
  8  } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  9  import { db } from "./admin";
 10  import { BID_STATUS, LISTING_STATUS } from "./constants";
 11  
 12  /** Bids that still count towards the auction — neither the seller nor the bidder has killed them. */
 13  const LIVE_BID_STATUSES: string[] = [BID_STATUS.pending, BID_STATUS.outbid];
 14  
 15  export function pesos(centavos: number): string {
 16    return `₱${(centavos / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
 17  }
 18  
 19  /**
 20   * Awards `listingRef` to `bidSnap` and opens the chat room the two of them trade in.
 21   *
 22   * No order is created: the winner's commitment deposit is already held, and the rest of
 23   * the price is settled in person. The listing goes to `pending_meetup` rather than
 24   * `matched` — they still have to meet and hand the item over before this is a completed
 25   * trade, and `markTradeCompleted` is what releases the deposit to the seller.
 26   *
 27   * Write-only — callers must have finished every transaction read before calling.
 28   */
 29  export function awardListing(
 30    tx: Transaction,
 31    listingRef: DocumentReference,
 32    listing: DocumentData,
 33    bidSnap: DocumentSnapshot | QueryDocumentSnapshot,
 34    now: Timestamp
 35  ): { chatId: string } {
 36    const bid = bidSnap.data()!;
 37    const chatRef = db.collection("chats").doc();
 38  
 39    tx.set(chatRef, {
 40      listingId: listingRef.id,
 41      listingTitle: listing.title ?? "",
 42      sellerUid: listing.ownerUid,
 43      buyerUid: bid.bidderUid,
 44      participantUids: [listing.ownerUid, bid.bidderUid],
 45      winningBidCentavos: bid.amountCentavos,
 46      winningBidId: bidSnap.id,
 47      lastMessage: "Auction won — arrange your meetup here.",
 48      lastMessageAt: now,
 49      status: "active",
 50      // Both UIDs must land here before the trade closes out; see markTradeCompleted.
 51      completedBy: [],
 52      createdAt: now,
 53    });
 54  
 55    tx.set(chatRef.collection("messages").doc(), {
 56      senderUid: "system",
 57      text:
 58        `Winning bid ${pesos(bid.amountCentavos as number)} on "${listing.title ?? "this item"}". ` +
 59        `Your deposit is held until the handover. Agree on a campus meetup here, then ` +
 60        `both of you tap "Mark completed".`,
 61      type: "system",
 62      sentAt: now,
 63    });
 64  
 65    tx.update(bidSnap.ref, {
 66      status: BID_STATUS.approved,
 67      chatId: chatRef.id,
 68      approvedAt: now,
 69    });
 70    tx.update(listingRef, {
 71      status: LISTING_STATUS.pendingMeetup,
 72      winningBidId: bidSnap.id,
 73      matchedAt: now,
 74    });
 75  
 76    return { chatId: chatRef.id };
 77  }
 78  
 79  /**
 80   * Re-derives a listing's denormalized `currentHighestBidCentavos` / `highestBidderUid` /
 81   * `bidCount` from its surviving bids, and promotes the new top bid back to `pending`.
 82   *
 83   * Needed because declining or withdrawing the top bid would otherwise leave the listing
 84   * advertising a bid nobody stands behind. Read-then-write, so call it before any other
 85   * write in the transaction.
 86   */
 87  export async function recomputeTopBid(
 88    tx: Transaction,
 89    listingRef: DocumentReference,
 90    listing: DocumentData,
 91    now: Timestamp,
 92    excludeBidId?: string
 93  ): Promise<void> {
 94    const snap = await tx.get(listingRef.collection("bids"));
 95  
 96    const live = snap.docs
 97      .filter((d) => d.id !== excludeBidId && LIVE_BID_STATUSES.includes(d.data().status))
 98      .sort((a, b) => (b.data().amountCentavos as number) - (a.data().amountCentavos as number));
 99  
100    if (live.length === 0) {
101      tx.update(listingRef, {
102        currentHighestBidCentavos: (listing.startingBidCentavos as number) ?? 0,
103        highestBidderUid: null,
104        bidCount: 0,
105      });
106      return;
107    }
108  
109    const [top, ...rest] = live;
110    if (top.data().status !== BID_STATUS.pending) {
111      tx.update(top.ref, { status: BID_STATUS.pending, promotedAt: now });
112    }
113    for (const doc of rest) {
114      if (doc.data().status === BID_STATUS.pending) {
115        tx.update(doc.ref, { status: BID_STATUS.outbid, outbidAt: now });
116      }
117    }
118  
119    tx.update(listingRef, {
120      currentHighestBidCentavos: top.data().amountCentavos,
121      highestBidderUid: top.data().bidderUid,
122      bidCount: live.length,
123    });
124  }
```

### functions/src/notify.ts

```typescript
 1  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
 2  import { FieldValue } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
 3  import { getMessaging } from "firebase-admin/messaging";
 4  import { db } from "./admin";
 5  
 6  /**
 7   * Best-effort push notification — the state it announces is already committed by
 8   * the time this runs, so a messaging failure (bad/stale token, client not yet
 9   * wired for FCM) must never fail the caller. Reads `users/{uid}.fcmTokens`
10   * (string[]), which nothing currently populates client-side; sends silently
11   * no-op until that registration ships.
12   */
13  export async function notifyUser(
14    uid: string,
15    message: { title: string; body: string; data: Record<string, string> }
16  ): Promise<void> {
17    try {
18      const userSnap = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
19      const tokens = (userSnap.data()?.["fcmTokens"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
20      if (tokens.length === 0) return;
21  
22      const response = await getMessaging().sendEachForMulticast({
23        tokens,
24        notification: { title: message.title, body: message.body },
25        data: message.data,
26      });
27  
28      const staleTokens = tokens.filter((_, i) => {
29        const err = response.responses[i].error;
30        return err?.code === "messaging/registration-token-not-registered";
31      });
32      if (staleTokens.length > 0) {
33        await db.collection("users").doc(uid).update({
34          fcmTokens: FieldValue.arrayRemove(...staleTokens),
35        });
36      }
37    } catch (err) {
38      logger.warn("notifyUser: failed, ignoring", { uid, data: message.data, err });
39    }
40  }
```
