### functions/src/orders.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError, CallableRequest } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import { onSchedule } from "firebase-functions/v2/scheduler";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import {
  5    DocumentData,
  6    DocumentReference,
  7    DocumentSnapshot,
  8    QueryDocumentSnapshot,
  9    Timestamp,
 10    Transaction,
 11  } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
 12  import { db } from "./admin";
 13  import { PayMongoClient, mintQrPhPayment, paymentUnavailable } from "./paymongo";
 14  import { paymongoSecretKey } from "./createQrPayment";
 15  import {
 16    ORDER_PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS,
 17    ORDER_STATUS,
 18    QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS,
 19    REGION,
 20    orderReference,
 21  } from "./constants";
 22  
 23  /**
 24   * An order is what a won auction turns into: the winning bidder owes the seller the bid
 25   * amount, and has ORDER_PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS to pay before the bid is released and the
 26   * auction reopens.
 27   *
 28   * Settlement is PayMongo QR Ph — the same three calls the seller's listing fee uses. That
 29   * matters for integrity: the money is confirmed by a signed webhook from PayMongo, never
 30   * by either student asserting it. Neither side can move an order to `paid`, and
 31   * firestore.rules denies all client writes here, so nobody can take an item without
 32   * actually having paid for it.
 33   *
 34   * The QR itself expires in ~10 minutes while the order lives for 24 hours, so the payment
 35   * screen can mint a fresh code as often as the buyer needs within that window.
 36   */
 37  
 38  /**
 39   * Creates the order alongside the chat when an auction is awarded. Write-only, so every
 40   * transaction read must already be done. Returns the new order id.
 41   */
 42  export function createOrderForWinningBid(
 43    tx: Transaction,
 44    listingRef: DocumentReference,
 45    listing: DocumentData,
 46    bidSnap: DocumentSnapshot | QueryDocumentSnapshot,
 47    chatId: string,
 48    now: Timestamp
 49  ): string {
 50    const bid = bidSnap.data()!;
 51    const orderRef = db.collection("orders").doc();
 52  
 53    tx.set(orderRef, {
 54      listingId: listingRef.id,
 55      listingTitle: listing.title ?? "",
 56      listingPhoto: (listing.photos as string[] | undefined)?.[0] ?? null,
 57      bidId: bidSnap.id,
 58      chatId,
 59      sellerUid: listing.ownerUid,
 60      buyerUid: bid.bidderUid,
 61      buyerName: bid.bidderName ?? "",
 62      participantUids: [listing.ownerUid, bid.bidderUid],
 63      amountCentavos: bid.amountCentavos,
 64      reference: orderReference(),
 65      status: ORDER_STATUS.awaitingPayment,
 66      dueAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + ORDER_PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS * 3_600_000),
 67      createdAt: now,
 68      // Filled in by createOrderQrPayment, refreshed whenever the code expires.
 69      paymongoIntentId: null,
 70      qrImageUrl: null,
 71      qrImageBase64: null,
 72      qrPayload: null,
 73      qrExpiresAt: null,
 74      paidAt: null,
 75    });
 76  
 77    return orderRef.id;
 78  }
 79  
 80  /** Loads an order and checks the caller really is the buyer on it. */
 81  async function loadBuyerOrder(
 82    request: CallableRequest
 83  ): Promise<{ uid: string; ref: DocumentReference; order: DocumentData }> {
 84    const auth = request.auth;
 85    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 86  
 87    const { orderId } = (request.data ?? {}) as { orderId?: string };
 88    if (!orderId) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "orderId is required.");
 89  
 90    const ref = db.collection("orders").doc(orderId);
 91    const snap = await ref.get();
 92    if (!snap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "That order no longer exists.");
 93  
 94    const order = snap.data()!;
 95    if (order.buyerUid !== auth.uid) {
 96      throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Only the winning bidder can pay for this.");
 97    }
 98  
 99    if (order.status === ORDER_STATUS.released) {
100      throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "The payment window closed and the bid was released.");
101    }
102    if (order.status === ORDER_STATUS.paid) {
103      throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This order is already paid.");
104    }
105    if (order.status === ORDER_STATUS.cancelled) {
106      throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This order was cancelled.");
107    }
108  
109    return { uid: auth.uid, ref, order };
110  }
111  
112  /**
113   * Mints a QR Ph code the winning bidder scans to pay the seller.
114   *
115   * Returning a code says nothing about payment: only paymongoWebhook moves the order to
116   * `paid`. Safe to call repeatedly — a QR lapses after about ten minutes while the order
117   * stands for a day, so the payment screen re-mints on demand. A still-valid code is
118   * handed back rather than stacking another intent against the same order.
119   */
120  export const createOrderQrPayment = onCall(
121    { secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: REGION },
122    async (request) => {
123      const { ref, order } = await loadBuyerOrder(request);
124      const now = Timestamp.now();
125  
126      const existingExpiry = order.qrExpiresAt as Timestamp | null | undefined;
127      if (existingExpiry && existingExpiry.toMillis() > now.toMillis() + 30_000) {
128        return {
129          reused: true,
130          qrImageUrl: order.qrImageUrl ?? null,
131          qrImageBase64: order.qrImageBase64 ?? null,
132          qrPayload: order.qrPayload ?? null,
133          amountCentavos: order.amountCentavos,
134          expiresAt: existingExpiry.toMillis(),
135          reference: order.reference,
136        };
137      }
138  
139      const buyerSnap = await db.collection("users").doc(order.buyerUid as string).get();
140      const buyer = buyerSnap.data() ?? {};
141  
142      const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
143      let minted;
144      try {
145        minted = await mintQrPhPayment(client, {
146          amountCentavos: order.amountCentavos as number,
147          description: `NUTrade winning bid — ${order.listingTitle} (${order.reference})`,
148          billingName: (buyer.displayName as string) ?? "NUTrade student",
149          billingEmail: (buyer.email as string) ?? "",
150        });
151      } catch (err) {
152        throw paymentUnavailable(err);
153      }
154      const { intentId, qr } = minted;
155  
156      const expiresAt = Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + QR_EXPIRY_SECONDS * 1000);
157      await ref.update({
158        paymongoIntentId: intentId,
159        qrImageUrl: qr.qrImageUrl ?? null,
160        qrImageBase64: qr.qrImageBase64 ?? null,
161        qrPayload: qr.qrPayload ?? null,
162        qrExpiresAt: expiresAt,
163      });
164  
165      logger.info("createOrderQrPayment: code issued", { orderId: ref.id, intentId });
166  
167      return {
168        reused: false,
169        qrImageUrl: qr.qrImageUrl ?? null,
170        qrImageBase64: qr.qrImageBase64 ?? null,
171        qrPayload: qr.qrPayload ?? null,
172        amountCentavos: order.amountCentavos,
173        expiresAt: expiresAt.toMillis(),
174        reference: order.reference,
175      };
176    }
177  );
178  
179  /**
180   * Settles a paid order from the PayMongo webhook, matched on the payment intent the QR
181   * was minted against. Returns false when nothing matched so the webhook can fall through
182   * to its other handlers instead of treating it as an error.
183   */
184  export async function settleOrderPaid(intentId: string | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
185    if (!intentId) return false;
186  
187    const found = await db
188      .collection("orders")
189      .where("paymongoIntentId", "==", intentId)
190      .limit(1)
191      .get();
192    if (found.empty) return false;
193  
194    const snap = found.docs[0];
195    const order = snap.data();
196    if (order.status === ORDER_STATUS.paid) return true; // PayMongo retried the same event.
197  
198    const now = Timestamp.now();
199    await snap.ref.update({ status: ORDER_STATUS.paid, paidAt: now });
200  
201    await db.collection("chats").doc(order.chatId as string).collection("messages").doc().set({
202      senderUid: "system",
203      text:
204        `Payment of ₱${((order.amountCentavos as number) / 100).toFixed(2)} received ` +
205        `(${order.reference}). Arrange the handover, then both tap Mark completed.`,
206      type: "system",
207      sentAt: now,
208    });
209  
210    logger.info("settleOrderPaid: order paid", { orderId: snap.id, intentId });
211    return true;
212  }
213  
214  /**
215   * Releases bids whose payment window closed unpaid. The auction goes back to `active`
216   * with the bid struck out, so the seller can approve someone else rather than being stuck
217   * behind a buyer who never paid.
218   */
219  export const releaseUnpaidOrders = onSchedule(
220    { schedule: "every 5 minutes", region: REGION },
221    async () => {
222      const now = Timestamp.now();
223      const due = await db
224        .collection("orders")
225        .where("status", "==", ORDER_STATUS.awaitingPayment)
226        .where("dueAt", "<=", now)
227        .limit(100)
228        .get();
229  
230      if (due.empty) return;
231      logger.info("releaseUnpaidOrders: releasing", { count: due.size });
232  
233      for (const orderDoc of due.docs) {
234        const order = orderDoc.data();
235        try {
236          await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
237            const fresh = await tx.get(orderDoc.ref);
238            // Re-check inside the transaction: the webhook may have landed meanwhile.
239            if (!fresh.exists || fresh.data()!.status !== ORDER_STATUS.awaitingPayment) return;
240  
241            const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(order.listingId as string);
242            const listingSnap = await tx.get(listingRef);
243  
244            tx.update(orderDoc.ref, { status: ORDER_STATUS.released, releasedAt: now });
245            tx.update(listingRef.collection("bids").doc(order.bidId as string), {
246              status: "released",
247              releasedAt: now,
248            });
249  
250            // Only reopen a listing still sitting on this order's sale.
251            if (listingSnap.exists && listingSnap.data()!.status === "matched") {
252              tx.update(listingRef, {
253                status: "active",
254                winningBidId: null,
255                orderId: null,
256                matchedAt: null,
257                reopenedAt: now,
258              });
259            }
260  
261            tx.set(db.collection("chats").doc(order.chatId as string).collection("messages").doc(), {
262              senderUid: "system",
263              text: "Payment window closed with no payment, so the bid was released and the auction reopened.",
264              type: "system",
265              sentAt: now,
266            });
267          });
268        } catch (err) {
269          logger.error("releaseUnpaidOrders: failed", { orderId: orderDoc.id, err });
270        }
271      }
272    }
273  );
```

### functions/src/passwordReset.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as crypto from "crypto";
  2  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";
  5  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  6  import { db } from "./admin";
  7  import { mailSecrets, sendMail } from "./brevo";
  8  import { consumeMailAllowance } from "./mailRateLimit";
  9  import { generateCode, hashCode, maskEmail, timingSafeEquals } from "./emailOtp";
 10  import { passwordResetEmail } from "./mailTemplates";
 11  import {
 12    OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
 13    OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
 14    PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES,
 15    PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES,
 16    REGION,
 17  } from "./constants";
 18  
 19  /**
 20   * Forgot password, the same shape as registration: email → six-digit code → new
 21   * password. The code goes out through Brevo.
 22   *
 23   * Firebase Auth's own `sendPasswordResetEmail` is deliberately not used. It mails from
 24   * Google's servers with Google's template and drops the student into a web page, so it
 25   * could not go through Brevo at all, and it would be the one flow in the app that leaves
 26   * the app. This keeps the student on one screen and every email on one provider.
 27   *
 28   * Like the signup callables these are open to signed-out callers by necessity. What
 29   * limits abuse: one code per address per OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS
 30   * guesses per code, and codes and tokens stored only as hashes in
 31   * `passwordResetChallenges`, which firestore.rules does not expose to clients at all.
 32   */
 33  
 34  const MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8;
 35  
 36  /** Said to everyone, whether or not the address has an account — see startPasswordReset. */
 37  const START_AGAIN = "That reset has expired. Ask for a new code.";
 38  
 39  function sha256(value: string): string {
 40    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
 41  }
 42  
 43  /** Lowercased and trimmed; the same shape check as NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail. */
 44  function normalizeEmail(raw: unknown): string {
 45    const email = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
 46    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
 47      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter a valid email address.");
 48    }
 49    return email;
 50  }
 51  
 52  /** Keyed by a hash so the document id never carries the address itself. */
 53  function challengeRef(email: string) {
 54    return db.collection("passwordResetChallenges").doc(sha256(email));
 55  }
 56  
 57  /**
 58   * The account behind an address, or null when there is none.
 59   *
 60   * A `rejected` account is treated as none at all: an admin who revoked it with
 61   * setUserVerification should not watch the student reset their way back in, and the
 62   * caller says nothing either way, so this reveals nothing a stranger could use.
 63   */
 64  async function resettableUid(email: string): Promise<string | null> {
 65    let uid: string;
 66    try {
 67      ({ uid } = await getAuth().getUserByEmail(email));
 68    } catch (err) {
 69      if ((err as { code?: string }).code === "auth/user-not-found") return null;
 70      throw err;
 71    }
 72  
 73    const profile = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
 74    if (profile.data()?.["verificationStatus"] === "rejected") {
 75      logger.warn("startPasswordReset: refused a blocked account", { uid });
 76      return null;
 77    }
 78    return uid;
 79  }
 80  
 81  /**
 82   * Step 1: mail a six-digit code to an address that has an account.
 83   *
 84   * The reply is the same whether or not the address is registered. Registration already
 85   * discloses that much — startSignup answers "an account with this email already exists" —
 86   * so this is not a guarantee about the system as a whole; it just declines to be a second
 87   * oracle, on the endpoint a stranger would reach for to test a list of addresses.
 88   */
 89  export const startPasswordReset = onCall({ secrets: mailSecrets, region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 90    const email = normalizeEmail(request.data?.email);
 91    const quiet = {
 92      sentTo: maskEmail(email),
 93      expiresInSeconds: PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES * 60,
 94      resendAfterSeconds: OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
 95    };
 96  
 97    const ref = challengeRef(email);
 98    const now = Timestamp.now();
 99  
100    const lastSentAt = (await ref.get()).data()?.lastSentAt as Timestamp | undefined;
101    if (lastSentAt) {
102      const elapsedSeconds = (now.toMillis() - lastSentAt.toMillis()) / 1000;
103      if (elapsedSeconds < OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) {
104        throw new HttpsError(
105          "resource-exhausted",
106          `Wait ${Math.ceil(OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS - elapsedSeconds)}s before asking for another code.`
107        );
108      }
109    }
110  
111    // Charged before the account lookup on purpose: an address with no account spends its
112    // allowance too, so a caller cannot tell the two apart by whether the cap ever trips.
113    await consumeMailAllowance(email);
114  
115    const uid = await resettableUid(email);
116    if (!uid) {
117      // No challenge document, so nothing to brute-force and nothing to fill Firestore
118      // with. The student sees the same screen and simply never gets an email.
119      logger.info("startPasswordReset: no account for that address");
120      return quiet;
121    }
122  
123    const code = generateCode();
124    const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
125  
126    // Written before the send: a code that reached the inbox but was never recorded
127    // would be unusable, which is the worse of the two failure modes.
128    await ref.set({
129      uid,
130      email,
131      salt,
132      codeHash: hashCode(code, salt),
133      attempts: 0,
134      createdAt: now,
135      lastSentAt: now,
136      expiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000),
137      tokenHash: null,
138      tokenExpiresAt: null,
139    });
140  
141    await sendMail(email, passwordResetEmail(code));
142    logger.info("startPasswordReset: code issued", { uid });
143  
144    return quiet;
145  });
146  
147  /**
148   * Step 2: check the code. Success spends the code and hands back a one-time reset
149   * token — 256 random bits, stored only as a hash — that completePasswordReset requires.
150   */
151  export const verifyPasswordResetCode = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
152    const email = normalizeEmail(request.data?.email);
153    const submitted = String(request.data?.code ?? "").trim();
154    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(submitted)) {
155      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.");
156    }
157  
158    const ref = challengeRef(email);
159    const challenge = (await ref.get()).data();
160    if (!challenge || !challenge.codeHash) {
161      throw new HttpsError("not-found", "That code has expired. Ask for a new one.");
162    }
163  
164    const now = Timestamp.now();
165    if ((challenge.expiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis() <= now.toMillis()) {
166      await ref.delete();
167      throw new HttpsError("deadline-exceeded", "That code has expired. Ask for a new one.");
168    }
169  
170    const attempts = (challenge.attempts as number) ?? 0;
171    if (attempts >= OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
172      await ref.delete();
173      throw new HttpsError("resource-exhausted", "Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.");
174    }
175  
176    if (!timingSafeEquals(hashCode(submitted, challenge.salt as string), challenge.codeHash as string)) {
177      await ref.update({ attempts: attempts + 1 });
178      const left = OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS - (attempts + 1);
179      throw new HttpsError(
180        "permission-denied",
181        left > 0 ? `That code isn't right. ${left} attempt${left === 1 ? "" : "s"} left.` : "That code isn't right."
182      );
183    }
184  
185    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
186    await ref.update({
187      codeHash: null,
188      verifiedAt: now,
189      tokenHash: sha256(token),
190      tokenExpiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000),
191    });
192  
193    return { resetToken: token };
194  });
195  
196  /**
197   * Step 3: set the new password.
198   *
199   * Every other session is signed out at the same time. Someone resetting because their
200   * password leaked is not helped by a new password that leaves the thief's existing
201   * refresh token working.
202   */
203  export const completePasswordReset = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
204    const data = request.data ?? {};
205    const email = normalizeEmail(data.email);
206    const password = typeof data.password === "string" ? data.password : "";
207    if (password.length < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
208      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", `Use at least ${MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters for your password.`);
209    }
210  
211    const ref = challengeRef(email);
212    const challenge = (await ref.get()).data();
213    const token = typeof data.resetToken === "string" ? data.resetToken : "";
214    if (!challenge?.tokenHash || !token || !timingSafeEquals(sha256(token), challenge.tokenHash as string)) {
215      throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", START_AGAIN);
216    }
217    if ((challenge.tokenExpiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis() <= Date.now()) {
218      await ref.delete();
219      throw new HttpsError("deadline-exceeded", START_AGAIN);
220    }
221  
222    const uid = challenge.uid as string;
223    try {
224      await getAuth().updateUser(uid, { password });
225    } catch (err) {
226      const code = (err as { code?: string }).code;
227      if (code === "auth/invalid-password") {
228        throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Choose a stronger password.");
229      }
230      // The account was deleted between the code and this call. Nothing to reset.
231      if (code === "auth/user-not-found") {
232        await ref.delete();
233        throw new HttpsError("not-found", START_AGAIN);
234      }
235      throw err;
236    }
237  
238    await getAuth().revokeRefreshTokens(uid);
239    await ref.delete();
240    logger.info("completePasswordReset: password changed", { uid });
241  
242    return { reset: true };
243  });
```

### functions/src/paymongo.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  2  import { HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  3  
  4  const PAYMONGO_BASE_URL = "https://api.paymongo.com/v1";
  5  
  6  /**
  7   * A rejection from PayMongo, carrying the HTTP status so callers can tell "our account is
  8   * misconfigured" (401) from "the network wobbled" — they need very different messages.
  9   */
 10  export class PayMongoError extends Error {
 11    constructor(message: string, readonly status: number) {
 12      super(message);
 13      this.name = "PayMongoError";
 14    }
 15  }
 16  
 17  /**
 18   * Turns a PayMongo failure into something safe to show a student.
 19   *
 20   * A 401 means *our* secret key is wrong — which is not the student's problem and not
 21   * something retrying fixes, so it says so plainly rather than surfacing as a bare
 22   * "INTERNAL". PayMongo's own wording is never passed through: it talks about API keys.
 23   */
 24  export function paymentUnavailable(err: unknown): HttpsError {
 25    if (err instanceof PayMongoError && err.status === 401) {
 26      logger.error("PayMongo rejected our secret key — PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY is wrong or unset");
 27      return new HttpsError(
 28        "failed-precondition",
 29        "Payments aren't set up yet. Let a NUTrade admin know — this isn't something you did."
 30      );
 31    }
 32    return new HttpsError(
 33      "unavailable",
 34      "Couldn't reach the payment provider. Try again in a moment."
 35    );
 36  }
 37  
 38  /**
 39   * Thin wrapper over the PayMongo REST API. PayMongo uses HTTP Basic auth with
 40   * the secret key as the username and an empty password.
 41   *
 42   * NOTE on response shapes: PayMongo's Payment Intent / Payment Method / QRPh
 43   * "next_action" payload has a couple of documented variants (a hosted
 44   * `redirect.url` for e-wallets like GCash, and a `code.image_url` /
 45   * `code.image` for inline QR rendering). We extract every field we can find
 46   * defensively and log the raw response, so the first real test call can be
 47   * used to confirm/adjust the exact path — see `extractQrFromNextAction`.
 48   */
 49  export class PayMongoClient {
 50    constructor(private readonly secretKey: string) {}
 51  
 52    private authHeader(): string {
 53      const token = Buffer.from(`${this.secretKey}:`).toString("base64");
 54      return `Basic ${token}`;
 55    }
 56  
 57    private async request<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
 58      const res = await fetch(`${PAYMONGO_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
 59        method,
 60        headers: {
 61          "Content-Type": "application/json",
 62          "Authorization": this.authHeader(),
 63        },
 64        body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
 65      });
 66  
 67      const json = (await res.json()) as unknown;
 68      if (!res.ok) {
 69        logger.error("PayMongo API error", { path, status: res.status, body: json });
 70        const message =
 71          (json as { errors?: Array<{ detail?: string }> })?.errors?.[0]?.detail ??
 72          `PayMongo request failed with status ${res.status}`;
 73        throw new PayMongoError(message, res.status);
 74      }
 75      return json as T;
 76    }
 77  
 78    /** Creates a Payment Intent for the given amount (centavos, PHP). */
 79    async createPaymentIntent(amountCentavos: number, description: string) {
 80      return this.request<PaymongoResource>("POST", "/payment_intents", {
 81        data: {
 82          attributes: {
 83            amount: amountCentavos,
 84            currency: "PHP",
 85            capture_type: "automatic",
 86            payment_method_allowed: ["qrph"],
 87            payment_method_options: { qrph: { auto_capture: true } },
 88            description,
 89          },
 90        },
 91      });
 92    }
 93  
 94    /** Creates a QRPh Payment Method. */
 95    async createQrPhPaymentMethod(billingName: string, billingEmail: string) {
 96      return this.request<PaymongoResource>("POST", "/payment_methods", {
 97        data: {
 98          attributes: {
 99            type: "qrph",
100            billing: { name: billingName, email: billingEmail },
101          },
102        },
103      });
104    }
105  
106    /** Attaches a Payment Method to a Payment Intent, triggering QR generation. */
107    async attachPaymentMethod(paymentIntentId: string, paymentMethodId: string, clientKey: string) {
108      return this.request<PaymongoResource>(
109        "POST",
110        `/payment_intents/${paymentIntentId}/attach`,
111        {
112          data: {
113            attributes: {
114              payment_method: paymentMethodId,
115              client_key: clientKey,
116            },
117          },
118        }
119      );
120    }
121  
122    async retrievePaymentIntent(paymentIntentId: string) {
123      return this.request<PaymongoResource>("GET", `/payment_intents/${paymentIntentId}`);
124    }
125  
126    /**
127     * Refunds a *payment*, not an intent — PayMongo refunds the charge, and an intent can
128     * hold more than one. Use {@link paymentIdFromIntent} to get the id.
129     *
130     * QR Ph is refundable by API, with one hole: a QR Ph payment made through **Maya**
131     * checkout cannot be refunded at all, and Maya partial refunds are barred until the
132     * following day. Callers must have a path that does not depend on this succeeding.
133     */
134    async createRefund(paymentId: string, amountCentavos: number, reason: string) {
135      return this.request<PaymongoResource>("POST", "/refunds", {
136        data: {
137          attributes: {
138            amount: amountCentavos,
139            payment_id: paymentId,
140            reason,
141          },
142        },
143      });
144    }
145  }
146  
147  /** The id of the settled charge behind an intent, or null when nothing was captured. */
148  export function paymentIdFromIntent(resource: PaymongoResource): string | null {
149    const payments = resource.data.attributes["payments"] as Array<{ id?: string; attributes?: { status?: string } }> | undefined;
150    if (!Array.isArray(payments)) return null;
151  
152    const paid = payments.find((p) => p?.attributes?.status === "paid") ?? payments[0];
153    return paid?.id ?? null;
154  }
155  
156  export interface PaymongoResource {
157    data: {
158      id: string;
159      type: string;
160      attributes: Record<string, unknown>;
161    };
162  }
163  
164  /**
165   * Best-effort extraction of a renderable QR (image URL, base64 image, or raw
166   * payload) plus an optional hosted checkout URL from a Payment Intent's
167   * `next_action`. Logs the raw shape so it can be corrected from real traffic.
168   */
169  export function extractQrFromNextAction(resource: PaymongoResource): {
170    qrImageUrl?: string;
171    qrImageBase64?: string;
172    qrPayload?: string;
173    redirectUrl?: string;
174    /** ISO time PayMongo stops accepting this code (seen live: ~30 minutes after minting). */
175    expiresAt?: string;
176  } {
177    const nextAction = resource.data.attributes["next_action"] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
178    logger.info("PayMongo next_action", { paymentIntentId: resource.data.id, nextAction });
179  
180    if (!nextAction) return {};
181  
182    const code = nextAction["code"] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
183    const redirect = nextAction["redirect"] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
184  
185    return {
186      qrImageUrl: (code?.["image_url"] as string) ?? undefined,
187      qrImageBase64: (code?.["image"] as string) ?? undefined,
188      qrPayload: (code?.["data"] as string) ?? (code?.["payload"] as string) ?? undefined,
189      redirectUrl: (redirect?.["url"] as string) ?? undefined,
190      expiresAt: (code?.["expires_at"] as string) ?? undefined,
191    };
192  }
193  
194  /**
195   * PayMongo's own word that a Payment Intent was paid. Used to settle a fee without the
196   * webhook — the answer comes from PayMongo with our secret key, never from a student.
197   */
198  export function intentIsPaid(intent: PaymongoResource): boolean {
199    const attrs = intent.data.attributes;
200    if (attrs["status"] === "succeeded") return true;
201    const payments = (attrs["payments"] as Array<{ attributes?: { status?: string } }> | undefined) ?? [];
202    return payments.some((p) => p.attributes?.status === "paid");
203  }
204  
205  /**
206   * Mints a QR Ph code for an amount: payment intent, then a QRPh payment method, then
207   * attach — which is what makes PayMongo generate the code.
208   *
209   * Shared by both money flows, because they are the same three calls: the seller paying
210   * a listing fee (createQrPayment) and the buyer paying the winning bid (createOrderQrPayment).
211   */
212  export async function mintQrPhPayment(
213    client: PayMongoClient,
214    params: {
215      amountCentavos: number;
216      description: string;
217      billingName: string;
218      billingEmail: string;
219    }
220  ) {
221    const intent = await client.createPaymentIntent(params.amountCentavos, params.description);
222    const method = await client.createQrPhPaymentMethod(params.billingName, params.billingEmail);
223  
224    const clientKey = intent.data.attributes["client_key"] as string;
225    const attached = await client.attachPaymentMethod(intent.data.id, method.data.id, clientKey);
226  
227    return { intentId: intent.data.id, qr: extractQrFromNextAction(attached) };
228  }
```

### functions/src/paymongoWebhook.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as crypto from "crypto";
  2  import { onRequest } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  3  import { defineSecret } from "firebase-functions/params";
  4  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  5  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  6  import { db } from "./admin";
  7  import { paymongoSecretKey } from "./createQrPayment";
  8  import { checkIntentWithPayMongo, reconcilePayment } from "./listingFees";
  9  import { settleOrderPaid } from "./orders";
 10  import { commitDeposit } from "./deposits";
 11  import { PayMongoClient } from "./paymongo";
 12  
 13  export const paymongoWebhookSecret = defineSecret("PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET");
 14  
 15  /**
 16   * Verifies PayMongo's `Paymongo-Signature` header: `t=<unix ts>,te=<test hmac>,li=<live hmac>`,
 17   * where the hmac is HMAC-SHA256 over `${t}.${rawBody}` keyed by the webhook's signing secret.
 18   * We're a live-mode endpoint, so we check the `li` component. Uses a constant-time compare.
 19   */
 20  function isValidSignature(rawBody: Buffer, signatureHeader: string, secret: string): boolean {
 21    const parts = Object.fromEntries(
 22      signatureHeader.split(",").map((kv) => {
 23        const [k, v] = kv.split("=");
 24        return [k?.trim(), v?.trim()];
 25      })
 26    );
 27  
 28    const timestamp = parts["t"];
 29    const liveSignature = parts["li"];
 30    if (!timestamp || !liveSignature) return false;
 31  
 32    const signedPayload = `${timestamp}.${rawBody.toString("utf8")}`;
 33    const expected = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(signedPayload).digest("hex");
 34  
 35    const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected, "utf8");
 36    const actualBuf = Buffer.from(liveSignature, "utf8");
 37    if (expectedBuf.length !== actualBuf.length) return false;
 38    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, actualBuf);
 39  }
 40  
 41  export const paymongoWebhook = onRequest(
 42    { secrets: [paymongoWebhookSecret, paymongoSecretKey], region: "asia-southeast1" },
 43    async (req, res) => {
 44      const signatureHeader = req.header("Paymongo-Signature");
 45      if (!signatureHeader) {
 46        res.status(401).send("Missing Paymongo-Signature header.");
 47        return;
 48      }
 49  
 50      const rawBody = (req as unknown as { rawBody: Buffer }).rawBody;
 51      if (!rawBody || !isValidSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, paymongoWebhookSecret.value())) {
 52        logger.warn("paymongoWebhook: signature mismatch");
 53        res.status(401).send("Invalid signature.");
 54        return;
 55      }
 56  
 57      const payload = req.body as {
 58        data?: {
 59          attributes?: {
 60            type?: string;
 61            data?: { id?: string; attributes?: Record<string, unknown> };
 62          };
 63        };
 64      };
 65  
 66      const eventType = payload?.data?.attributes?.type;
 67      logger.info("paymongoWebhook event", { eventType, payload });
 68  
 69      if (eventType !== "payment.paid" && eventType !== "payment.failed") {
 70        // Acknowledge everything else so PayMongo does not retry-storm us.
 71        res.status(200).send("ignored");
 72        return;
 73      }
 74  
 75      const paymentResource = payload?.data?.attributes?.data;
 76      const attrs = paymentResource?.attributes ?? {};
 77      const paymentIntentId =
 78        (attrs["payment_intent_id"] as string | undefined) ??
 79        ((attrs["data"] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.["attributes"] as
 80          | Record<string, unknown>
 81          | undefined)?.["payment_intent_id"] as string | undefined;
 82  
 83      if (!paymentIntentId) {
 84        logger.error("paymongoWebhook: could not locate payment_intent_id in payload", { payload });
 85        res.status(200).send("no payment_intent_id found — logged for inspection");
 86        return;
 87      }
 88  
 89      const paymentsSnap = await db
 90        .collection("payments")
 91        .where("paymongoIntentId", "==", paymentIntentId)
 92        .limit(1)
 93        .get();
 94  
 95      // A valid signature proves the sender holds the webhook secret; it is not proof of
 96      // payment. Nothing is settled or failed until PayMongo's own API — asked with our
 97      // secret key — agrees, so a leaked webhook secret cannot mark anything paid. When
 98      // PayMongo can't confirm yet, answer 503 so it retries the delivery later.
 99      const client = new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value());
100  
101      if (paymentsSnap.empty) {
102        // Not a listing fee — it may be a bid deposit. Checked before orders because
103        // deposits are the model going forward; orders are only still here until the
104        // in-flight ones drain.
105        const depositSnap = await db
106          .collection("bidIntents")
107          .where("paymongoIntentId", "==", paymentIntentId)
108          .limit(1)
109          .get();
110        if (!depositSnap.empty) {
111          if (eventType !== "payment.paid") {
112            res.status(200).send("ignored");
113            return;
114          }
115          if ((await checkIntentWithPayMongo(client, paymentIntentId)) !== "paid") {
116            logger.warn("paymongoWebhook: deposit not confirmed by PayMongo", { paymentIntentId });
117            res.status(503).send("payment not confirmed by PayMongo yet");
118            return;
119          }
120          // A fast path only. checkBidDeposit does the same thing when the app polls, and
121          // that is what actually places bids here — this webhook has never arrived.
122          await commitDeposit(depositSnap.docs[0].ref, "webhook");
123          res.status(200).send("ok");
124          return;
125        }
126  
127        // Or a buyer paying for a won auction. Only a paid event can settle an order; a
128        // failed one leaves it waiting for a new code.
129        const orderSnap = await db
130          .collection("orders")
131          .where("paymongoIntentId", "==", paymentIntentId)
132          .limit(1)
133          .get();
134        if (orderSnap.empty) {
135          logger.error("paymongoWebhook: no matching payments, deposits or orders doc", { paymentIntentId });
136          res.status(200).send("no matching payment record");
137          return;
138        }
139        if (eventType !== "payment.paid") {
140          res.status(200).send("ignored");
141          return;
142        }
143        if ((await checkIntentWithPayMongo(client, paymentIntentId)) !== "paid") {
144          logger.warn("paymongoWebhook: order payment not confirmed by PayMongo", { paymentIntentId });
145          res.status(503).send("payment not confirmed by PayMongo yet");
146          return;
147        }
148        await settleOrderPaid(paymentIntentId);
149        res.status(200).send("ok");
150        return;
151      }
152  
153      const paymentDoc = paymentsSnap.docs[0];
154      const payment = paymentDoc.data();
155  
156      if (payment.status === "paid" || payment.status === "failed") {
157        // Already processed — PayMongo retried the same event.
158        res.status(200).send("already processed");
159        return;
160      }
161  
162      // Settles (shared with the reconcilers) only if PayMongo confirms the payment.
163      const verdict = await reconcilePayment(client, paymentDoc.ref, paymentIntentId, "webhook");
164      if (verdict === "paid") {
165        res.status(200).send("ok");
166        return;
167      }
168      if (verdict === "unknown" || eventType === "payment.paid") {
169        logger.warn("paymongoWebhook: event not confirmed by PayMongo", { paymentIntentId, eventType, verdict });
170        res.status(503).send("payment not confirmed by PayMongo yet");
171        return;
172      }
173  
174      // payment.failed, and PayMongo agrees nothing was paid.
175      const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(payment.listingId as string);
176      await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
177        const listingSnap = await tx.get(listingRef);
178        tx.update(paymentDoc.ref, { status: "failed", failedAt: Timestamp.now() });
179        // Only revert if still awaiting this payment — don't clobber a listing
180        // that a retried, since-succeeded payment already published.
181        if (listingSnap.exists && listingSnap.data()!.status === "pending_payment") {
182          tx.update(listingRef, { status: "draft" });
183        }
184      });
185      res.status(200).send("ok");
186    }
187  );
```

### functions/src/payouts.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  3  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  4  import { db } from "./admin";
  5  import { LEDGER_KIND, postToLedger, readBalance } from "./wallet";
  6  import {
  7    MIN_PAYOUT_CENTAVOS,
  8    PAYOUT_METHODS,
  9    PAYOUT_STATUS,
 10    PayoutMethod,
 11    REGION,
 12  } from "./constants";
 13  
 14  /**
 15   * Cashing an internal balance out to GCash or Maya.
 16   *
 17   * NUTrade does not move the money itself — an admin does, by hand, and then records it
 18   * here. So the balance is debited the moment the request is made, not when the admin
 19   * pays: a student who could ask twice while the first request sat in the queue could be
 20   * paid twice. Declining a request puts the balance back.
 21   *
 22   * That makes `payoutRequests` the held-funds record, and the wallet balance always means
 23   * "spendable now" rather than "earned so far".
 24   */
 25  
 26  const MAX_ACCOUNT_NAME = 60;
 27  
 28  function payoutRef(id: string) {
 29    return db.collection("payoutRequests").doc(id);
 30  }
 31  
 32  function cleanAccountName(raw: unknown): string {
 33    const name = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ") : "";
 34    if (name.length === 0) {
 35      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter the name on the account.");
 36    }
 37    if (name.length > MAX_ACCOUNT_NAME) {
 38      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", `Keep the account name under ${MAX_ACCOUNT_NAME} characters.`);
 39    }
 40    return name;
 41  }
 42  
 43  /** Philippine mobile numbers, the only thing GCash and Maya accept. */
 44  function cleanAccountNumber(raw: unknown): string {
 45    const digits = (typeof raw === "string" ? raw : "").replace(/[^\d]/g, "");
 46    const local = digits.startsWith("63") ? `0${digits.slice(2)}` : digits;
 47    if (!/^09\d{9}$/.test(local)) {
 48      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter the 11-digit mobile number, starting 09.");
 49    }
 50    return local;
 51  }
 52  
 53  function cleanMethod(raw: unknown): PayoutMethod {
 54    const method = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
 55    if (!(PAYOUT_METHODS as readonly string[]).includes(method)) {
 56      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Choose GCash or Maya.");
 57    }
 58    return method as PayoutMethod;
 59  }
 60  
 61  function assertAdmin(role: unknown): void {
 62    if (role !== "admin") throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Admins only.");
 63  }
 64  
 65  /**
 66   * Student asks for their balance. Debits it in the same transaction that records the
 67   * request, so the money is held rather than merely promised.
 68   */
 69  export const requestPayout = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 70    const auth = request.auth;
 71    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 72  
 73    const data = request.data ?? {};
 74    const method = cleanMethod(data.method);
 75    const accountName = cleanAccountName(data.accountName);
 76    const accountNumber = cleanAccountNumber(data.accountNumber);
 77  
 78    const requestRef = db.collection("payoutRequests").doc();
 79  
 80    const amount = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
 81      // Read before any write, and read inside the transaction: two taps in quick
 82      // succession would otherwise both see the same balance and both be allowed.
 83      const balance = await readBalance(auth.uid, tx);
 84      if (balance < MIN_PAYOUT_CENTAVOS) {
 85        return null;
 86      }
 87  
 88      const now = Timestamp.now();
 89      tx.set(requestRef, {
 90        uid: auth.uid,
 91        amountCentavos: balance,
 92        method,
 93        accountName,
 94        accountNumber,
 95        status: PAYOUT_STATUS.requested,
 96        createdAt: now,
 97        resolvedAt: null,
 98        resolvedBy: null,
 99        declineReason: null,
100      });
101  
102      // The whole balance goes out at once — a partial payout is more states to reconcile
103      // by hand than it is worth while an admin is sending these one by one.
104      postToLedger(tx, auth.uid, -balance, LEDGER_KIND.payout, {
105        payoutRequestId: requestRef.id,
106        note: `Payout to ${method}`,
107      });
108  
109      return balance;
110    });
111  
112    if (amount === null) {
113      throw new HttpsError(
114        "failed-precondition",
115        `You need at least ₱${(MIN_PAYOUT_CENTAVOS / 100).toFixed(2)} before you can cash out.`
116      );
117    }
118  
119    logger.info("requestPayout: raised", { uid: auth.uid, requestId: requestRef.id, amount });
120    return { payoutRequestId: requestRef.id, amountCentavos: amount };
121  });
122  
123  /** Admin confirms they have sent the money. The balance was already debited. */
124  export const markPayoutPaid = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
125    const auth = request.auth;
126    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
127    assertAdmin(auth.token.role);
128  
129    const id = typeof request.data?.payoutRequestId === "string" ? request.data.payoutRequestId : "";
130    if (!id) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "payoutRequestId is required.");
131  
132    await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
133      const snapshot = await tx.get(payoutRef(id));
134      const payout = snapshot.data();
135      if (!payout) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "No such payout request.");
136      if (payout.status !== PAYOUT_STATUS.requested) {
137        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "That request has already been resolved.");
138      }
139  
140      tx.update(payoutRef(id), {
141        status: PAYOUT_STATUS.paid,
142        resolvedAt: Timestamp.now(),
143        resolvedBy: auth.uid,
144      });
145    });
146  
147    logger.info("markPayoutPaid", { requestId: id, admin: auth.uid });
148    return { payoutRequestId: id, status: PAYOUT_STATUS.paid };
149  });
150  
151  /** Admin refuses. The held balance goes back to the student, with a ledger row saying so. */
152  export const declinePayout = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
153    const auth = request.auth;
154    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
155    assertAdmin(auth.token.role);
156  
157    const data = request.data ?? {};
158    const id = typeof data.payoutRequestId === "string" ? data.payoutRequestId : "";
159    if (!id) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "payoutRequestId is required.");
160    const reason = typeof data.reason === "string" ? data.reason.trim().slice(0, 200) : "";
161  
162    const refunded = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
163      const snapshot = await tx.get(payoutRef(id));
164      const payout = snapshot.data();
165      if (!payout) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "No such payout request.");
166      if (payout.status !== PAYOUT_STATUS.requested) {
167        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "That request has already been resolved.");
168      }
169  
170      const amount = payout.amountCentavos as number;
171      tx.update(payoutRef(id), {
172        status: PAYOUT_STATUS.declined,
173        resolvedAt: Timestamp.now(),
174        resolvedBy: auth.uid,
175        declineReason: reason || null,
176      });
177  
178      postToLedger(tx, payout.uid as string, amount, LEDGER_KIND.refundCredit, {
179        payoutRequestId: id,
180        note: reason ? `Payout declined: ${reason}` : "Payout declined",
181      });
182  
183      return { uid: payout.uid as string, amount };
184    });
185  
186    logger.info("declinePayout", { requestId: id, admin: auth.uid, ...refunded });
187    return { payoutRequestId: id, status: PAYOUT_STATUS.declined };
188  });
```

### functions/src/signup.ts

```typescript
  1  import * as crypto from "crypto";
  2  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  3  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  4  import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";
  5  import { Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  6  import { db } from "./admin";
  7  import { OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS, OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, OTP_TTL_MINUTES, PROGRAMS, REGION } from "./constants";
  8  import { mailSecrets } from "./brevo";
  9  import { consumeMailAllowance } from "./mailRateLimit";
 10  import { generateCode, hashCode, maskEmail, sendOtpEmail, timingSafeEquals } from "./emailOtp";
 11  
 12  /**
 13   * Registration, code first: email → six-digit code → first name, last name, program
 14   * and password → account.
 15   *
 16   * Nothing is created until the code has been proven, so an abandoned sign-up leaves no
 17   * half-made account behind, and the account is born verified. (sendEmailOtp /
 18   * verifyEmailOtp still verify accounts that already exist — Google sign-in and older
 19   * accounts — and are unchanged.)
 20   *
 21   * These callables are open to signed-out callers by necessity. What limits abuse: one
 22   * code per address per OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS guesses per code,
 23   * and codes and tokens stored only as hashes in `signupChallenges`, which
 24   * firestore.rules does not expose to clients at all.
 25   */
 26  
 27  /** How long a proven email stays usable for finishing the account. */
 28  const SIGNUP_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES = 30;
 29  const MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8;
 30  const MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 40;
 31  
 32  function sha256(value: string): string {
 33    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
 34  }
 35  
 36  /** Lowercased and trimmed; the same shape check as NUTradeConstants.IsValidEmail. */
 37  function normalizeEmail(raw: unknown): string {
 38    const email = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
 39    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
 40      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter a valid email address.");
 41    }
 42    return email;
 43  }
 44  
 45  function cleanName(raw: unknown, label: string): string {
 46    const name = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ") : "";
 47    if (name.length === 0) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", `Enter your ${label}.`);
 48    if (name.length > MAX_NAME_LENGTH) {
 49      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", `Keep your ${label} under ${MAX_NAME_LENGTH} characters.`);
 50    }
 51    return name;
 52  }
 53  
 54  /** One of PROGRAMS, exactly — it is shown to other students under the name. */
 55  function cleanProgram(raw: unknown): string {
 56    const program = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim() : "";
 57    if (!(PROGRAMS as readonly string[]).includes(program)) {
 58      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Choose your program.");
 59    }
 60    return program;
 61  }
 62  
 63  /** Keyed by a hash so the document id never carries the address itself. */
 64  function challengeRef(email: string) {
 65    return db.collection("signupChallenges").doc(sha256(email));
 66  }
 67  
 68  async function emailIsRegistered(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
 69    try {
 70      await getAuth().getUserByEmail(email);
 71      return true;
 72    } catch (err) {
 73      if ((err as { code?: string }).code === "auth/user-not-found") return false;
 74      throw err;
 75    }
 76  }
 77  
 78  const EMAIL_TAKEN = "An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.";
 79  const START_AGAIN = "Your email confirmation has expired. Start again to get a new code.";
 80  
 81  /** Step 1: mail a six-digit code to an address that has no account yet. */
 82  export const startSignup = onCall({ secrets: mailSecrets, region: REGION }, async (request) => {
 83    const email = normalizeEmail(request.data?.email);
 84    if (await emailIsRegistered(email)) throw new HttpsError("already-exists", EMAIL_TAKEN);
 85  
 86    const ref = challengeRef(email);
 87    const now = Timestamp.now();
 88  
 89    const lastSentAt = (await ref.get()).data()?.lastSentAt as Timestamp | undefined;
 90    if (lastSentAt) {
 91      const elapsedSeconds = (now.toMillis() - lastSentAt.toMillis()) / 1000;
 92      if (elapsedSeconds < OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) {
 93        throw new HttpsError(
 94          "resource-exhausted",
 95          `Wait ${Math.ceil(OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS - elapsedSeconds)}s before asking for another code.`
 96        );
 97      }
 98    }
 99  
100    await consumeMailAllowance(email);
101  
102    const code = generateCode();
103    const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
104  
105    // Written before the send: a code that reached the inbox but was never recorded
106    // would be unusable, which is the worse of the two failure modes.
107    await ref.set({
108      email,
109      salt,
110      codeHash: hashCode(code, salt),
111      attempts: 0,
112      createdAt: now,
113      lastSentAt: now,
114      expiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + OTP_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000),
115      tokenHash: null,
116      tokenExpiresAt: null,
117    });
118  
119    await sendOtpEmail(email, code);
120    logger.info("startSignup: code issued", { challenge: ref.id });
121  
122    return {
123      sentTo: maskEmail(email),
124      expiresInSeconds: OTP_TTL_MINUTES * 60,
125      resendAfterSeconds: OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
126    };
127  });
128  
129  /**
130   * Step 2: check the code. Success spends the code and hands back a one-time signup
131   * token — 256 random bits, stored only as a hash — that completeSignup requires.
132   */
133  export const verifySignupCode = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
134    const email = normalizeEmail(request.data?.email);
135    const submitted = String(request.data?.code ?? "").trim();
136    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(submitted)) {
137      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Enter the 6-digit code from your email.");
138    }
139  
140    const ref = challengeRef(email);
141    const challenge = (await ref.get()).data();
142    if (!challenge || !challenge.codeHash) {
143      throw new HttpsError("not-found", "That code has expired. Ask for a new one.");
144    }
145  
146    const now = Timestamp.now();
147    if ((challenge.expiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis() <= now.toMillis()) {
148      await ref.delete();
149      throw new HttpsError("deadline-exceeded", "That code has expired. Ask for a new one.");
150    }
151  
152    const attempts = (challenge.attempts as number) ?? 0;
153    if (attempts >= OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
154      await ref.delete();
155      throw new HttpsError("resource-exhausted", "Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.");
156    }
157  
158    if (!timingSafeEquals(hashCode(submitted, challenge.salt as string), challenge.codeHash as string)) {
159      await ref.update({ attempts: attempts + 1 });
160      const left = OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS - (attempts + 1);
161      throw new HttpsError(
162        "permission-denied",
163        left > 0 ? `That code isn't right. ${left} attempt${left === 1 ? "" : "s"} left.` : "That code isn't right."
164      );
165    }
166  
167    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
168    await ref.update({
169      codeHash: null,
170      verifiedAt: now,
171      tokenHash: sha256(token),
172      tokenExpiresAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() + SIGNUP_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000),
173    });
174  
175    return { signupToken: token };
176  });
177  
178  /**
179   * Step 3: create the account — already verified, since the email was proven in step 2 —
180   * and its profile. The student then signs in with the email and password.
181   */
182  export const completeSignup = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
183    const data = request.data ?? {};
184    const email = normalizeEmail(data.email);
185    const firstName = cleanName(data.firstName, "first name");
186    const lastName = cleanName(data.lastName, "last name");
187    const program = cleanProgram(data.program);
188    const password = typeof data.password === "string" ? data.password : "";
189    if (password.length < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
190      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", `Use at least ${MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters for your password.`);
191    }
192  
193    const ref = challengeRef(email);
194    const challenge = (await ref.get()).data();
195    const token = typeof data.signupToken === "string" ? data.signupToken : "";
196    if (!challenge?.tokenHash || !token || !timingSafeEquals(sha256(token), challenge.tokenHash as string)) {
197      throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", START_AGAIN);
198    }
199    if ((challenge.tokenExpiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis() <= Date.now()) {
200      await ref.delete();
201      throw new HttpsError("deadline-exceeded", START_AGAIN);
202    }
203  
204    const displayName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`;
205    let uid: string;
206    try {
207      ({ uid } = await getAuth().createUser({ email, password, displayName, emailVerified: true }));
208    } catch (err) {
209      const code = (err as { code?: string }).code;
210      if (code === "auth/email-already-exists") throw new HttpsError("already-exists", EMAIL_TAKEN);
211      if (code === "auth/invalid-password") throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Choose a stronger password.");
212      throw err;
213    }
214  
215    await getAuth().setCustomUserClaims(uid, { verified: true });
216  
217    const now = Timestamp.now();
218    await db.collection("users").doc(uid).set({
219      uid,
220      email,
221      displayName,
222      firstName,
223      lastName,
224      studentId: "",
225      campusHub: "Unknown",
226      program,
227      photoUrl: null,
228      tradesCompleted: 0,
229      rating: null,
230      role: "student",
231      verificationStatus: "verified",
232      verifiedAt: now,
233      verifiedVia: "email_otp",
234      fcmTokens: [],
235      createdAt: now,
236    });
237  
238    await ref.delete();
239    logger.info("completeSignup: account created", { uid });
240  
241    return { uid };
242  });
```

### functions/src/tradeResolution.ts

```typescript
  1  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";
  2  import * as logger from "firebase-functions/logger";
  3  import { DocumentData, DocumentReference, FieldValue, Timestamp } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
  4  import { db } from "./admin";
  5  import { PayMongoClient } from "./paymongo";
  6  import { paymongoSecretKey } from "./createQrPayment";
  7  import { readDepositForBid, resolveDeposit, tryPayMongoRefund } from "./depositResolution";
  8  import { BID_STATUS, DISPUTE_STATUS, LISTING_STATUS, REFUND_REASON, REGION } from "./constants";
  9  
 10  /**
 11   * The two ways a matched trade ends badly.
 12   *
 13   * A confirmed handover is the happy path and lives in `markTradeCompleted`. This file
 14   * covers the rest: the seller pulling out, and the winning bidder not turning up.
 15   *
 16   * The asymmetry is deliberate. A seller cancelling is their own decision, so the buyer is
 17   * made whole immediately and automatically. A buyer failing to appear is one person's word
 18   * against another's, so it opens a **dispute** an admin settles — a seller who could
 19   * forfeit a deposit by pressing a button could simply steal it.
 20   */
 21  
 22  /** Reads the chat, the winning bid and its deposit. Call before writing anything. */
 23  async function readTrade(
 24    tx: FirebaseFirestore.Transaction,
 25    chatRef: DocumentReference
 26  ): Promise<{
 27    chat: DocumentData;
 28    bidRef: DocumentReference | null;
 29    deposit: { ref: DocumentReference; data: DocumentData } | null;
 30  }> {
 31    const chatSnap = await tx.get(chatRef);
 32    if (!chatSnap.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Trade not found.");
 33    const chat = chatSnap.data()!;
 34  
 35    const winningBidId = chat.winningBidId as string | undefined;
 36    if (!winningBidId) return { chat, bidRef: null, deposit: null };
 37  
 38    const bidRef = db
 39      .collection("listings")
 40      .doc(chat.listingId as string)
 41      .collection("bids")
 42      .doc(winningBidId);
 43    const bidSnap = await tx.get(bidRef);
 44    if (!bidSnap.exists) return { chat, bidRef: null, deposit: null };
 45  
 46    return { chat, bidRef, deposit: await readDepositForBid(tx, bidSnap.data()!) };
 47  }
 48  
 49  function assertOpen(chat: DocumentData): void {
 50    if (chat.status === "archived") {
 51      throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "This trade is already closed.");
 52    }
 53  }
 54  
 55  /**
 56   * The seller pulls out after a deposit has been paid.
 57   *
 58   * The buyer gets nothing from the trade, so real money back is the fair outcome and a
 59   * PayMongo refund is attempted first. It fails for QR Ph paid through Maya, and for a
 60   * payment PayMongo will not reverse — in which case the wallet credit is the fallback, and
 61   * the student is told which happened.
 62   *
 63   * The refund call happens *outside* the transaction because it is a network round trip;
 64   * the transaction then records whichever way it went.
 65   */
 66  export const cancelTrade = onCall(
 67    { secrets: [paymongoSecretKey], region: REGION },
 68    async (request) => {
 69      const auth = request.auth;
 70      if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
 71  
 72      const data = request.data ?? {};
 73      const chatId = typeof data.chatId === "string" ? data.chatId : "";
 74      if (!chatId) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "chatId is required.");
 75      const reason = typeof data.reason === "string" ? data.reason.trim().slice(0, 300) : "";
 76  
 77      const chatRef = db.collection("chats").doc(chatId);
 78  
 79      // Peek first, so the refund can be attempted before the transaction opens.
 80      const peek = await chatRef.get();
 81      if (!peek.exists) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "Trade not found.");
 82      const peeked = peek.data()!;
 83      if (peeked.sellerUid !== auth.uid) {
 84        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Only the seller can cancel a trade.");
 85      }
 86      assertOpen(peeked);
 87  
 88      let refundedViaPayMongo = false;
 89      const winningBidId = peeked.winningBidId as string | undefined;
 90      if (winningBidId) {
 91        const bidSnap = await db
 92          .collection("listings")
 93          .doc(peeked.listingId as string)
 94          .collection("bids")
 95          .doc(winningBidId)
 96          .get();
 97        const depositId = bidSnap.data()?.["depositIntentId"] as string | undefined;
 98        if (depositId) {
 99          const depositSnap = await db.collection("bidIntents").doc(depositId).get();
100          const deposit = depositSnap.data();
101          if (deposit && deposit.status === "locked_in_escrow") {
102            refundedViaPayMongo = await tryPayMongoRefund(
103              new PayMongoClient(paymongoSecretKey.value()),
104              deposit
105            );
106          }
107        }
108      }
109  
110      const outcome = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
111        const { chat, bidRef, deposit } = await readTrade(tx, chatRef);
112        if (chat.sellerUid !== auth.uid) {
113          throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Only the seller can cancel a trade.");
114        }
115        assertOpen(chat);
116  
117        const now = Timestamp.now();
118  
119        if (deposit) {
120          resolveDeposit(tx, deposit.ref, deposit.data, "refunded_to_buyer", {
121            reason: REFUND_REASON.sellerCancelled,
122            via: refundedViaPayMongo ? "paymongo_refund" : "wallet_credit",
123            note: refundedViaPayMongo
124              ? "Seller cancelled — refunded to your GCash"
125              : "Seller cancelled — deposit returned",
126          });
127        }
128        if (bidRef) tx.update(bidRef, { status: BID_STATUS.declined, declinedAt: now });
129  
130        tx.update(chatRef, { status: "archived", cancelledAt: now, cancelledBy: auth.uid });
131        tx.set(chatRef.collection("messages").doc(), {
132          senderUid: "system",
133          text: reason
134            ? `The seller cancelled this trade: ${reason}`
135            : "The seller cancelled this trade. Your deposit has been returned.",
136          type: "system",
137          sentAt: now,
138        });
139        tx.update(db.collection("listings").doc(chat.listingId as string), {
140          status: LISTING_STATUS.cancelled,
141          cancelledAt: now,
142        });
143  
144        return { buyerUid: chat.buyerUid as string, refundedViaPayMongo };
145      });
146  
147      logger.info("cancelTrade", { chatId, seller: auth.uid, ...outcome });
148      return { ok: true, refundedViaPayMongo };
149    }
150  );
151  
152  /**
153   * The seller says the winning bidder never turned up.
154   *
155   * This forfeits nothing by itself. It opens a dispute for an admin, because the deposit is
156   * the buyer's money and one party should not be able to take it on their own say-so.
157   */
158  export const reportNoShow = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
159    const auth = request.auth;
160    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
161  
162    const data = request.data ?? {};
163    const chatId = typeof data.chatId === "string" ? data.chatId : "";
164    if (!chatId) throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "chatId is required.");
165    const note = typeof data.note === "string" ? data.note.trim().slice(0, 300) : "";
166  
167    const chatRef = db.collection("chats").doc(chatId);
168    const disputeRef = db.collection("disputes").doc();
169  
170    await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
171      const { chat, deposit } = await readTrade(tx, chatRef);
172      if (chat.sellerUid !== auth.uid) {
173        throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Only the seller can report a no-show.");
174      }
175      assertOpen(chat);
176      if (chat.disputeId) {
177        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "A dispute is already open on this trade.");
178      }
179      if (!deposit) {
180        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "There is no deposit on this trade to dispute.");
181      }
182  
183      const now = Timestamp.now();
184      tx.set(disputeRef, {
185        chatId,
186        listingId: chat.listingId,
187        listingTitle: chat.listingTitle ?? "",
188        sellerUid: chat.sellerUid,
189        buyerUid: chat.buyerUid,
190        depositIntentId: deposit.ref.id,
191        depositCentavos: deposit.data.depositCentavos,
192        note: note || null,
193        status: DISPUTE_STATUS.open,
194        createdAt: now,
195        resolvedAt: null,
196        resolvedBy: null,
197        resolution: null,
198      });
199      tx.update(chatRef, { disputeId: disputeRef.id, disputedAt: now });
200      tx.set(chatRef.collection("messages").doc(), {
201        senderUid: "system",
202        text: "The seller reported a no-show. A NUTrade admin will review this.",
203        type: "system",
204        sentAt: now,
205      });
206    });
207  
208    logger.info("reportNoShow: dispute opened", { chatId, disputeId: disputeRef.id });
209    return { disputeId: disputeRef.id };
210  });
211  
212  /**
213   * An admin settles a no-show dispute.
214   *
215   * `forfeit` is the only path in the whole system that keeps a student's deposit, so it
216   * also records a strike — a pattern of them is what an admin acts on, not one bad day.
217   * `refund` returns it as credit and leaves no mark.
218   */
219  export const resolveDispute = onCall({ region: REGION }, async (request) => {
220    const auth = request.auth;
221    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
222    if (auth.token.role !== "admin") throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Admins only.");
223  
224    const data = request.data ?? {};
225    const disputeId = typeof data.disputeId === "string" ? data.disputeId : "";
226    const resolution = data.resolution === "forfeit" ? "forfeit" : data.resolution === "refund" ? "refund" : null;
227    if (!disputeId || !resolution) {
228      throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "disputeId and a resolution of forfeit or refund are required.");
229    }
230  
231    const disputeRef = db.collection("disputes").doc(disputeId);
232  
233    const outcome = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
234      const disputeSnap = await tx.get(disputeRef);
235      const dispute = disputeSnap.data();
236      if (!dispute) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "No such dispute.");
237      if (dispute.status !== DISPUTE_STATUS.open) {
238        throw new HttpsError("failed-precondition", "That dispute has already been resolved.");
239      }
240  
241      const depositRef = db.collection("bidIntents").doc(dispute.depositIntentId as string);
242      const depositSnap = await tx.get(depositRef);
243      const deposit = depositSnap.data();
244      if (!deposit) throw new HttpsError("not-found", "The deposit for this dispute is missing.");
245  
246      const now = Timestamp.now();
247      const buyerUid = dispute.buyerUid as string;
248  
249      if (resolution === "forfeit") {
250        resolveDeposit(tx, depositRef, deposit, "forfeited", { reason: "no_show" });
251        tx.set(
252          db.collection("users").doc(buyerUid),
253          { strikes: FieldValue.increment(1), lastStrikeAt: now },
254          { merge: true }
255        );
256      } else {
257        resolveDeposit(tx, depositRef, deposit, "refunded_to_buyer", {
258          reason: "no_show_dismissed",
259          note: "Dispute resolved in your favour — deposit returned",
260        });
261      }
262  
263      tx.update(disputeRef, {
264        status: DISPUTE_STATUS.resolved,
265        resolution,
266        resolvedAt: now,
267        resolvedBy: auth.uid,
268      });
269      tx.update(db.collection("chats").doc(dispute.chatId as string), {
270        status: "archived",
271        completedAt: now,
272      });
273  
274      return { buyerUid, resolution };
275    });
276  
277    logger.info("resolveDispute", { disputeId, admin: auth.uid, ...outcome });
278    return { disputeId, resolution };
279  });
```

### functions/src/wallet.ts

```typescript
 1  import { FieldValue, Timestamp, Transaction } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
 2  import { db } from "./admin";
 3  
 4  /**
 5   * The student's internal balance, and the append-only record behind it.
 6   *
 7   * Two documents move together or not at all: `wallets/{uid}` holds the running total, and
 8   * every change writes a `ledgerEntries` row saying why. The total is therefore always
 9   * reconstructible by summing the entries — which is the only reason to trust it, since a
10   * balance nobody can audit is just a number.
11   *
12   * Nothing here is a callable. Balances change as a *consequence* of something else
13   * settling — a handover confirmed, a deposit forfeited, a payout marked paid — so every
14   * mutation takes the caller's transaction and rides along with whatever else that
15   * transaction is writing. There is no "add money" endpoint by design.
16   */
17  
18  /** What a ledger entry is for. Stored as-is on the row, and shown to the student. */
19  export const LEDGER_KIND = {
20    /** A buyer's commitment deposit credited to the seller after a confirmed handover. */
21    depositCredit: "deposit_credit",
22    /** A seller cancelled after a deposit was paid; the buyer gets in-app credit. */
23    refundCredit: "refund_credit",
24    /** Balance paid out to the student off-platform. Always negative. */
25    payout: "payout",
26  } as const;
27  
28  export type LedgerKind = (typeof LEDGER_KIND)[keyof typeof LEDGER_KIND];
29  
30  export interface LedgerContext {
31    listingId?: string | null;
32    bidId?: string | null;
33    payoutRequestId?: string | null;
34    note?: string | null;
35  }
36  
37  export function walletRef(uid: string) {
38    return db.collection("wallets").doc(uid);
39  }
40  
41  /**
42   * Moves `amountCentavos` (negative to debit) and records why, inside the caller's
43   * transaction.
44   *
45   * Firestore requires every read in a transaction to happen before any write, so this
46   * deliberately does **not** read the wallet: `FieldValue.increment` is applied blind and
47   * resolved server-side, which is both correct under concurrency and safe to call after
48   * the caller has already written. A caller that must refuse to go negative has to read
49   * the balance itself, first — see `requestPayout`.
50   */
51  export function postToLedger(
52    tx: Transaction,
53    uid: string,
54    amountCentavos: number,
55    kind: LedgerKind,
56    context: LedgerContext = {}
57  ): void {
58    const now = Timestamp.now();
59  
60    tx.set(
61      walletRef(uid),
62      {
63        uid,
64        balanceCentavos: FieldValue.increment(amountCentavos),
65        updatedAt: now,
66      },
67      { merge: true }
68    );
69  
70    tx.set(db.collection("ledgerEntries").doc(), {
71      uid,
72      kind,
73      amountCentavos,
74      listingId: context.listingId ?? null,
75      bidId: context.bidId ?? null,
76      payoutRequestId: context.payoutRequestId ?? null,
77      note: context.note ?? null,
78      createdAt: now,
79    });
80  }
81  
82  /** Current balance in centavos. Zero for a student who has never had a wallet document. */
83  export async function readBalance(uid: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<number> {
84    const ref = walletRef(uid);
85    const snapshot = await (tx ? tx.get(ref) : ref.get());
86    return (snapshot.data()?.["balanceCentavos"] as number | undefined) ?? 0;
87  }
```

  1  import { onCall, HttpsError } from "firebase-functions/v2/https";

  7  
  8  /**
  9   * Development seeder. Admin-only, and it writes through the Admin SDK precisely
 10   * the shape the real flow produces: the bid documents and denormalized listing
 11   * counters that placeBid maintains, and the published/pinned listings that
 12   * createQrPayment and the PayMongo webhook leave behind. The app therefore reads
 13   * genuinely live Firestore data rather than anything hard-coded client-side.
 14   *
 15   * Idempotent: listings use fixed ids and are overwritten, their bids subcollections
 16   * are cleared first, and anything a previous settlement produced for them (chats,
 17   * their messages, and trade records) is deleted — so re-running really does produce
 18   * the same state, even after closeExpiredAuctions has already awarded an auction.
 19   *
 20   * Never called by the app. Invoke it from scripts/seed.mjs.
 21   */

 61    endsInMinutes: number;

 64    bids: Array<[string, number, number]>;
 65  }

112      condition: "Good",

116      isPinned: false,

119      reservePriceCentavos: 40000,
120      auctionDurationHours: 48,
121      endsInMinutes: 32,
122      publishedHoursAgo: 20,
123      bids: [["paolo", 35000, 40], ["mika", 38000, 30], ["paolo", 43000, 20], ["mika", 48000, 2]],
124    },
