```typescript
131      condition: "New",
132      category: "Other",
133      campusZone: "Gymnasium",
134      package: "Priority",
135      isPinned: true,
136      startingBidCentavos: 80000,
137      minIncrementCentavos: 10000,
138      reservePriceCentavos: null,
139      auctionDurationHours: 72,
140      endsInMinutes: 1200,
141      publishedHoursAgo: 4,
142      bids: [["paolo", 90000, 14], ["mika", 100000, 12]],
143    },
144  ];
145  
146  export const seedDevData = onCall({ region: REGION, timeoutSeconds: 300 }, async (request) => {
147    const auth = request.auth;
148    if (!auth) throw new HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Sign in required.");
149    if (auth.token.role !== "admin") throw new HttpsError("permission-denied", "Admins only.");
150  
151    const { password, endsInMinutes } = (request.data ?? {}) as {
152      password?: string;
153      endsInMinutes?: number;
154    };
155    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
156      throw new HttpsError(
157        "invalid-argument",
158        "A password of at least 8 characters is required. It becomes the sign-in password for every seeded account."
159      );
160    }
161  
162    // Overrides every listing's auction length. A negative value seeds auctions that have
163    // already ended, which is the only practical way to watch closeExpiredAuctions settle
164    // one without waiting out a real countdown.
165    const endsOverride =
166      typeof endsInMinutes === "number" && Number.isFinite(endsInMinutes) ? endsInMinutes : null;
167  
168    const now = Timestamp.now();
169    const uids: Record<string, string> = {};
170  
171    // 1. Real Auth accounts, so you can actually sign in as any seeded student.
172    for (const account of ACCOUNTS) {
173      let uid: string;
174      try {
175        uid = (await getAuth().getUserByEmail(account.email)).uid;
176        await getAuth().updateUser(uid, { password, displayName: account.displayName });
177      } catch {
178        uid = (
179          await getAuth().createUser({
180            email: account.email,
181            password,
182            displayName: account.displayName,
183            emailVerified: true,
184          })
185        ).uid;
186      }
187      // Seeded students are pre-verified; a real signup waits on admin ID review.
188      await getAuth().setCustomUserClaims(uid, { verified: true });
189      uids[account.key] = uid;
190  
191      await db.collection("users").doc(uid).set({
192        uid,
193        email: account.email,
194        displayName: account.displayName,
195        studentId: account.studentId,
196        campusHub: account.campusHub,
197        photoUrl: null,
198        tradesCompleted: account.tradesCompleted,
199        rating: account.rating,
200        role: "student",
201        verificationStatus: "verified",
202        verifiedAt: now,
203        fcmTokens: [],
204        createdAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() - 180 * 86_400_000),
205      });
206    }
207  
208    // 2. Listings, in exactly the shape createQrPayment and the webhook leave them.
209    for (const spec of LISTINGS) {
210      const listingRef = db.collection("listings").doc(spec.id);
211  
212      const existingBids = await listingRef.collection("bids").get();
213      await Promise.all(existingBids.docs.map((d) => d.ref.delete()));
214  
215      // Re-seeding puts the listing back to `active`, so anything a previous
216      // settlement produced for it has to go too. Without this, every re-seed of an
217      // auction that closeExpiredAuctions had already awarded leaves an orphaned chat
218      // behind and the same item shows up repeatedly in the chat list.
219      const staleChats = await db.collection("chats").where("listingId", "==", spec.id).get();
220      for (const chatDoc of staleChats.docs) {
221        const messages = await chatDoc.ref.collection("messages").get();
222        await Promise.all(messages.docs.map((m) => m.ref.delete()));
223        await chatDoc.ref.delete();
224      }
225  
226      const staleTrades = await db.collection("trades").where("listingId", "==", spec.id).get();
227      await Promise.all(staleTrades.docs.map((t) => t.ref.delete()));
228  
229      const ladder = [...spec.bids].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
230      const top = ladder[ladder.length - 1];
231      const publishedAt = Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() - spec.publishedHoursAgo * 3_600_000);
232  
233      await listingRef.set({
234        ownerUid: uids[spec.owner],
235        title: spec.title,
236        description: spec.description,
237        condition: spec.condition,
238        category: spec.category,
239        photos: [],
240        campusZone: spec.campusZone,
241        package: spec.package,
242        isPinned: spec.isPinned,
243        status: LISTING_STATUS.active,
244        // Seeded auctions were published hours ago, so their hourly slot has long
245        // passed — they belong on the feed immediately whatever their package.
246        isVisible: true,
247        visibleFrom: publishedAt,
248        startingBidCentavos: spec.startingBidCentavos,
249        minIncrementCentavos: spec.minIncrementCentavos,
250        reservePriceCentavos: spec.reservePriceCentavos,
251        currentHighestBidCentavos: top ? top[1] : spec.startingBidCentavos,
252        highestBidderUid: top ? uids[top[0]] : null,
253        bidCount: ladder.length,
254        auctionEndsAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(
255          now.toMillis() + (endsOverride ?? spec.endsInMinutes) * 60_000
256        ),
257        winningBidId: null,
258        createdAt: publishedAt,
259        publishedAt,
260      });
261  
262      // Only the highest bid is pending; everything under it is outbid. Same
263      // invariant placeBid maintains.
264      const batch = db.batch();
265      ladder.forEach(([bidderKey, amount, minutesAgo], index) => {
266        const isTop = index === ladder.length - 1;
267        batch.set(listingRef.collection("bids").doc(), {
268          listingId: spec.id,
269          bidderUid: uids[bidderKey],
270          bidderName: ACCOUNTS.find((a) => a.key === bidderKey)!.displayName,
271          amountCentavos: amount,
272          status: isTop ? BID_STATUS.pending : BID_STATUS.outbid,
273          createdAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now.toMillis() - minutesAgo * 60_000),
274        });
275      });
276      await batch.commit();
277    }
278  
279    logger.info("seedDevData: complete", { accounts: ACCOUNTS.length, listings: LISTINGS.length });
280  
281    return {
282      accounts: ACCOUNTS.map((a) => ({ email: a.email, uid: uids[a.key], displayName: a.displayName })),
283      listings: LISTINGS.map((l) => l.id),
284    };
285  });
```

### firestore.rules

```
  1  rules_version = '2';
  2  service cloud.firestore {
  3    match /databases/{database}/documents {
  4  
  5      // ---- Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
  6      function isSignedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
  7      function isOwner(userId) { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid == userId; }
  8      function isVerified() { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.token.verified == true; }
  9      // Admins carry a custom claim, which only the Admin SDK can set: `role: 'admin'`
 10      // (bootstrapAdmin) or `admin: true`, the web admin panel's name for the same thing.
 11      // Deliberately NOT trusted: `role` on the user's own users/{uid} document.
 12      function isAdmin() {
 13        return isSignedIn() && (
 14          request.auth.token.get('role', '') == 'admin'
 15          || request.auth.token.get('admin', false) == true
 16        );
 17      }
 18  
 19      // Mirrors NUTradeConstants.Programs and PROGRAMS in functions/src/constants.ts.
 20      function programs() { return ['SACE', 'SAHS', 'SABM', 'SHS']; }
 21  
 22      function changedKeys() {
 23        return request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys();
 24      }
 25  
 26      // ---- Users ---------------------------------------------------------------
 27      match /users/{userId} {
 28        allow read: if isSignedIn();
 29  
 30        // A new account is always unverified and unprivileged. The `verified` custom
 31        // claim is granted by verifyEmailOtp once the student enters the code emailed
 32        // to them; setUserVerification lets an admin revoke it afterwards.
 33        allow create: if isOwner(userId)
 34          && request.resource.data.uid == userId
 35          && request.resource.data.verificationStatus == 'pending'
 36          && request.resource.data.role == 'student'
 37          && request.resource.data.tradesCompleted == 0
 38          // Blank for app builds from before the program was asked for.
 39          && request.resource.data.get('program', '') in [''].concat(programs());
 40  
 41        // Students may edit their own presentational fields and submit an ID photo,
 42        // but never their own verification state, role, or trade history.
 43        allow update: if isAdmin()
 44          || (isOwner(userId) && changedKeys().hasOnly([
 45                'displayName', 'studentId', 'campusHub', 'photoUrl', 'idPhotoUrl',
 46                'fcmTokens', 'program'
 47              ])
 48              // Shown to other students under the name, so only a real program. Checked
 49              // only when it changes: older profiles may hold something else.
 50              && (!changedKeys().hasAny(['program'])
 51                  || request.resource.data.program in programs()));
 52  
 53        allow delete: if false;
 54      }
 55  
 56      // ---- Listings ------------------------------------------------------------
 57      match /listings/{listingId} {
 58        allow read: if isSignedIn();
 59  
 60        // Clients may only ever author a *draft*. Every later status, pinning, and
 61        // every auction counter are Admin-SDK only: createQrPayment and the PayMongo
 62        // webhook move a paid draft to pending_approval, and only an admin's
 63        // approveListing / rejectListing decides what happens after that.
 64        allow create: if isVerified()
 65          && request.resource.data.ownerUid == request.auth.uid
 66          && request.resource.data.status == 'draft'
 67          && request.resource.data.isPinned == false
 68          && request.resource.data.bidCount == 0
 69          && request.resource.data.highestBidderUid == null
 70          && request.resource.data.winningBidId == null
 71          && request.resource.data.publishedAt == null
 72          // Feed visibility is decided at publish time by visibilityFor(), not by the
 73          // client — it is the whole substance of the Priority fee.
 74          && request.resource.data.isVisible == false
 75          && request.resource.data.startingBidCentavos is int
 76          && request.resource.data.startingBidCentavos > 0
 77          && request.resource.data.minIncrementCentavos is int
 78          && request.resource.data.minIncrementCentavos > 0
 79          // "Add up to 4 photos": MAX_LISTING_PHOTOS / NUTradeConstants.MaxListingPhotos.
 80          // Checked here because a listing can't be edited after creation (update is
 81          // denied below), so this is the one place the photo count is ever set.
 82          && request.resource.data.photos is list
 83          && request.resource.data.photos.size() <= 4;
 84          // No duration check: every auction runs AUCTION_DURATION_HOURS, applied
 85          // server-side at publish. The create form no longer asks.
 86  
 87        // Every mutation goes through a Cloud Function — the web admin panel included,
 88        // which approves and rejects through approveListing / rejectListing.
 89        allow update: if false;
 90        allow delete: if isOwner(resource.data.ownerUid) && resource.data.status == 'draft';
 91  
 92        // Bids are written only by placeBid / approveBid / declineBid / withdrawBid.
 93        // Bid history is readable by any signed-in student because the listing detail
 94        // page shows it.
 95        match /bids/{bidId} {
 96          allow read: if isSignedIn();
 97          allow write: if false;
 98        }
 99      }
100  
101      // The My Bids tab reads every listings/{id}/bids subcollection at once with a
102      // collection-group query. A nested match only authorises the literal path it is
103      // written under, so that query is denied unless a recursive match exists too —
104      // this is that rule, not a duplicate of the one above.
105      match /{path=**}/bids/{bidId} {
106        allow read: if isSignedIn();
107        allow write: if false;
108      }
109  
110      // ---- Chats ---------------------------------------------------------------
111      function chatParticipants(chatId) {
112        return get(/databases/$(database)/documents/chats/$(chatId)).data.participantUids;
113      }
114  
115      match /chats/{chatId} {
116        // Opened by awardListing when an auction is won; closed by markTradeCompleted.
117        allow read: if isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid in resource.data.participantUids;
118        allow write: if false;
119  
120        match /messages/{messageId} {
121          allow read: if isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid in chatParticipants(chatId);
122  
123          // Participants type their own messages; only a Function may post as
124          // 'system'. onChatMessageCreated mirrors the text onto the parent chat.
125          allow create: if isSignedIn()
126            && request.auth.uid in chatParticipants(chatId)
127            && request.resource.data.senderUid == request.auth.uid
128            && request.resource.data.type == 'text'
129            && request.resource.data.text is string
130            && request.resource.data.text.size() > 0
131            && request.resource.data.text.size() <= 2000;
132  
133          allow update, delete: if false;
134        }
135      }
136  
137      // ---- Email one-time codes -------------------------------------------------
138      // Hashed codes and attempt counters. Entirely invisible to clients: a student
139      // who could read their own challenge document could brute-force the hash offline,
140      // and one who could write it could reset their own attempt counter. Both sides go
141      // through sendEmailOtp / verifyEmailOtp.
142      match /otpChallenges/{userId} {
143        allow read, write: if false;
144      }
145  
146      // The same, for the two flows that mail a code to a signed-out caller: registration
147      // and forgot-password. Both are keyed by a hash of the address rather than the
148      // address itself, and both hold a hashed code and then a hashed one-time token, so
149      // there is nothing here a client may see. startSignup / verifySignupCode and
150      // startPasswordReset / verifyPasswordResetCode / completePasswordReset are the only
151      // way in. (Unlisted collections are denied anyway — these are spelled out so the
152      // intent survives the next edit.)
153      match /signupChallenges/{emailHash} {
154        allow read, write: if false;
155      }
156  
157      match /passwordResetChallenges/{emailHash} {
158        allow read, write: if false;
159      }
160  
161      // How many codes each address has been mailed this hour, so the per-send cooldown
162      // can't be ridden indefinitely. Survives challenge deletion, which is the whole
163      // point of keeping it out of the challenge documents. Written only by
164      // consumeMailAllowance. A Firestore TTL policy on expiresAt sweeps spent counters.
165      match /mailRateLimits/{emailHash} {
166        allow read, write: if false;
167      }
168  
169      // ---- Server-owned records ------------------------------------------------
170      // Payments: the client reads its own doc to drive the QR screen, nothing more.
171      match /payments/{paymentId} {
172        allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.uid) || isAdmin();
173        allow write: if false;
174      }
175  
176      // Listing-fee revenue records, written by paymongoWebhook.
177      match /transactions/{txId} {
178        allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.userId) || isAdmin();
179        allow write: if false;
180      }
181  
182      // Completed student-to-student trades, written by markTradeCompleted.
183      match /trades/{tradeId} {
184        allow read: if isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid in resource.data.participantUids;
185        allow write: if false;
186      }
187  
188      // What the winning bidder owes the seller. Both sides read it — the buyer to pay,
189      // the seller to watch for payment — but neither may write. Settlement is asserted
190      // only by PayMongo's signed webhook, never by a student: a client that could set
191      // `status: 'paid'` could take an item without paying for it. Written by
192      // createOrderQrPayment, paymongoWebhook and releaseUnpaidOrders.
193      match /orders/{orderId} {
194        allow read: if isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid in resource.data.participantUids;
195        allow write: if false;
196      }
197  
198      // Bid deposits. The bidder reads their own to drive the QR screen and to see where
199      // the money ended up; the seller reads the ones on their listing. Never written by a
200      // client — requestBid mints them, commitDeposit settles them, and a client that could
201      // write here could place a bid without paying for it.
202      match /bidIntents/{intentId} {
203        allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.bidderUid)
204                    || isOwner(resource.data.sellerUid)
205                    || isAdmin();
206        allow write: if false;
207      }
208  
209      // No-show disputes. Both sides read the one about their own trade so neither is
210      // arguing in the dark; only resolveDispute writes, because forfeiting a deposit is
211      // an admin decision and a seller who could write here could take the money.
212      match /disputes/{disputeId} {
213        allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.sellerUid)
214                    || isOwner(resource.data.buyerUid)
215                    || isAdmin();
216        allow write: if false;
217      }
218  
219      // ---- Internal wallet -----------------------------------------------------
220      // The balance a student can see but never move. Every change is written by a Cloud
221      // Function inside a transaction that also writes the ledger entry explaining it, so
222      // a client that could write here could mint money out of nothing.
223      match /wallets/{userId} {
224        allow read: if isOwner(userId) || isAdmin();
225        allow write: if false;
226      }
227  
228      // Append-only, and append-only from the server. Readable by the student it belongs
229      // to so the balance above can be audited rather than merely believed.
230      match /ledgerEntries/{entryId} {
231        allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.uid) || isAdmin();
232        allow write: if false;
233      }
234  
235      // Cash-out requests. The student reads their own to follow the status; only
236      // requestPayout / markPayoutPaid / declinePayout write, because the balance is
237      // debited in the same transaction that raises the request.
238      match /payoutRequests/{requestId} {
239        allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.uid) || isAdmin();
240        allow write: if false;
241      }
242  
243      match /counters/{counterId} {
244        allow read: if isAdmin();
245        allow write: if false;
246      }
247    }
248  }
```

### storage.rules

```
 1  rules_version = '2';
 2  service firebase.storage {
 3    match /b/{bucket}/o {
 4  
 5      function isSignedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
 6      function isVerified() { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.token.verified == true; }
 7      function isAdmin() { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.token.role == 'admin'; }
 8  
 9      function isImageUnder(maxBytes) {
10        return request.resource.contentType.matches('image/.*')
11          && request.resource.size < maxBytes;
12      }
13  
14      // Listing photos. Readable by any signed-in student because they render on the
15      // public feed; writable only into your own folder, and only once verified — the
16      // same gate that stops you creating the listing they would belong to.
17      match /listings/{userId}/{photoId} {
18        allow read: if isSignedIn();
19        allow write: if isVerified()
20          && request.auth.uid == userId
21          && isImageUnder(8 * 1024 * 1024);
22      }
23  
24      // Profile avatars.
25      match /avatars/{userId}/{photoId} {
26        allow read: if isSignedIn();
27        allow write: if isSignedIn()
28          && request.auth.uid == userId
29          && isImageUnder(4 * 1024 * 1024);
30      }
31  
32      // Student ID photos. The one bucket path that is NOT publicly readable: only the
33      // student who uploaded it and the admins reviewing the queue can see it. Write-once
34      // per upload, and never deletable by the student, so evidence can't be pulled after
35      // review. See docs/architecture-and-security.md section 2.B.
36      match /ids/{userId}/{photoId} {
37        allow read: if isOwnerOrAdmin(userId);
38        allow create: if isSignedIn()
39          && request.auth.uid == userId
40          && isImageUnder(8 * 1024 * 1024);
41        allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
42      }
43  
44      function isOwnerOrAdmin(userId) {
45        return (isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid == userId) || isAdmin();
46      }
47  
48      // Anything not matched above is denied.
49      match /{allPaths=**} {
50        allow read, write: if false;
51      }
52    }
53  }
```

## 6. Scripts

### scripts/check-email-dns.mjs

```javascript
 1  #!/usr/bin/env node
 2  /**
 3   * Checks whether the DNS records Brevo needs for NUTrade's email are live yet.
 4   *
 5   * Brevo's dashboard only tells you pass/fail after you click "Authenticate this domain";
 6   * this shows which individual record is missing, which is usually the fastest way to spot
 7   * the classic Cloudflare mistake of leaving a record proxied (orange cloud) instead of
 8   * DNS-only, or a provider that silently appended the domain to an already-absolute name.
 9   *
10   * Brevo asks for three records on the sending domain:
11   *   brevo-code.<domain>       TXT   brevo-code:<32 hex chars>   (ownership)
12   *   mail._domainkey.<domain>  TXT   k=rsa; p=...                (DKIM)
13   *   <domain>                  TXT   v=spf1 include:spf.brevo.com mp:all  (SPF)
14   *
15   * Usage: node scripts/check-email-dns.mjs [domain]
16   */
17  import { Resolver } from "node:dns/promises";
18  
19  // slice(2) drops the node binary and the script path — both contain dots and would
20  // otherwise be mistaken for the domain.
21  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
22  const domain = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("-")) ?? "nutrade.com";
23  
24  // Query a public resolver directly so a stale local cache can't show a false negative.
25  const resolver = new Resolver();
26  resolver.setServers(["8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1"]);
27  
28  const ok = (m) => console.log("  OK    " + m);
29  const missing = (m) => { console.log("  MISS  " + m); process.exitCode = 1; };
30  
31  async function txt(name) {
32    try {
33      return (await resolver.resolveTxt(name)).map((chunks) => chunks.join(""));
34    } catch {
35      return [];
36    }
37  }
38  
39  console.log(`\nBrevo email DNS for ${domain}\n`);
40  
41  console.log("1. domain ownership (brevo-code TXT)");
42  const code = await txt(`brevo-code.${domain}`);
43  code.some((r) => r.includes("brevo-code:"))
44    ? ok(code.find((r) => r.includes("brevo-code:")))
45    : missing(`no brevo-code TXT at brevo-code.${domain} (copy the exact value from Brevo)`);
46  
47  console.log("\n2. DKIM");
48  const dkim = await txt(`mail._domainkey.${domain}`);
49  dkim.some((r) => r.includes("p="))
50    ? ok(`mail._domainkey present (${dkim[0].length} chars)`)
51    : missing(`no DKIM TXT at mail._domainkey.${domain}`);
52  
53  console.log("\n3. SPF on the domain itself");
54  const spf = await txt(domain);
55  const spfRecord = spf.find((r) => r.startsWith("v=spf1"));
56  if (!spfRecord) {
57    missing(`no SPF TXT at ${domain} (expecting v=spf1 include:spf.brevo.com mp:all)`);
58  } else if (!spfRecord.includes("spf.brevo.com")) {
59    // Only one SPF record is allowed per domain, so an existing one must be edited to add
60    // the include rather than a second one being added beside it.
61    missing(`SPF exists but doesn't include Brevo — add include:spf.brevo.com to "${spfRecord}"`);
62  } else {
63    ok(spfRecord);
64  }
65  
66  console.log("\n4. DMARC (optional, but improves deliverability)");
67  const dmarc = await txt(`_dmarc.${domain}`);
68  dmarc.some((r) => r.startsWith("v=DMARC1"))
69    ? ok(dmarc.find((r) => r.startsWith("v=DMARC1")))
70    : console.log(`  none  no _dmarc.${domain} — fine to skip, worth adding before launch`);
71  
72  console.log(
73    process.exitCode
74      ? "\nNot ready. Add the missing records in your DNS provider, set each to DNS only (grey\n" +
75        "cloud in Cloudflare, not proxied), then click Authenticate this domain in Brevo.\n"
76      : "\nAll required records are live. Authenticate the domain in Brevo if you have not,\n" +
77        "then set BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL in functions/.env and redeploy the mailing functions.\n"
78  );
```

### scripts/seed.mjs

```javascript
  1  #!/usr/bin/env node
  2  /**
  3   * Seeds the NUTrade Firestore project with real, live auction data.
  4   *
  5   * Talks only to public endpoints — Firebase Auth REST and the deployed callable
  6   * Functions — so it needs no service-account key on your machine. The privileged
  7   * work happens server-side inside `seedDevData`, which is gated on an admin claim.
  8   *
  9   * Steps:
 10   *   1. Sign in (or create) the admin account with email + password.
 11   *   2. POST to `bootstrapAdmin` with the Secret Manager value, granting that
 12   *      account `role: admin` and `verified: true`.
 13   *   3. Re-exchange the refresh token so the new claims are actually in the ID token.
 14   *   4. Call `seedDevData`, which writes five student accounts and four live auctions
 15   *      with their bid ladders.
 16   *
 17   * Usage:
 18   *   node scripts/seed.mjs \
 19   *     --admin-email you@nu-lipa.edu.ph \
 20   *     --admin-password "..." \
 21   *     --bootstrap-secret "<ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET>" \
 22   *     --seed-password "..."
 23   *
 24   * Every flag can also come from the environment: NUTRADE_ADMIN_EMAIL,
 25   * NUTRADE_ADMIN_PASSWORD, NUTRADE_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET, NUTRADE_SEED_PASSWORD.
 26   */
 27  
 28  const PROJECT_ID = "nutrade-a25c7";
 29  const API_KEY = "AIzaSyDXWnLMuCkcnVUeNRnJLmeRVVXDZ7KXWXo";
 30  const REGION = "asia-southeast1";
 31  
 32  const IDENTITY = "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts";
 33  const SECURE_TOKEN = "https://securetoken.googleapis.com/v1/token";
 34  const fnUrl = (name) => `https://${REGION}-${PROJECT_ID}.cloudfunctions.net/${name}`;
 35  
 36  function arg(flag, envVar) {
 37    const index = process.argv.indexOf(`--${flag}`);
 38    if (index !== -1 && process.argv[index + 1]) return process.argv[index + 1];
 39    return process.env[envVar];
 40  }
 41  
 42  function fail(message) {
 43    console.error(`\n  ${message}\n`);
 44    process.exit(1);
 45  }
 46  
 47  async function postJson(url, body, headers = {}) {
 48    const response = await fetch(url, {
 49      method: "POST",
 50      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...headers },
 51      body: JSON.stringify(body),
 52    });
 53    const text = await response.text();
 54    let json;
 55    try {
 56      json = JSON.parse(text);
 57    } catch {
 58      json = { raw: text };
 59    }
 60    return { ok: response.ok, status: response.status, json };
 61  }
 62  
 63  /** Signs in, creating the account first if it does not exist yet. */
 64  async function signInOrSignUp(email, password) {
 65    let result = await postJson(`${IDENTITY}:signInWithPassword?key=${API_KEY}`, {
 66      email,
 67      password,
 68      returnSecureToken: true,
 69    });
 70  
 71    if (result.ok) return result.json;
 72  
 73    const code = result.json?.error?.message ?? "";
 74    if (code === "CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND") {
 75      fail(
 76        "Firebase Authentication has never been initialised on this project.\n" +
 77          "  Open the console, go to Authentication, click Get started, and enable the\n" +
 78          "  Email/Password provider. Then re-run this script.\n" +
 79          `  https://console.firebase.google.com/project/${PROJECT_ID}/authentication/providers`
 80      );
 81    }
 82  
 83    if (code !== "EMAIL_NOT_FOUND" && code !== "INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS") {
 84      fail(`Could not sign in as ${email}: ${code || JSON.stringify(result.json)}`);
 85    }
 86  
 87    console.log(`  no account for ${email} yet, creating it`);
 88    result = await postJson(`${IDENTITY}:signUp?key=${API_KEY}`, {
 89      email,
 90      password,
 91      returnSecureToken: true,
 92    });
 93  
 94    if (!result.ok) {
 95      const signUpCode = result.json?.error?.message ?? "";
 96      if (signUpCode === "OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED") {
 97        fail(
 98          "The Email/Password provider is not enabled on this project.\n" +
 99            `  https://console.firebase.google.com/project/${PROJECT_ID}/authentication/providers`
100        );
101      }
102      fail(`Could not create ${email}: ${signUpCode || JSON.stringify(result.json)}`);
103    }
104  
105    return result.json;
106  }
107  
108  /** Re-exchanges a refresh token so newly granted custom claims land in the ID token. */
109  async function refreshIdToken(refreshToken) {
110    const response = await fetch(`${SECURE_TOKEN}?key=${API_KEY}`, {
111      method: "POST",
112      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
113      body: new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: "refresh_token", refresh_token: refreshToken }),
114    });
115    if (!response.ok) fail(`Token refresh failed: ${await response.text()}`);
116    return response.json();
117  }
118  
119  function readClaims(idToken) {
120    const payload = idToken.split(".")[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
121    return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, "base64").toString("utf8"));
122  }
123  
124  async function main() {
125    const adminEmail = arg("admin-email", "NUTRADE_ADMIN_EMAIL");
126    const adminPassword = arg("admin-password", "NUTRADE_ADMIN_PASSWORD");
127    const bootstrapSecret = arg("bootstrap-secret", "NUTRADE_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET");
128    const seedPassword = arg("seed-password", "NUTRADE_SEED_PASSWORD") ?? adminPassword;
129    const endsInMinutesRaw = arg("ends-in-minutes", "NUTRADE_SEED_ENDS_IN_MINUTES");
130  
131    if (!adminEmail || !adminPassword || !bootstrapSecret) {
132      fail(
133        "Missing arguments. Required:\n" +
134          "    --admin-email       the account to promote to admin and seed from\n" +
135          "    --admin-password    its password (the account is created if absent)\n" +
136          "    --bootstrap-secret  the ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET value from Secret Manager\n" +
137          "  Optional:\n" +
138          "    --seed-password     password for the five seeded student accounts\n" +
139          "    --ends-in-minutes   override every auction's end time; pass a negative value\n" +
140          "                        to seed already-ended auctions and watch\n" +
141          "                        closeExpiredAuctions settle them on its next 5-min run"
142      );
143    }
144  
145    let endsInMinutes;
146    if (endsInMinutesRaw !== undefined) {
147      endsInMinutes = Number(endsInMinutesRaw);
148      if (!Number.isFinite(endsInMinutes)) fail("--ends-in-minutes must be a number.");
149    }
150  
151    if (seedPassword.length < 8) fail("The seed password must be at least 8 characters.");
152  
153    console.log(`\nSeeding ${PROJECT_ID}\n`);
154  
155    console.log("1. signing in as the admin account");
156    const session = await signInOrSignUp(adminEmail, adminPassword);
157    console.log(`   uid ${session.localId}`);
158  
159    console.log("2. granting the admin claim via bootstrapAdmin");
160    const bootstrap = await postJson(
161      fnUrl("bootstrapAdmin"),
162      { email: adminEmail },
163      { "X-Bootstrap-Secret": bootstrapSecret }
164    );
165    if (!bootstrap.ok) {
166      fail(
167        bootstrap.status === 401
168          ? "bootstrapAdmin rejected the secret. Check the value in Secret Manager."
169          : `bootstrapAdmin failed (${bootstrap.status}): ${JSON.stringify(bootstrap.json)}`
170      );
171    }
172    console.log("   role=admin verified=true");
173  
174    console.log("3. refreshing the ID token so the new claims take effect");
175    const refreshed = await refreshIdToken(session.refreshToken);
176    const claims = readClaims(refreshed.id_token);
177    if (claims.role !== "admin") {
178      fail(`The refreshed token still has no admin claim (role=${claims.role}). Try re-running.`);
179    }
180  
181    console.log("4. calling seedDevData");
182    const payload = { password: seedPassword };
183    if (endsInMinutes !== undefined) {
184      payload.endsInMinutes = endsInMinutes;
185      console.log(`   overriding every auction end time to now ${endsInMinutes >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${endsInMinutes} min`);
186    }
187    const seeded = await postJson(
188      fnUrl("seedDevData"),
189      { data: payload },
190      { Authorization: `Bearer ${refreshed.id_token}` }
191    );
192  
193    if (!seeded.ok || seeded.json?.error) {
194      fail(`seedDevData failed: ${JSON.stringify(seeded.json?.error ?? seeded.json)}`);
195    }
196  
197    const result = seeded.json.result;
198    console.log(`\nSeeded ${result.listings.length} live auctions and ${result.accounts.length} student accounts.\n`);
199    console.log("  Sign in to the app as any of these (password = your --seed-password):");
200    for (const account of result.accounts) {
201      console.log(`    ${account.email.padEnd(32)} ${account.displayName}`);
202    }
203    console.log(`\n  Listings: ${result.listings.join(", ")}`);
204    console.log(
205      "\n  Note: seeded students are pre-verified. A real signup stays unverified\n" +
206        "  until the student enters the six-digit code emailed to them.\n"
207    );
208  }
209  
210  main().catch((err) => fail(err?.stack ?? String(err)));
```

```html
 1  <!doctype html>

 3  <head>
 4  <meta charset="utf-8">
 5  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
 6  <title>Payment cancelled · NUTrade</title>
 7  <style>
 8    :root { --navy:#1C2C58; --gold:#E8A317; --ink:#41496A; --bg:#F4F6FB; --card:#FFFFFF; }
 9    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
10      :root { --bg:#0E1630; --card:#17224A; --ink:#C4CCE6; }
11    }
12    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
13    body {
14      margin:0; min-height:100dvh; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:24px;
15      background:var(--bg); color:var(--navy);
16      font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
17    }
18    .card {
19      background:var(--card); border-radius:20px; padding:36px 28px; max-width:400px; width:100%;
20      text-align:center; box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(28,44,88,.10);
21    }
22    .tick {
23      width:64px; height:64px; margin:0 auto 20px; border-radius:50%;
24      background:#FEECEC; display:grid; place-items:center;
25    }
26    .tick svg { width:30px; height:30px; }
27    h1 { margin:0 0 10px; font-size:22px; }
28    p { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink); }
29    .ref {
30      display:inline-block; margin-top:18px; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
31      background:rgba(232,163,23,.14); color:var(--gold); font-weight:700;
32      font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.04em;

40        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="3"
41             stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
42      </div>
43      <h1>Payment cancelled</h1>
44      <p>Nothing was charged.</p>
45      <p>Your bid is still reserved until the payment window closes — reopen NUTrade to try again.</p>
46      <span class="ref" id="ref" hidden></span>
47      <p class="hint">You can close this tab.</p>
48    </main>
49  <script>
50    // PayMongo appends the order reference we handed it, so the student can quote it.
51    var ref = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("ref");
52    if (ref) { var el = document.getElementById("ref"); el.textContent = ref; el.hidden = false; }
53  </script>
54  </body>
55  </html>
```
